# Thebes Stage 4: Monuments and a Grander City Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Monuments and a grander city (spec 10, stage 4): seven monuments rising course by course with blocks, ramp, sleds and gangs, casing, the gilded tip and the gold capstone; the builders' guild, quarry and brickworks, crews, stone and bricks delivered to sites and bridged by storehouses, idling with no wages, Memphis's stone; monuments as the late-game gold sink (founding, work gold, gilding, capstone, never below 0) with the Monuments spending row and the capital run's band; prestige measured from state, the pyramids' prestige unlocks and the mood row; score v2 with the Monuments part, medals at 200, 300 and 400, the two new splits, the `t2` link and version-aware history; the Monuments tab, the honest site sheet and the supply buildings' sheets, the summary's Monuments section and Welcome back's site lines; big footprints on phones (the camera fit at the pick, Ground's room, monument chips, rotation, seeing behind); the Monuments goals, firsts, achievements, feats, daily goals, tips and remarks; festival and dedication processions, plazas and sphinxes, supply buildings with visible work, a title backdrop with a monument going up; the Motion setting (Full, Gentle, Still) and ambient life a notch more visible; the picture cards and the reworded opening goals; Web Audio music; the palace in five styles; the papyrus-and-lapis interface look; problem markers pinned to their buildings; world version 5.

**Architecture:** One contract track lands first: Track 0, four tasks on `stage-4-monuments`, gives world version 5 and its migration, all of Stage 4's data, the costs, every new module with its final names and signatures (stubs that return safe defaults, and complete versions of the pure rules more than one track reads: prestige, desirability by state, the palace, the site's sheet facts from state, the monthly roll, the stall warnings, the prestige unlocks, plazas, the `t2` link, the Motion setting's shape), and every seam two tracks share, wired once. Eight tracks then run in their own worktrees, at most five agents at once, each owning its own files: A the monuments sim, supply chain and palace sim; B art; C interface; D score v2 and gamification; E motion and the moving grand city; G picture cards and music; H the interface look. The controller merges them onto `stage-4-monuments` in the order A, B, C, D, E, G, H, running the full suite after each, and then does Track F (balance and integration) itself. Ruling 282 (the controller's) sets the eight tracks and wins where ruling 279 differs.

**Tech Stack:** HTML + CSS + JavaScript ES modules, Canvas 2D, Web Audio, the in-house test harness in headless Edge (`tests/run-tests.ps1`), `tests/serve.py`, PowerShell tools (`tools/sw-files.ps1`, `tools/shots.ps1 -Stage4`, `tools/contact.py --stage4`, and Track G's new `tools/tutorial.ps1`).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-thebes-design.md` as revised for Stage 4 (main `6342176`): sections 2, 3, 4.1, 4.4, 4.5, 4.7-4.17, 4.19, 4.20, 5.1, 5.4-5.7, 6.3-6.6, 6.8, 6.9, 7.2, 7.3, 7.5, 9 and 10; rulings 178-281 in `docs/superpowers/notes/handoff-2026-10-11/rulings-so-far.md` part 9, and the controller's ruling 282 (the tracks). Background: `docs/superpowers/notes/2026-10-12-stage-4-review.md` (sections 3-7 and 10).

**Out of scope** (Stage 5 or later, spec 3 and 10): missions, ruler requests and grave goods; progress while the game is closed; separate stonemasons', bricklayers' and carpenters' guilds and work camps; the sphinx, sun temple and mausoleum as monument kinds; bent pyramids, pyramid complexes, burial chambers; collapse and architects; plague, floods and river seasons; scribes; temple complexes, pleasure gardens, a quay and river trade, a day-night cycle; recorded music; choosing which guild works which site; global leaderboards and checked scores.

## Global Constraints

- No build step, no npm, no frameworks, no third-party code. Plain ES modules, plain CSS in `css/ui.css`. Nothing downloaded at run time: no images or fonts for the look (CSS and inline SVG only, spec 6.9), no audio files for the music (Web Audio, spec 5.5). Targets: iOS Safari 16+, current Android Chrome, desktop Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari.
- The sim stays deterministic: no wall clock, no `Math.random`, no storage or DOM in `src/sim`. All randomness is a stateless `hash2` draw keyed by building id and day, or by an index, with the world's seed and a salt. Every site's state (courses, laid units, stockpile, carried gold, idle days, last month) and the palace's style and works live on their buildings, so saving and loading mid-course changes nothing. Path, reach and coverage caches live outside the world. The music's seeded bars are the interface's and never touch the sim's draws.
- The UI changes the world only through sim functions: the Stage 1-3 commands, and this stage's `place(world, type, x, y, { rot, roadLater })`, `setPaused` on a site, `paintPlazaTiles`, `enlargePalace` and `undo` (which refuses a site once work has begun).
- `WORLD_VERSION` goes from 4 to 5 in Task 0.1 with a migration; nothing else changes the save's top-level shape. A track that needs another world field asks the controller for a contract change and never adds one alone. Inside the contract's records (a building's `b.site`, `stats.lastMonth`, `feats.counters`) the owning track may add fields, documented in its module's header, never remove or retype one.
- No upgrade lowers capacity or tax per tile; no arbitrage (no partner buys stone or bricks). The 10-year village's 60-70% band is unchanged (ruling 193).
- Spec 6.1 binds every new control and row: real buttons with labels, 44 px targets, 4.5:1 text, nothing over the middle of the map, one panel at a time, Back closes one step, meaning never by colour alone. The phone height budget (spec 6.3) holds, with the new "pyramid" placing scene (ruling 252). `tests/ui/mobileBudget.test.js` passes on every UI merge.
- **Motion (spec 5.4).** Every moving thing asks `settings.motionLevel()` ('full' | 'gentle' | 'still'), never the device directly. Gentle allows walkers, units, sleds, gangs and processions along their paths and fades in place; no sway, drift, rising, pulses, bursts, rare life, shine or camera moves; the interface's own transitions are instant under Gentle as under Still (ruling 247). Under 3 flashes a second, nothing pulses longer than 5 s, ambient changes at most once a second. Every visual review shoots Full and Gentle (ruling 220).
- **Words in the interface must match what the sim does.** Every line that states a rule (a site's pace, a stall's cause, a chip's "No builders' guild near", a locked card's count, "Enlarge to a columned hall: 600 gold", a confirm bar's "+32 Monuments when finished") is computed from the sim's own function, and a test sets the world up both ways and checks the words follow the function. Every site-sheet row gets a words-against-sim test (ruling 252).
- Copy: plain English, sentence case; every player-facing string lives in `src/ui/text.js`, inside the track's own section; "Pharaoh" never appears, and nothing names or hints at an employer anywhere (code, comments, commits, notes). the controller's employer-name `git grep -n -i` check before every commit must print nothing (the word itself is never written in the repo).
- Commit identity for this repo only: `Joshua Hedge <181878008+joshuahedge@users.noreply.github.com>` (check `git config --local user.email`; worktrees share it). Every commit message ends with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- LF line endings, UTF-8 without BOM.
- **Never push.** A push to `main` deploys the live site; the controller merges locally and Josh publishes.
- **Branches and worktrees.** Track 0 runs on `stage-4-monuments` in `C:\dev\thebes`. Each of Tracks A-E, G and H works in its own worktree `C:\dev\thebes-s4-<track>` on the branch `s4-<track>`, cut from the Track 0 commit (`<track>` is `sim`, `art`, `ui`, `score`, `motion`, `cards` or `look`):
  `git -C C:\dev\thebes worktree add C:\dev\thebes-s4-sim -b s4-sim <track-0-commit>`. Run every command from the worktree's root; `tests/run-tests.ps1` and `tools/shots.ps1` serve the folder they sit in. Track F runs on `stage-4-monuments` in `C:\dev\thebes` after the merges. At most five track agents at once (A, B, C, D, E first; G and H as slots free up, or G and H early and E later: the controller's call).
- **Tests.** Every Stage 4 `describe` name starts with its track's prefix: `s4 contract`, `s4 sim`, `s4 art`, `s4 ui`, `s4 score`, `s4 motion`, `s4 cards`, `s4 look` or `s4 balance`. New test files go in `tests/stage4/<track>/` and are imported only from `tests/stage4/<track>.all.js`; nobody edits `tests/all.js` after Track 0. While iterating, run the track alone: `-Grep "s4 <track>" -WaitSeconds 150`. Before each commit: `tools/sw-files.ps1`, then the full suite with `-WaitSeconds 150`, ending `ALL PASSED`.
- **Headless Edge reports `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.** Under Stage 4 that makes "follow the device" mean **Gentle**. A test of Full motion must force it (`createSettings({ ..., systemReducedMotion: () => false })`, or `settings.set({ motion: 'full' })`); a test of Gentle or Still sets that level. Never let a test depend on the machine's setting.
- `sw-files.js` is regenerated, never hand-edited. On a merge conflict in it, take either side, run `tools/sw-files.ps1`, run the full suite, commit. Track G's `assets/tutorial/*` files must be in it (the PWA test checks every file the game needs).
- Timing assertions flake under load (`longrun` < 3000 ms, `capital` < 5000 ms, the stress frame, the desirability preview, and from Stage 4 the 1 ms monument budget and the music's scheduler). Stagger full runs across worktrees (14 logical CPUs; one full run at a time is safest); rerun a timing failure once before investigating it. If the suite times out, check `Get-Process python*` for CPU-heavy strays (idle `http.server` processes on ports 8731/8765 belong to other sessions: leave them).
- Shared files follow the ownership table in the contract: a track edits only the files and sections it owns, and the seams Track 0 made are the only way into the others.
- **Catching up before the last task.** Tracks merge in the order A, B, C, D, E, G, H. Before its last task, a track merges `stage-4-monuments` (which then holds the tracks merged before it) into its branch and runs the full suite, so its merge is clean and its cross-track checks meet the real thing: B's gangs and C's sheets against A's real crews and stalls; D's goals and feats against A's courses; E's dedication procession against A's `monument_done`; G's raid mood against real raids (Stage 3). Until then a track's tests set the other tracks' state by hand to the contract's shapes (a `b.site` with `course`, `crews`, `idle`, `reason`; a palace's `style` and `works`) and never assert a STUB's default.
- **Screenshots.** `tools/shots.ps1 -Stage4` and `tools/contact.py --stage4` (the infrastructure merged at `f90fcb4`) shoot the dev scenes `title`, `tutorial`, `site`, `pyramid`, `capstone`, `procession`, `palace`, `sitesheet`, `motion` under Full and reduced motion. A scene's `S4-TODO` names what its Stage 4 version must show; the track that makes the thing fills its scene (B: `site`, `pyramid`, `capstone`; E: `procession`, `motion` and `setMotion`; C: `sitesheet`, `palace`; G: `tutorial`; F: `title`). The integrator looks at every contact sheet.

## Conventions every task relies on

- Tests use `describe`/`it`/`expect` from `tests/harness.js` (`toBe`, `toEqual`, `toBeTruthy`, `toBeFalsy`, `toBeGreaterThan`, `toBeGreaterThanOrEqual`, `toBeLessThan`, `toBeLessThanOrEqual`, `toContain`, `toThrow`; there is no `.not` and no `toBeCloseTo`). Always clean up in `try/finally`: a test that throws before its cleanup leaves a mounted shell that breaks every later UI test.
- Sim fixtures: `makeTestWorld({ size, fertile, gold, raiderEntries })` (desert, fertile land at x < 8), `setRoad`, `addRaw` (bypasses every check, so a monument can sit on fields, a site can be set by hand: `Object.assign(addRaw(w, 'colossus', 12, 8).site, { course: 2, crews: [g.id] })`), `staffAll` (`tests/helpers/testWorld.js`). UI fixtures: `rigUI({ width, height, hooks, welcome, sfx, clock, now, world, settings })`, `mountShell`, `fakeHistory`, `fakeDoc` (`tests/helpers/uiWorld.js`); `mount`, `fire`, `key` (`tests/helpers/dom.js`); `makeCanvas` (`tests/helpers/canvas.js`); `contrastIn` (`tests/helpers/contrast.js`).
- A test can reach the rigged game's interfaces as `r.ui.danger`, `r.ui.scoreUi` and (Stage 4) `r.ui.monumentUi`; replacing one of their functions in a test (`r.ui.monumentUi.pickFit = ...`, `r.ui.monumentUi.sheetParts.building = ...`, `r.ui.placement.rotate = ...`) is how another track's behaviour is stood in for.
- Sim events are plain objects pushed into the optional `events` array; the sim never reads it.
- **STUBs.** A function whose comment starts `STUB.` returns a safe default until its track replaces the body in place, keeping its signature and the contract its comment states (add detail to the comment, never contradict it). Functions marked "complete" are owned by the named track afterwards, which may refine but never change their behaviour without the controller.
- **Data and its words land together** (`houseSheetEconomy.test.js`, the celebrate, tips and goals tests check that firsts, achievements, daily goals, tips and chapters have words).
- **Words.** A track keeps its words in its own section of `src/ui/text.js` as its own exported object (`SIM4_TEXT`, `ART4_TEXT`, `UI4_TEXT`, `SCORE4_TEXT`, `MOTION4_TEXT`, `CARDS4_TEXT`, `LOOK4_TEXT`, `BALANCE4_TEXT`) and adds to the shared tables only with `Object.assign(...)` inside its own section. **text.js is one module: namespace everything** (Stage 3 ruling 5): every top-level name a section declares or imports carries its track's prefix (`sim4`, `art4`, `ui4`, `score4`, `motion4`, `cards4`, `look4`, `balance4`); grep the whole file for a new name before committing.
- **Styles.** Each track's rules go in its own `/* ── s4 <name> ── */` section at the end of `css/ui.css`, just above the end marker; Track H owns the base (below).

### World version 5

`createWorld` adds one field (in `REQUIRED`, checked by `validateWorld`):

| Field | Default | Shape and meaning | Writer |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prestigeUnlocks` | `{ pyramid_small: null, pyramid_great: null }` (`newPrestigeUnlocks()`) | monument type -> the day the city first had its milestone and its prestige together (`MONUMENTS[k].unlock`), or null; it stays once set (ruling 243) | `updatePrestigeUnlocks` (contract; A) |

Every building gains `rot: 0` (0, or 1 for a type that `rotates`: its `w` and `d` are swapped, `dimsOf(type, rot)`). A monument gains `b.site` (`newSite()`); the palace gains `b.style` (0-4, `PALACE_STYLES` index) and `b.works` (null, or `{ style, left }`: the style being built and the game days to go).

The site (`b.site`, written only by Track A's `monumentDay` and `monumentMonth`; read by everyone):

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `course` | courses finished, 0 .. the kind's courses |
| `laid` | `{ stone, bricks }`: units laid on the course under way (fractions allowed: a full crew lays 2/3 a day) |
| `stock` | `{ stone, bricks }`: units on site (fractions allowed) |
| `carry` | work gold owed and not yet paid, 0 <= carry < 1 (ruling 240) |
| `extraPaid` | the gilding or the capstone has been paid (false for a kind with none) |
| `crews` | the builders' guild ids at work today, in the order they took it |
| `idle` | days in a row with no work while unpaused, unfinished and on a road (stalled at `MONUMENT.stallDays`) |
| `reason` | the cause of the last day without work (the reason codes below), or null after a day of work |
| `month` | `{ units, gold, crews, crewDays, starvedDays }`: this month so far (gold: work, gilding and capstone; crews: the most at work on one day; starvedDays: crew-days idle for lack of material) |
| `last` | last month's `{ units, gold, crews }`, or null before the site's first month end |
| `starved` | any month of its build had a crew idle for lack of material (the Steady hands feat) |
| `done` | the day it was finished, or null |

Tallies (`STAGE4_TALLY`, all in `TALLY_KEYS`, all start at 0): `stoneLaid`, `bricksLaid`, `stoneDelivered`, `bricksDelivered` (by a quarry, a brickworks or a site's draw from a storehouse), `courses`, `monumentsDone`, `enlargements` (palace enlargements paid).

Splits: `world.splits` holds score v2's seven (`SPLITS`): the five milestones (`updateMilestone`), `pyramids` (the day `prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small` was set) and `great_pyramid` (the day the first great pyramid was finished; `updatePrestigeUnlocks` records it from state).

History: each month-end row is `{ day, people, gold, mood, score, parts, version }` (`scoreRow`); `MIGRATIONS[4]` marks every row of a version 4 save that has a score `version: 1` (its parts are v1's four).

Last month (`stats.lastMonth`, `monthlyEconomy`): gains `monuments` (0 there; `monumentMonth` sets the month's monument gold: work, gilding, capstone; it is **not** in `net`, which it never was, because it was paid daily).

`MIGRATIONS[4]` (v4 -> v5): every building `rot: 0`; `prestigeUnlocks` empty; the Stage 4 tallies at 0; scored history rows `version: 1`; the Stage 4 build items the city's milestone has unlocked (`STAGE4_ITEMS`) join `newItems` once each (ruling 253); `stats` and everything else kept. The device's settings move to Motion in `src/ui/settings.js` (not in the world).

### Data

- `src/data/monuments.js`: `MONUMENT_KINDS` (`obelisk_small`, `obelisk_large`, `colossus`, `mastaba_small`, `mastaba_large`, `pyramid_small`, `pyramid_great`); `MONUMENTS[k]` `{ name, w, d, rotates, crews, crewMonths, courses: [{ stone, bricks }], founding, extra: null | { kind: 'gilding' | 'capstone', gold }, prestige: { courses, done }, desirability, unlock: { milestone[, prestige] } }` with the spec 4.16 numbers (courses' units add up to `crewMonths x 20`; the large mastaba's five courses are equal: contract note 4); `MATERIALS` `['stone', 'bricks']`; `MONUMENT` `{ unitsPerCrewMonth: 20, goldPerUnit: 5, crewReach: 12, producerReach: 12, supplyReach: 16, stockPerCrew: 40, stallDays: 3, demolishRefund: 0.25 }`; `SITE_DESIRABILITY` `[-3, -2, -1]`; `PRESTIGE` `{ moodPer: 70, moodMax: 10, scoreFull: 700 }`; `PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS` `['pyramid_small', 'pyramid_great']`; `MONUMENT_PLACING` `{ fitRadius: 16, bigArea: 9, silhouetteAlpha: 0.35, fadeBehind: 0.4 }`.
- `src/data/palace.js`: `PALACE_STYLES` (courtyard, columned, pylons, gilded, lapis: `{ id, milestone, price, days, desirability, mood }`, spec 4.20), `PALACE` `{ type: 'palace', lastStyle: 4 }`.
- `BUILDINGS` adds `builders_guild` (2x2, 150, upkeep 10, 16 workers, `monuments` priority, `reach: 12`), `quarry` (2x2, rocky, 100, 6, 10, stone 30 a month, producer reach 12), `brickworks` (2x2, 90, 6, 8, bricks 30 from clay), `plaza` (1x1, 8 a tile, Homes, no road), `sphinx` (1x1, 150, Homes, no road), `palace` (3x3, 300, Services, road, `palace: true`, `oneOnly: true`) and the seven monuments (`cost` = founding, no workers or upkeep, `category: 'monuments'`, `needsRoad: true`, `monument: true`, `rotates` for the mastabas). `dimsOf(type, rot)`. The storehouse stores stone and bricks.
- `GOODS` adds `stone` and `bricks` (`kind: 'material'`, `MATERIAL_GOODS`).
- `MILESTONES`: the palace with Town; guild, quarry, brickworks, both obelisks and the plaza with City; colossus, small mastaba and sphinx with Great city; large mastaba with Capital; the pyramids in no list (prestige). `CATEGORIES`: Homes ends `plaza`, `sphinx`; Services ends `palace`; Monuments is `builders_guild`, `quarry`, `brickworks`, then the seven. `toolForItem('plaza')` is `{ kind: 'plazas' }`. `AUTO_OVERLAY.quarry` is `'ground'` (C adds the monuments').
- `DESIRABILITY`: guild and brickworks as a workshop, quarry as the clay pit, plaza `[2, 1]`, sphinx `[10, 8, 6, 4, 2]`, palace its first style's, each monument its finished values; `FIRE_RISK`: quarry 0.15, brickworks 1.0, guild 0.3 (plazas, sphinxes, the palace and monuments are not listed: they never burn).
- `PARTNERS.memphis.sells.stone` `{ price: 6, quota: 200, from: 'city' }` (a good with `from` is listed only from that milestone: `tradePrices` filters, so caravans and the trade sheet follow).
- Score v2 (`src/data/scoring.js`): `SCORE_VERSION` 2; `SCORE_PARTS` five, `SCORE_PARTS_V1` four; `SCORE_WEIGHTS.monuments` `{ prestige: 100 }`; `SCORE_TERMS.prestigeFull` 700; `MEDALS` 200, 300, 400; `SPLIT_MILESTONES` (five, unchanged) and `SPLITS` (seven); `SHARE.format` `'t2'`, `SHARE.formats` `{ t1: { version 1, four parts, five splits }, t2: { version 2, five parts, seven splits } }`.
- `STAGE4_MOOD_ROWS` (`src/data/mood.js`): `monuments`, `palace` (their numbers live in `PRESTIGE` and `PALACE_STYLES`).
- Settings (`src/ui/settings.js`): `motion` (`'system'` | `'full'` | `'gentle'` | `'still'`, default `'system'`), `music` (true), `musicVolume` (0-100 in tens, 30), `cardsSeen` (false); `reducedMotion` and `ambient` are gone (read-only mirrors remain on `get()` for Stage 3 readers until E retires them: contract note 9).
- Tips (`src/data/tips.js`): `TIPS` is `TIPS_BASE` then one list per track: C (the palace's), D (the Monuments tips), E (the Gentle tip), G, F.

### Costs (`src/sim/costs.js`)

`costOf(world, type)` as every building (a monument's founding, the palace, the plaza a tile); `workGoldPerUnit(world)` = 5 x the difficulty's cost, **not rounded** (the site pays whole gold and carries the fraction); `extraGoldOf(world, type)` (the gilding or capstone, rounded; 0 for others); `palacePriceOf(world, style)` (rounded; 0 for style 0); `canPayNoDebt(world, cost)` (true when paying keeps the treasury at 0 or above: founding, work gold, gilding, capstone, enlarging). Upkeep and wages are never scaled.

### Sim modules

Complete in Track 0 (the owner may refine, never change the behaviour):
- `src/sim/prestige.js` (A; re-exported by `monuments.js`): `prestigeOfBuilding(b)` (floor(courses share x done / courses) + the completion share once finished), `prestigeByKind(world)` (`{ kind: { prestige, id } }`, the most advanced standing one of each kind; ties keep the lower id), `prestigeOf(world)`, `holdsPrestige(world, b)`, `monumentMood(world)` (+1 per 70, at most 10), `monumentsPart(prestige)` (round(100 x sqrt(p / 700)), at most 100).
- `src/sim/monuments.js` (A): `courseOf(b)`, `siteProgress(b)` (`{ course, courses, inCourse, done }`), `remainingNeed(b)`, `stockRoom(b)` (ruling 238), `paceOf(world, b)` (days left at last month's pace, or null), `crewsFor(world, b)` (`{ guilds: site.crews, max }`), `supplyNear(world, probe, good)`, `monumentMonth(world, events)` (the monthly roll: `month` -> `last`, `starved`, `stats.lastMonth.monuments`), `monumentAlerts(world)` (`{ code: 'site_stalled', id, reason }` for each unpaused, unfinished, road-touching site idle `MONUMENT.stallDays` or more), `updatePrestigeUnlocks(world, events)` (the unlock days, `newItems`, the two splits, `prestige_unlock` events), `guildSite(world, g)` (the site whose crews hold the guild, or null).
- `src/sim/palace.js` (A): `palaceOf(world)`, `palaceQuote(world, id)` (`{ next, price, days, milestone, ok, reason }`, reasons `not_palace`, `works`, `last_style`, `locked`, `no_road`, `no_gold`), `enlargePalace(world, id)` (pays, starts the works, counts `tally.enlargements`, pushes no undo), `palaceDay(world, events)` (the works count down; `palace_done`), `palaceMood(world)` (the style's mood while a road touches it).
- `src/sim/desirability.js` (A): `valuesOf(b)` (a home by tier; a site `SITE_DESIRABILITY`; a finished monument its kind's; the palace its style's), `givesDesirability(world, b)` (a road, except a finished monument); the field's signature includes a palace's style and a monument's finish; `desirabilityPreview(world, type, x, y, { rot, site })`.
- `src/sim/score.js` (D): the Monuments part's value (its reason `{ code: 'prestige', prestige }` is a STUB for D's next-step reasons), `splitMonths` over `SPLITS`, `scoreRow`'s `version`.
- `src/ui/share.js` (D): `shareLink` writes `t2` (five parts, seven splits); `parseShareLink` reads `t1` and `t2` and returns `version` and `older`.
- `src/sim/progression.js` (contract): `isUnlocked` reads `prestigeUnlocks` for the pyramids.
- `src/sim/trade.js` (A): `tradePrices` lists a good with `from` only from that milestone.

### Commands (spec 7.3)

| Command | Module | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `place(world, type, x, y, { rot, roadLater })` | commands.js (complete) | as before; `rot` 1 turns a type that `rotates`; a monument is founded as a site; refuses `not_on_fields` (a fertile tile), `locked` (incl. a pyramid's prestige), `one_only` (a second palace), `no_gold` (a monument's founding below 0; others below -500) |
| `canPlace`, `conditionsFor` (same options) | commands.js (complete) | a monument's conditions are `ground` (with `fertile`, `of`), `road`, then once a road touches it `crew` (`n`, reason `no_crew`) and `supply` (`good`, reason `no_stone` / `no_bricks`), both `later`, then `gold` (with `floor: 0`); canPlace's warnings carry the same reasons |
| `setPaused(world, id, paused)` | commands.js (complete) | a site pauses like any building; a finished monument refuses `finished` |
| `undo(world)` | undo.js (complete) | a site's placing once work has begun (`course > 0` or anything laid) refuses `{ ok: false, reason: 'work_begun', id, type }` and drops the step; undoing a monument's demolish puts its courses and stock back and takes the refund back |
| `demolishAt`, `demolishTiles` | unchanged | a monument's refund is a quarter of its founding (as any building's) |
| `previewPlazaTiles(world, list)`, `paintPlazaTiles(world, list)` | commands.js (complete) | `{ ok, reason, warnings, positions, cost, skipped }` / `+ ids`; refuses `locked` (before City), `nothing_to_place`, `no_gold` (below -500); one undo step |
| `enlargePalace(world, id)` | palace.js (complete) | `{ ok, warnings, style, price, days }` or `palaceQuote`'s reason; not undoable |

### Events

| Event | Pushed by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `{ type: 'course_done', id, type: kind, course, prestige }` | A | a course was laid; `course` the courses now done; `prestige` what it added (ruling 242) |
| `{ type: 'monument_done', id, type: kind, prestige }` | A | finished; `prestige` the completion share it added (0 for a second of a kind) |
| `{ type: 'site_stalled', id, type: kind, reason }` | A | the day a site reaches `MONUMENT.stallDays` without work |
| `{ type: 'prestige_unlock', id: kind, day }` | contract (`updatePrestigeUnlocks`) | a pyramid's prestige unlock reached |
| `{ type: 'palace_done', id, style }` | contract (`palaceDay`) | the palace's works ended |

D's captions (course laid, monument finished, milestone tier) and firsts read these; E's dedication procession starts on `monument_done` (or from state: a monument whose `site.done` is within the last 30 days, so a reload shows it).

### Alerts and words

`alertsFor` appends `monumentAlerts` (`site_stalled`, a **warning**: badge, list row, marker; never a critical, ruling 211). A road-less site has the existing `no_road` warning; a paused one none. Who words what: **C** words every Stage 4 interface string, including `ALERT_TEXT.site_stalled` (its cause and fix by reason, the same phrases as the sheet's), the chips, the sheets, the summary and Welcome back; **A** words only the `REASONS` its commands return (`not_on_fields` "Monuments stand on the desert, not the fields", `one_only`, `work_begun` with the site's name, `finished`, the palace's quote reasons); **D** words goals, firsts, achievements, feats, daily goals, tips' text, captions, remarks and the score; **E** the Motion row and the Gentle tip; **G** the cards, How to play and Music rows. The mood rows' names (`MOOD_NAMES.monuments`, `.palace`) are Track 0's.

### Render

- `renderFrame` takes `opts.live(g, o)`: for an object whose art entry has `live: true` (the seven monuments) it is called in the depth-sorted pass, in art px with the art origin set, with `o.b` the building; such slots never go through the sprite cache. Without `opts.live` the renderer falls back to the slot's sprite. `stats.live` counts them. `createUI` passes `live: (g, o) => drawMonument(g, world, o.b, { now, timeDays, motion: motionLevel(), ghost: { type, x, y, w, d } | null, selectedId })`; the title backdrop passes the same (still).
- The problem markers: `createUI` computes `markerLayout = layoutMarkers(world, alerts, cam, view)` each frame before drawing and draws `drawMarkers(g, world, alerts, range, markerLayout)` in the overlay pass in place of `drawProblemMarkers`.
- Art slots (`src/render/art/stage4.js`, placeholders B replaces, keeping names and footprints): `builders_guild`, `quarry`, `brickworks`, `plaza`, `sphinx`, `palace`, `palace.s0`-`palace.s4` (`slotFor` reads `b.style`), the seven monuments (`live: true`; their `draw` serves the card thumbnail and the fallback).

### Interface

- `createUI` makes `monumentUi = createMonumentUi(seamCtx)` after `danger` and `scoreUi`; it joins `seams()` (events, refresh, alert actions, commands, destroy), its `sheets` join the custom sheets and its `sheetParts` the parts list (after the score's and the danger's).
- `pick(item)`: once a monument's ghost lands, `monumentUi.pickFit(type, ghost, placingInsets)` may return `{ zoom, extent }`; the camera then keeps the ghost in view at that zoom (`cameraControl.keepVisible(..., extent, zoom)`: never past the least zoom; an instant cut under Gentle and Still because the camera follows `settings.reducedMotion()`).
- A tap outside a tool asks `markerAt(markerLayout, x, y)` first: a hit goes to `monumentUi.markerTap(marker)`, else selects `marker.ids[0]`; only then is the building under the tap picked.
- R (`keyActions.rotate`) calls `placement.rotate()` when Track C gives the placement one (`tool.rot` 0/1 is C's to keep in the store's tool).
- `settings.motionLevel()` and `r.ui.motionLevel()` give the level; `settings.reducedMotion()` stays "anything but Full" for Stage 1-3 code (Gentle behaves as Still until E gives it its own variants). `createAmbient`'s `enabled` is Full only until E.
- Boot (spec 4.1, 5.5): one `music = createMusic({ enabled: settings.music, volume: musicVolume / 100, seed: the city's (or the title city's), mood: musicMood(the city on screen) })` for the page: `unlock()` on pointerdown, pointerup and keydown until true; `stop()` when hidden, `start()` when shown; `refresh()` on every settings change; `tick(now)` from the title's and the game's loops; `destroy()` with the page. "Play with sound" / "Play muted" sets both `sound` and `music` (ruling 269). New city, Start new city and This week's Nile show the picture cards first while `cardsSeen` is false, then set it and start the city; `hooks.pictureCards(onDone)` shows them any time (G's How to play buttons call it; createUI passes `hooks` in `seamCtx`).
- Settings sheet: one Motion choice row (`.choice.motion`, `system`/`full`/`gentle`/`still`, words `CONTRACT4_TEXT` until E words it "Motion: Gentle (your device asks for less motion)"); G adds Music On / Off and its volume (44 px buttons).
- The plaza card starts `{ kind: 'plazas' }`, an area tool drawn like plots (touch plan, mouse rectangle, one ✓, one Undo step) through `previewPlazaTiles` / `paintPlazaTiles`; C words its bar.

### Shared files

- `src/ui/text.js`: after the Stage 3 sections, one section per Stage 4 track in the order contract, sim, art, ui, score, motion, cards, look, balance, each between `// ── s4 <name> (Track X) ──` and `// ── end s4 <name> ──`, with three stable separator lines between sections, each declaring its own `…4_TEXT` object. Names carry the track's prefix.
- `css/ui.css`: the same order of `/* ── s4 <name> (Track X) ── */` sections at the end. **Track H owns the base** (everything above the first `/* ── s3` marker: the `:root` tokens and the Stage 1-2 rules) and its `s4 look` section; it restyles there (papyrus tones, the frieze, cartouche headings, gold-on-lapis `button.primary`, the serif stack as a token, ornaments as CSS data-URI SVG) and never edits an s3 or s4 section. Every other track writes only in its own section, uses the tokens (`var(--...)`), prefixes any custom property it adds (`--s4c-...`), and asks the controller when a base rule must change. Category tints stay as they are (they carry meaning).
- `src/data/tips.js`: one list per track (`TIPS_S4_UI`, `TIPS_S4_SCORE`, `TIPS_S4_MOTION`, `TIPS_S4_CARDS`, `TIPS_S4_BALANCE`) between `// ── s4 <name> ──` markers; `TIPS` concatenates them after `TIPS_BASE`.
- `tests/all.js` imports `tests/stage4/{contract,sim,art,ui,score,motion,cards,look,balance}.all.js`; each track edits only its own aggregator.
- `sw-files.js`: regenerated by every track; on conflict, regenerate.

## How to run tests

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/sw-files.ps1
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/run-tests.ps1 -WaitSeconds 150
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/run-tests.ps1 -Grep "s4 sim" -WaitSeconds 150
```

Expected at the end of every task: `ALL PASSED`. Run `tools/sw-files.ps1` after editing any cached file (`src/`, `css/`, `index.html`, `assets/`) and before a full run; `pwa.test.js` fails on a stale list. A full run takes 30-90 s; `-WaitSeconds 150` covers a loaded machine. If a run times out, check `Get-Process python*` for a CPU-heavy stray before rerunning. After Track 0 the suite is 1,426 tests.

## Tracks and tasks

Track 0 runs first, alone, on `stage-4-monuments`. Then the tracks run in their worktrees (at most five agents at once); each keeps its own ledger in its worktree's `.superpowers/sdd/<plan>/progress.md`, and the controller keeps the master ledger in `C:\dev\thebes`. The controller merges `s4-sim`, `s4-art`, `s4-ui`, `s4-score`, `s4-motion`, `s4-cards`, `s4-look` into `stage-4-monuments` in that order (`git merge --no-ff s4-<track>`), regenerating `sw-files.js` and running the full suite after each merge. Track F then runs on `stage-4-monuments`. Model hints: **sonnet** where the task's code is complete and the job is transcription; **opus** for art, judgement, and every task whose words must follow the sim.

## Contract notes

Places where the spec was ambiguous or the code disagreed, and what the contract chose. The controller rules on each before the worktrees are cut; until then the contract's choice stands.

1. **Score v2 lands in Track 0, not Track D.** Changing `SCORE_PARTS`, `MEDALS` and `SHARE` breaks every consumer at once, so Track 0 made the minimal consistent switch: `scoreOf` computes the Monuments part's value (its reason is a STUB `{ code: 'prestige', prestige }`), `splitMonths` and records use the seven `SPLITS`, `shareLink` writes `t2`, `parseShareLink` still reads `t1` (with `version` and `older`), history rows carry `version`. Pinned Stage 3 tests (score, records, share, title card, next threshold) were updated to v2 numbers. D's tasks start from there; `TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.partsLine` now lists only the parts a link has (one filter, so a `t1` friend shows four).
2. **The two new splits live in `world.splits`** under `pyramids` and `great_pyramid`; `SPLIT_MILESTONES` stays the five milestones (the summary's milestone rows), `SPLITS` is the seven (the link, records, `splitMonths`). The prestige unlock days live in the new `world.prestigeUnlocks` (the pyramids' cards read it through `isUnlocked`); `updatePrestigeUnlocks` runs daily in the tick, so the pyramids unlock the day a course takes prestige over 100 (if the city is already a Capital), not at a month end.
3. **Pure rules several tracks read are complete in Track 0:** prestige (incl. the Monuments part and mood), desirability by state (a site's dust only with a road, a finished monument's with none, the palace by style), the whole palace (quote, enlarge, works, mood), plazas, the site's facts from state (`siteProgress`, `remainingNeed`, `stockRoom`, `paceOf`, `crewsFor`, most of `siteStatus`), the monthly roll and `stats.lastMonth.monuments`, the stall warnings from state, `guildSite`, and Memphis's `from`. A owns them after. This lets B, C and D test against real rules before A merges.
4. **The large mastaba's courses are equal**: four brick courses of 960 and a stone course of 960 (3,840 bricks and 960 stone), so its "one course at 1x: 4 min" holds; the spec's "about 3,600 and 1,200" would make the top course a third longer. The small mastaba is 1,620 bricks and 540 stone (three of 540, then one). Every kind's units add up to crew-months x 20 (a data test). F may retune.
5. **"3x3 and up" for the 16-tile nearest fit** is read by area (`MONUMENT_PLACING.bigArea` 9): the 4x3 mastaba, both pyramids and the palace search 16 tiles; the 3x2 small mastaba keeps 10. Say if the small mastaba should search 16 too.
6. **A monument's crew and supply are placing warnings** (`no_crew`, `no_stone` / `no_bricks`) in `canPlace` as well as conditions in `conditionsFor` (once a road touches it), so the ghost's nearest fit prefers a spot near a guild and a quarry ("fewest later"). `guildsNear` does not yet check "with room for a crew" (A refines). Ruling 232 only spoke of road-later fits; if crew and supply should not steer the fit, C's `nearestFit` can count only `needs_road`.
7. **Founding's gold** refuses below 0 only for monuments (`canPay` in commands.js); the palace's 300 to build goes to the -500 floor like any building (spec 4.20 only forbids its enlargements below 0). The gold condition of a monument carries `floor: 0` so C can word "Founding 1,000 gold: you have 640".
8. **Undo's `work_begun`** counts a course done or any unit laid; delivered stock alone does not (a site that only received stone can still be undone, refunding its founding; the stone is lost). It returns `{ ok: false, reason: 'work_begun', id, type }` so C can name the site; the step is dropped.
9. **The Motion setting replaces `reducedMotion` and `ambient` in `DEFAULT_SETTINGS`**, but `settings.set()` still reads the two old keys (ruling 249's mapping) and `get()` keeps them as non-enumerable read-only mirrors, because `src/dev/scenes.js` `setMotion` (the infra merge, marked S4-TODO for E) and its test `tests/dev/sampleCity.test.js` still use them. E retires both together. `reducedMotion()` now means "anything but Full", so until E every Stage 1-3 reduced-motion path treats Gentle as it treated reduced motion (the city looks Still under Gentle until E1).
10. **Headless Edge now runs "follow the device" as Gentle.** Tests that need Full set it. Stage 3's tests already force reduced motion off where they need motion; none changed meaning.
11. **The monuments interface is a Stage 3-style seam** (`createMonumentUi`, C) plus `pickFit` and `markerTap`, rather than a sheet router in createUI: C may route a monument's info sheet to its own kind inside `sheets.js`, which it owns.
12. **Problem markers:** B lays out and draws (`layoutMarkers`, `drawMarkers` in `render/markers.js`), C handles what a tap does (`markerTap`) and View's outline; the tap's hit test (`markerAt`, a 22 px reach round the badge and along the stem) is the contract's, so both test against the same rule. Stage 3's `drawProblemMarkers` stays in `overlays.js` for its tests; createUI no longer calls it directly.
13. **The live draw falls back to the placeholder sprite** when a caller passes no `opts.live` (a bare `renderFrame`, Stage 1-3 render tests). B keeps each monument slot's `draw` for thumbnails and that fallback; the game and the title backdrop always pass `live`.
14. **Supply buildings produce into storehouses until A** (no idle rule, no site delivery); a quarry in a Stage 4 test city fills storehouses with stone as any producer would. `supplyNeeded` is a STUB returning true.
15. **The storehouse stores stone and bricks from Track 0**, so its accept switches and the goods summary list them at once; the good's line reads "Stone: made by quarries; used by monument sites; bought from Memphis".
16. **Memphis lists stone only from City**, done in `tradePrices` (so caravans, the trade sheet and its rows follow); a Stage 4 trade test treats a good with `from` as not listed before its milestone.
17. **`stats.lastMonth.monuments` is not in `net`**: work gold, gilding and the capstone are paid daily as they happen, as trade was; the summary's spending row (C) and the capital run's share (F) add it explicitly.
18. **Who words what** (above): C words every Stage 4 interface string including `ALERT_TEXT.site_stalled`; A only its commands' `REASONS`; D the goals and rewards; Track 0 the two mood rows.
19. **The reworded opening goals (ruling 265) are D's**, with every other goal, so one track owns `goals.js` and its words; G owns only the picture cards and the music (ruling 282 asked us to decide).
20. **Track H works in CSS only**: the ornaments are CSS data-URI SVG on pseudo-elements, so H needs no hook in `sheets.js` (C's) or `titleCard.js`; "at most one glyph per sheet head" is a CSS rule on the head. If H needs a class on a sheet head that does not exist, it asks C through the controller.
21. **Shared files by function** (welcomeBack.js C and D; menu.js E and G; titleCard.js E and G; scenes.js one scene per track): the integrator keeps both sides.
22. **The palace sim is complete in Track 0 but owned by A** (ruling 282); C's palace sheet and Enlarge button can be built and tested at once. `enlargePalace` pushes no undo entry and no event; `palace_done` comes from `palaceDay`.
23. **`siteStatus.reason` before A** is the stored `site.reason` or `no_road` / `paused` from state; A judges the order of ruling 245 in `monumentDay` and keeps `site.reason` true, so the sheet, the alert and the event read one value.
24. **`b.site.month.crews`** (the most crews at work on one day) was added in Task 0.2 for the sheet's "Last month: 300 gold for 3 crews"; `last.crews` carries it.
25. **The new world field is one record** (`prestigeUnlocks`); every other Stage 4 state is on buildings or in tallies, splits and history rows. A track that needs more asks the controller (e.g. if A wants a per-city delivery log).

# Track 0: the contract

## Track 0: the contract

Track 0 runs on the branch `stage-4-monuments` in `C:\dev\thebes` itself, one task after another, before any worktree exists. When Task 0.4 is committed, its commit is the base every track branch is cut from (see "Tracks and tasks" in the header). Every code block below was applied, in this order, to `main` at `f90fcb4` (the Stage 4 spec `6342176` plus the screenshot infrastructure merge) on the scratch branch `s4-scratch` (`C:\dev\thebes-s4-scratch`), and the full suite run after each task: **1,396, 1,413, 1,424 and 1,426 tests, `ALL PASSED`** (main itself: 1,378). The scratch commits are `4985215`, `afa5f8b`, `95ee949` and `73198fb`; `git -C C:\dev\thebes-s4-scratch show <hash>` is the ground truth if a block below reads ambiguously. The before-blocks are exact at the time each is applied; apply them top to bottom. `sw-files.js` is never shown: run `tools/sw-files.ps1`.

How the blocks are written: "Create `path`:" gives a whole new file; "In `path`, replace: ... with: ..." gives one change, with up to three unchanged lines either side so the before-block is unique. A file with several changes has several pairs, in file order.

Model: **sonnet** for all four tasks (the code is complete; the job is transcription and running the suite).

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { BUILDINGS, BUILDABLE, dimsOf } from '../../../src/data/buildings.js';
import { GOODS, MATERIAL_GOODS } from '../../../src/data/goods.js';
import { MILESTONES } from '../../../src/data/progression.js';
import { DESIRABILITY } from '../../../src/data/desirability.js';
import { FIRE_RISK } from '../../../src/data/fire.js';
import { PARTNERS } from '../../../src/data/trade.js';
import { CATEGORIES } from '../../../src/data/ui.js';
import { MONUMENTS, MONUMENT_KINDS, MONUMENT, MATERIALS, SITE_DESIRABILITY, PRESTIGE, PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS, MONUMENT_PLACING } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { PALACE_STYLES } from '../../../src/data/palace.js';
import { SCORE_VERSION, SCORE_PARTS, SCORE_PARTS_V1, SCORE_WEIGHTS, MEDALS, SPLITS, SPLIT_MILESTONES, SHARE } from '../../../src/data/scoring.js';
import { ART } from '../../../src/render/art/registry.js';
import { costOf, workGoldPerUnit, extraGoldOf, palacePriceOf, canPayNoDebt } from '../../../src/sim/costs.js';
import { makeTestWorld } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';

const pick = (o, keys) => Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k, o[k]]));
const units = (m) => m.courses.reduce((s, c) => s + c.stone + c.bricks, 0);
const total = (m, good) => m.courses.reduce((s, c) => s + c[good], 0);
const byLevel = (fn) => ['peaceful', 'relaxed', 'normal', 'hard'].map((d) => { const w = makeTestWorld(); w.difficulty = d; return fn(w); });

describe('s4 contract monument data', () => {
  it('has the seven kinds of spec 4.16 with their footprints, courses, crews, work and times', () => {
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS).toEqual(['obelisk_small', 'obelisk_large', 'colossus', 'mastaba_small', 'mastaba_large', 'pyramid_small', 'pyramid_great']);
    const rows = MONUMENT_KINDS.map((k) => { const m = MONUMENTS[k]; return [k, m.w, m.d, m.rotates, m.courses.length, m.crews, m.crewMonths]; });
    expect(rows).toEqual([
      ['obelisk_small', 1, 1, false, 3, 1, 3], ['obelisk_large', 1, 1, false, 4, 2, 18], ['colossus', 2, 2, false, 6, 2, 48],
      ['mastaba_small', 3, 2, true, 4, 3, 108], ['mastaba_large', 4, 3, true, 5, 4, 240], ['pyramid_small', 4, 4, false, 8, 4, 384],
      ['pyramid_great', 7, 7, false, 12, 4, 720],
    ]);
    // Months with the kind's most crews and full supply: 3 months, 9 months, 2, 3, 5, 8 and 15 years (ruling 179).
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS.map((k) => MONUMENTS[k].crewMonths / MONUMENTS[k].crews)).toEqual([3, 9, 24, 36, 60, 96, 180]);
    for (const k of MONUMENT_KINDS) expect([k, units(MONUMENTS[k])]).toEqual([k, MONUMENTS[k].crewMonths * MONUMENT.unitsPerCrewMonth]);
  });
  it('gives each course a recipe of stone and bricks: stone for obelisks and the colossus, brick cores for mastabas, ramp bricks for pyramids', () => {
    const mat = (k) => [total(MONUMENTS[k], 'stone'), total(MONUMENTS[k], 'bricks')];
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS.map(mat)).toEqual([[60, 0], [360, 0], [960, 0], [540, 1620], [960, 3840], [6528, 1152], [12240, 2160]]);
    expect(MONUMENTS.mastaba_small.courses.map((c) => (c.stone ? 'stone' : 'bricks'))).toEqual(['bricks', 'bricks', 'bricks', 'stone']);
    for (const c of MONUMENTS.pyramid_great.courses) expect(c.bricks / (c.stone + c.bricks)).toBe(0.15);
    expect(MATERIALS).toEqual(MATERIAL_GOODS);
    expect(MATERIAL_GOODS).toEqual(['stone', 'bricks']);
    for (const g of MATERIAL_GOODS) expect([g, GOODS[g].kind, 'perResidentPerMonth' in GOODS[g]]).toEqual([g, 'material', false]);
  });
  it('sets founding, gilding and capstone gold, the prestige split and the unlocks', () => {
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS.map((k) => MONUMENTS[k].founding)).toEqual([150, 400, 600, 1000, 2000, 3000, 6000]);
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS.map((k) => MONUMENTS[k].extra)).toEqual([null, { kind: 'gilding', gold: 1000 }, null, null, null, null, { kind: 'capstone', gold: 5000 }]);
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS.map((k) => MONUMENTS[k].prestige.courses + MONUMENTS[k].prestige.done)).toEqual([10, 30, 50, 70, 110, 160, 270]);
    for (const k of MONUMENT_KINDS) expect([k, MONUMENTS[k].prestige.courses]).toEqual([k, MONUMENTS[k].prestige.done]);
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS.reduce((s, k) => s + MONUMENTS[k].prestige.courses + MONUMENTS[k].prestige.done, 0)).toBe(PRESTIGE.scoreFull);
    expect(MONUMENT_KINDS.map((k) => MONUMENTS[k].unlock)).toEqual([
      { milestone: 'city' }, { milestone: 'city' }, { milestone: 'great_city' }, { milestone: 'great_city' }, { milestone: 'capital' },
      { milestone: 'capital', prestige: 100 }, { milestone: 'capital', prestige: 300 },
    ]);
    expect(PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS).toEqual(['pyramid_small', 'pyramid_great']);
    expect(PRESTIGE).toEqual({ moodPer: 70, moodMax: 10, scoreFull: 700 });
  });
  it('keeps the shared rules: 20 units a crew-month, 5 gold a unit, the reaches, the stockpile, the stall, the big-footprint fit', () => {
    expect(MONUMENT).toEqual({ unitsPerCrewMonth: 20, goldPerUnit: 5, crewReach: 12, producerReach: 12, supplyReach: 16, stockPerCrew: 40, stallDays: 3, demolishRefund: 0.25 });
    expect(MONUMENT_PLACING).toEqual({ fitRadius: 16, bigArea: 9, silhouetteAlpha: 0.35, fadeBehind: 0.4 });
    expect(SITE_DESIRABILITY).toEqual([-3, -2, -1]);
  });
});

describe('s4 contract building data', () => {
  it('adds the builders\' guild, quarry and brickworks at the monuments priority, in the Monuments tab, from City', () => {

    expect(pick(BUILDINGS.brickworks, [...KEYS, 'produces', 'consumes'])).toEqual({ name: 'Brickworks', w: 2, d: 2, cost: 90, upkeep: 6, workers: 8, priority: 'monuments', category: 'monuments', needsRoad: true, produces: { good: 'bricks', perMonth: 30 }, consumes: 'clay' });

    expect(pick(BUILDINGS.sphinx, ['w', 'd', 'cost', 'upkeep', 'workers', 'category', 'needsRoad'])).toEqual({ w: 1, d: 1, cost: 150, upkeep: 0, workers: 0, category: 'homes', needsRoad: false });
    expect(pick(BUILDINGS.palace, ['w', 'd', 'cost', 'upkeep', 'workers', 'category', 'needsRoad', 'palace', 'oneOnly'])).toEqual({ w: 3, d: 3, cost: 300, upkeep: 0, workers: 0, category: 'services', needsRoad: true, palace: true, oneOnly: true });
    expect(PALACE_STYLES.map((s) => [s.id, s.milestone, s.price, s.days, s.mood])).toEqual([

    ]);

    for (const p of Object.values(PARTNERS)) for (const g of MATERIAL_GOODS) expect([g, p.buys[g]]).toEqual([g, undefined]);

});

describe('s4 contract score v2 data and costs', () => {
  it('sets score v2: five parts, Monuments from prestige, medals at 200, 300 and 400, seven splits and the t2 link', () => {
    expect(SCORE_VERSION).toBe(2);
    expect(SCORE_PARTS).toEqual([...SCORE_PARTS_V1, 'monuments']);
    expect(SCORE_WEIGHTS.monuments).toEqual({ prestige: 100 });
    expect(MEDALS.map((m) => m.at)).toEqual([200, 300, 400]);
    expect(SPLITS).toEqual([...SPLIT_MILESTONES, 'pyramids', 'great_pyramid']);
    expect(SHARE.format).toBe('t2');
    expect(SHARE.formats).toEqual({ t1: { version: 1, parts: SCORE_PARTS_V1, splits: SPLIT_MILESTONES }, t2: { version: 2, parts: SCORE_PARTS, splits: SPLITS } });
  });
  it('scales founding, work gold, gilding, the capstone and the palace by the difficulty\'s cost, never below 0', () => {
    expect(byLevel((w) => costOf(w, 'pyramid_great'))).toEqual([4800, 4800, 6000, 7500]);
    expect(byLevel(workGoldPerUnit)).toEqual([4, 4, 5, 6.25]);                    // not rounded: the site carries the fraction
    expect(byLevel((w) => extraGoldOf(w, 'pyramid_great'))).toEqual([4000, 4000, 5000, 6250]);
    expect(byLevel((w) => extraGoldOf(w, 'obelisk_large'))).toEqual([800, 800, 1000, 1250]);
    expect(byLevel((w) => extraGoldOf(w, 'colossus'))).toEqual([0, 0, 0, 0]);
    expect(byLevel((w) => palacePriceOf(w, 4))).toEqual([8000, 8000, 10000, 12500]);
    expect(byLevel((w) => palacePriceOf(w, 0))).toEqual([0, 0, 0, 0]);
    const w = makeTestWorld({ gold: 100 });
    expect([canPayNoDebt(w, 100), canPayNoDebt(w, 101)]).toEqual([true, false]);
  });
});
```

Create `tests/stage4/contract/worldV5.test.js`:

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import {
  createWorld, makeBuilding, insertBuilding, WORLD_VERSION, STAGE4_TALLY, newTally, newSite, newPrestigeUnlocks, isMonument, isSite, isFinished,
} from '../../../src/sim/world.js';
import { serialize, deserialize, validateWorld, REQUIRED, TALLY_KEYS } from '../../../src/save/serialize.js';
import { migrate, MIGRATIONS, CURRENT_VERSION, STAGE4_ITEMS } from '../../../src/save/migrate.js';
import { advanceDays } from '../../../src/sim/clock.js';
import { drawRoad, paintHouses, place } from '../../../src/sim/commands.js';

// A version 4 save as Stage 3 wrote it: a lived-in city without the version 5 fields, with month-end rows that carry v1 scores.
function v4City({ milestone = null } = {}) {
  const w = createWorld({ seed: 7 });
  const { x, y } = w.focus;
  expect(drawRoad(w, x - 6, y, x + 6, y).ok).toBe(true);
  expect(paintHouses(w, x - 5, y + 1, x + 5, y + 1).ids.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(place(w, 'well', x, y - 1).ok).toBe(true);
  advanceDays(w, 75);
  const v4 = JSON.parse(serialize(w));
  delete v4.prestigeUnlocks;
  for (const k of STAGE4_TALLY) delete v4.tally[k];
  for (const b of Object.values(v4.buildings)) delete b.rot;
  for (const r of v4.history) { delete r.version; delete r.parts.monuments; }
  if (milestone) v4.milestone = milestone;
  v4.newItems = [];
  v4.version = 4;
  return v4;
}
const validAfter = (fn) => { const w = JSON.parse(serialize(createWorld({ seed: 3 }))); fn(w); return validateWorld(w); };

describe('s4 contract world v5', () => {
  it('creates a version 5 world with no prestige unlocks and the Stage 4 tallies at zero', () => {
    const w = createWorld({ seed: 4 });
    expect([WORLD_VERSION, w.version, CURRENT_VERSION]).toEqual([5, 5, 5]);
    expect(w.prestigeUnlocks).toEqual({ pyramid_small: null, pyramid_great: null });
    expect(w.prestigeUnlocks).toEqual(newPrestigeUnlocks());
    expect(STAGE4_TALLY).toEqual(['stoneLaid', 'bricksLaid', 'stoneDelivered', 'bricksDelivered', 'courses', 'monumentsDone', 'enlargements']);
    for (const k of STAGE4_TALLY) { expect([k, w.tally[k]]).toEqual([k, 0]); expect(TALLY_KEYS).toContain(k); }
    expect(w.tally).toEqual(newTally());
    expect(Object.keys(w).sort()).toEqual([...REQUIRED].sort());
    expect(validateWorld(JSON.parse(serialize(w)))).toBe(true);
  });
  it('gives every building a rotation, a monument an empty site and the palace its first style', () => {
    const w = createWorld({ seed: 4 });
    expect(makeBuilding(w, 'well', 3, 3).rot).toBe(0);
    const m = makeBuilding(w, 'mastaba_large', 3, 3, 1);
    expect([m.w, m.d, m.rot]).toEqual([3, 4, 1]);
    const p = makeBuilding(w, 'pyramid_small', 3, 3, 1);                          // a pyramid does not turn
    expect([p.w, p.d, p.rot]).toEqual([4, 4, 0]);
    expect(m.site).toEqual({
      course: 0, laid: { stone: 0, bricks: 0 }, stock: { stone: 0, bricks: 0 }, carry: 0, extraPaid: false, crews: [], idle: 0, reason: null,
      month: { units: 0, gold: 0, crewDays: 0, starvedDays: 0 }, last: null, starved: false, done: null,
    });
    expect(m.site).toEqual(newSite());
    const pal = makeBuilding(w, 'palace', 3, 3);
    expect([pal.style, pal.works, 'site' in pal]).toEqual([0, null, false]);
    expect([isMonument(m), isSite(m), isFinished(m), isMonument(pal)]).toEqual([true, true, false, false]);
    m.site.done = 40;
    expect([isSite(m), isFinished(m)]).toEqual([false, true]);
    expect('site' in makeBuilding(w, 'quarry', 3, 3)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('round-trips a world with a rotated site mid-course, a finished monument, a palace under works and an unlock day', () => {
    const w = createWorld({ seed: 6 });
    const s = insertBuilding(w, makeBuilding(w, 'mastaba_small', 10, 10, 1));
    Object.assign(s.site, { course: 2, laid: { stone: 0, bricks: 133.33 }, stock: { stone: 12, bricks: 40.5 }, carry: 0.4, crews: [9], idle: 1, reason: 'no_bricks', last: { units: 40, gold: 200, crews: 2 } });
    const f = insertBuilding(w, makeBuilding(w, 'obelisk_small', 20, 20));
    Object.assign(f.site, { course: 3, done: 300 });
    const pal = insertBuilding(w, makeBuilding(w, 'palace', 30, 30));
    Object.assign(pal, { style: 2, works: { style: 3, left: 44 } });
    w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = 900;
    w.splits = { town: 100, pyramids: 900 };
    expect(deserialize(serialize(w))).toEqual(w);
  });
  it('checks every building\'s rotation, a monument\'s site, the palace\'s style and works and the unlock days', () => {
    const withB = (type, fn) => validAfter((w) => {
      const b = makeBuilding(w, type, 2, 2);
      w.buildings[b.id] = b;
      for (let y = 2; y < 2 + b.d; y++) for (let x = 2; x < 2 + b.w; x++) w.occ[y * w.size + x] = b.id;
      fn(b);
    });
    expect(withB('well', () => {})).toBe(true);
    expect(withB('well', (b) => { b.rot = 2; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('well', (b) => { delete b.rot; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('colossus', () => {})).toBe(true);
    expect(withB('colossus', (b) => { delete b.site; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('colossus', (b) => { b.site.course = -1; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('colossus', (b) => { b.site.stock.stone = -3; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('colossus', (b) => { b.site.done = 'soon'; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('colossus', (b) => { b.site.crews = ['x']; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('palace', () => {})).toBe(true);
    expect(withB('palace', (b) => { b.style = 5; })).toBe(false);
    expect(withB('palace', (b) => { b.works = { style: 1, left: 30 }; })).toBe(true);
    expect(withB('palace', (b) => { b.works = { style: 0, left: 30 }; })).toBe(false);
    expect(validAfter((w) => { w.prestigeUnlocks = {}; })).toBe(false);
    expect(validAfter((w) => { w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_great = 1.5; })).toBe(false);
    expect(validAfter((w) => { w.tally.stoneLaid = 'x'; })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('s4 contract migrate v4 to v5', () => {
  it('adds rot 0, no prestige unlocks and the Stage 4 tallies, marks scored rows v1, and keeps everything else', () => {
    const v4 = v4City();
    const v5 = MIGRATIONS[4](v4);
    expect(v5.version).toBe(5);
    expect(validateWorld(v5)).toBe(true);
    expect(v5.prestigeUnlocks).toEqual({ pyramid_small: null, pyramid_great: null });
    for (const k of STAGE4_TALLY) expect([k, v5.tally[k]]).toEqual([k, 0]);
    for (const b of Object.values(v5.buildings)) expect([b.id, b.rot]).toEqual([b.id, 0]);
    expect(v5.history.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const r of v5.history) expect([r.day, r.version, Object.keys(r.parts)]).toEqual([r.day, 1, ['people', 'prosperity', 'culture', 'safety']]);
    const strip = (w) => { const o = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(w)); delete o.version; delete o.prestigeUnlocks; for (const k of STAGE4_TALLY) delete o.tally[k]; for (const b of Object.values(o.buildings)) delete b.rot; for (const r of o.history) delete r.version; return o; };
    expect(strip(v5)).toEqual(strip(v4));
    expect(v4.history[0].version).toBe(undefined);                               // the migration copies, never edits the save it was given
  });
  it('leaves a row with no score (a Stage 2 row) unmarked, and gives New badges for the Stage 4 cards the milestone unlocks', () => {
    const v4 = v4City({ milestone: 'great_city' });
    v4.history.unshift({ day: 0, people: 0, gold: 2000, mood: 60 });
    const v5 = MIGRATIONS[4](v4);
    expect(v5.history[0]).toEqual({ day: 0, people: 0, gold: 2000, mood: 60 });
    expect(v5.newItems).toEqual(['palace', 'builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks', 'obelisk_small', 'obelisk_large', 'plaza', 'colossus', 'mastaba_small', 'sphinx']);
    expect(MIGRATIONS[4](v4City()).newItems).toEqual([]);                        // a Village has none yet
    expect(STAGE4_ITEMS.length).toBe(11);
  });
  it('runs through migrate and deserialize, and reports a malformed version 4 save as corrupt', () => {
    const v4 = v4City();
    expect(migrate(v4)).toEqual(MIGRATIONS[4](v4));
    expect(deserialize(JSON.stringify(v4)).version).toBe(5);
    let msg = null;
    try { deserialize(JSON.stringify({ version: 4 })); } catch (e) { msg = e.message; }
    expect(msg).toBe('corrupt_save');
  });
});
```

```js
// else, or a type that does not rotate, is the data's own footprint (rot 0).
export function dimsOf(type, rot = 0) {
```

Create `src/data/monuments.js`:

```js
// Monuments (spec 4.16, rulings 179-243), every number a first value: Josh's playtest sets the final ones (ruling 224).
// Seven kinds, each a building type in BUILDINGS (monument: true, category 'monuments'), founded as a site and built
// course by course by builders' guild crews from stone and bricks. Times are game time with the kind's most crews and
// full supply: a full crew lays MONUMENT.unitsPerCrewMonth units a month, so a kind takes crewMonths / crews months.
//   name        the card's and the sheet's name
//   w, d        the footprint as the data draws it (rot 0); rotates: the mastabas turn a quarter (rot 1 swaps w and d)
//   crews       the most crews the site takes (one builders' guild gives one crew)
//   crewMonths  the work in crew-months; it equals the sum of every course's units / unitsPerCrewMonth (a data test)
//   courses     one entry per course, bottom first: the units of stone and of bricks it takes. A course whose recipe names
//               both is laid in proportion, so it waits when either is missing (ruling 239)
//   founding    the gold paid when the site is placed (x the difficulty's cost; never below 0, ruling 227)
//   extra       null, or { kind: 'gilding' | 'capstone', gold }: paid on the day the last course begins (ruling 241)
//   prestige    { courses, done }: the share earned course by course (rounded down, ruling 242) and on completion
//   desirability  the finished monument's values by distance 1-6 (spec 4.7); a site under way gives SITE_DESIRABILITY
//   unlock      { milestone } or { milestone, prestige }: the pyramids also need that much prestige (ruling 200)
export const MONUMENT_KINDS = ['obelisk_small', 'obelisk_large', 'colossus', 'mastaba_small', 'mastaba_large', 'pyramid_small', 'pyramid_great'];

// n courses of the same recipe.
const even = (n, stone, bricks = 0) => Array.from({ length: n }, () => ({ stone, bricks }));

export const MONUMENTS = {
  obelisk_small: {
    name: 'Small obelisk', w: 1, d: 1, rotates: false, crews: 1, crewMonths: 3, courses: even(3, 20),
    founding: 150, extra: null, prestige: { courses: 5, done: 5 }, desirability: [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1], unlock: { milestone: 'city' },
  },
  obelisk_large: {
    name: 'Large obelisk', w: 1, d: 1, rotates: false, crews: 2, crewMonths: 18, courses: even(4, 90),
    founding: 400, extra: { kind: 'gilding', gold: 1000 }, prestige: { courses: 15, done: 15 }, desirability: [10, 8, 6, 4, 2, 1], unlock: { milestone: 'city' },
  },
  colossus: {
    name: 'Colossus', w: 2, d: 2, rotates: false, crews: 2, crewMonths: 48, courses: even(6, 160),
    founding: 600, extra: null, prestige: { courses: 25, done: 25 }, desirability: [12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 2], unlock: { milestone: 'great_city' },
  },
  // Bricks for the core courses, stone for the top (facing) course: 1,620 bricks and 540 stone.
  mastaba_small: {
    name: 'Small mastaba', w: 3, d: 2, rotates: true, crews: 3, crewMonths: 108, courses: [...even(3, 0, 540), ...even(1, 540)],
    founding: 1000, extra: null, prestige: { courses: 35, done: 35 }, desirability: [10, 8, 6, 4, 2, 1], unlock: { milestone: 'great_city' },
  },
  // 3,840 bricks and 960 stone, in five equal courses (contract note 4: the spec's "about 3,600 and 1,200").
  mastaba_large: {
    name: 'Large mastaba', w: 4, d: 3, rotates: true, crews: 4, crewMonths: 240, courses: [...even(4, 0, 960), ...even(1, 960)],
    founding: 2000, extra: null, prestige: { courses: 55, done: 55 }, desirability: [14, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4], unlock: { milestone: 'capital' },
  },
  // Stone for the courses, bricks for the ramp (15% of each course): 6,528 stone and 1,152 bricks.
  pyramid_small: {
    name: 'Small pyramid', w: 4, d: 4, rotates: false, crews: 4, crewMonths: 384, courses: even(8, 816, 144),
    founding: 3000, extra: null, prestige: { courses: 80, done: 80 }, desirability: [16, 14, 12, 10, 8, 6], unlock: { milestone: 'capital', prestige: 100 },
  },
  // 12,240 stone and 2,160 bricks, then the gold capstone.
  pyramid_great: {
    name: 'Great pyramid', w: 7, d: 7, rotates: false, crews: 4, crewMonths: 720, courses: even(12, 1020, 180),
    founding: 6000, extra: { kind: 'capstone', gold: 5000 }, prestige: { courses: 135, done: 135 }, desirability: [24, 20, 16, 12, 10, 8], unlock: { milestone: 'capital', prestige: 300 },
  },
};

// The materials monuments use (GOODS kind 'material', src/data/goods.js), in the order sheets list them.
export const MATERIALS = ['stone', 'bricks'];

// The rules every kind shares (spec 4.5, 4.11, 4.16; rulings 184-191, 237-244).
export const MONUMENT = {
  unitsPerCrewMonth: 20,   // a full crew lays 20 units a month (two-thirds of a unit a day); below MIN_STAFF_RATIO it stops
  goldPerUnit: 5,          // work gold: 5 a unit laid (100 a full crew-month) x the difficulty's cost, whole gold, fraction carried
  crewReach: 12,           // a builders' guild works the nearest unpaused, unfinished site with room within this many road tiles
  producerReach: 12,       // a quarry or brickworks delivers to a site within its producer reach (BUILDINGS[..].producerReach)
  supplyReach: 16,         // a site also draws from storehouses within this many road tiles
  stockPerCrew: 40,        // a site's stockpile holds at most this x its kind's most crews, never more of one than its courses need
  stallDays: 3,            // a site with no work this many days in a row (unpaused, unfinished, on a road) is stalled (a warning)
  demolishRefund: 0.25,    // demolishing a monument or site refunds a quarter of its founding (ECONOMY.demolishRefund)
};

// A site under way is a little unpleasant to live beside once a road touches it (dust and noise, spec 4.7).
export const SITE_DESIRABILITY = [-3, -2, -1];

// Prestige (spec 4.16, 4.9, 4.19): +1 mood for every moodPer, at most moodMax; the Monuments score part is
// 100 x sqrt(prestige / scoreFull), at most 100. One of each kind is 700.
export const PRESTIGE = { moodPer: 70, moodMax: 10, scoreFull: 700 };

// The monument kinds that unlock by prestige (with their milestone), in order: their days are recorded once reached
// (world.prestigeUnlocks) and stay, as milestones do (ruling 243).
export const PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS = MONUMENT_KINDS.filter((k) => Number.isFinite(MONUMENTS[k].unlock.prestige));

// Placing big footprints (spec 6.5, rulings 208, 209, 231, 232): the nearest-fit search reaches fitRadius tiles (else
// NEAREST_FIT_RADIUS, src/data/ui.js) for footprints of at least bigArea tiles ("3x3 and up": the 4x3 mastaba, the
// pyramids and the palace; the 3x2 mastaba keeps 10, contract note 5); the ghost's silhouette of the finished monument is
// drawn at silhouetteAlpha, and a monument the ghost or a selected building lies behind fades to fadeBehind.
export const MONUMENT_PLACING = { fitRadius: 16, bigArea: 9, silhouetteAlpha: 0.35, fadeBehind: 0.4 };
```

Create `src/data/palace.js`:

```js
// The palace (spec 4.20, rulings 271-275), every number a first value. One per city, a 3x3 civic building from Town
// (BUILDINGS.palace: 300 gold x the difficulty's cost, no workers, no upkeep, needs a road). The player enlarges it one
// style at a time from its sheet (enlargePalace, src/sim/palace.js): the price is paid in full at once and never takes
// the treasury below 0; the works then take `days` game days, during which the old style and its desirability hold.
//   id            the style's key (art slot palace.s<index>, words PALACE_TEXT in src/ui/text.js)
//   milestone     the milestone the city must have reached to enlarge to it (the first is as built)
//   price         gold to enlarge to it (x the difficulty's cost); 0 for the first
//   days          the works' game days (30 at 1x is 20 s)
//   desirability  its values by distance 1-6 (spec 4.7), only while a road touches it
//   mood          its Palace mood row (spec 4.9), only while a road touches it: +1 a style above the first
export const PALACE_STYLES = [
  { id: 'courtyard', milestone: 'town', price: 0, days: 0, desirability: [4, 3, 2, 1], mood: 0 },
  { id: 'columned', milestone: 'market_town', price: 600, days: 30, desirability: [6, 5, 4, 3, 2], mood: 1 },
  { id: 'pylons', milestone: 'city', price: 1500, days: 60, desirability: [8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3], mood: 2 },
  { id: 'gilded', milestone: 'great_city', price: 4000, days: 90, desirability: [10, 9, 8, 6, 4, 2], mood: 3 },
  { id: 'lapis', milestone: 'capital', price: 10000, days: 120, desirability: [14, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4], mood: 4 },
];

// Demolishing refunds a quarter of the 300 to build it (ECONOMY.demolishRefund); the enlargements are lost.
export const PALACE = { type: 'palace', lastStyle: PALACE_STYLES.length - 1 };
```

Create `src/render/art/stage4.js`:

```js
// Stage 4 placeholder art (contract, Track 0): one plain slot for every Stage 4 building, so cards, thumbnails, the
// sprite cache and the renderer have something to show until Track B replaces them. STUB. Track B keeps every slot
// name and its { w, d } (a 2x2 stays 2x2), and may move the slots to art/industry.js, art/monuments.js, art/plaza.js and
// art/palace.js (registry.js imports them).
//   builders_guild, quarry, brickworks, plaza, sphinx   sprite slots like any building's
//   palace.s0 .. palace.s4                              one sprite per style (slotFor reads b.style); 'palace' is the card's
//   obelisk_small .. pyramid_great                      live: true. The renderer never caches these: in the depth-sorted pass
//                                                      it calls opts.live(g, o) (src/render/monuments.js drawMonument) with
//                                                      the art origin set; `draw` is only for the card's thumbnail.
import { box } from './primitives.js';
import { WASH, MUD, STONE } from './palette.js';
import { boundsFor } from '../iso.js';
import { MONUMENT_KINDS, MONUMENTS } from '../../data/monuments.js';
import { PALACE_STYLES } from '../../data/palace.js';

const slot = (w, d, height, draw, extra = {}) => ({ w, d, height, bounds: boundsFor(w, d, height), shadows: [[0.1, 0.1, w - 0.2, d - 0.2, Math.min(height, 12)]], draw, ...extra });
const block = (C, h, inset = 0.12) => (w, d) => (g, x, y) => box(g, x + inset, y + inset, w - 2 * inset, d - 2 * inset, h, 0, C);

// A stepped stack, one box a step, narrowing as it rises: the placeholder for every monument.
const stack = (w, d, steps, stepH, C) => (g, x, y) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const k = Math.min(w, d) * 0.4 * (i / steps);
    box(g, x + 0.08 + k, y + 0.08 + k, w - 0.16 - 2 * k, d - 0.16 - 2 * k, stepH, i * stepH, C);
  }
};

export const STAGE4_ART = {
  builders_guild: slot(2, 2, 14, block(WASH, 14)(2, 2)),
  quarry: slot(2, 2, 8, block(STONE, 8)(2, 2)),
  brickworks: slot(2, 2, 12, block(MUD, 12)(2, 2)),
  plaza: { w: 1, d: 1, height: 1, bounds: boundsFor(1, 1, 1), shadows: [], draw: block(STONE, 1, 0)(1, 1) },
  sphinx: slot(1, 1, 10, block(MUD, 10, 0.2)(1, 1)),
  palace: slot(3, 3, 18, block(WASH, 18)(3, 3)),
};
PALACE_STYLES.forEach((s, i) => { STAGE4_ART[`palace.s${i}`] = slot(3, 3, 14 + 4 * i, block(i >= 3 ? STONE : WASH, 14 + 4 * i)(3, 3)); });
for (const k of MONUMENT_KINDS) {
  const m = MONUMENTS[k];
  const h = Math.max(24, 10 * Math.min(m.w, m.d));
  // A rotated mastaba is drawn from b.w and b.d by the live draw; the slot keeps the data's footprint.
  STAGE4_ART[k] = slot(m.w, m.d, h, stack(m.w, m.d, Math.min(m.courses.length, 6), h / Math.min(m.courses.length, 6), k.startsWith('obelisk') ? STONE : WASH), { live: true });
}
```

```js
// The Stage 4 build items a city of this milestone has already unlocked (spec 4.14, ruling 253: a city saved before Stage 4
// gets "New" badges for the Stage 4 cards its milestone unlocks), in the milestones' order.
export const STAGE4_ITEMS = ['palace', 'builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks', 'obelisk_small', 'obelisk_large', 'plaza', 'colossus', 'mastaba_small', 'sphinx', 'mastaba_large'];
function stage4Unlocked(milestone) {
  const reached = MILESTONES.findIndex((m) => m.id === milestone);
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= reached; i++) for (const t of MILESTONES[i].unlocks) if (STAGE4_ITEMS.includes(t)) out.push(t);
  return out;
}

// v4 -> v5 (Stage 4). Every building gets rot 0 (nothing turned before Stage 4); no monument, site or palace exists yet,
// so none needs a site or a style. The city has reached no prestige unlock, the Stage 4 tallies start at zero, and its
// splits keep their five milestones (the pyramids' two are not reached). Every month-end history row that has a score is
// marked score version 1 (spec 7.5, ruling 203: Welcome back compares rows of one version only). Already-unlocked Stage 4
// build items join newItems. Last month's stats gain no monuments row (the summary reads a missing one as 0). The device's
// settings move to Motion in src/ui/settings.js (they are not in the world). Every other field is kept as it was.
function v4ToV5(w) {
  const tally = w.tally !== null && typeof w.tally === 'object' && !Array.isArray(w.tally) ? w.tally : {};
  const buildings = {};
  if (w.buildings && typeof w.buildings === 'object') {
    for (const [id, b] of Object.entries(w.buildings)) buildings[id] = b && typeof b === 'object' ? { ...b, rot: 0 } : b;
  }
  const history = Array.isArray(w.history)
    ? w.history.map((r) => (r && typeof r === 'object' && Number.isFinite(r.score) && !Number.isInteger(r.version) ? { ...r, version: 1 } : r))
    : w.history;
  const items = Array.isArray(w.newItems) ? w.newItems.slice() : w.newItems;
  if (Array.isArray(items)) for (const t of stage4Unlocked(w.milestone)) if (!items.includes(t)) items.push(t);
  return {
    ...w,
    version: 5,
    buildings,
    history,
    newItems: items,
    tally: { ...tally, ...Object.fromEntries(STAGE4_TALLY.map((k) => [k, 0])) },
    prestigeUnlocks: newPrestigeUnlocks(),
  };
}

// Each entry upgrades a world from version N to N + 1. Add one whenever WORLD_VERSION goes up.
```

```js
// What placing a building of this type at (x, y) would do (spec 4.7), once a road touches it, without placing it: the tiles it would change
// with their change v, and how many housing plots (any tier, empty ones too, as homesServedFrom counts) would get
// a better or a worse best tile. Stage 4: rot turns a mastaba's footprint; a monument previews its finished values unless
// site is true (the site's dust and noise: "while building: N homes less pleasant", spec 4.7).
export function desirabilityPreview(world, type, x, y, { rot = 0, site = false } = {}) {

  });
```

Create `src/sim/prestige.js`:

```js
// Prestige (spec 4.16, 4.9, 4.19, rulings 199, 201, 202, 242): measured from the monuments standing, never stored.
// Complete in the contract (Track 0), because the score, the mood, the cards' locks, the confirm bar and the site sheet all
// read it; Track A owns it afterwards and may refine, never change, the behaviour. src/sim/monuments.js re-exports these.
// Pure: no world writes, no events.
import { MONUMENTS, MONUMENT_KINDS, PRESTIGE } from '../data/monuments.js';
import { allBuildings } from './world.js';

// One monument's prestige: its courses' share rounded down (half x courses done / courses), plus the completion share
// once finished. 0 for anything that is not a monument.
export function prestigeOfBuilding(b) {
  const m = b && MONUMENTS[b.type];
  if (!m || !b.site) return 0;
  const n = m.courses.length;
  const course = Math.max(0, Math.min(n, b.site.course));
  return Math.floor((m.prestige.courses * course) / n) + (b.site.done !== null ? m.prestige.done : 0);
}

// Each kind's share: the most any standing monument of that kind gives (one of each kind counts; a second adds
// desirability only). { kind: { prestige, id } } for every kind, id null when none stands.
export function prestigeByKind(world) {
  const out = Object.fromEntries(MONUMENT_KINDS.map((k) => [k, { prestige: 0, id: null }]));
  for (const b of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (!MONUMENTS[b.type]) continue;
    const p = prestigeOfBuilding(b), cur = out[b.type];
    if (cur.id === null || p > cur.prestige) out[b.type] = { prestige: p, id: b.id };   // ties keep the older (lower id)
  }
  return out;
}

// The city's prestige: the sum of the kinds' shares (0-700 with the data's numbers).
export function prestigeOf(world) {
  const by = prestigeByKind(world);
  return MONUMENT_KINDS.reduce((s, k) => s + by[k].prestige, 0);
}

// Whether this monument is the one whose prestige counts for its kind (a second of a kind says "One of each kind counts").
export const holdsPrestige = (world, b) => prestigeByKind(world)[b.type] !== undefined && prestigeByKind(world)[b.type].id === b.id;

// The mood term: +1 for every PRESTIGE.moodPer prestige, at most PRESTIGE.moodMax.
export const monumentMood = (world) => Math.min(PRESTIGE.moodMax, Math.floor(prestigeOf(world) / PRESTIGE.moodPer));

// The Monuments score part, 0-100: 100 x sqrt(prestige / PRESTIGE.scoreFull), at most 100, rounded.
export const monumentsPart = (prestige) => Math.round(100 * Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, prestige) / PRESTIGE.scoreFull)));
```

```js
// Game-months from the start to each split the city has reached (world.splits; score v2's seven, SPLITS), null where not.
export function splitMonths(world) {
  return Object.fromEntries(SPLITS.map((id) => [id, Number.isInteger(world.splits[id]) ? Math.floor(world.splits[id] / DAYS_PER_MONTH) : null]));
}

// The month-end history row's score fields (runMonth): { score, parts, version } (Stage 4: the score version, so the trend
// compares rows of one version only; a v4 save's rows are marked 1 when loaded).
export function scoreRow(world) {
  const s = scoreOf(world);
  return { score: s.total, parts: { ...s.parts }, version: s.version };
}
```

```js
  'raidersByTowers', 'raidersBySoldiers', 'soldiersWounded', 'goldStolen', 'festivals', 'wallTiles'];
```

```js
// a brickworks or a site's draw from a storehouse), courses finished, monuments finished and palace enlargements paid for.
export const STAGE4_TALLY = ['stoneLaid', 'bricksLaid', 'stoneDelivered', 'bricksDelivered', 'courses', 'monumentsDone', 'enlargements'];
export const newTally = () => ({
  harvested: 0, profitMonths: 0, peakPeople: 0, upgrades: 0, dailyDone: 0, made: {}, sold: 0, bought: 0, tradeIncome: 0, caravans: 0,

  ...Object.fromEntries(STAGE4_TALLY.map((k) => [k, 0])),
```
