```js
// ── pyramids ──

function pyramidGeom(type, x, y, w) {
  const L = MONUMENT_LOOK[type], B = bodyOf(type, w, w), n = MONUMENTS[type].courses.length;
  const core = L.height * 0.9, ch = core / n, step = (B.w / 2) * 0.9 / n;
  return { L, B, n, ch, step, bx: x + B.x, by: y + B.y, side: B.w };
}

function pyramidSite(g, x, y, w, look, newest) {
  const { n, ch, step, bx, by, side } = pyramidGeom(look.type, x, y, w);
  const ink = inkFor();
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(look.course, n); i++) {
    const k = i * step, F = slab(g, bx + k, by + k, side - 2 * k, side - 2 * k, ch, i * ch, 0, i % 2 ? CORE2 : CORE, ink);
    joints(ink, F, side - 2 * k, side - 2 * k, ch, 0.45, i % 2);
  }
  if (look.course < n && look.laid > 0) {
    const k = look.course * step;
    courseUnderWay(g, bx + k, by + k, side - 2 * k, side - 2 * k, look.course * ch, ch, look, newest, look.course % 2 ? CORE2 : CORE, ink);
  }
  flush(g, ink);
  // the ramp up the +y face from the left of the apron to the top of the courses laid, landing on the course under way
  const z1 = look.course * ch, k = Math.min(look.course, n - 1) * step;
  return ramp(g, x + 0.1, bx + side - k - (side - 2 * k) * 0.25, by + side + 0.26, 0.36, by + side - k, z1);
}

export function pyramidFinished(g, x, y, w, type) {
  const { L, bx, by, side } = pyramidGeom(type, x, y, w);
  const apex = U(p(bx + side / 2, by + side / 2), L.height);
  const A = p(bx, by + side), Bp = p(bx + side, by + side), C = p(bx + side, by);
  shadedFace(g, A, Bp, apex, CASING[1]);
  shadedFace(g, Bp, C, apex, CASING[2]);
  const segs = [];                                                           // the casing's courses, barely there
  for (let k = 1; k < 10; k++) {
    const f = k / 10, at = (q) => [q[0] + (apex[0] - q[0]) * f, q[1] + (apex[1] - q[1]) * f];
    segs.push(['M', at(A)], ['L', at(Bp)], ['L', at(C)]);
  }
  g.stroke(segs, '#B8AAB8', 0.4, 0.22);
  g.stroke([['M', A], ['L', apex], ['L', C]], OUTLINE, 0.6, 0.32);
  g.line(Bp, apex, '#FFFFFF', 0.8, 0.7);                                     // the lit edge
  // the gold capstone: the top eighth
  const t = 0.125, cap = (q) => [apex[0] + (q[0] - apex[0]) * t, apex[1] + (q[1] - apex[1]) * t];
  g.poly([cap(A), cap(Bp), apex], GOLDC[1]);
  g.poly([cap(Bp), cap(C), apex], GOLDC[2]);
  g.line(cap(Bp), apex, '#FFF4C8', 0.6, 0.9);
  return { apex, cap: [cap(A), cap(Bp), cap(C)] };
}

// ── mastabas ──

function mastabaGeom(type, x, y, w, d) {
  const L = MONUMENT_LOOK[type], B = bodyOf(type, w, d), n = MONUMENTS[type].courses.length;
  const tiers = n - 1, ch = L.height / tiers, step = 0.1;
  return { L, B, n, tiers, ch, step, bx: x + B.x, by: y + B.y };
}
// Tier i of a mastaba (0 at the bottom): its rectangle; its walls are battered, narrowing a little to the top.
function tier(G, i) { const k = i * G.step; return [G.bx + k, G.by + k, G.B.w - 2 * k, G.B.d - 2 * k]; }

// The core rises in mudbrick tiers, then the last course, the stone facing, goes on from the ground up in whitewash.
function mastabaSite(g, x, y, w, d, look, newest) {
  const G = mastabaGeom(look.type, x, y, w, d), ink = inkFor();
  const facing = look.course >= G.tiers;
  const Zf = facing ? G.L.height * (look.laid / look.blocks) : 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(look.course, G.tiers); i++) {
    const [tx, ty, tw, td] = tier(G, i);
    const F = slab(g, tx, ty, tw, td, G.ch, i * G.ch, 0.04, MUD2, ink);
    joints(ink, F, tw, td, G.ch, 0.3, i % 2);
    const hf = Math.min(G.ch, Zf - i * G.ch);
    if (hf > 0.2) slab(g, tx, ty, tw, td, hf, i * G.ch, 0.04 * (hf / G.ch), WASH, ink);
  }
  if (!facing && look.laid > 0) {
    const [tx, ty, tw, td] = tier(G, look.course);
    courseUnderWay(g, tx, ty, tw, td, look.course * G.ch, G.ch, look, newest, MUD2, ink);
  }
  flush(g, ink);
  const c = Math.min(look.course, G.tiers), z1 = c * G.ch, k = Math.min(c, G.tiers - 1) * G.step;
  return ramp(g, x + 0.1, G.bx + G.B.w - k - 0.35, G.by + G.B.d + 0.22, 0.3, G.by + G.B.d - k, z1);
}

export function mastabaFinished(g, x, y, w, d, type) {
  const G = mastabaGeom(type, x, y, w, d), ink = inkFor();
  let F0 = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < G.tiers; i++) {
    const [tx, ty, tw, td] = tier(G, i);
    const F = slab(g, tx, ty, tw, td, G.ch, i * G.ch, 0.04, i % 2 ? WASH2 : WASH, ink);
    if (i === 0) F0 = F;
  }
  flush(g, ink);
  qd(g, F0.L, 0.62, 0.74, 0, G.ch - 1.6, DOOR);                             // the false door and its lintel
  qd(g, F0.L, 0.58, 0.78, G.ch - 1.6, G.ch - 0.8, RED, { alpha: 0.8 });
  qd(g, F0.L, 0.2, 0.3, 0, G.ch * 0.6, '#E2D6C2');                           // the offering niche
  const [tx, ty, tw, td] = tier(G, G.tiers - 1);
  g.line(U(p(tx, ty + td), G.L.height), U(p(tx + tw, ty + td), G.L.height), TEAL, 0.9);   // a teal line along the cornice
  box(g, G.bx + G.B.w * 0.55, G.by + G.B.d + 0.06, 0.24, 0.14, 2, 0, STONE, 0);   // the offering table
}

// ── obelisks ──

function obeliskGeom(type, x, y) {
  const L = MONUMENT_LOOK[type], n = MONUMENTS[type].courses.length, ped = 4;
  return { L, n, cx: x + 0.5, cy: y + 0.5, ped, seg: L.shaft / n, base: L.base, topW: L.base * 0.66 };
}
const shaftW = (G, z) => G.base + (G.topW - G.base) * (z / G.L.shaft);

// A piece of the shaft from z0, h tall, tapering with the whole shaft.
function obeliskShaft(g, G, z0, h, C, ink, newest = null) {
  const w0 = shaftW(G, z0), w1 = shaftW(G, z0 + h);
  if (newest) return alphaBox(g, G.cx - w0 / 2, G.cy - w0 / 2, w0, w0, h, G.ped + z0 + newest.drop, C, newest.alpha);
  return slab(g, G.cx - w0 / 2, G.cy - w0 / 2, w0, w0, h, G.ped + z0, (w0 - w1) / 2, C, ink);
}

function obeliskSite(g, x, y, look, newest) {
  const G = obeliskGeom(look.type, x, y), ink = inkFor();
  slab(g, G.cx - 0.24, G.cy - 0.24, 0.48, 0.48, G.ped, 0, 0, STONE, ink);
  flush(g, ink);
  const built = (look.course + look.laid / look.blocks) * G.seg;
  scaffold(g, G.cx - G.base / 2, G.cy - G.base / 2, G.base, G.base, G.ped + built + 6, true);
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(look.course, G.n); i++) obeliskShaft(g, G, i * G.seg, G.seg, STONE, ink);
  if (look.course < G.n && look.laid > 0) {
    const per = G.seg / look.blocks, settled = newest ? look.laid - 1 : look.laid;
    if (settled > 0) obeliskShaft(g, G, look.course * G.seg, settled * per, STONE, ink);
    flush(g, ink);
    if (newest) obeliskShaft(g, G, look.course * G.seg + settled * per, per, STONE, ink, newest);
  }
  flush(g, ink);
  scaffold(g, G.cx - G.base / 2, G.cy - G.base / 2, G.base, G.base, G.ped + built + 6, false);
  return null;
}
```

```js
export function obeliskFinished(g, x, y, type) {
  const G = obeliskGeom(type, x, y), ink = inkFor();
  const P = slab(g, G.cx - 0.24, G.cy - 0.24, 0.48, 0.48, G.ped, 0, 0, STONE, ink);
  flush(g, ink);
  qd(g, P.L, 0, 1, 1.2, 2.2, TEAL); qd(g, P.R, 0, 1, 1.2, 2.2, TEAL_DARK);
  const F = obeliskShaft(g, G, 0, G.L.shaft, STONE, ink);
  flush(g, ink);
  for (const s of [G.L.shaft * 0.62, G.L.shaft * 0.84]) {                  // painted bands
    qd(g, F.L, 0, 1, s, s + 1, TEAL); qd(g, F.R, 0, 1, s, s + 1, TEAL_DARK);
  }
  qd(g, F.L, 0, 1, G.L.shaft * 0.84 + 1, G.L.shaft * 0.84 + 1.8, RED); qd(g, F.R, 0, 1, G.L.shaft * 0.84 + 1, G.L.shaft * 0.84 + 1.8, RED, { alpha: 0.75 });
  const glyphs = [];
  for (let s = 4; s < G.L.shaft * 0.58; s += 3.2) glyphs.push(['M', F.L(0.35, s)], ['L', F.L(0.65, s + 0.6)]);
  g.stroke(glyphs, '#9C8C9E', 0.5, 0.55);                                    // a column of carved signs
  const top = G.ped + G.L.shaft, hw = G.topW / 2, tipH = G.L.height - top;
  const a = U(p(G.cx - hw, G.cy + hw), top), b = U(p(G.cx + hw, G.cy + hw), top), c = U(p(G.cx + hw, G.cy - hw), top), t = U(p(G.cx, G.cy), top + tipH);
  const gilded = MONUMENTS[type].extra && MONUMENTS[type].extra.kind === 'gilding';
  g.poly([a, b, t], gilded ? GOLDC[1] : STONE[1]);
  g.poly([b, c, t], gilded ? GOLDC[2] : STONE[2]);
  g.line(b, t, gilded ? '#FFF4C8' : '#FFFFFF', 0.6, 0.9);
  return { apex: t, cap: gilded ? [a, b, c] : null };
}

// ── the colossus: a seated king facing +y, built of blocks so a site shows it rising course by course ──

// Each part: [x, y, w, d, z, h], in a 2x2 footprint's tiles and art px, back to front.
const COLOSSUS = [
  [0.22, 0.2, 1.56, 1.6, 0, 9],         // 0 the plinth
  [0.6, 0.5, 0.8, 0.32, 9, 23],         // 1 the throne's back
  [0.72, 0.82, 0.56, 0.6, 9, 11],       // 2 the lap and shins
  [0.76, 0.66, 0.48, 0.3, 20, 15],      // 3 the body
  [0.64, 0.86, 0.12, 0.5, 20, 3.4],     // 4 the left forearm on the knee
  [1.24, 0.86, 0.12, 0.5, 20, 3.4],     // 5 the right forearm
  [0.76, 0.62, 0.48, 0.36, 33, 10],     // 6 the head in its headcloth
  [0.95, 0.98, 0.1, 0.08, 30, 5],       // 7 the beard
  [0.84, 0.68, 0.32, 0.24, 43, 2.6],    // 8 the gold band of the crown
];
const colossusZ = (type, look) => MONUMENT_LOOK[type].height * (look.course + look.laid / look.blocks) / look.n;

// The parts overlap on screen, so each part's edges are stroked as it is drawn.
function colossusSite(g, x, y, look, newest) {
  const H = MONUMENT_LOOK[look.type].height, Z = colossusZ(look.type, look), per = H / look.n / look.blocks;
  const Zs = newest ? Math.max(0, Z - per) : Z;                              // the newest block's slab fades in on top
  const ink = inkFor();
  scaffold(g, x + 0.5, y + 0.42, 1.0, 1.0, Math.min(H, Z) + 6, true);
  for (const [px, py, pw, pd, z, h] of COLOSSUS) {
    if (z < Zs) {
      const hh = Math.min(h, Zs - z), F = slab(g, x + px, y + py, pw, pd, hh, z, 0, SANDSTONE, ink);
      if (hh > 8) ink.joint.push(['M', F.L(0, 8)], ['L', F.L(1, 8)]);
      flush(g, ink);
    }
    const lo = Math.max(z, Zs), hi = Math.min(z + h, Z);
    if (newest && hi > lo) alphaBox(g, x + px, y + py, pw, pd, hi - lo, lo + newest.drop, SANDSTONE, newest.alpha);
  }
  scaffold(g, x + 0.5, y + 0.42, 1.0, 1.0, Math.min(H, Z) + 6, false);
  return null;
}

export function colossusFinished(g, x, y) {
  const ink = inkFor();
  const parts = COLOSSUS.map(([px, py, pw, pd, z, h], i) => {
    const F = slab(g, x + px, y + py, pw, pd, h, z, i === 6 ? -0.02 : 0, i === 0 ? STONE : i === 8 ? GOLDC : SANDSTONE, ink);
    flush(g, ink);
    return F;
  });
  const [P, Th, , Tr, , , Hc] = parts;
  qd(g, P.L, 0, 1, 2.6, 4.4, TEAL); qd(g, P.R, 0, 1, 2.6, 4.4, TEAL_DARK);
  qd(g, P.L, 0, 1, 7.8, 9, GOLD); qd(g, P.R, 0, 1, 7.8, 9, GOLDC[2]);
  qd(g, P.L, 0.36, 0.64, 5, 7, BLUE, { alpha: 0.75 });                       // the king's name on the plinth
  qd(g, Th.R, 0, 1, 15, 17.4, BLUE, { alpha: 0.8 });
  qd(g, Tr.L, 0, 1, 11.4, 15, GOLD);                                         // the gold collar
  for (let s = 1; s < 11; s += 2.4) {                                        // the headcloth's blue stripes
    qd(g, Hc.L, 0, 0.24, s, s + 1.1, BLUE); qd(g, Hc.L, 0.76, 1, s, s + 1.1, BLUE);
    qd(g, Hc.R, 0, 1, s, s + 1.1, BLUE, { alpha: 0.85 });
  }
  qd(g, Hc.L, 0.3, 0.7, 1.2, 8.6, SANDSTONE[1]);                             // the face
  qd(g, Hc.L, 0.36, 0.46, 5.4, 6.4, DOOR); qd(g, Hc.L, 0.54, 0.64, 5.4, 6.4, DOOR);
  qd(g, Hc.L, 0.44, 0.56, 2.4, 3, RED, { alpha: 0.7 });
  return { apex: U(p(x + 1, y + 0.8), 45), cap: null };
}

// ── the scene ──

// The ground shadow, as tall as what stands now (at most 12 px, so it never reaches far over a neighbour).
function shadow(g, x, y, type, w, d, h) {
  const B = bodyOf(type, w, d);
  if (h > 0.5) groundShadow(g, x + B.x, y + B.y, B.w, B.d, Math.min(12, h));
}

// A site under way at (x, y), w x d (the building's own, rotation applied). `newest` is the newest block's
// { alpha, drop } while it fades in, or null. Returns the ramp's geometry (for the gangs), or null.
export function drawSite(g, x, y, w, d, look, newest = null) {
  const type = look.type, fam = MONUMENT_LOOK[type].family, B = bodyOf(type, w, d);
  apron(g, x, y, w, d);
  if (look.course > 0) shadow(g, x, y, type, w, d, builtHeight(type, look));   // once a whole course stands on the body
  const founded = look.course === 0;                                        // the stakes stand until the first course is laid
  if (founded) stakes(g, x, y, B, false);
  let r = null;
  if (fam === 'pyramid') r = pyramidSite(g, x, y, w, look, newest);
  else if (fam === 'mastaba') r = mastabaSite(g, x, y, w, d, look, newest);
  else if (fam === 'obelisk') r = obeliskSite(g, x, y, look, newest);
  else r = colossusSite(g, x, y, look, newest);
  if (founded) stakes(g, x, y, B, true);
  if (fam === 'obelisk') stockpile(g, x + 0.76, y + 0.36, look, 0.5);
  else if (fam === 'colossus') stockpile(g, x + 1.74, y + 0.36, look, 0.6);
  else stockpile(g, x + B.x + B.w + 0.05, y + d * 0.45, look, Math.min(1, B.x / 0.3));
  return r;
}

// The finished monument at (x, y), w x d. Returns { apex, cap } (art px): where the gold's shine and sparkle go
// (cap null: no gold to shine on).
export function drawFinished(g, x, y, w, d, type) {
  const fam = MONUMENT_LOOK[type].family;
  apron(g, x, y, w, d);
  shadow(g, x, y, type, w, d, MONUMENT_LOOK[type].height);
  if (fam === 'pyramid') return pyramidFinished(g, x, y, w, type);
  if (fam === 'mastaba') { mastabaFinished(g, x, y, w, d, type); return { apex: null, cap: null }; }
  if (fam === 'obelisk') return obeliskFinished(g, x, y, type);
  return colossusFinished(g, x, y);
}
```

```js
// Monuments drawn live (spec 5.7, rulings 182, 183, 209, 221, 246): sites course by course (blocks fading in, the ramp,
// sleds and gangs on game time, the stockpile, stakes and cords), finished monuments (casing, the gilded tip, the gold
// capstone and its one slow shine under Full), the course-done dust or still outline, and the see-through fade. Stage 4
// contract: Track 0 fixed the name and the renderer hook; Track B implements it and owns this file.
//
// The renderer (src/render/renderer.js) never caches a slot whose art entry has live: true (the seven monument kinds,
// src/render/art/monuments.js). In its depth-sorted pass it calls opts.live(g, o) for such an object, in art px with the
// art origin set (as opts.fire is), where o is { key, id, slot, def, x, y, b } and b the building. createUI passes
//   live: (g, o) => drawMonument(g, world, o.b, { now, timeDays, motion, ghost, selectedId })
// now: the frame's real-clock ms; timeDays: the sim's day plus the fraction since the last tick (gangs move on game time);
// motion: settings.motionLevel(); ghost: the placing ghost { type, x, y, w, d } or null; selectedId: the selected
// building's id or null (the monument fades to MONUMENT_PLACING.fadeBehind when either lies behind it).
// Budget: three sites within 1 ms a frame on the stress city (spec 5.7).
//
// What moves, by Motion level (spec 5.4): the newest block fades in and settles 3 px over 400 ms under Full, fades in place
// over 200 ms under Gentle, and appears at once under Still. A monument finished while on screen gets one slow shine
// across its gold and a short sparkle under Full, and a still outline for a moment under Gentle and Still. The scene
// itself is a pure function of the building (src/render/art/monuments.js); the only state kept here is what the draw saw
// last of each site (its blocks and course, and when they changed), outside the world, so a reload shows the same scene
// with nothing fading.
import { ART } from './art/registry.js';
import { makeDraw } from './art/ctx.js';
import { siteLook, drawSite, drawFinished, builtHeight, bodyOf, MONUMENT_LOOK, CASING, CORE } from './art/monuments.js';
import { GOLD, GOLDC, UI } from './art/palette.js';
import { p, U, depthKey } from './iso.js';
import { MONUMENT_PLACING } from '../data/monuments.js';
import { BUILDINGS } from '../data/buildings.js';

export const FADE_MS = { full: 400, gentle: 200 };   // the newest block's fade, by Motion level (Still: none)
export const SETTLE_PX = 3;                          // how far a new block settles under Full
export const SHINE_MS = 2400;                        // the one slow shine across the gold, Full only
export const SPARKLE_MS = 1500;
export const OUTLINE_MS = 1500;                      // the still outline for a moment, Gentle and Still

const seen = new WeakMap();   // world -> Map<id, { blocks, course, done, blockAt, courseAt, doneAt, lastCourse }>

// What the draw saw of a site last frame, updated with what it shows now: when its newest block, its last course and its
// finish appeared (real ms; -Infinity for what was already there when the draw first met it).
export function siteMemo(world, b, look, now) {
  let byId = seen.get(world);
  if (!byId) { byId = new Map(); seen.set(world, byId); }
  const blocks = look.course * 100000 + look.laid;
  let m = byId.get(b.id);
  if (!m) {
    m = { blocks, course: look.course, done: look.done, blockAt: -Infinity, courseAt: -Infinity, doneAt: -Infinity, lastCourse: -1 };
    byId.set(b.id, m);
    return m;
  }
  if (blocks > m.blocks && look.laid > 0) m.blockAt = now;
  if (look.course > m.course && !look.done) { m.courseAt = now; m.lastCourse = look.course - 1; }
  if (look.done && !m.done) m.doneAt = now;
  m.blocks = blocks; m.course = look.course; m.done = look.done;
  return m;
}

// The newest block's fade, or null once it has settled (or at once under Still).
export function newestBlock(m, now, motion) {
  const dur = FADE_MS[motion];
  if (!dur) return null;
  const age = now - m.blockAt;
  if (!(age >= 0 && age < dur)) return null;
  const t = age / dur;
  return { alpha: t, drop: motion === 'full' ? SETTLE_PX * (1 - t) * (1 - t) : 0 };
}

// The monument's box on the map in art px [left, top, right, bottom], tall enough for what stands now and its marks.
export function monumentBounds(b, look = siteLook(b)) {
  const h = builtHeight(b.type, look);
  return [p(b.x, b.y + b.d)[0] - 12, p(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2)[1] - h - 30, p(b.x + b.w, b.y)[0] + 12, p(b.x + b.w, b.y + b.d)[1] + 6];
}

// The roof a problem marker's stem stands on: the top of what stands now, over the footprint's middle (art px).
export function monumentTop(b) {
  return U(p(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2), builtHeight(b.type, siteLook(b)));
}

// Whether a building or ghost { type, x, y, w, d } lies behind the monument: drawn before it (a smaller depth key) and
// overlapping it on screen.
export function liesBehind(o, b, look = siteLook(b)) {
  if (!o || depthKey(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.d) >= depthKey(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d)) return false;
  const def = ART[o.type] || null, oh = MONUMENT_LOOK[o.type] ? MONUMENT_LOOK[o.type].height : def ? def.height : 20;
  const ol = p(o.x, o.y + o.d)[0], or = p(o.x + o.w, o.y)[0], ot = p(o.x, o.y)[1] - oh, ob = p(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.d)[1];
  const [ml, mt, mr, mb] = monumentBounds(b, look);
  return ol < mr && or > ml && ot < mb && ob > mt;
}

// Whether the monument fades: the ghost or the selected building lies behind it.
export function fadesBehind(world, b, ghost, selectedId, look = siteLook(b)) {
  if (ghost && liesBehind(ghost, b, look)) return true;
  if (selectedId === null || selectedId === undefined || selectedId === b.id) return false;
  const s = world.buildings[selectedId];
  return Boolean(s) && liesBehind(s, b, look);
}

let layer = null;   // one scratch canvas for the see-through fade, reused

// Draws `draw(g)` through a layer at `alpha`, so the faded monument's own faces never show through one another.
function throughLayer(g, alpha, bounds, draw) {
  const s = g.scale, [l, t, r, bt] = bounds;
  const W = Math.ceil((r - l) * s) + 2, H = Math.ceil((bt - t) * s) + 2;
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || W <= 0 || H <= 0 || W * H > 16e6) { draw(g); return; }
  if (!layer) layer = document.createElement('canvas');
  if (layer.width < W) layer.width = W;
  if (layer.height < H) layer.height = H;
  const lc = layer.getContext('2d');
  lc.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  lc.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  lc.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 1 - l * s, 1 - t * s);
  draw(makeDraw(lc, s, g.cssScale));
  const ctx = g.ctx;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.drawImage(layer, 0, 0, W, H, l * s - 1, t * s - 1, W, H);
  ctx.restore();
}
```

```js
// The one slow shine: a pale band crossing the gold from left to right over SHINE_MS (t 0..1).
function shine(g, mark, t) {
  if (!mark || !mark.cap) return;
  const [a, b2, c] = mark.cap, apex = mark.apex;
  const xs = [a[0], c[0], apex[0]], left = Math.min(...xs) - 3, right = Math.max(...xs) + 3;
  const x = left + (right - left) * t, top = apex[1] - 2, bottom = Math.max(a[1], b2[1], c[1]) + 2;
  g.save();
  g.clip([a, b2, c, apex]);
  g.poly([[x - 2.4, bottom], [x + 0.4, bottom], [x + 2.4, top], [x - 0.4, top]], '#FFFDF2', { alpha: 0.75 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t) });
  g.restore();
}

// A short sparkle round the top: four-pointed glints, gold-edged, growing and fading once (t 0..1).
function sparkle(g, apex, t) {
  const k = Math.sin(Math.PI * t);
  for (const [dx, dy, r] of [[-9, 2, 3.2], [8, -4, 4], [-3, -10, 2.8], [10, 7, 2.4]]) {
    const c = [apex[0] + dx, apex[1] + dy], R = r * k;
    const star = [[c[0], c[1] - R * 1.6], [c[0] + R * 0.35, c[1] - R * 0.35], [c[0] + R * 1.6, c[1]], [c[0] + R * 0.35, c[1] + R * 0.35],
      [c[0], c[1] + R * 1.6], [c[0] - R * 0.35, c[1] + R * 0.35], [c[0] - R * 1.6, c[1]], [c[0] - R * 0.35, c[1] - R * 0.35]];
    g.poly(star, '#FFF8DC', { alpha: k, stroke: GOLD, strokeWidth: 0.4, strokeAlpha: k });
  }
}

// The still outline for a moment: the monument's silhouette in white over gold, held still (Gentle and Still).
export function silhouette(b) {
  const look = siteLook(b), B = bodyOf(b.type, b.w, b.d), h = builtHeight(b.type, look);
  const x0 = b.x + B.x, y0 = b.y + B.y, x1 = x0 + B.w, y1 = y0 + B.d;
  if (MONUMENT_LOOK[b.type].family === 'pyramid' && look.done) {
    const apex = U(p((x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2), h);
    return [p(x0, y1), p(x1, y1), p(x1, y0), apex];
  }
  return [p(x0, y1), p(x1, y1), p(x1, y0), U(p(x1, y0), h), U(p(x0, y0), h), U(p(x0, y1), h)];
}
function outline(g, pts) {
  g.poly(pts, 'none', { stroke: UI.halo, strokeWidth: 2, strokeAlpha: 0.9 });
  g.poly(pts, 'none', { stroke: GOLD, strokeWidth: 0.9, strokeAlpha: 1 });
}

// The scene of one monument, without the see-through fade.
function drawScene(g, world, b, look, { now, motion }) {
  const m = siteMemo(world, b, look, now);
  if (look.done) {
    const mark = drawFinished(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, b.type);
    const age = now - m.doneAt;
    if (motion === 'full') {
      if (age >= 0 && age < SHINE_MS) shine(g, mark, age / SHINE_MS);
      if (age >= 0 && age < SPARKLE_MS && mark && mark.apex) sparkle(g, mark.apex, age / SPARKLE_MS);
    } else if (age >= 0 && age < OUTLINE_MS) outline(g, silhouette(b));
    return { look, memo: m, ramp: null };
  }
  const ramp = drawSite(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, look, newestBlock(m, now, motion));
  return { look, memo: m, ramp };
}

export function drawMonument(g, world, b, { now = 0, timeDays = 0, motion = 'full', ghost = null, selectedId = null } = {}) {
  if (!b || !b.site && !MONUMENT_LOOK[b.type]) return;
  const look = siteLook(b);
  const opts = { now, timeDays, motion };
  if (fadesBehind(world, b, ghost, selectedId, look)) throughLayer(g, MONUMENT_PLACING.fadeBehind, monumentBounds(b, look), (lg) => drawScene(lg, world, b, look, opts));
  else drawScene(g, world, b, look, opts);
}

// ── the minimap glyph (spec 5.7 item 2: "A minimap glyph marks each"); Track C's minimap calls it for a monument ──

// Draws a monument's glyph on the minimap's context, at the building's place, `scale` device px a tile: a pyramid's
// white triangle with a gold tip, an obelisk's tall bar, a mastaba's bench, the colossus's seated block; a site under way
// in sandstone with a dark edge. At least 5 device px across, centred on the footprint.
export function minimapGlyph(ctx, b, scale, dpr = 1) {
  const fam = MONUMENT_LOOK[b.type] ? MONUMENT_LOOK[b.type].family : null;
  if (!fam) return;
  const done = siteLook(b).done, min = 5 * dpr;
  const w = Math.max(min, b.w * scale), d = Math.max(min, b.d * scale);
  const cx = (b.x + b.w / 2) * scale, cy = (b.y + b.d / 2) * scale, x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = cy - d / 2;
  const fill = done ? CASING[0] : CORE[1], edge = done ? '#6E5E70' : '#7A5E44';
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, dpr);
  ctx.strokeStyle = edge;
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  ctx.beginPath();
  if (fam === 'pyramid') { ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 + d); ctx.lineTo(x0 + w, y0 + d); ctx.lineTo(cx, y0); ctx.closePath(); }
  else if (fam === 'obelisk') { const bw = Math.max(3 * dpr, w * 0.4); ctx.rect(cx - bw / 2, y0 - d * 0.3, bw, d * 1.3); }
  else if (fam === 'mastaba') { ctx.rect(x0, y0 + d * 0.3, w, d * 0.7); ctx.rect(x0 + w * 0.2, y0, w * 0.6, d * 0.3); }
  else { ctx.rect(x0 + w * 0.15, y0 + d * 0.35, w * 0.7, d * 0.65); ctx.rect(cx - w * 0.15, y0, w * 0.3, d * 0.35); }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fill();                                              // over the stroke's inner half, so a small glyph keeps its colour
  if (done && (fam === 'pyramid' || b.type === 'obelisk_large')) {
    ctx.fillStyle = GOLDC[0];
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (fam === 'pyramid') { ctx.moveTo(cx - w * 0.14, y0 + d * 0.28); ctx.lineTo(cx + w * 0.14, y0 + d * 0.28); ctx.lineTo(cx, y0); }
    else { const bw = Math.max(3 * dpr, w * 0.4); ctx.moveTo(cx - bw / 2, y0 - d * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(cx + bw / 2, y0 - d * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(cx, y0 - d * 0.6); }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// Whether a building type is a monument drawn live (its art slot has live: true).
export const isLiveMonument = (type) => Boolean(ART[type] && ART[type].live && BUILDINGS[type] && BUILDINGS[type].monument);
```

```js
// ── Track B: the monument scenes ──

// A great pyramid at monumentSpot, its site written to the contract's shapes (b.site: course, laid, stock, crews), a road
// along its front, and full builders' guilds on free desert beyond the road (as many as fit, at most `guilds`), whose
// ids are its crews, as a site under way would have them. The sample city starts paused, so the scene stays as set.
export function pyramidScene(world, { course, frac = 0, stock = { stone: 120, bricks: 40 }, guilds = 4 } = {}) {
  const s = monumentSpot(world), N = world.size;
  const b = insertBuilding(world, makeBuilding(world, 'pyramid_great', s.x, s.y));
  const front = s.y + s.n;
  for (let x = s.x - 1; x <= s.x + s.n; x++) world.road[idx(N, x, front)] = 1;
  world.roadVersion++;
  const crews = [], free = (x, y) => freeLand(world, x, y) && !world.road[idx(N, x, y)];
  for (let x = s.x - 1; x + 1 <= s.x + s.n && crews.length < guilds; x += 2) {
    if (![0, 1].every((dx) => [1, 2].every((dy) => free(x + dx, front + dy)))) continue;
    const g = insertBuilding(world, makeBuilding(world, 'builders_guild', x, front + 1));
    g.staff = BUILDINGS.builders_guild.workers;
    crews.push(g.id);
  }
  const c = MONUMENTS.pyramid_great.courses[Math.min(course, MONUMENTS.pyramid_great.courses.length - 1)];
  Object.assign(b.site, { course, laid: { stone: c.stone * frac, bricks: c.bricks * frac }, stock: { ...stock }, crews, idle: 0, reason: null });
  return b;
}

// A great pyramid's site part built (review note 3.3): the paved apron, stockpiled blocks, five courses laid and the
// sixth half laid, the ramp up the front, the guilds' crews at work; framed whole at zoom 0.75.
async function site(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'site');
  const b = pyramidScene(g.world, { course: 5, frac: 0.55 });
  g.cam.zoom = 0.75;
  focus(g, b.x + b.w / 2 - 0.8, b.y + b.d / 2 - 0.8);
  await wait(200);
  return `site ${b.x},${b.y} course ${b.site.course} crews ${b.site.crews.length}`;
}

// A pyramid course going up, framed close at zoom 1.5 on the course under way: blocks laid row by row, the ramp landing
// on it, the gangs and the masons (review note 3.3).
async function pyramid(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'pyramid');
  const b = pyramidScene(g.world, { course: 8, frac: 0.6, stock: { stone: 160, bricks: 120 } });
  g.cam.zoom = 1.5;
  focus(g, b.x + b.w / 2 - 2.2, b.y + b.d / 2 - 2.2);
  await wait(200);
  return `pyramid ${b.x},${b.y} course ${b.site.course}`;
}

// A great pyramid's capstone set: its last course is laid on screen, then a second later it is finished (course 12,
// done today, its crews gone), so the capture, 1.8 s after the scene, falls in the one slow shine and the sparkle under
// Full and in the still outline under Gentle. Framed whole at zoom 1.
async function capstone(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'capstone'), { world } = g;
  const b = pyramidScene(world, { course: 11, frac: 0.98, stock: { stone: 0, bricks: 0 } });
  g.cam.zoom = 1;
  focus(g, b.x + b.w / 2 - 1.2, b.y + b.d / 2 - 1.2);
  setTimeout(() => {
    Object.assign(b.site, { course: MONUMENTS.pyramid_great.courses.length, laid: { stone: 0, bricks: 0 }, crews: [], done: world.day, extraPaid: true });
  }, 1000);
  await wait(200);
  return `capstone ${b.x},${b.y}`;
}
```

```js
import { drawMonument, gangLayout, isWorking, siteMemo, monumentTop, GANG, DUST_MS, OUTLINE_MS } from '../../../src/render/monuments.js';

import { createCamera, artToScreen } from '../../../src/render/camera.js';
import { UI } from '../../../src/render/art/palette.js';
import { MONUMENTS } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { makeBuilding, insertBuilding, newSite } from '../../../src/sim/world.js';
import { makeTestWorld, addRaw, setRoad } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { makeCanvas, canvasHash, hexToRgb } from '../../helpers/canvas.js';

function drawAt(fn, w = 520, h = 400, ox = 260, oy = 150) {
  const c = makeCanvas(w, h);
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.translate(ox, oy);
  fn(makeDraw(ctx, 2, 2));
  return c;
}
const countNear = (c, hex, tol = 10) => {
  const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(hex), d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data;
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i + 3] >= 250 && Math.abs(d[i] - r) <= tol && Math.abs(d[i + 1] - g) <= tol && Math.abs(d[i + 2] - b) <= tol) n++;
  return n;
};
function siteIn(w, type, x, y, { course = 0, frac = 0, crews = [], reason = null, paused = false, done = null } = {}) {
  const b = insertBuilding(w, makeBuilding(w, type, x, y));
  const c = MONUMENTS[type].courses[Math.min(course, MONUMENTS[type].courses.length - 1)];
  Object.assign(b.site, { course, laid: { stone: c.stone * frac, bricks: c.bricks * frac }, stock: { stone: 40, bricks: 20 }, crews, reason, done });
  b.paused = paused;
  return b;
}
// The ramp a site draws (its geometry), for the gangs.
const rampOf = (b) => drawSite(makeDraw(makeCanvas(4, 4).getContext('2d'), 1), b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, siteLook(b));

describe('s4 art monument gangs', () => {
  it('hauls one sled with four haulers a crew up the ramp and back on game time, masons swinging at the course', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const b = siteIn(w, 'pyramid_great', 4, 4, { course: 6, frac: 0.5, crews: [1, 2, 3] });
    const look = siteLook(b), ramp = rampOf(b);
    expect(isWorking(b, look)).toBe(true);
    const a = gangLayout(b, look, ramp, 10), later = gangLayout(b, look, ramp, 11);
    expect([a.working, a.sleds.length, a.people.length, a.masons.length]).toEqual([true, 3, 3 * GANG.haulers, 2]);
    expect(a.people.every((m) => m.pose === 'pull') && a.masons.every((m) => m.pose === 'mallet')).toBe(true);
    expect(JSON.stringify(gangLayout(b, look, ramp, 10))).toBe(JSON.stringify(a));     // the same day, the same scene
    expect(JSON.stringify(later.sleds) !== JSON.stringify(a.sleds)).toBe(true);        // a day later they have moved
    for (const s of a.sleds) expect(s.q[0] >= ramp.xf - 1e-9 && s.q[0] <= ramp.xt + 1e-9 && s.z >= 0 && s.z <= ramp.z1).toBe(true);
    const loads = new Set();                                                            // up loaded, down empty, out of step
    for (let t = 0; t < GANG.tripDays; t += 0.25) for (const s of gangLayout(b, look, ramp, t).sleds) loads.add(s.loaded);
    expect([...loads].sort()).toEqual([false, true]);
    expect(new Set(a.sleds.map((s) => s.q[0].toFixed(3))).size).toBe(3);
  });

  it('moves under every Motion level (gangs are walkers), and holds still while the game is paused', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const b = siteIn(w, 'mastaba_large', 4, 4, { course: 2, frac: 0.4, crews: [1, 2] });
    const at = (motion, timeDays) => canvasHash(drawAt((g) => drawMonument(g, w, b, { now: 99999, timeDays, motion }), 520, 400, 260, 60));
    for (const motion of ['full', 'gentle', 'still']) {
      expect([motion, at(motion, 20) !== at(motion, 20.5)]).toEqual([motion, true]);
      expect([motion, at(motion, 20)]).toEqual([motion, at(motion, 20)]);              // paused: timeDays stands, so do they
    }
  });

  it('parks the sleds at the ramp\'s foot with the haulers standing by when the site does no work', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const stalled = siteIn(w, 'pyramid_great', 4, 4, { course: 6, frac: 0.5, crews: [1, 2], reason: 'no_stone' });
    const L = siteLook(stalled), ramp = rampOf(stalled), a = gangLayout(stalled, L, ramp, 10);
    expect([isWorking(stalled, L), a.working, a.people.length, a.people.every((m) => m.pose === 'rest'), a.masons.every((m) => m.pose === 'rest')]).toEqual([false, false, 2 * GANG.haulers, true, true]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(gangLayout(stalled, L, ramp, 13.7))).toBe(JSON.stringify(a)); // idle: nothing moves
    expect(a.sleds.every((s) => !s.loaded && s.q[0] - ramp.xf < (ramp.xt - ramp.xf) * 0.2)).toBe(true);
    const paused = siteIn(w, 'pyramid_small', 20, 4, { course: 3, crews: [], paused: true });   // pausing sends the crews away
    const p = gangLayout(paused, siteLook(paused), rampOf(paused), 10);
    expect([p.sleds.length, p.people.length, p.masons.length, p.sleds[0].loaded]).toEqual([1, 0, 0, false]);
    const done = siteIn(w, 'colossus', 4, 20, { course: 6, done: 12, crews: [] });
    expect(isWorking(done)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('works along the apron before the first course and round the scaffold of an obelisk or the colossus', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    for (const [type, course] of [['pyramid_great', 0], ['obelisk_large', 2], ['colossus', 3]]) {
      const b = siteIn(w, type, 4 + 8 * ['pyramid_great', 'obelisk_large', 'colossus'].indexOf(type), 4, { course, frac: 0.3, crews: [1, 2] });
      const look = siteLook(b), spots = workSpots(type, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, look), lay = gangLayout(b, look, rampOf(b), 7);
      expect([type, rampOf(b), lay.people.length, lay.sleds.every((s) => s.z === 0)]).toEqual([type, null, 2 * GANG.haulers, true]);
      for (const s of lay.sleds) expect([type, s.q[0] >= spots.path.x0 - 1e-9 && s.q[0] <= spots.path.x1 + 1e-9, s.q[1]]).toEqual([type, true, spots.path.y]);
    }
  });

  it('raises a dust puff along a course laid under Full, a still outline under Gentle and Still, then nothing', () => {
    const shot = (motion, after) => {
      const w = makeTestWorld();
      const b = siteIn(w, 'pyramid_small', 4, 4, { course: 3, frac: 0.99 });
      drawAt((g) => drawMonument(g, w, b, { now: 0, motion }));
      Object.assign(b.site, { course: 4, laid: { stone: 0, bricks: 0 } });
      drawAt((g) => drawMonument(g, w, b, { now: 100, motion }));
      expect(siteMemo(w, b, siteLook(b), 100 + after).lastCourse).toBe(3);
      return drawAt((g) => drawMonument(g, w, b, { now: 100 + after, motion }));
    };
    const fresh = (() => { const w = makeTestWorld(); const b = siteIn(w, 'pyramid_small', 4, 4, { course: 4 }); return drawAt((g) => drawMonument(g, w, b, { now: 0, motion: 'full' })); })();
    expect(canvasHash(shot('full', DUST_MS / 2)) !== canvasHash(fresh)).toBe(true);
    expect(canvasHash(shot('full', DUST_MS + 1))).toBe(canvasHash(fresh));
    for (const motion of ['gentle', 'still']) {
      expect([motion, countNear(shot(motion, OUTLINE_MS / 2), '#E2B13C', 8) > countNear(fresh, '#E2B13C', 8) + 20]).toEqual([motion, true]);
      expect([motion, canvasHash(shot(motion, OUTLINE_MS + 1)) === canvasHash(fresh)]).toEqual([motion, true]);
    }
    const edge = courseTop('pyramid_small', 4, 4, 4, 4, 3);
    expect([edge.length, edge[1][1] > edge[0][1], edge[1][1] > edge[2][1]]).toEqual([3, true, true]);   // the front corner is lowest on screen
  });

  it('draws a record that is not in the world from itself (the placing silhouette), and keeps no state by id', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const ghost = { id: -1, type: 'pyramid_great', x: 4, y: 4, w: 7, d: 7, rot: 0, paused: false, site: { ...newSite(), course: 12, done: 0 } };
    const c = drawAt((g) => drawMonument(g, w, ghost, { motion: 'still' }));
    expect(canvasHash(c)).toBe(canvasHash(drawAt((g) => drawFinished(g, 4, 4, 7, 7, 'pyramid_great'))));
    const twin = { ...ghost, site: { ...ghost.site } };
    expect(siteMemo(w, twin, siteLook(twin), 5) !== siteMemo(w, ghost, siteLook(ghost), 5)).toBe(true);
  });
```

```js
describe('s4 art pinned markers', () => {
  const view = { width: 390, height: 844 };
  const camOn = (x, y, zoom = 1) => createCamera({ x, y, zoom });

  it('pins a badge on a stem of at least 10 px to the roof of its own building, the road mark when it has no road', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const well = addRaw(w, 'well', 10, 10), pot = addRaw(w, 'potter', 14, 14);
    const cam = camOn(12, 12);
    const layout = layoutMarkers(w, [{ code: 'no_road', id: well.id }, { code: 'understaffed', id: pot.id }], cam, view);
    expect(layout.map((m) => [m.ids, m.glyph, m.tone, m.count])).toEqual([[[well.id], 'road', 'problem', 1], [[pot.id], '!', 'problem', 1]]);
    for (const m of layout) {
      const b = w.buildings[m.ids[0]], roof = roofOf(b), [fx, fy] = artToScreen(cam, view, roof[0], roof[1]);
      expect([Math.abs(m.foot.x - fx) < 1e-9, Math.abs(m.foot.y - fy) < 1e-9, m.x, m.r >= 10, m.foot.y - (m.y + m.r) >= MARKER.stem - 1e-9]).toEqual([true, true, m.foot.x, true, true]);
    }
    expect(layoutMarkers(w, [], cam, view)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('never overlaps two badges: the one further back stands on a longer stem; more than three in one place merge', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const back = addRaw(w, 'well', 10, 10), front = addRaw(w, 'well', 11, 11);    // one behind the other on screen, zoomed out
    const cam = camOn(11, 11, 0.5);
    const two = layoutMarkers(w, [{ code: 'no_road', id: back.id }, { code: 'no_road', id: front.id }], cam, view);
    expect(two.map((m) => m.ids[0])).toEqual([back.id, front.id]);                // back first: the front is drawn last, asked first
    const [b, f] = two, stem = (m) => m.foot.y - m.y;
    expect(Math.hypot(b.x - f.x, b.y - f.y) >= 2 * MARKER.r).toBe(true);
    expect(stem(b)).toBeGreaterThan(stem(f));
    expect(markerAt(two, f.x, f.y).ids).toEqual([front.id]);
    const crowd = [12, 13, 14, 15].map((k) => addRaw(w, 'well', k, k));            // six wells in a diagonal row, zoomed out
    const all = [back, front, ...crowd].map((x) => ({ code: 'no_road', id: x.id }));
    const far = layoutMarkers(w, all, camOn(12, 12, 0.5), view);
    const merged = far.find((m) => m.count > 1);
    expect(Boolean(merged)).toBe(true);
    expect([merged.count, merged.ids]).toEqual([4, [crowd[3].id, crowd[2].id, crowd[1].id, crowd[0].id]]);   // front first
    expect(far.filter((m) => m.count === 1).map((m) => m.ids[0]).sort()).toEqual([back.id, front.id].sort());
    for (let i = 0; i < far.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < far.length; j++) expect(Math.hypot(far[i].x - far[j].x, far[i].y - far[j].y) >= 2 * MARKER.r).toBe(true);
  });

  it('marks a home about to lose a tier in amber with ↓, and stands a stalled site\'s stem on what is built', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const home = addRaw(w, 'house', 10, 10, { tier: 3, residents: 5, downTimer: 4 });
    setRoad(w, 9, 9, 9, 12);                                                      // a road beside it: the road would decide the mark
    const site = siteIn(w, 'pyramid_small', 14, 8, { course: 5, crews: [1], reason: 'no_stone' });
    const cam = camOn(13, 11);
    const layout = layoutMarkers(w, [{ code: 'site_stalled', id: site.id, reason: 'no_stone' }], cam, view);
    const h = layout.find((m) => m.ids[0] === home.id), s = layout.find((m) => m.ids[0] === site.id);
    expect([h.glyph, h.tone, s.glyph, s.tone]).toEqual(['down', 'warning', '!', 'problem']);
    const top = monumentTop(site), [, ty] = artToScreen(cam, view, top[0], top[1]);
    expect(Math.abs(s.foot.y - ty) < 1e-9).toBe(true);
    expect(roofOf(site)).toEqual(top);
    const lone = addRaw(w, 'house', 4, 20, { tier: 3, residents: 5, downTimer: 4 });   // no road: one marker, the road's
    const mine = layoutMarkers(w, [], camOn(4.5, 20.5), view).filter((m) => m.ids.includes(lone.id));
    expect(mine.map((m) => m.glyph)).toEqual(['road']);
  });

  it('draws the ring and wash on the footprint, the stem and roof dot, and the badge in the marker\'s colour', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const well = addRaw(w, 'well', 10, 10);
    const cam = camOn(10.5, 10.5);
    const v = { width: 300, height: 300 };
    const layout = layoutMarkers(w, [{ code: 'understaffed', id: well.id }], cam, v);
    const c = makeCanvas(300, 300), ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    const origin = artToScreen(cam, v, 0, 0);
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, origin[0], origin[1]);
    drawMarkers(makeDraw(ctx, 2, 2), w, [], { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 31, y1: 31 }, layout);
    const px = (x, y) => Array.from(c.getContext('2d').getImageData(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), 1, 1).data);
    const [r, g, b2] = hexToRgb(UI.problem), m = layout[0];
    const at = px(m.x, m.y + m.r * 0.6);
    expect(Math.abs(at[0] - r) < 12 && Math.abs(at[1] - g) < 12 && Math.abs(at[2] - b2) < 12).toBe(true);
    expect(countNear(c, UI.problem, 12)).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    const stem = px(m.x, (m.y + m.r + m.foot.y) / 2);
    expect(stem[3]).toBe(255);
    expect(slotFor(well)).toBe('well');
  });
});
```

```js
// A monument's gang (spec 5.7, rulings 182, 246): many small working figures in one go, each { q: [ax, ay] (its feet,
// art px), s (its scale), pose: 'pull' (leaning, arms forward to a rope) | 'mallet' (a mason, his mallet at `swing` 0..1)
// | 'rest' (standing by, arms down) }. Drawn as a few batched paths (shadows, legs, kilts, bodies, collars, arms, heads),
// so a site's dozen or more figures cost about what one walker does. Pass them back to front.
const SKIN = '#A0663F', HAIR = '#1E150E', KILT = '#F7F2E8';
export function gang(g, people) {
  if (!people.length) return;
  const shadows = [], legs = [], kilts = [], bodies = [], collars = [], arms = [], heads = [], mallets = [];
  for (const { q, s, pose = 'rest', swing = 0 } of people) {
    const [X, Y] = q, lean = pose === 'pull' ? 1.6 * s : 0;
    shadows.push([[X - 2.6 * s, Y], [X, Y - 1 * s], [X + 2.6 * s, Y], [X, Y + 1 * s]]);
    legs.push(['M', [X - 0.8 * s, Y]], ['L', [X - 0.8 * s + lean * 0.3, Y - 3.2 * s]], ['M', [X + 0.8 * s, Y]], ['L', [X + 0.8 * s + lean * 0.3, Y - 3.2 * s]]);
    kilts.push([[X - 1.8 * s + lean * 0.3, Y - 2.6 * s], [X + 1.8 * s + lean * 0.3, Y - 2.6 * s], [X + 1.4 * s + lean * 0.5, Y - 5.4 * s], [X - 1.4 * s + lean * 0.5, Y - 5.4 * s]]);
    bodies.push([[X - 1.4 * s + lean * 0.5, Y - 5.3 * s], [X + 1.4 * s + lean * 0.5, Y - 5.3 * s], [X + 1.6 * s + lean, Y - 8.2 * s], [X - 1.6 * s + lean, Y - 8.2 * s]]);
    collars.push(['M', [X - 1.4 * s + lean, Y - 8 * s]], ['L', [X + 1.4 * s + lean, Y - 8 * s]]);
    const hx = X + lean * 1.1, hy = Y - 9.8 * s;
    heads.push([[hx - 1.4 * s, hy], [hx - 1 * s, hy - 1.3 * s], [hx + 1 * s, hy - 1.3 * s], [hx + 1.4 * s, hy], [hx + 1 * s, hy + 1.3 * s], [hx - 1 * s, hy + 1.3 * s]]);
    if (pose === 'pull') arms.push(['M', [X + lean, Y - 7.6 * s]], ['L', [X + lean + 3.4 * s, Y - 5.6 * s]]);
    else if (pose === 'mallet') {
      const a = -0.9 + 1.5 * swing, hand = [X + 1.6 * s + Math.cos(a) * 2.4 * s, Y - 7.8 * s - Math.sin(a) * 2.4 * s];
      arms.push(['M', [X + 1.2 * s, Y - 7.6 * s]], ['L', hand]);
      mallets.push(['M', hand], ['L', [hand[0] + Math.cos(a + 0.6) * 3 * s, hand[1] - Math.sin(a + 0.6) * 3 * s]]);
    } else arms.push(['M', [X - 1.6 * s, Y - 7.8 * s]], ['L', [X - 2 * s, Y - 4.6 * s]], ['M', [X + 1.6 * s, Y - 7.8 * s]], ['L', [X + 2 * s, Y - 4.6 * s]]);
  }
  const s0 = people[0].s;
  g.polys(shadows, SHADOW, { alpha: 0.22 });
  g.stroke(legs, SKIN, 1 * s0);
  g.polys(kilts, KILT);
  g.polys(bodies, SKIN);
  g.stroke(collars, BLUE, 0.9 * s0);
  g.stroke(arms, SKIN, 0.8 * s0);
  if (mallets.length) g.stroke(mallets, WOOD, 1.1 * s0);
  g.polys(heads, HAIR);
}
```

```js
// ── where the work happens (Task B3: the gangs, the masons, the course-done dust) ──

// The top front edges of course i (left corner, front corner, right corner, art px): where its dust rises and its still
// outline runs. For a mastaba's facing course, the top tier's; for an obelisk, the shaft at that height; for the colossus,
// the plinth up to its top and the throne and lap above it.
export function courseTop(type, x, y, w, d, i) {
  const fam = MONUMENT_LOOK[type].family;
  let x0, y0, x1, y1, z;
  if (fam === 'pyramid') {
    const G = pyramidGeom(type, x, y, w), k = i * G.step;
    [x0, y0, x1, y1, z] = [G.bx + k, G.by + k, G.bx + G.side - k, G.by + G.side - k, (i + 1) * G.ch];
  } else if (fam === 'mastaba') {
    const G = mastabaGeom(type, x, y, w, d), t = Math.min(i, G.tiers - 1), [tx, ty, tw, td] = tier(G, t);
    [x0, y0, x1, y1, z] = [tx + 0.04, ty + 0.04, tx + tw - 0.04, ty + td - 0.04, (t + 1) * G.ch];
  } else if (fam === 'obelisk') {
    const G = obeliskGeom(type, x, y), zz = (i + 1) * G.seg, hw = shaftW(G, zz) / 2;
    [x0, y0, x1, y1, z] = [G.cx - hw, G.cy - hw, G.cx + hw, G.cy + hw, G.ped + zz];
  } else {
    const H = MONUMENT_LOOK[type].height, zz = (i + 1) * H / MONUMENTS[type].courses.length;
    [x0, y0, x1, y1] = zz <= COLOSSUS[0][5] ? [x + 0.22, y + 0.2, x + 1.78, y + 1.8] : [x + 0.6, y + 0.5, x + 1.4, y + 1.42];
    z = zz;
  }
  return [U(p(x0, y1), z), U(p(x1, y1), z), U(p(x1, y0), z)];
}

// Where a site's people work (tiles and art px): `masons` the spots where two masons stand at the course under way (by
// the edge of the blocks laid, on the course below; on the scaffold's top for an obelisk or the colossus), and `path`, the
// way the sleds go when there is no ramp yet (or never one): along the apron in front, { x0, x1, y, z }.
export function workSpots(type, x, y, w, d, look) {
  const fam = MONUMENT_LOOK[type].family;
  if (fam === 'obelisk' || fam === 'colossus') {
    const z = builtHeight(type, look) - 4, c = fam === 'obelisk' ? [x + 0.5, y + 0.5] : [x + 1, y + 1];
    return { masons: [[c[0] + 0.16, c[1] + 0.3, z], [c[0] + 0.32, c[1] + 0.1, z]], path: { x0: x + 0.1, x1: x + w * 0.62, y: y + d - 0.1, z: 0 } };
  }
  const path = { x0: x + 0.12, x1: x + w * 0.6, y: y + d - 0.14, z: 0 };
  let rect, z;
  if (fam === 'pyramid') {
    const G = pyramidGeom(type, x, y, w), c = Math.min(look.course, G.n - 1), k = c * G.step;
    rect = [G.bx + k, G.by + k, G.side - 2 * k, G.side - 2 * k]; z = c * G.ch;
  } else {
    const G = mastabaGeom(type, x, y, w, d), c = Math.min(look.course, G.tiers - 1);
    rect = tier(G, c); z = c * G.ch;
    if (look.course >= G.tiers) z = G.L.height;                               // the facing: on the top
  }
  const [cx, cy, cw, cd] = rect, N = look.blocks;
  const cols = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.sqrt((N * cw) / Math.max(0.01, cd)))), rows = Math.ceil(N / cols);
  const full = Math.floor(look.laid / cols), rem = look.laid - full * cols;
  const fx = cx + Math.min(cw - 0.1, Math.max(0.15, (rem + 0.5) * (cw / cols))), fy = cy + Math.min(cd - 0.08, (full + 1.4) * (cd / rows));
  return { masons: [[fx, fy, z], [Math.max(cx + 0.1, fx - 0.34), Math.min(cy + cd - 0.08, fy + 0.12), z]], path };
}
```

```js
// What the draw saw of a site last frame, updated with what it shows now: when its newest block, its last course and its
// finish appeared (real ms; -Infinity for what was already there when the draw first met it).
export function siteMemo(world, b, look, now) {

    byId.set(b.id, m);
    return m;
  }
  if (blocks > m.blocks && look.laid > 0) m.blockAt = now;
```

```js
export const GANG = {

  tripDays: 6,           // game days a sled takes up and back (4 s at 1x): up loaded for upShare of it, down empty
  upShare: 0.6,
  spacing: 0.16,         // tiles between the haulers in a file, and from the sled to the first pair

};

// finish appeared (real ms; -Infinity for what was already there when the draw first met it). Kept by the building record
// itself, never looked up by id: a loaded city has new records (so nothing fades after a reload), and a record that is not
// in the world at all (Track C's placing silhouette: id -1, every course laid) is drawn from itself alone.

  let m = seen.get(b);

    m = { blocks, course: look.course, done: look.done, blockAt: -Infinity, courseAt: -Infinity, doneAt: -Infinity, lastCourse: -1 };
    seen.set(b, m);
    return m;
  }
  if (blocks > m.blocks && look.laid > 0) m.blockAt = now;
```

```js
// Whether a site's crews are at work today: crews on it, not paused, not finished, and its last day was a working day
// (site.reason is null after a day of work, src/sim/monuments.js monumentDay).
export function isWorking(b, look = siteLook(b)) {
  return look.crews > 0 && !b.paused && !look.done && (b.site.reason === null || b.site.reason === undefined);
}

// The gangs: one sled and GANG.haulers haulers a crew, up the ramp (or along the apron before there is one) and back on
// game time, crews out of step; two masons a crew (at most four) at the course under way, swinging their mallets. A site
// that does no work keeps its sleds parked at the ramp's foot, its haulers standing by (and its masons at rest); with no
// crews, one empty sled stands there.
export function gangLayout(b, look, ramp, timeDays) {
  const spots = workSpots(b.type, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, look), working = isWorking(b, look);
  const way = ramp ? { x0: ramp.xf, x1: ramp.xt, y: (ramp.yo + ramp.yr) / 2, z0: 0, z1: ramp.z1 } : { ...spots.path, z0: 0, z1: 0 };
  const at = (t, side = 0) => U(p(way.x0 + (way.x1 - way.x0) * t, way.y + side), way.z0 + (way.z1 - way.z0) * t);
  const run = Math.max(0.05, Math.abs(way.x1 - way.x0)), dt = GANG.spacing / run;
  const sleds = [], people = [];
  const crews = look.crews, n = Math.max(1, crews);
  for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
    if (!working) {
      const t = Math.min(0.9, j * 0.12);                                      // parked at the foot, one behind another
      sleds.push({ q: [way.x0 + (way.x1 - way.x0) * t, way.y], z: way.z0 + (way.z1 - way.z0) * t, loaded: false });
      if (j < crews) for (let k = 0; k < GANG.haulers; k++) people.push({ q: at(Math.min(1, t + dt * (1 + (k >> 1))), (k % 2 ? 0.1 : -0.1) + 0.04), s: GANG.scale, pose: 'rest' });
      continue;
    }
    const phase = (((timeDays / GANG.tripDays + j / n) % 1) + 1) % 1, up = phase < GANG.upShare;
    const t = up ? phase / GANG.upShare : 1 - (phase - GANG.upShare) / (1 - GANG.upShare);
    const ahead = up ? 1 : -1, span = dt * (1 + GANG.haulers / 2);
    const ts = up ? Math.min(t, 1 - span) : Math.max(t, span);                // the sled, its haulers on the ramp ahead of it
    sleds.push({ q: [way.x0 + (way.x1 - way.x0) * ts, way.y], z: way.z0 + (way.z1 - way.z0) * ts, loaded: up });
    for (let k = 0; k < GANG.haulers; k++) {
      const tk = ts + ahead * dt * (1 + (k >> 1)), bob = Math.abs(Math.sin((timeDays * 3 + k * 0.37 + j * 0.21) * Math.PI)) * 0.8;
      const q = at(tk, k % 2 ? 0.08 : -0.08);
      people.push({ q: [q[0], q[1] - bob], s: GANG.scale, pose: 'pull' });
    }
  }
  const masons = [];
  if (!look.done && crews > 0) {
    for (let j = 0; j < Math.min(2, crews); j++) {
      const [mx, my, mz] = spots.masons[j];
      const swing = working ? Math.abs(Math.sin((timeDays * 2 + j * 0.5) * Math.PI)) : 0.2;
      masons.push({ q: U(p(mx, my), mz), s: GANG.scale, pose: working ? 'mallet' : 'rest', swing });
    }
  }
  return { working, sleds, people, masons };
}

// Draws the gangs of gangLayout: the masons (on the course, further back) first, then the sleds and their haulers.
function drawGangs(g, layout) {
  gang(g, layout.masons);
  for (const s of layout.sleds) {
    box(g, s.q[0] - 0.13, s.q[1] - 0.08, 0.26, 0.16, 1, s.z, ['#C9A26A', '#A8814E', '#86705E'], 0);
    if (s.loaded) box(g, s.q[0] - 0.09, s.q[1] - 0.06, 0.18, 0.12, 3.2, s.z + 1, STONE, 0);
  }
  gang(g, [...layout.people].sort((a, b) => a.q[1] - b.q[1]));
}

// The course-done dust (Full, t 0..1): soft puffs rising a little and fading along the course's top edges.
function dust(g, edge, t) {
  const [a, f, c] = edge, k = 1 - t;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
    const u = i / 8, q = u <= 0.5 ? [a[0] + (f[0] - a[0]) * u * 2, a[1] + (f[1] - a[1]) * u * 2] : [f[0] + (c[0] - f[0]) * (u - 0.5) * 2, f[1] + (c[1] - f[1]) * (u - 0.5) * 2];
    const r = 2.4 + 3.6 * t;
    g.ell([q[0], q[1] - 1 - 4 * t], r, r * 0.6, '#F1E3C4', { alpha: 0.55 * k });
  }
}

// The scene of one monument, without the see-through fade.
function drawScene(g, world, b, look, { now, timeDays, motion }) {
  const m = siteMemo(world, b, look, now);
  if (look.done) {
    const mark = drawFinished(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, b.type);
```

Replace the whole of `src/render/markers.js` (in 2 blocks; paste them one after another, in order, as one file). Block 1 of 2:

```js
// Problem markers pinned to their own buildings (spec 6.3, rulings 280, 281): a badge on a stem rising from a dot on the
// building's roof, a 2 px ring and faint wash on its footprint in the marker's colour, badges laid out so none overlaps
// (the one further back gets a longer stem; more than three in one place merge into a count badge with a ring on each
// footprint). Nothing pulses. Stage 4 contract: Track 0 fixed the names and the createUI wiring; Track B implements
// layoutMarkers and drawMarkers and owns this file; Track C owns what a tap on a marker does (createUI's tap seam and
// View's outline), reading the same layout.
//
// A marker, in the layout: { ids: [building ids, front first], x, y (the badge's centre, CSS px on screen), r (its radius,
// CSS px; at least 10), foot: { x, y } (the stem's foot on the roof, CSS px), glyph ('road' | '!' | 'down'), tone
// ('problem' | 'warning'), count (ids.length; more than one is a count badge) }.
//
// createUI lays the markers out once a frame after the camera moves (layoutMarkers(world, alerts, cam, view)), draws them
// in the overlay pass (drawMarkers(g, world, alerts, range, layout)) and, outside a tool, asks markerAt(layout, x, y) on
// every tap before it picks the building under the tap.
//
// Which buildings get one, and its mark, are Stage 3's rules (render/overlays.js problemMarkers: one per building with an
// alert, the road mark when it has no road, "↓" amber for a home about to lose a tier; roadlessPlotBadges: one road
// badge per group of plots with no road, each plot keeping its dashed amber outline). The layout is in the order to draw:
// back first, so the front badge is drawn last and asked first.
import { problemMarkers, roadlessPlots, roadlessPlotBadges } from './overlays.js';
import { artToScreen, visibleTileRange } from './camera.js';
import { makeDraw } from './art/ctx.js';
import { ART, slotFor } from './art/registry.js';
import { UI, INK } from './art/palette.js';
import { p, U, quad, depthKey } from './iso.js';
import { MONUMENT_LOOK } from './art/monuments.js';
import { monumentTop } from './monuments.js';

// The 44 px tap area round a badge and its stem (ruling 281): the half-width either side of the stem and the badge.
export const MARKER_TAP_PX = 22;
export const MARKER = {
  r: 11,          // the badge's radius, CSS px (22 across: P13's 20 at the least)
  stem: 10,       // the shortest stem, CSS px, from the roof dot to the badge's foot
  gap: 3,         // CSS px kept clear between two badges
  most: 3,        // more than this many in one place merge into a count badge
  ring: 2,        // the footprint ring's width, CSS px
  wash: 0.12,     // the footprint wash's strength
};

// The roof a building's stem stands on, in art px: a monument's top as it stands now; any other building's sprite at
// four fifths of its height over the footprint's middle (its roof, below its flags); a plot's ground.
export function roofOf(b) {
  if (MONUMENT_LOOK[b.type] && b.site) return monumentTop(b);
  const art = ART[slotFor(b)];
  return U(p(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2), art ? art.height * 0.8 : 0);
}

const toneOf = (glyph) => (glyph === 'down' ? 'warning' : 'problem');

// Stage 3's markers as { id, ids, glyph, key }, one per building: a group of road-less plots' road badge first (the road
// decides the mark, P13), then every other building with an alert or a home about to lose a tier.
function candidates(world, alerts, range) {
  const out = [], seen = new Set();
  const add = (b, glyph) => { if (b && !seen.has(b.id)) { seen.add(b.id); out.push({ id: b.id, ids: [b.id], glyph, key: depthKey(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d) }); } };
  for (const m of roadlessPlotBadges(world, range)) add(world.buildings[m.id], 'road');
  for (const m of problemMarkers(world, alerts, range)) add(world.buildings[m.id], m.kind === 'down' ? 'down' : m.cause === 'no_road' ? 'road' : '!');
  return out;
}

// The markers on screen, laid out (see the header). Pure: the same world, alerts, camera and view give the same layout.
export function layoutMarkers(world, alerts, cam, view) {
  const range = visibleTileRange(cam, view, world.size);
  const list = candidates(world, alerts, range);
  if (!list.length) return [];
  const { r, stem, gap, most } = MARKER, near = 2 * r + gap;
  for (const c of list) {
    const q = roofOf(world.buildings[c.id]);
    const [fx, fy] = artToScreen(cam, view, q[0], q[1]);
    c.foot = { x: fx, y: fy };
    c.base = fy - stem - r;                                                     // the badge's centre on the shortest stem
  }
  // Places: markers whose badges on their shortest stems would overlap, joined in chains; a chain of more than MARKER.most
  // is cut, front first, into places no wider than two badges' reach round their front marker, so a long crowded row at a
  // low zoom makes several count badges, not one.
  const byFront = (a, b) => b.key - a.key || a.id - b.id;
  list.sort(byFront);
  const link = list.map((_, i) => i);
  const find = (i) => (link[i] === i ? i : (link[i] = find(link[i])));
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < list.length; j++) {
    if (Math.hypot(list[i].foot.x - list[j].foot.x, list[i].base - list[j].base) < near) link[find(j)] = find(i);
  }
  const chains = new Map();
  list.forEach((c, i) => { const k = find(i); if (!chains.has(k)) chains.set(k, []); chains.get(k).push(c); });
  const places = [];
  for (const chain of chains.values()) {
    if (chain.length <= most) { places.push(chain); continue; }
    const cut = [];
    for (const c of chain) {
      const home = cut.find((g) => Math.hypot(g[0].foot.x - c.foot.x, g[0].base - c.base) < 2 * near);
      if (home) home.push(c); else cut.push([c]);
    }
    places.push(...cut);
  }
  places.sort((a, b) => byFront(a[0], b[0]));
  const placed = [];
  const clear = (x, y) => placed.every((m) => Math.hypot(m.x - x, m.y - y) >= near);
  const put = (foot, ids, glyph, tone) => {
    let y = foot.y - stem - r;
    while (!clear(foot.x, y)) y -= near;                                       // further back: a longer stem
    const m = { ids, x: foot.x, y, r, foot: { ...foot }, glyph, tone, count: ids.length };
    placed.push(m);
    return m;
  };
  for (const g of places) {
    if (g.length > most) {
      const front = g[0], ids = g.map((c) => c.id);
      put(front.foot, ids, g.some((c) => c.glyph !== 'down') ? '!' : 'down', g.some((c) => toneOf(c.glyph) === 'problem') ? 'problem' : 'warning');
    } else for (const c of g) put(c.foot, c.ids, c.glyph, toneOf(c.glyph));
  }
  return placed.reverse();                                                      // back first: the front is drawn last
}

const TONE = { problem: UI.problem, warning: UI.warn };

// The road mark: two bars, white on the badge.
function roadMark(h, x, y, R) {
  const half = 0.55 * R, gap = 0.28 * R;
  for (const dy of [-gap, gap]) h.line([x - half, y + dy], [x + half, y + dy], UI.halo, Math.max(1.6, 0.3 * R), 1);
}

```

`src/render/markers.js`, block 2 of 2 (continues straight on from block 1):

```js
// A plot with no road beside it: a dashed amber outline on its tile (Stage 3's, kept with the pinned badges).
function dashedAmberTile(g, x, y) {
  const pts = quad(x, y, 1, 1, 0);
  g.poly(pts, UI.warn, { alpha: 0.18 });
  g.poly(pts, 'none', { stroke: UI.halo, strokeWidth: 2.4, strokeAlpha: 0.7 });
  g.ctx.setLineDash([3 * g.scale, 2 * g.scale]);
  g.poly(pts, 'none', { stroke: UI.warn, strokeWidth: 1.4 });
  g.ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

// Draws the layout: the road-less plots' dashed outlines, then each marker's footprint rings (in art px, on the map),
// then its stem, roof dot and badge (in CSS px, so they keep their size at any zoom), back to front.
export function drawMarkers(g, world, alerts, range, layout = []) {
  for (const t of roadlessPlots(world, range)) dashedAmberTile(g, t.x, t.y);
  if (!layout.length) return;
  const css = g.cssScale || g.scale, ringW = MARKER.ring / css;
  for (const m of layout) {
    const color = TONE[m.tone] || UI.problem;
    for (const id of m.ids) {
      const b = world.buildings[id];
      if (!b) continue;
      const pts = quad(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, 0);
      g.poly(pts, color, { alpha: MARKER.wash });
      g.poly(pts, 'none', { stroke: UI.halo, strokeWidth: ringW + 1.6 / css, strokeAlpha: 0.75 });
      g.poly(pts, 'none', { stroke: color, strokeWidth: ringW });
    }
  }
  const ctx = g.ctx, dpr = g.scale / css;
  if (!ctx || typeof ctx.setTransform !== 'function') return;                   // a stand-in drawing helper: the rings only
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  const h = makeDraw(ctx, 1, 1);                                                // CSS px from here
  for (const m of layout) {
    const color = TONE[m.tone] || UI.problem, bottom = m.y + m.r;
    h.line([m.foot.x, m.foot.y], [m.x, bottom], UI.halo, 4, 0.9);                // the stem: ink on a white halo
    h.line([m.foot.x, m.foot.y], [m.x, bottom], INK, 2, 1);
    h.circ([m.foot.x, m.foot.y], 4, UI.halo, { alpha: 0.95 });                   // the dot on the roof
    h.circ([m.foot.x, m.foot.y], 2.6, color);
    h.circ([m.x, m.y], m.r + 2, UI.halo, { alpha: 0.95 });                        // the badge
    h.circ([m.x, m.y], m.r, color, { stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 0.8, strokeAlpha: 0.5 });
    const ink = m.tone === 'warning' ? UI.label : UI.halo;
    if (m.count > 1) h.text([m.x, m.y + 0.5], String(m.count), { size: m.count > 9 ? 0.95 * m.r : 1.2 * m.r, weight: '700', color: ink });
    else if (m.glyph === 'road') roadMark(h, m.x, m.y, m.r);
    else h.text([m.x, m.y + 0.5], m.glyph === 'down' ? '↓' : '!', { size: 1.4 * m.r, weight: '700', color: ink });
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// The marker a tap at (x, y) (CSS px) hits, or null: within MARKER_TAP_PX of the badge's centre, or of the stem from the
// badge down to its foot; the front marker of the layout wins (the last laid out is drawn on top, so it is asked first).
// Complete in the contract.
export function markerAt(layout, x, y) {
  for (let i = layout.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = layout[i];
    const reach = Math.max(MARKER_TAP_PX, m.r || 0);
    if (Math.hypot(x - m.x, y - m.y) <= reach) return m;
    const foot = m.foot || { x: m.x, y: m.y };
    const top = Math.min(m.y, foot.y), bottom = Math.max(m.y, foot.y);
    if (Math.abs(x - foot.x) <= MARKER_TAP_PX && y >= top && y <= bottom) return m;
  }
  return null;
}
```

# Track C: Interface

CONTRACT NOTE: The seam context (`createUI`'s `seamCtx`) carries no camera, but `pickFit` must never zoom in, so it needs the camera's zoom (ruling 231). Track C works around it in its own files: `createMinimap` (C's `minimap.js`), which `createUI` builds before the monuments interface, records the `{ cam, view }` it is given per world (`cameraOf(world)`), and `pickFit` and `markerTap` read it. Smallest fix: add `cam` (read-only) to `seamCtx` in `src/ui/createUI.js`; C's two readers then take `ctx.cam` first.
CONTRACT NOTE: `createUI` calls `drawOverlay(g, world, kind, range, placingType)` with the type only, so the Ground overlay cannot know a mastaba's turn. Track C keeps the placing rotation per world in `src/render/overlays.js` (`setPlacingRot`, set by `placement.start` and `placement.rotate`; `placingRotOf` read by the Ground draw and its legend). Smallest fix: pass `s.tool` (or `s.tool.rot`) as a sixth argument.
CONTRACT NOTE: `createUI`'s `actions.ghostDragStart` tests the grab against `BUILDINGS[type].w`/`.d` with half a tile of slack, so a turned mastaba's grab box is the unturned footprint, and the 35% silhouette cannot be grabbed (spec 6.5 "drag by the body"). It is in a contract file; Track C does not change it. Smallest fix: use `dimsOf(s.tool.type, s.tool.rot || 0)` there, and widen the box upward by the silhouette's height (`footprintExtent` in `src/ui/monumentSheet.js` gives it in art px).
CONTRACT NOTE: `createUI`'s `showMeAt` (Show me from a goal, a site's "No crew" row, a stall's alert row) lands a monument's ghost but never asks `monumentUi.pickFit`, so Show me for a great pyramid on a phone leaves most of its ghost off screen (seen in the `pyramid-placing` budget scene, which picks through Show me). Smallest fix: in `showMeAt`, when `def.monument`, call `monumentUi.pickFit(tool.type, g, placingInsets(...))` and pass its zoom and extent to the camera move as `pick()` does.
CONTRACT NOTE: Ruling 252's mobile budget scene cannot be called `pyramid`: that name is Track B's Stage 4 shot scene in the same `SCENES` table of `src/dev/scenes.js`. Track C names it `pyramid-placing` (`MOBILE_SCENES`, `MOBILE_SCENE_PARAMS`, `tests/ui/mobileBudget.test.js`) and adds it to `tools/shots.ps1 -Mobile`'s list (that tool is in no row of the ownership table; one line).
CONTRACT NOTE: Five pinned tests outside `tests/stage4/ui/` change with Track C, each by a line or two: `tests/ui/stage2Cards.test.js` (at Capital the small pyramid's card now shows, locked with its count, ruling 243), `tests/stage3/balance/scenes.test.js` (the scene list in its error message), `tests/ui/mobileBudget.test.js` (the new scene), and the three tips counts (`tests/ui/tips.test.js` `TIPS.length` 20, `tests/stage4/contract/uiSeams.test.js` "its tips sections add nothing yet", `tests/stage3/score/dangerGoals.test.js` `TIPS.slice(14)`), which now check that the Stage 3 tips come first rather than a total, so Tracks D, E and G add their tips without touching them again.
CONTRACT NOTE: Naming. The palace's style words are `UI4_PALACE_TEXT` (the prefix rule), not the `PALACE_TEXT` that `src/data/palace.js`'s comment names; the contract's text section for Track A says A words `ALERT_TEXT.site_stalled`, but the header gives every Stage 4 interface string, `site_stalled` included, to C, so C words it (`ui4CauseText`, shared by the sheet, the alert list and Welcome back). If Track A also assigns `ALERT_TEXT.site_stalled`, the integrator keeps C's.
CONTRACT NOTE: Track B seams Track C relies on, beyond the contract's names: the ghost's silhouette calls `drawMonument(g, world, b, { motion: 'still' })` on a building record that is not in the world (`id: -1`, a site with every course laid and `done: 0`), so B's draw must not look the building up by id; the minimap calls `minimapGlyph(ctx, b, scale)` from `src/render/monuments.js` when B exports it (`ctx`: the minimap canvas's 2D context, `scale`: minimap px a tile, the footprint at `b.x * scale, b.y * scale`), through a namespace import, and until then fills the footprint in the Monuments gold.
CONTRACT NOTE: View's outline (ruling 281) is drawn by `drawReachHighlight` in `src/render/overlays.js` (C's), which `createUI` already calls every frame on the selected building; View selects, so the outline needs no new createUI hook. The View buttons in C's files (`ui/alerts.js` banner, `sheets.js` problems and alert list, `welcomeBack.js`) call `noteView(world, id)`; the clock and Motion level come from the monuments interface (`setViewClock`). The minimap's pins have no View button of their own (a tap on the minimap pans), so they start no outline.

```js
// Track C, Task C1: the Monuments tab and its cards (spec 4.4, 4.14, 6.3; rulings 207, 243). Every lock's words are the sim's
// own count (prestigeOf, isUnlocked), checked with the world set up both ways.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { cardShown, cardInfo, cardsKey, shownItems, lockTextOf } from '../../../src/ui/cards.js';
import { CATEGORIES } from '../../../src/data/ui.js';
import { MONUMENTS, MONUMENT_KINDS } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { prestigeOf } from '../../../src/sim/prestige.js';
import { UI4_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { makeTestWorld, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { fire } from '../../helpers/dom.js';

// A finished monument of a kind, set by hand to the contract's site shape.
function finished(w, type, x, y) {
  const b = addRaw(w, type, x, y);
  Object.assign(b.site, { course: MONUMENTS[type].courses.length, done: 1 });
  return b;
}

describe('s4 ui the Monuments tab', () => {
  it('holds the guild, quarry, brickworks and the seven monuments in order, shown greyed while City is next', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    expect(CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === 'monuments').items).toEqual(['builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks', ...MONUMENT_KINDS]);
    w.milestone = 'town';
    expect(shownItems(w, 'monuments')).toEqual([]);
    w.milestone = 'market_town';
    expect(shownItems(w, 'monuments')).toEqual(['builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks', 'obelisk_small', 'obelisk_large']);
    expect(shownItems(w, 'monuments').every((t) => cardInfo(w, t).locked)).toBe(true);
    w.milestone = 'city';
    expect(shownItems(w, 'monuments').map((t) => cardInfo(w, t).locked)).toEqual([false, false, false, false, false, true, true]);
  });

  it('shows the small pyramid greyed from Great city and the great pyramid once the small one unlocks (ruling 243)', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    w.milestone = 'city';
    expect([cardShown(w, 'pyramid_small'), cardShown(w, 'pyramid_great')]).toEqual([false, false]);
    w.milestone = 'great_city';
    expect([cardShown(w, 'pyramid_small'), cardShown(w, 'pyramid_great')]).toEqual([true, false]);
    w.milestone = 'capital';
    expect([cardShown(w, 'pyramid_small'), cardShown(w, 'pyramid_great')]).toEqual([true, false]);
    w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = 40;
    expect([cardShown(w, 'pyramid_small'), cardInfo(w, 'pyramid_small').locked, cardShown(w, 'pyramid_great'), cardInfo(w, 'pyramid_great').locked]).toEqual([true, false, true, true]);
  });

  it('words a prestige lock with the city\'s own count, and the milestone with it until that is reached', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    w.milestone = 'great_city';
    expect(cardInfo(w, 'pyramid_small').lockText).toBe('Needs Capital and 100 prestige');
    w.milestone = 'capital';
    expect(cardInfo(w, 'pyramid_small').lockText).toBe('Needs 100 prestige (you have 0)');
    finished(w, 'colossus', 20, 20);
    finished(w, 'obelisk_small', 25, 25);
    expect([prestigeOf(w), cardInfo(w, 'pyramid_small').lockText]).toEqual([60, UI4_TEXT.needsPrestige(100, prestigeOf(w))]);
    expect(cardInfo(w, 'pyramid_small').lockText).toBe('Needs 100 prestige (you have 60)');
    const before = cardsKey(w, 'monuments', null);
    finished(w, 'obelisk_large', 28, 28);                                          // +30: the count moves, so the card is built again
    expect(cardInfo(w, 'pyramid_small').lockText).toBe('Needs 100 prestige (you have 90)');
    expect(cardsKey(w, 'monuments', null) === before).toBe(false);
    w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = 10;
    expect(lockTextOf(w, 'pyramid_great')).toBe('Needs 300 prestige (you have 90)');
    expect(lockTextOf(w, 'colossus')).toBe('Unlocks at Great city');
  });

  it('says a monument stands on the desert, on its card and in its tooltip', async () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    w.milestone = 'city';
    expect([cardInfo(w, 'obelisk_small').terrainText, cardInfo(w, 'quarry').terrainText, cardInfo(w, 'builders_guild').terrainText]).toEqual(['Desert', 'Rocky ground', '']);
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      r.world.milestone = 'city';
      r.ui.refresh();
      fire(r.root.querySelector('#dock .cat[data-category="monuments"]'), 'click');
      const card = r.root.querySelector('#dock .tray .card[data-item="obelisk_small"]');
      expect([card.querySelector('.terrain').textContent, card.getAttribute('title')]).toEqual(['Desert', 'Small obelisk: on the desert, not the fields']);
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#dock .tray .card[data-item="quarry"]').getAttribute('title')).toBe(null);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```
