Create `tests/stage4/ui/placing.test.js`:

```js
// Track C, Task C1: placing big footprints (spec 6.3 Ground, 6.5; rulings 226-234, 251, 252). Every chip and the confirm bar's
// line are the sim's own conditions in words (conditionsFor, workGoldPerUnit, desirabilityPreview, prestigeByKind), checked with
// the world set up both ways.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { toolPreview, ghostsFor, nearestFit, fitRadiusOf, monumentLine } from '../../../src/ui/placement.js';
import { fitZoom, footprintExtent } from '../../../src/ui/monumentSheet.js';
import { roomTiles, drawGhost, drawOverlay, setPlacingRot } from '../../../src/render/overlays.js';
import { desirabilityPreview } from '../../../src/sim/desirability.js';
import { workGoldPerUnit } from '../../../src/sim/costs.js';
import { MONUMENTS } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { AUTO_OVERLAY, NEAREST_FIT_RADIUS } from '../../../src/data/ui.js';
import { ART } from '../../../src/render/art/registry.js';
import { MIN_ZOOM } from '../../../src/render/camera.js';
import { makeDraw } from '../../../src/render/art/ctx.js';
import { p } from '../../../src/render/iso.js';
import { idx } from '../../../src/sim/grid.js';
import { UI4_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { rigUI, uiWorld } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { makeCanvas, pixelAt } from '../../helpers/canvas.js';
import { fire } from '../../helpers/dom.js';

// A Capital with both pyramids unlocked and a road along y = 10 (fertile land at x < 8).
function capital(gold = 20000) {
  const w = makeTestWorld({ gold });
  setRoad(w, 0, 10, 31, 10);
  w.milestone = 'capital';
  w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = 0;
  w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_great = 0;
  return w;
}
const preview = (w, type, x, y, rot = 0) => toolPreview(w, { tool: { kind: 'building', type, rot }, ghost: { x, y } });
const chips = (pv) => Object.fromEntries(pv.conditions.map((c) => [c.key, `${c.mark} ${c.text}`]));

describe('s4 ui monument chips', () => {
  it('words the ground: desert, or how many tiles are on the fields (coral, refused)', () => {
    const w = capital();
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11)).ground).toBe('✓ Desert ground');
    const on = preview(w, 'colossus', 7, 11);                                      // x 7 is fertile, x 8 is not: 2 of 4
    expect([on.state, chips(on).ground]).toEqual(['bad', '✕ Not on the fields: 2 of 4 tiles are fertile']);
    expect(on.footprint.filter((t) => t.state === 'cant').length).toBe(2);
  });

  it('words the road as later, and the crew and supply only once a road touches it', () => {
    const w = capital();
    const far = preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 13);
    expect([far.state, chips(far)]).toEqual(['warn', { ground: '✓ Desert ground', road: '! No road yet: crews and stone come by road' }]);
    const near = preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11);
    expect(chips(near)).toEqual({ ground: '✓ Desert ground', road: '✓ Road beside it', crew: "! No builders' guild near", supply: '! No stone near' });
    addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 24, 11);
    addRaw(w, 'quarry', 27, 11);
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11))).toEqual({ ground: '✓ Desert ground', road: '✓ Road beside it', crew: "✓ Crew: 1 builders' guild near", supply: '✓ Stone near' });
    addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 14, 11);
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11)).crew).toBe("✓ Crew: 2 builders' guilds near");
  });

  it('names the first course\'s materials: bricks for a mastaba, both for a pyramid', () => {
    const w = capital();
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'mastaba_small', 16, 11)).supply).toBe('! No bricks near');
    addRaw(w, 'brickworks', 20, 11);
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'mastaba_small', 16, 11)).supply).toBe('✓ Bricks near');
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'pyramid_small', 10, 11)).supply).toBe('! No stone near');
    addRaw(w, 'quarry', 24, 11);
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'pyramid_small', 10, 11)).supply).toBe('✓ Stone and bricks near');
  });

  it('shows the founding only when it would take the treasury below 0, and then refuses', () => {
    const w = capital(600);
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11)).gold).toBe(undefined);
    w.gold = 599;
    const p1 = preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11);
    expect([p1.state, chips(p1).gold]).toEqual(['bad', '✕ Founding 600 gold: you have 599']);
    w.gold = 640;
    expect(chips(preview(w, 'pyramid_great', 10, 11)).gold).toBe('✕ Founding 6,000 gold: you have 640');
  });
});

describe('s4 ui the monument line', () => {
  it('says the work gold a crew is paid a month from the sim, and what it does to the homes when finished and while building', () => {
    const w = capital();
    expect(monumentLine(w, 'colossus', 20, 11)).toBe(`then ${workGoldPerUnit(w) * 20} gold a crew a month`);
    expect(monumentLine(w, 'colossus', 20, 11)).toBe('then 100 gold a crew a month');
    w.difficulty = 'hard';
    expect(monumentLine(w, 'colossus', 20, 12)).toBe('then 125 gold a crew a month');
    w.difficulty = 'normal';
    for (const x of [17, 18, 19]) addRaw(w, 'house', x, 11, { tier: 2, residents: 5 });
    const done = desirabilityPreview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11), site = desirabilityPreview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11, { site: true });
    expect([done.better > 0, site.worse > 0]).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(monumentLine(w, 'colossus', 20, 11)).toBe(`then 100 gold a crew a month · finished: ${done.better} homes nicer · while building: ${site.worse} homes less pleasant`);
  });

  it('says a second of a kind earns no prestige', () => {
    const w = capital();
    expect(monumentLine(w, 'obelisk_small', 20, 11).startsWith(UI4_TEXT.oneOfEach)).toBe(false);
    addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 28, 20);
    expect(monumentLine(w, 'obelisk_small', 20, 11)).toBe('One of each kind counts: no prestige · then 100 gold a crew a month');
  });

  it('rides in the confirm bar, after the score\'s part, while it can be placed or waits for its road', () => {
    const w = capital();
    const ok = preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 11), road = preview(w, 'colossus', 20, 13), bad = preview(w, 'colossus', 7, 11);
    expect([ok.line.endsWith(monumentLine(w, 'colossus', 20, 11)), road.line.endsWith(monumentLine(w, 'colossus', 20, 13)), bad.line]).toEqual([true, true, '']);
    expect(ok.nicer).toBe('');
  });
});

describe('s4 ui rotating, fitting and the silhouette', () => {
  it('searches 16 tiles for footprints of 3x3 and up and 10 below, and lands a pyramid on the nearest desert', () => {
    expect(['pyramid_great', 'pyramid_small', 'mastaba_large', 'palace', 'mastaba_small', 'colossus', 'obelisk_small'].map(fitRadiusOf)).toEqual([16, 16, 16, 16, NEAREST_FIT_RADIUS, NEAREST_FIT_RADIUS, NEAREST_FIT_RADIUS]);
    const w = makeTestWorld({ size: 48, fertile: [[0, 0, 13, 48]] });
    w.milestone = 'capital'; w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_great = 0;
    const tool = { kind: 'building', type: 'pyramid_great' };
    expect(nearestFit(w, tool, 0, 20)).toEqual({ x: 13, y: 20 });
    expect(nearestFit(w, tool, 0, 20, 10)).toEqual({ x: 0, y: 20 });          // within 10 nothing fits: it stays put
  });

  it('turns a mastaba\'s ghost a quarter about its centre tile with the bar\'s ⟳ and R, and founds it turned', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 1280, height: 800, world: capital() });
    try {
      const { placement, store } = r.ui;
      placement.start({ kind: 'building', type: 'mastaba_small' });
      placement.moveGhost(20, 12);
      expect(placement.rotate()).toBe(true);
      expect([store.get().tool.rot, store.get().ghost]).toEqual([1, { x: 21, y: 11 }]);
      expect(placement.ghosts()[0].w * 10 + placement.ghosts()[0].d).toBe(23);
      const turn = r.root.querySelector('#confirm .rotate');
      expect(turn.disabled).toBe(false);
      fire(turn, 'click');
      expect([store.get().tool.rot, store.get().ghost]).toEqual([0, { x: 20, y: 12 }]);
      fire(r.root, 'keydown', { key: 'r' });
      expect(store.get().tool.rot).toBe(1);
      const res = placement.confirm();
      const b = r.world.buildings[res.id];
      expect([b.type, b.rot, b.w, b.d, b.x, b.y]).toEqual(['mastaba_small', 1, 2, 3, 21, 11]);
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#toasts').textContent.includes('Small mastaba founded')).toBe(true);
      placement.start({ kind: 'building', type: 'colossus' });
      expect([placement.rotate(), r.root.querySelector('#confirm .rotate')]).toEqual([false, null]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('says a site placed with no road needs one, and keeps two chip rows for a monument', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844, world: capital() });
    try {
      r.ui.placement.start({ kind: 'building', type: 'obelisk_small' });
      r.ui.placement.moveGhost(20, 14);
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#confirm .conds').classList.contains('tall')).toBe(true);
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#confirm .monument-line').textContent.endsWith('then 100 gold a crew a month')).toBe(true);
      r.ui.placement.confirm();
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#toasts').textContent.includes('Small obelisk founded · needs a road')).toBe(true);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('draws the finished monument\'s silhouette with the ghost', () => {
    const w = capital();
    const [shape] = ghostsFor(w, { tool: { kind: 'building', type: 'mastaba_small', rot: 1 }, ghost: { x: 20, y: 11 } });
    const b = shape.silhouette.b;
    expect([shape.w, shape.d, b.w, b.d, b.rot, b.site.course, b.site.done !== null, shape.silhouette.world === w]).toEqual([2, 3, 2, 3, 1, MONUMENTS.mastaba_small.courses.length, true, true]);
    expect(ghostsFor(w, { tool: { kind: 'building', type: 'granary' }, ghost: { x: 20, y: 11 } })[0].silhouette).toBe(undefined);
    const c = makeCanvas(240, 200), ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    const [ax, ay] = p(20, 11);
    ctx.translate(120 - 2 * ax, 120 - 2 * ay);
    drawGhost(makeDraw(ctx, 2), shape);
    let inked = 0;
    for (let y = 0; y < 110; y += 2) for (let x = 0; x < 240; x += 2) if (pixelAt(c, x, y)[3] > 0) inked++;   // above the footprint: the silhouette
    expect(inked).toBeGreaterThan(20);
  });

  it('fits the footprint and silhouette at the pick: just enough zoom out, never in, never past the least zoom', () => {
    const phone = { width: 390, height: 844 }, insets = { top: 100, right: 0, bottom: 240, left: 0 };
    const e = footprintExtent('pyramid_great');
    expect(e).toEqual({ up: ART.pyramid_great.height + 56, down: 56, across: 224 });
    const fit = fitZoom('pyramid_great', 0, 1, phone, insets);
    expect(fit).toEqual({ zoom: Math.min((390 - 96) / (224 * 2), (844 - 340 - 96) / ((e.up + e.down) * 2)), extent: { up: e.up, down: e.down } });
    expect(fit.zoom < 1).toBe(true);
    expect(fitZoom('pyramid_great', 0, 0.55, phone, insets)).toEqual({ extent: { up: e.up, down: e.down } });   // already fits: no zoom in
    expect(fitZoom('obelisk_small', 0, 1, phone, insets).zoom).toBe(undefined);
    expect(fitZoom('pyramid_great', 0, 1, { width: 200, height: 200 }, { top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 }).zoom).toBe(MIN_ZOOM);
    expect(footprintExtent('mastaba_large', 1).across).toBe(footprintExtent('mastaba_large', 0).across);
  });

  it('zooms the camera out once when a great pyramid\'s card is picked on a phone (a cut under Gentle)', async () => {
    const w = uiWorld();
    w.milestone = 'capital'; w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = 0; w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_great = 0; w.gold = 20000;
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844, world: w });
    try {
      r.ui.refresh();
      fire(r.root.querySelector('#dock .cat[data-category="monuments"]'), 'click');
      fire(r.root.querySelector('#dock .tray .card[data-item="pyramid_great"]'), 'click');
      expect([r.store.get().tool.type, r.store.get().overlay]).toEqual(['pyramid_great', 'ground']);
      expect([r.cam.zoom < 1, r.cam.zoom >= MIN_ZOOM]).toEqual([true, true]);
      const zoomed = r.cam.zoom;
      r.ui.placement.cancel();
      fire(r.root.querySelector('#dock .tray .card[data-item="obelisk_small"]'), 'click');
      expect(r.cam.zoom).toBe(zoomed);                                            // never zooms back in
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});

describe('s4 ui the Ground overlay for a monument', () => {
  it('turns Ground on for every monument, and finds room on dry ground that is not the fields, in each rotation', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(MONUMENTS).every((k) => AUTO_OVERLAY[k] === 'ground')).toBe(true);
    const w = makeTestWorld({ fertile: [[0, 0, 8, 32], [10, 0, 22, 32]] });   // a desert strip two tiles wide, x 8 and 9
    expect([roomTiles(w, 'mastaba_small', 0).size, roomTiles(w, 'mastaba_small', 1).size]).toEqual([0, 64]);
    const open = makeTestWorld();
    const room = roomTiles(open, 'colossus');
    expect([room.has(idx(32, 8, 0)), room.has(idx(32, 7, 0))]).toEqual([true, false]);
    addRaw(open, 'granary', 20, 20);
    expect(roomTiles(open, 'colossus').has(idx(32, 20, 20))).toBe(false);        // worked out again once the buildings change
  });

  it('draws the room as a gold wash and says it in the legend: room, or none left in this rotation', async () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld({ gold: 20000, fertile: [[0, 0, 8, 32], [10, 0, 22, 32]] });
    w.milestone = 'great_city';
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 1280, height: 800, world: w });
    try {
      r.ui.placement.start({ kind: 'building', type: 'mastaba_small' }, { x: 8, y: 12 });
      const legend = () => r.root.querySelector('#legend').textContent;
      expect([r.store.get().overlay, legend().includes('Fertile: no monuments here'), legend().includes('No room left for a small mastaba')]).toEqual(['ground', true, true]);
      r.ui.placement.rotate();
      expect(legend().includes('Gold: room for a small mastaba')).toBe(true);
      r.ui.placement.start({ kind: 'building', type: 'farm_grain' }, { x: 2, y: 2 });
      expect(legend().includes('Rocky: mines')).toBe(true);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
    const c = makeCanvas(240, 200), ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    const [ax, ay] = p(8, 12);
    ctx.translate(120 - 2 * ax, 100 - 2 * ay);
    setPlacingRot(w, 1);
    drawOverlay(makeDraw(ctx, 2), w, 'ground', { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 31, y1: 31 }, 'mastaba_small');
    const [rr, gg, bb] = pixelAt(c, 120, 100 + 16);                              // the middle of tile (8, 12): gold over sand
    expect(rr > bb + 40 && gg > bb).toBe(true);
    setPlacingRot(w, 0);
  });
});
```

with:

```js
// Track C's words: the Monuments tab's cards and locks, the monument chips and confirm-bar line, the site, guild, quarry,
// brickworks and palace sheets, the summary's Monuments section, Welcome back's site lines, the stall warnings' tier
// words and View's outline. Add new lines just above the end marker.
// Whole gold with thousands marked, as the spec writes it ("1,000 gold").
export const ui4Gold = (n) => String(Math.round(n)).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
const ui4Lower = (type) => buildingName(type).toLowerCase();
const ui4Cap = (s) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
export const UI4_TEXT = {
  // The Monuments tab's cards (spec 4.4, 4.14, 6.3): the ground a monument stands on, and a prestige lock with its count.
  desert: 'Desert',
  desertTip: 'on the desert, not the fields',
  needsPrestige: (need, have) => `Needs ${need} prestige (you have ${have})`,
  needsMilestoneAndPrestige: (milestone, need) => `Needs ${milestone} and ${need} prestige`,
  // The monument chips (spec 6.5, ruling 230), each the sim's own condition in words.
  groundMet: 'Desert ground',
  notOnFields: (fertile, of) => `Not on the fields: ${fertile} of ${of} tiles are fertile`,
  roadLater: 'No road yet: crews and stone come by road',
  crewMet: (n) => `Crew: ${plural(n, "builders' guild", "builders' guilds")} near`,
  crewLater: "No builders' guild near",
  supplyMet: (goods) => `${ui4Cap(listText(goods.map((g) => goodName(g).toLowerCase())))} near`,
  supplyLater: (good) => `No ${goodName(good).toLowerCase()} near`,
  founding: (cost, have) => `Founding ${ui4Gold(cost)} gold: you have ${ui4Gold(have)}`,
  // The confirm bar's line (spec 6.5, ruling 251), after the score's "+N Monuments when finished" (Track D).
  crewGold: (gold) => `then ${ui4Gold(gold)} gold a crew a month`,
  finishedNicer: (n) => `finished: ${plural(n, 'home', 'homes')} nicer`,
  whileBuilding: (n) => `while building: ${plural(n, 'home', 'homes')} less pleasant`,
  oneOfEach: 'One of each kind counts: no prestige',
  founded: (type) => `${buildingName(type)} founded`,
  // The Ground overlay while a monument is placed (spec 6.3, ruling 229).
  groundFertile: 'Fertile: no monuments here',
  roomFor: (type) => `Gold: room for a ${ui4Lower(type)}`,
  noRoomFor: (type) => `No room left for a ${ui4Lower(type)}`,
};
// One monument condition's chip words (src/sim/commands.js conditionsFor: ground, road, crew, supply, gold). firstGoods: the
// materials of the first course, which the supply chip names when it is met. Ground refusals other than the fields keep the
// shared words (conditionText).
export function ui4ConditionText(cond, type, firstGoods = []) {
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  if (cond.key === 'ground') {
    if (cond.state === 'met') return U.groundMet;
    if (cond.reason === 'not_on_fields') return U.notOnFields(cond.fertile, cond.of);
    return conditionText(cond, type);
  }
  if (cond.key === 'road') return cond.state === 'met' ? CONDITION_TEXT.roadMet : cond.state === 'later' ? U.roadLater : CONDITION_TEXT.roadCant;
  if (cond.key === 'crew') return cond.state === 'met' ? U.crewMet(cond.n) : U.crewLater;
  if (cond.key === 'supply') return cond.state === 'met' ? U.supplyMet(firstGoods) : U.supplyLater(cond.good);
  if (cond.key === 'gold') return U.founding(cond.cost, cond.have);
  return conditionText(cond, type);
}
// ── end s4 ui ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

//
```

```js
const roomMemo = new WeakMap();   // world -> { key, room: Map type -> Set of tile indices }

// The tile indices that belong to at least one free spot where a `type` building's whole footprint fits on its own ground
// (every tile of the right terrain with nothing on it). Ground only: whether a road touches the spot, or the gold is there, is
// the placement bar's business. Empty for a type with no terrain. Memoised on the buildings, roads and walls (the same
// signature the other overlays use), so a ghost that moves around asks once.
export function roomTiles(world, type) {
  const def = BUILDINGS[type];
  if (!def || !def.terrain) return new Set();
  const key = `${world.roadVersion}|${world.wallVersion}|${world.nextId}|${buildingSignature(world)}`;
  let m = roomMemo.get(world);
  if (!m || m.key !== key) { m = { key, room: new Map() }; roomMemo.set(world, m); }
  let room = m.room.get(type);
  if (room) return room;
  room = new Set();
  const want = TERRAIN_BY_NAME[def.terrain], n = world.size;
  for (let y = 0; y + def.d <= n; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x + def.w <= n; x++) {
      let fits = true;
      for (let dy = 0; dy < def.d && fits; dy++) for (let dx = 0; dx < def.w && fits; dx++) {
        const i = idx(n, x + dx, y + dy);
        fits = world.terrain[i] === want && groundFree(world, i);
      }
      if (!fits) continue;
      for (let dy = 0; dy < def.d; dy++) for (let dx = 0; dx < def.w; dx++) room.add(idx(n, x + dx, y + dy));
    }
  }
  m.room.set(type, room);
  return room;
}
```

```js
const roomMemo = new WeakMap();   // world -> { key, room: Map `type|rot` -> Set of tile indices }

// The tile indices that belong to at least one free spot where a `type` building's whole footprint fits on its own ground
// (every tile of the right terrain with nothing on it). Ground only: whether a road touches the spot, or the gold is there, is
// the placement bar's business. Empty for a type with no terrain. Memoised on the buildings, roads and walls (the same
// signature the other overlays use), so a ghost that moves around asks once.
// Stage 4 (Track C, spec 6.3, ruling 229): a monument's room is the opposite case, every tile of a free spot where its whole
// footprint, in rotation `rot` (dimsOf), sits on dry ground that is not fertile land (desert, rocky, meadow, scrub, bank).
// Worked out at the pick and on each rotation, then kept until the roads or buildings change (the memo's key).
export function roomTiles(world, type, rot = 0) {
  const def = BUILDINGS[type];
  if (!def || (!def.terrain && !def.monument)) return new Set();
  const key = `${world.roadVersion}|${world.wallVersion}|${world.nextId}|${buildingSignature(world)}`;
  let m = roomMemo.get(world);
  if (!m || m.key !== key) { m = { key, room: new Map() }; roomMemo.set(world, m); }
  const { w, d } = dimsOf(type, rot);
  const slot = `${type}|${w}x${d}`;
  let room = m.room.get(slot);
  if (room) return room;
  room = new Set();
  const n = world.size;
  const want = def.terrain ? TERRAIN_BY_NAME[def.terrain] : null;
  const ok = def.terrain
    ? (i) => world.terrain[i] === want && groundFree(world, i)
    : (i) => world.terrain[i] !== TILE.WATER && world.terrain[i] !== TILE.FERTILE && groundFree(world, i);
  for (let y = 0; y + d <= n; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x + w <= n; x++) {
      let fits = true;
      for (let dy = 0; dy < d && fits; dy++) for (let dx = 0; dx < w && fits; dx++) fits = ok(idx(n, x + dx, y + dy));
      if (!fits) continue;
      for (let dy = 0; dy < d; dy++) for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) room.add(idx(n, x + dx, y + dy));
    }
  }
  m.room.set(slot, room);
  return room;
}
```

```js
export function createOverlayLegend({ container, store, world = null }) {
  let lastKey = undefined;

  // The Ground overlay's third line, while a farm, orchard or mine is being placed: where its brighter tiles are. Stage 4: while
  // a monument is placed, where its gold room is in its current rotation (or that none is left).
  function roomWords(s) {
    if (s.overlay !== 'ground' || !s.tool || s.tool.kind !== 'building') return null;
    const type = s.tool.type;
    if (BUILDINGS[type] && BUILDINGS[type].monument) {
      const any = world ? roomTiles(world, type, placingRotOf(world)).size > 0 : true;
      return { monument: true, words: any ? UI4_TEXT.roomFor(type) : UI4_TEXT.noRoomFor(type) };
    }
    if (!groundThing(type)) return null;
    return { monument: false, words: groundRoomText(type, world ? roomTiles(world, type).size > 0 : true) };
  }

  function render() {
    const s = store.get(), kind = s.overlay, room = roomWords(s);
    const key = `${kind}|${room ? room.words : ''}|${room && room.monument ? 'm' : ''}`;
    if (key === lastKey) return;
    lastKey = key;
    clear(container);
```

with:

```js
// Which cards a tray shows (spec 4.14): everything unlocked, and what the next milestone unlocks (locked, with its
// condition); buildings of later milestones stay hidden, so the tray never fills with grey. Roads and demolish
// always show.
// Stage 4 (Track C, spec 4.14, ruling 243): a card that unlocks by prestige is a step of its own. The first (the small
// pyramid) shows, greyed, once its milestone is the next one or reached; each later one once the one before it has unlocked.
export function cardShown(world, item) {
  if (!BUILDINGS[item] || isUnlocked(world, item)) return true;
  const step = PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS.indexOf(item);
  if (step > 0) return isUnlocked(world, PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS[step - 1]);
  if (step === 0) return milestoneIndex(world.milestone) + 1 >= milestoneIndex(MONUMENTS[item].unlock.milestone);
  const next = MILESTONES[milestoneIndex(world.milestone) + 1];
  return Boolean(next && next.unlocks.includes(item));
}

// A locked card's condition (spec 4.14): a prestige unlock says its count once its milestone is reached ("Needs 100 prestige
// (you have 60)"), else both ("Needs Capital and 100 prestige"); any other card its milestone.
export function lockTextOf(world, item) {
  if (!PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS.includes(item)) return unlockText(item);
  const u = MONUMENTS[item].unlock;
  if (milestoneIndex(world.milestone) >= milestoneIndex(u.milestone)) return UI4_TEXT.needsPrestige(u.prestige, prestigeOf(world));
  return UI4_TEXT.needsMilestoneAndPrestige(MILESTONES[milestoneIndex(u.milestone)].name, u.prestige);
}

export function shownItems(world, category) {
  const cat = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === category);
  return cat ? cat.items.filter((item) => cardShown(world, item)) : [];
```

```js
export function monumentLine(world, type, x, y, rot = 0) {
  const field = desirabilityField(world);
  const key = `${type}|${x}|${y}|${rot}|${world.difficulty}|${world.nextId}`;
  const m = lineMemo.get(world);
  if (m && m.field === field && m.key === key) return m.value;
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  const parts = [];
  if (prestigeByKind(world)[type].id !== null) parts.push(U.oneOfEach);
  parts.push(U.crewGold(workGoldPerUnit(world) * MONUMENT.unitsPerCrewMonth));
  const done = desirabilityPreview(world, type, x, y, { rot });
  if (done.better) parts.push(U.finishedNicer(done.better));
  const site = desirabilityPreview(world, type, x, y, { rot, site: true });
  if (site.worse) parts.push(U.whileBuilding(site.worse));
  const value = parts.join(' · ');
  lineMemo.set(world, { field, key, value });
  return value;
}

// The finished monument a ghost stands for: a building record of the contract's shape (a site with every course done), never in
// the world, so the live draw shows its final form.
function finishedGhost(tool, ghost, w, d) {
  const m = MONUMENTS[tool.type];
  const site = {
    course: m.courses.length, laid: { stone: 0, bricks: 0 }, stock: { stone: 0, bricks: 0 }, carry: 0, extraPaid: Boolean(m.extra), crews: [], idle: 0, reason: null,
    month: { units: 0, gold: 0, crews: 0, crewDays: 0, starvedDays: 0 }, last: null, starved: false, done: 0,
  };
  return { id: -1, type: tool.type, x: ghost.x, y: ghost.y, w, d, rot: rotOf(tool), staff: 0, paused: false, store: {}, site };
}
```

with:

```js
//   markerTap(marker) -> true when it handled a tap on a problem marker (src/render/markers.js); createUI otherwise selects
//     the marker's front building. A count badge zooming in one step is C's (ruling 281).
//
// Track C. The seam context has no camera: the fit reads the one the minimap was given (src/ui/minimap.js cameraOf).
import { BUILDINGS, dimsOf } from '../data/buildings.js';
import { ART } from '../render/art/registry.js';
import { pxPerArt, MIN_ZOOM } from '../render/camera.js';
import { FRAME_MARGIN_PX } from './cameraControl.js';
import { cameraOf } from './minimap.js';

// The art px a building of `type` in rotation `rot` reaches about its footprint's middle: up (its drawn height plus the back
// half of the footprint, iso.js p(): a tile is 32 x 16 art px), down (the front half) and across (the footprint's width).
export function footprintExtent(type, rot = 0) {
  const { w, d } = dimsOf(type, rot);
  const art = ART[type];
  return { up: (art ? art.height : 0) + 4 * (w + d), down: 4 * (w + d), across: 16 * (w + d) };
}

// The pick's one camera move for a monument (spec 6.5, ruling 231): { extent } when the footprint and the finished monument's
// silhouette already fit the free map (the view less the insets and the camera's margin) at the current zoom, else
// { zoom, extent } with the zoom that just fits them, never past MIN_ZOOM and never in. view: { width, height } CSS px.
export function fitZoom(type, rot, zoom, view, insets, margin = FRAME_MARGIN_PX) {
  const e = footprintExtent(type, rot);
  const k = pxPerArt({ zoom: 1 });                                    // CSS px per art px at zoom 1
  const freeW = view.width - insets.left - insets.right - 2 * margin;
  const freeH = view.height - insets.top - insets.bottom - 2 * margin;
  const fits = Math.min(freeW / (e.across * k), freeH / ((e.up + e.down) * k));
  const extent = { up: e.up, down: e.down };
  if (fits >= zoom) return { extent };
  return { zoom: Math.max(MIN_ZOOM, fits), extent };
}
```

```js
// great pyramid's prestige unlock reached and the gold to found it (the contract's state, written as a scene does), then the

async function pyramidPlacing(api, options) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'pyramid-placing'), { world, ui } = g;
  world.milestone = 'capital';
  for (const k of ['pyramid_small', 'pyramid_great']) world.prestigeUnlocks[k] = world.day;
  world.gold = Math.max(world.gold, 20000);
  ui.refresh();
  await settle(options, 100);
  ui.showMeAt({ category: 'monuments', item: 'pyramid_great', x: world.focus.x, y: world.focus.y });
  await settle(options, 500);
  return `pyramid-placing ${ui.store.get().mode} ${ui.store.get().overlay}`;
}
```

```js
// Track C, Task C2: the site sheet (spec 6.3, 4.16; rulings 210, 245, 252). Every row is checked against the sim's own function
// with the world set up both ways. Track A's state (site.crews, site.reason, site.last, siteStatus's makers and stores) is set
// by hand to the contract's shapes.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { siteRows, causeText, causeFix } from '../../../src/ui/monumentSheet.js';
import { siteStatus, siteProgress, paceOf, prestigeOfBuilding } from '../../../src/sim/monuments.js';
import { workGoldPerUnit, extraGoldOf } from '../../../src/sim/costs.js';
import { MONUMENTS } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { UI4_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { openSheet } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { fire } from '../../helpers/dom.js';

// A Capital with a road along y = 10 and a small pyramid site touching it.
function city() {
  const w = makeTestWorld({ gold: 20000 });
  setRoad(w, 0, 10, 31, 10);
  w.milestone = 'capital';
  w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = 0;
  w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_great = 0;
  return w;
}
const rowsOf = (w, b, s) => Object.fromEntries(siteRows(w, b, s).map((r) => [r.key, r.text]));

describe('s4 ui the site sheet', () => {
  it('says the course under way and the share done, from siteProgress', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 12, 11);
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).progress).toBe('Course 1 of 8 · 0% done');
    Object.assign(b.site, { course: 3, laid: { stone: 408, bricks: 72 } });       // half the fourth course (816 + 144)
    const p = siteProgress(b);
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).progress).toBe(UI4_TEXT.progress(p.course, p.courses, p.done));
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).progress).toBe('Course 4 of 8 · 43% done');
    expect(siteRows(w, b)[0].share).toBe(p.done);
  });

  it('counts the crews at work against the most the kind takes', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 12, 11);
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).crews).toBe('Crews: 0 of 4.');
    const g1 = addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 20, 11), g2 = addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 23, 11);
    b.site.crews = [g1.id];
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).crews).toBe("Crews: 1 of 4. 1 builders' guild works here.");
    b.site.crews = [g1.id, g2.id];
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).crews).toBe("Crews: 2 of 4. 2 builders' guilds work here.");
  });

  it('names the cause of a day without work and its fix, in ruling 245\'s words, or nothing after a day of work', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 12, 11);
    const cause = () => siteRows(w, b).find((r) => r.key === 'cause') || null;
    expect(cause()).toBe(null);
    b.site.reason = 'no_crew';
    expect([cause().text, cause().fix]).toEqual(["No crew: build a builders' guild within 12 road tiles", { showMe: { category: 'monuments', item: 'builders_guild', x: 14, y: 13 } }]);
    b.site.reason = 'no_bricks';
    expect([cause().text, cause().fix.showMe.item]).toEqual(['Waiting for bricks: no brickworks or storehouse with bricks within reach', 'brickworks']);
    b.site.reason = 'no_stone';
    expect([cause().text, cause().fix.showMe.item]).toEqual(['Waiting for stone: no quarry or storehouse with stone within reach', 'quarry']);
    b.site.reason = 'no_gold';
    expect([cause().text, cause().fix]).toEqual(['No gold for the crews: work waits until the treasury is above 0', null]);
    const g = addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 20, 11);
    b.site.reason = 'crew_short'; b.site.crews = [g.id];
    expect([cause().text, cause().fix]).toEqual(["The builders' guild is short of workers", { view: g.id }]);
    b.site.reason = 'crew_burning';
    expect(cause().text).toBe("The builders' guild is on fire");
    b.paused = true;
    expect([cause().text, siteStatus(w, b).reason]).toEqual(['Paused: no work and no work gold until you resume it', 'paused']);
  });

  it('waits for the gilding or the capstone in the city\'s own gold', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_great', 12, 11);
    expect(causeText(w, b, 'waiting_capstone')).toBe(`Waiting for 5,000 gold for the capstone`);
    w.difficulty = 'hard';
    expect(causeText(w, b, 'waiting_capstone')).toBe(UI4_TEXT.cause.waiting_capstone(extraGoldOf(w, 'pyramid_great')));
    expect(causeText(w, b, 'waiting_capstone')).toBe('Waiting for 6,250 gold for the capstone');
    expect(causeText(w, addRaw(w, 'obelisk_large', 25, 11), 'waiting_gilding')).toBe('Waiting for 1,250 gold for the gilding');
  });

  it('says a site with no road needs one, with the road tool, and shows no pace', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 20, 14);
    const rows = siteRows(w, b);
    const cause = rows.find((r) => r.key === 'cause');
    expect([cause.text, cause.fix.showMe.item, rows.some((r) => r.key === 'pace')]).toEqual(['No road yet: crews and stone come by road', 'road', false]);
  });

  it('says each material on site and what reaches the site, from siteStatus', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 12, 11);
    b.site.stock.stone = 46.6;
    const s = siteStatus(w, b);
    expect(rowsOf(w, b, s)['material-stone']).toBe(UI4_TEXT.material('stone', s.materials.stone.onSite, s.materials.stone.makers.length, s.materials.stone.stores.length));
    const none = { ...s, materials: { stone: { ...s.materials.stone, makers: [], stores: [] }, bricks: { ...s.materials.bricks, makers: [], stores: [] } } };
    expect(rowsOf(w, b, none)['material-stone']).toBe('Stone: 46 on site. No quarry or storehouse reaches this site.');
    const some = { ...s, materials: { stone: { ...s.materials.stone, makers: [5, 6], stores: [7] }, bricks: { ...s.materials.bricks, makers: [8], stores: [] } } };
    expect([rowsOf(w, b, some)['material-stone'], rowsOf(w, b, some)['material-bricks']]).toEqual(['Stone: 46 on site. 2 quarries and 1 storehouse reach this site.', 'Bricks: 0 on site. 1 brickworks reaches this site.']);
    expect(rowsOf(w, addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 25, 11))['material-bricks']).toBe(undefined);   // only the materials the kind uses
  });

  it('gives the pace at last month\'s rate, says when it is not progressing, and waits for a month at first', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 12, 11);
    Object.assign(b.site, { course: 3, laid: { stone: 408, bricks: 72 } });
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).pace).toBe('Pace shows after a month of work');
    b.site.last = { units: 40, gold: 200, crews: 2 };
    expect([paceOf(w, b), rowsOf(w, b).pace]).toEqual([3240, 'At last month\'s pace, about 9 years to finish']);
    b.site.last = { units: 300, gold: 1500, crews: 4 };
    expect([paceOf(w, b), rowsOf(w, b).pace]).toEqual([432, UI4_TEXT.pace(432)]);
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).pace).toBe('At last month\'s pace, about 1 year 3 months to finish');
    b.site.last = { units: 0, gold: 0, crews: 0 };
    b.site.reason = 'no_stone';
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).pace).toBe('Not progressing: no stone');
    b.paused = true;
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).pace).toBe(undefined);
  });

  it('says last month\'s gold, or the work gold a crew is paid before then', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'colossus', 12, 11);
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).gold).toBe(`Work gold: ${workGoldPerUnit(w) * 20} gold a crew a month. Work stops if gold would go below 0.`);
    w.difficulty = 'hard';
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).gold).toBe('Work gold: 125 gold a crew a month. Work stops if gold would go below 0.');
    b.site.last = { units: 60, gold: 300, crews: 3 };
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).gold).toBe('Last month: 300 gold for 3 crews. Work stops if gold would go below 0.');
  });

  it('says its prestige so far and to come, or that another of its kind holds it', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 12, 11);
    b.site.course = 3;
    expect([prestigeOfBuilding(b), rowsOf(w, b).prestige]).toEqual([30, 'Prestige 30 so far; +130 when finished']);
    const other = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 20, 11);
    other.site.course = 5;
    expect(rowsOf(w, b).prestige).toBe('One of each kind counts: the other small pyramid holds its prestige');
    expect(rowsOf(w, other).prestige).toBe(`Prestige ${prestigeOfBuilding(other)} so far; +${160 - prestigeOfBuilding(other)} when finished`);
  });

  it('opens as its own sheet with a bar, the fix buttons, Pause, View and Demolish, and no workers row', async () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'pyramid_small', 12, 11);
    b.site.reason = 'no_crew';
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844, world: w });
    try {
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'info', b.id));
      const sheet = r.root.querySelector('#sheet');
      expect(sheet.querySelector('h2').textContent).toBe('Small pyramid');
      expect([...sheet.querySelectorAll('.s4-rows.site li')].map((li) => li.dataset.row)).toEqual(['progress', 'crews', 'cause', 'material-stone', 'material-bricks', 'pace', 'gold', 'prestige']);
      expect(sheet.querySelector('.s4-rows .meter').getAttribute('aria-valuenow')).toBe('0');
      expect(sheet.textContent.includes('Workers')).toBe(false);
      expect([...sheet.querySelectorAll('.actions button')].map((x) => x.textContent)).toEqual(['Pause', 'View', 'Demolish']);
      fire(sheet.querySelector('.actions .pause'), 'click');
      expect([b.paused, r.root.querySelector('#sheet .row-cause .text').textContent]).toEqual([true, UI4_TEXT.cause.paused]);
      fire(r.root.querySelector('#sheet .actions .pause'), 'click');
      expect(b.paused).toBe(false);
      fire(r.root.querySelector('#sheet .row-cause .show-me'), 'click');
      expect([r.store.get().mode, r.store.get().tool.type]).toEqual(['placing', 'builders_guild']);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

```js
// Track C, Task C2: the finished monument's, the supply buildings' and the palace's sheets, Demolish's question, Undo's words
// for a site with work begun and the plaza toast (spec 4.16, 4.20, 6.3; rulings 236, 258, 271-275). Words checked against the
// sim's own functions with the world set up both ways; Track A's state and functions are handed in to the contract's shapes.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { finishedRows, supplyLine, palaceRows, enlargeModel, demolishQuestion, homesMadeNicer } from '../../../src/ui/monumentSheet.js';
import { siteStatus, prestigeOfBuilding } from '../../../src/sim/monuments.js';
import { palaceQuote } from '../../../src/sim/palace.js';
import { demolishRefundFor } from '../../../src/sim/commands.js';
import { MONUMENTS } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { UI4_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { cardInfo } from '../../../src/ui/cards.js';
import { openSheet } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { fire } from '../../helpers/dom.js';

function city(milestone = 'capital') {
  const w = makeTestWorld({ gold: 20000 });
  setRoad(w, 0, 10, 31, 10);
  w.milestone = milestone;
  return w;
}
const done = (w, type, x, y, day = 400) => { const b = addRaw(w, type, x, y); Object.assign(b.site, { course: MONUMENTS[type].courses.length, done: day }); return b; };
const text = (rows) => Object.fromEntries(rows.map((r) => [r.key, r.text]));

describe('s4 ui a finished monument\'s sheet', () => {
  it('says the day it was finished, its prestige or which other holds it, and the homes it makes nicer', () => {
    const w = city();
    const b = done(w, 'colossus', 20, 11, 400);                                      // day 400: month 13, year 2 month 2
    expect(text(finishedRows(w, b))).toEqual({ finished: 'Finished in year 2, month 2', prestige: 'Counts for prestige: 50', nicer: 'Makes no homes nicer yet' });
    addRaw(w, 'house', 23, 11, { tier: 2, residents: 5 });
    expect([homesMadeNicer(w, b), text(finishedRows(w, b)).nicer]).toEqual([1, 'Makes 1 home nicer']);
    const older = done(w, 'colossus', 26, 11, 200);
    expect([text(finishedRows(w, older)).prestige, text(finishedRows(w, b)).prestige]).toEqual([UI4_TEXT.otherCounts('colossus'), 'Counts for prestige: 50']);
    expect(text(finishedRows(w, older)).prestige).toBe('The other colossus counts for prestige');
  });
});

describe('s4 ui the supply buildings\' sheets', () => {
  it('says where a guild\'s crew works, or that no site in reach has room', () => {
    const w = city();
    const g = addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 20, 11);
    const site = addRaw(w, 'mastaba_small', 12, 11);
    expect(supplyLine(w, g)).toBe("Idle: no monument site within 12 road tiles has room for a crew");
    site.site.crews = [g.id];
    expect(supplyLine(w, g)).toBe('Crew at work on the small mastaba');
    g.paused = true;
    expect(supplyLine(w, g)).toBe('');
  });

  it('says which site a quarry or brickworks sends to, that it idles when no site needs its material, or nothing while it works', () => {
    const w = city();
    const q = addRaw(w, 'quarry', 20, 11), k = addRaw(w, 'brickworks', 24, 11);
    const site = addRaw(w, 'colossus', 12, 11);
    const sim = (needed, makers = []) => ({
      supplyNeeded: () => needed, guildSite: () => null,
      siteStatus: (world, b) => { const s = siteStatus(world, b); for (const m of Object.values(s.materials)) m.makers = makers; return s; },
    });
    expect([supplyLine(w, q, sim(true)), supplyLine(w, k, sim(true))]).toEqual(['', '']);
    expect([supplyLine(w, q, sim(false)), supplyLine(w, k, sim(false))]).toEqual(['Idle: no monument site needs stone within reach', 'Idle: no monument site needs bricks within reach']);
    expect(supplyLine(w, q, sim(false, [q.id]))).toBe('Sends stone to the colossus');
    site.site.done = 10;                                                             // a finished monument is no site
    expect(supplyLine(w, q, sim(false, [q.id]))).toBe('Idle: no monument site needs stone within reach');
  });

  it('says a working quarry cuts stone, on its sheet', async () => {
    const w = city();
    const q = addRaw(w, 'quarry', 20, 11, { staff: 10 });
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 1280, height: 800, world: w });
    try {
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'info', q.id));
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#sheet .work-status').textContent).toBe('Cutting stone');
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});

describe('s4 ui the palace\'s sheet', () => {
  it('says its style, its desirability and mood while a road touches it, and the works\' days left', () => {
    const w = city('market_town');

    b.style = 2;
    expect(text(palaceRows(w, b))).toEqual({ style: 'Style: Pylons and banners', nicer: 'Makes homes nicer up to 6 tiles away (+8 beside it)', mood: 'Mood: +2' });
```

```js
// ── The sheets' rows (Task C2) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const centreOf = (b) => ({ x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.d / 2 });
const MAKER = { stone: 'quarry', bricks: 'brickworks' };

// Where a stall's fix points (spec 4.16 Stalls): Show me opens a card with its ghost near the site (a quarry on the rocky
// ground nearest it), View selects the guild that is short of workers or burning. null when the cause has no fix to offer.
export function causeFix(world, b, reason, status = null) {
  const c = centreOf(b);
  if (reason === 'no_road') return { showMe: { category: 'roads', item: 'road', x: c.x, y: c.y } };
  if (reason === 'no_crew') return { showMe: { category: 'monuments', item: 'builders_guild', x: c.x, y: c.y } };
  if (reason === 'no_stone' || reason === 'no_bricks') {
    const item = MAKER[reason.slice(3)];
    const at = BUILDINGS[item].terrain ? nearestTerrainTile(world, BUILDINGS[item].terrain, c) || c : c;
    return { showMe: { category: 'monuments', item, x: at.x, y: at.y } };
  }
  if (reason === 'crew_short' || reason === 'crew_burning') {
    const guilds = status ? status.crews.guilds : [];
    const id = guilds.length ? guilds[0] : guildsNear(world, b)[0];
    return Number.isInteger(id) && world.buildings[id] ? { view: id } : null;
  }
  return null;
}

// A stall's cause in words (spec 4.16), the same on the sheet, in the alert list and on Welcome back; '' for none.
export function causeText(world, b, reason) {
  const C = UI4_TEXT.cause;
  if (!reason) return '';
  if (reason === 'no_crew') return C.no_crew(MONUMENT.crewReach);
  if (reason === 'waiting_gilding' || reason === 'waiting_capstone') return C[reason](extraGoldOf(world, b.type));
  if (reason === 'no_stone' || reason === 'no_bricks') return C.material(reason.slice(3));
  return typeof C[reason] === 'string' ? C[reason] : '';
}

// The site sheet's rows (spec 6.3), from siteStatus: [{ key, text, share?, fix? }] in the spec's order: progress, crews, the
// cause of the last day without work (with its fix), each material, pace, gold, prestige.
export function siteRows(world, b, s = siteStatus(world, b)) {
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  const rows = [{ key: 'progress', text: U.progress(s.progress.course, s.progress.courses, s.progress.done), share: s.progress.done }];
  rows.push({ key: 'crews', text: U.crews(s.crews.guilds.length, s.crews.max) });
  const cause = causeText(world, b, s.reason);
  if (cause) rows.push({ key: 'cause', reason: s.reason, text: cause, fix: causeFix(world, b, s.reason, s) });
  for (const g of MATERIALS) {
    const m = s.materials[g];
    if (m) rows.push({ key: `material-${g}`, text: U.material(g, m.onSite, m.makers.length, m.stores.length) });
  }
  if (!s.paused && s.road) {
    let pace = U.paceLater;
    if (s.pace !== null) pace = U.pace(s.pace);
    else if (s.last && !(s.last.units > 0)) pace = U.notProgressing(s.reason);
    rows.push({ key: 'pace', text: pace });
  }
  rows.push({ key: 'gold', text: s.last ? U.lastMonth(s.last.gold, s.last.crews) : U.workGold(workGoldPerUnit(world) * MONUMENT.unitsPerCrewMonth) });
  rows.push({ key: 'prestige', text: s.prestige.holds ? U.prestige(s.prestige.now, s.prestige.more) : U.otherHolds(b.type) });
  return rows;
}

// How many homes a standing building makes nicer: the homes it adds desirability to (desirabilityContributors).
export function homesMadeNicer(world, b) {
  return housesOf(world).filter((h) => desirabilityContributors(world, h, Infinity).some((c) => c.id === b.id && c.value > 0)).length;
}

// A finished monument's rows (spec 6.3, ruling 258): the day it was finished, its prestige or which other of its kind holds it,
// and the homes it makes nicer.
export function finishedRows(world, b) {
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  const month = Math.floor(b.site.done / DAYS_PER_MONTH);
  return [
    { key: 'finished', text: U.finishedOn(Math.floor(month / MONTHS_PER_YEAR) + 1, (month % MONTHS_PER_YEAR) + 1) },
    { key: 'prestige', text: holdsPrestige(world, b) ? U.countsFor(prestigeOfBuilding(b)) : U.otherCounts(b.type) },
    { key: 'nicer', text: U.homesNicer(homesMadeNicer(world, b)) },
  ];
}

// A builders' guild's, quarry's or brickworks' line (spec 6.3, ruling 258), or '' (a working quarry says what it makes on the
// Stage 1 work line). A quarry or brickworks serves the first site whose siteStatus lists it among its makers. sim: the sim
// functions it reads (Track A's; a test hands in their contract shapes).
const SUPPLY_SIM = { siteStatus, supplyNeeded, guildSite };
export function supplyLine(world, b, sim = SUPPLY_SIM) {
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  if (b.type === 'builders_guild') {
    if (b.paused) return '';
    const id = sim.guildSite(world, b);
    return id !== null ? U.crewAt(world.buildings[id].type) : U.guildIdle(MONUMENT.crewReach);
  }
  const good = BUILDINGS[b.type].produces && BUILDINGS[b.type].produces.good;
  if (!good || !MATERIALS.includes(good) || b.paused) return '';
  for (const site of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (!isSite(site)) continue;
    const m = sim.siteStatus(world, site).materials[good];
    if (m && m.makers.includes(b.id)) return U.sends(good, site.type);
  }
  return sim.supplyNeeded(world, b) ? '' : U.supplyIdle(good);
}

// The palace's rows (spec 6.3, 4.20): its style, then its desirability and mood while a road touches it (else that it needs
// one, with Show me), and the works' days left while it is enlarged.
export function palaceRows(world, b) {
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  const style = PALACE_STYLES[b.style];
  const rows = [{ key: 'style', text: U.palaceStyle(UI4_PALACE_TEXT[style.id].name) }];
  if (touchesRoad(world, b)) rows.push({ key: 'nicer', text: U.palaceNicer(style.desirability) }, { key: 'mood', text: U.palaceMood(palaceMood(world)) });
  else rows.push({ key: 'road', text: U.palaceNoRoad, fix: causeFix(world, b, 'no_road') });
  if (b.works) rows.push({ key: 'works', text: U.palaceWorks(UI4_PALACE_TEXT[PALACE_STYLES[b.works.style].id].to, b.works.left) });
  return rows;
}

// Enlarge the palace (spec 4.20, ruling 273): { ok, text } from palaceQuote: the next style and its price, or why it waits.
export function enlargeModel(world, b) {
  const q = palaceQuote(world, b.id);
  const W = UI4_TEXT.enlargeWhy;
  const next = q.next === null ? null : UI4_PALACE_TEXT[PALACE_STYLES[q.next].id];
  if (q.ok) return { ok: true, text: UI4_TEXT.enlarge(next.to, q.price), quote: q, next };
  let text = W.last_style;
  if (q.reason === 'works') text = W.works(b.works.left);
  else if (q.reason === 'locked') text = W.locked(next.comes, MILESTONES[milestoneIndex(q.milestone)].name);
  else if (q.reason === 'no_road') text = W.no_road;
  else if (q.reason === 'no_gold') text = W.no_gold(world.gold);
  return { ok: false, text, quote: q, next };
}

// Demolish's question for a monument or the palace (spec 4.16, 4.20): what is lost and the refund, or null for anything else.
export function demolishQuestion(world, b) {
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  const refund = demolishRefundFor(world, b);
  if (b.type === 'palace') return U.tearDownPalace(b.style + (b.works ? 1 : 0), refund);
  if (!isMonument(b)) return null;
  const counts = holdsPrestige(world, b) ? prestigeOfBuilding(b) : 0;
  if (isFinished(b)) return U.tearDownFinished(b.type, counts, refund);
  return U.tearDownSite(b.type, b.site.course, MONUMENTS[b.type].courses.length, counts > 0, refund);
}

// ── The interface ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function createMonumentUi(ctx) {
  const { world, store } = ctx;
  const after = (e) => { if (typeof ctx.afterCommand === 'function') ctx.afterCommand(e); };
  const motion = () => (ctx.settings && typeof ctx.settings.motionLevel === 'function' ? ctx.settings.motionLevel() : 'still');

  // A row with its fix: Show me opens the card and aims its ghost; View selects the building.
  function fixButton(row) {
    const f = row.fix;
    if (!f) return null;
    if (f.showMe) return button(T.showMe, { class: 'show-me quiet', 'aria-label': `${T.showMe}: ${row.text}`, onClick: () => ctx.showMeAt(f.showMe) });
    const g = world.buildings[f.view];
    return button(T.view, { class: 'view quiet', 'aria-label': viewLabel(buildingName(g.type)), onClick: () => ctx.selectBuilding(f.view) });
  }
  const rowList = (cls, rows) => el('ul', { class: `s4-rows ${cls}` }, rows.map((r) => el('li', { class: `row-${r.key}`, dataset: { row: r.key } }, [
    el('span', { class: 'text', text: r.text }),
    Number.isFinite(r.share) ? el('span', { class: 'meter', role: 'progressbar', 'aria-valuemin': '0', 'aria-valuemax': '100', 'aria-valuenow': String(Math.floor(r.share * 100)), 'aria-label': r.text }, [
      el('span', { class: 'fill', style: { width: `${Math.floor(r.share * 100)}%` } })]) : null,
    fixButton(r),
  ])));

  function buildingPart(b) {
    if (isSite(b)) return [rowList('site', siteRows(world, b))];
    if (isFinished(b)) return [rowList('finished', finishedRows(world, b))];
    if (b.type === 'palace') return [rowList('palace', palaceRows(world, b))];
    const line = ['builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks'].includes(b.type) ? supplyLine(world, b) : '';
    return line ? [el('p', { class: 'work-status supply-line', text: line })] : [];
  }

  function enlarge(b, m) {
    store.set({ confirmDialog: { text: UI4_TEXT.enlargeAsk(m.next.to, m.quote.price), confirmLabel: UI4_TEXT.enlargeOk, onConfirm: () => {
      const r = enlargePalace(world, b.id);
      if (!r.ok) return;
      if (ctx.toasts) ctx.toasts.show(UI4_TEXT.enlarged(m.next.to, r.days));
      after({ kind: 'enlarge', result: r, undoable: false });
    } } });
  }

  function actionsPart(b) {
    if (isSite(b)) {
      return [
        button(b.paused ? T.resume : T.pause, { class: 'pause', onClick: () => {
          const r = setPaused(world, b.id, !b.paused);
          if (r.ok) { assignLabour(world); after({ kind: 'pause', result: r, text: b.paused ? T.paused : T.resumed, undoable: false }); }
        } }),
        button(T.view, { class: 'view', 'aria-label': viewLabel(buildingName(b.type)), onClick: () => ctx.selectBuilding(b.id) }),
      ];
    }
    if (b.type === 'palace') {
      const m = enlargeModel(world, b);
      return [button(m.text, { class: m.ok ? 'enlarge primary' : 'enlarge', disabled: !m.ok, onClick: () => enlarge(b, m) })];
    }
    return [];
  }

  return {
    sheets: {},
    sheetParts: { building: buildingPart, actions: actionsPart },
    onEvents(events) {
      for (const e of events) {
        if (e.type !== 'palace_done') continue;
        const b = world.buildings[e.id];
        if (ctx.celebrations) ctx.celebrations.show({ tier: 'info', text: UI4_TEXT.palaceDone(UI4_PALACE_TEXT[PALACE_STYLES[e.style].id].to) });
        if (b && ctx.effects && motion() === 'full') ctx.effects.sparkle(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2, GOLD, ctx.now());   // a small sparkle under Full only
      }
    },
    refresh() {},
    onAlertAction(alert, action) {},
    // Undo refused once work has begun on a site (ruling 236): its own words, naming the site (placement.js passes it on).
    onCommand(e) {
      if (e.kind === 'undo_refused' && e.result && e.result.reason === 'work_begun' && ctx.toasts) ctx.toasts.show(UI4_TEXT.workBegun(e.result.type));
    },
    pickFit(type, ghost, insets) {
      const shown = cameraOf(world);
      if (!shown || !BUILDINGS[type] || !BUILDINGS[type].monument || !ghost) return null;
```

```js
    return `${item}:${i.affordable ? 'a' : 'u'}${i.locked ? 'l' : 'o'}${i.isNew ? 'n' : ''}${i.lockText}${i.costText}`;   // a prestige count moving, or a palace standing, rebuilds it
  });
  return `${category}|${activeItem}|${states.join(',')}`;
}
```

```js
// Stage 4 (Track C, spec 6.3): a monument site's reach, the road tiles within MONUMENT.crewReach (its guilds, quarries and
// brickworks serve it from there) and within MONUMENT.supplyReach (it draws from storehouses there): { crew, supply }, tile
// indices; empty for a site no road touches.
export function siteReachTiles(world, b) {
  return { crew: [...roadReach(world, b, MONUMENT.crewReach).keys()], supply: [...roadReach(world, b, MONUMENT.supplyReach).keys()] };
}

export function drawReachHighlight(g, world, b) {
  if (isSite(b)) {
    // Both reaches: the 16-tile supply reach lighter, the 12-tile crew and producer reach at the usual strength.
    const { crew, supply } = siteReachTiles(world, b);
    const inner = new Set(crew);
    tintTiles(g, world, supply.filter((t) => !inner.has(t)), UI.housing, 0.1);
    tintTiles(g, world, crew, UI.housing, 0.22);
  } else tintTiles(g, world, RANGE_OF[b.type] ? rangeTiles(world, b) : reachTiles(world, b), UI.housing, 0.22);
  g.poly(quad(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, 0), 'none', { stroke: UI.halo, strokeWidth: 2.2, strokeAlpha: 0.9 });
  g.poly(quad(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d, 0), 'none', { stroke: UI.housing, strokeWidth: 1.2 });
}
```

```js
// Stage 4 (Track C, spec 6.3, ruling 281): View from the alert list, the banner or Welcome back outlines the building it selects
// in the marker's colour with a white halo for VIEW_OUTLINE.holdMs, then fades out over fadeMs under Full motion; under Gentle
// and Still it holds still and then goes. noteView(world, id) starts it (the View buttons call it); the clock and the Motion
// level come from the interface (setViewClock, the monuments interface sets it); drawReachHighlight draws it on the selected
// building, so it shows while View's selection does.
const viewClocks = new WeakMap();   // world -> { now(), motion() }
const viewed = new WeakMap();       // world -> { id, at }
export const setViewClock = (world, clock) => { viewClocks.set(world, clock); };
export function noteView(world, id) {
  const clock = viewClocks.get(world);
  if (Number.isInteger(id) && clock) viewed.set(world, { id, at: clock.now() });
}
// The outline's strength ms after View: 1 while it holds, easing to 0 over the fade under Full, else 0 once it has held.
export function viewOutlineAlpha(ms, motion) {
  if (ms < 0) return 0;
  if (ms < VIEW_OUTLINE.holdMs) return 1;
  if (motion === 'full' && ms < VIEW_OUTLINE.holdMs + VIEW_OUTLINE.fadeMs) return 1 - (ms - VIEW_OUTLINE.holdMs) / VIEW_OUTLINE.fadeMs;
  return 0;
}
// The outline's strength on building `id` now (0 when View did not pick it, or its time has passed).
export function viewOutlineOn(world, id) {
  const v = viewed.get(world), clock = viewClocks.get(world);
  if (!v || !clock || v.id !== id) return 0;
  return viewOutlineAlpha(clock.now() - v.at, clock.motion());
}
```

```js
// ── The summary and the markers (Task C3) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// The city summary's Monuments section (spec 6.3), from City: each site with its course (and its share done, for the bar), each
// finished monument, then the city's prestige and what it unlocks next (the next prestige unlock not yet reached, with its
// milestone while that waits), or the prestige of all seven once both are reached. [] before City.
export function summaryRows(world) {
  if (!atLeast(world, 'city')) return [];
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  const rows = [];
  const mine = allBuildings(world).filter(isMonument).sort((a, b) => MONUMENT_KINDS.indexOf(a.type) - MONUMENT_KINDS.indexOf(b.type) || a.id - b.id);
  for (const b of mine) {
    if (isFinished(b)) rows.push({ key: 'finished', id: b.id, text: U.finishedLine(b.type) });
    else {
      const s = siteStatus(world, b);
      rows.push({ key: 'site', id: b.id, text: U.siteLine(b.type, s.progress.course, s.progress.courses), share: s.progress.done });
    }
  }
  if (!mine.length) rows.push({ key: 'none', text: U.noMonumentYet });
  const p = prestigeOf(world);
  const next = PRESTIGE_UNLOCKS.find((k) => !Number.isInteger(world.prestigeUnlocks[k]));
  if (next) {
    const u = MONUMENTS[next].unlock;
    rows.push({ key: 'prestige', text: U.prestigeNext(p, next, u.prestige, atLeast(world, u.milestone) ? '' : MILESTONES[milestoneIndex(u.milestone)].name) });
  } else rows.push({ key: 'prestige', text: U.prestigeAll(p, PRESTIGE.scoreFull) });
  return rows;
}

// A count badge (more than one building on its stem) zooms in one step centred on its buildings (ruling 281): the camera's
// target { x, y, zoom }, or null for a single marker (createUI then selects its building).
export function countBadgeTarget(world, marker, zoom) {
  const ids = (marker && marker.ids || []).filter((id) => world.buildings[id]);
  if (ids.length < 2) return null;
  const bs = ids.map((id) => world.buildings[id]);
  const x = bs.reduce((s, b) => s + b.x + b.w / 2, 0) / bs.length, y = bs.reduce((s, b) => s + b.y + b.d / 2, 0) / bs.length;
  return { x, y, zoom: zoom * ZOOM_STEP };
}
```

```js
// Stage 4 (Track C, spec 4.17): each monument site's course and its pace, from siteStatus, oldest first: "Small pyramid: course
// 6 of 8, about 3 years left at last month's pace", "... not progressing: no stone", "... paused", "... no road yet", or
// "... pace shows after a month of work". Nothing advances while the game is closed, so this is where the player left it.
export function siteLines(world) {
  const U = UI4_TEXT;
  return allBuildings(world).filter(isSite).map((b) => {
    const s = siteStatus(world, b);
    let state = U.welcomeFirst;
    if (!s.road) state = U.welcomeNoRoad;
    else if (s.paused) state = U.welcomePaused;
    else if (s.pace !== null) state = U.welcomePace(s.pace);
    else if (s.last && !(s.last.units > 0)) state = U.welcomeStill(s.reason);
    return U.welcomeSite(b.type, s.progress.course, s.progress.courses, state);
  });
}
```

```js
// The nearest spot to (cx, cy), within r tiles, where `type` can be placed with a road touching it (the sim's strict
// canPlace), or null.
function spotFor(world, type, cx, cy, r) {
  let best = null;
  for (let y = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cy - r)); y <= Math.min(world.size - 1, Math.ceil(cy + r)); y++) {
    for (let x = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cx - r)); x <= Math.min(world.size - 1, Math.ceil(cx + r)); x++) {
      const d = Math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy);
      if (d > r || (best && d >= best.d) || !canPlace(world, type, x, y).ok) continue;
      best = { x, y, d };
    }
  }
  return best;
}

// Stage 4 (Track C): the town palace at its highest style (lapis and gold), in the town centre, its sheet open: the palace is

  const nearest = (type) => allBuildings(world).filter((b) => b.type === type).sort((a, b) => near(a) - near(b))[0];
  const temple = nearest('temple'), bazaar = nearest('bazaar');
```

```js
// Stage 4 (Track C, review note 3.9): a small pyramid's site sheet: its course and share done, two crews, stone and bricks on
// site, what holds it up (bricks), last month's pace and gold, and its prestige. The city is made a Capital with the small
// pyramid unlocked; the site and two builders' guilds are placed through the commands on spots with a road near the middle of
// the city, and the site's state (courses, stock, crews, last month, the reason it waits) is written to the contract's shape,
// as a few years of Track A's crews would leave it. Then the site is selected as a tap on it selects it.
async function sitesheet(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'sitesheet'), { world, ui } = g;
  world.milestone = 'capital';
  world.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = world.day;
  world.gold = Math.max(world.gold, 20000);
  const at = spotFor(world, 'pyramid_small', world.focus.x, world.focus.y, 16);
  if (!at) throw new Error('devScene sitesheet: no room for a small pyramid with a road near the middle of the city');
  const site = place(world, 'pyramid_small', at.x, at.y);
  if (!site.ok) throw new Error(`devScene sitesheet: the site would not go down (${site.reason})`);
  const guilds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const s = spotFor(world, 'builders_guild', at.x + 2, at.y + 2, 10);
    const r = s ? place(world, 'builders_guild', s.x, s.y) : null;
    if (r && r.ok) guilds.push(r.id);
  }
  const b = world.buildings[site.id];
  Object.assign(b.site, {
    course: 3, laid: { stone: 408, bricks: 72 }, stock: { stone: 46, bricks: 0 }, crews: guilds, idle: 3, reason: 'no_bricks',
    last: { units: 40, gold: 200, crews: guilds.length },
  });
  assignLabour(world);
  ui.refresh();
  g.cam.zoom = 1;
  focus(g, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2, 'sheet');
  ui.store.set(select(ui.store.get(), b.id));
  await wait(300);
  return `sitesheet ${b.id} at ${at.x},${at.y} crews ${guilds.length}`;
}
```

# Track D: score v2 and gamification

CONTRACT NOTE: The monument events follow the controller's ruling from Track A's plan: `{ type: 'course_done', id, kind, course, prestige }`, `{ type: 'monument_done', id, kind, prestige }`, `{ type: 'site_stalled', id, kind, reason }`, with `prestige` what the event added to the city's prestige (0 for a second of a kind). The contract's tables still write `type: kind` (a JavaScript object keeps only one `type`); D reads `e.kind` and never a second `type`. Smallest fix: the contract's event table and `src/sim/monuments.js`'s header say `kind`.
CONTRACT NOTE: Records by score version (the controller's ruling for D1): `noteCity` and `mergeCity` read each month-end row's `version` (a row without one is score v1), give each best its own version's medal (v1 on 160/240/320, `MEDALS_BY_VERSION`), and never compare a v1 score with a v2 one. A city row keeps its newest version's best as its own and the one before as an optional `older` field (`{ best, bestDay, medal, scoreVersion }`), so a city begun under v1 keeps its v1 best ("older scoring") beside its first v2 best; `bests()` lists one per seed, level and version; `bestFor(..., { version })` (a `t1` link asks for 1). A v1 chronicle entry keeps v1's four parts (no invented `monuments: 0`). D1 restores the pinned test Track 0 edited (`tests/stage3/score/records.test.js`: the rows carry no version, so the best is v1 240, silver) and edits two more lines of that file and one of `tests/stage3/score/scoreUi.test.js` (its trend row becomes a v2 row).
CONTRACT NOTE: `TIPS.length` is no longer pinned (the controller's accepted ruling): `tests/stage4/contract/uiSeams.test.js` and `tests/ui/tips.test.js` now check that the twenty base tips lead, in order, and every id is unique (Task D3). On the real branch the controller makes the same change to `uiSeams.test.js`; on merge keep either side (they are the same lines).
CONTRACT NOTE: Stage 1-3 tests that pin D's own lists change where Track D's data grows them: `tests/sim/goalsV2.test.js` (the event goals list gains `fix_site`), `tests/sim/goalsStage2.test.js` (the Stage 2 chain is read without the Monuments chapter), `tests/sim/achievements.test.js` (42 and four new measure kinds), `tests/sim/daily.test.js` (three ids), `tests/ui/achievementsSheet.test.js` (one more yes-or-no achievement), `tests/stage3/contract/dangerData.test.js` (12 feats), `tests/stage3/score/dangerGoals.test.js` and `feats.test.js` (their slices end where Stage 3's lists end), and `tests/stage3/score/score.test.js` (the Monuments reason). Each edit is listed in its task.
CONTRACT NOTE: Track D words the palace's caption when its works end ("The palace is now a columned hall", spec 4.20), since captions are D's, with its own style phrases (`SCORE4_TEXT.palaceStyles`), and adds the palace's first ("First palace") and the "Lapis and gold" achievement (spec 4.20, ruling 275). If Track C's palace sheet names the styles in its own section, the integrator may point D's caption at C's names (one line in `score4PalaceText`).
CONTRACT NOTE: The reworded opening goals and their whys live on the goals in `src/data/goals.js` (`why`), where every goal's words already live; `text.js`'s cards section comment says Track G words them, but contract note 19 gives them to D. The needs stay as they were (any six plots, any well), so every Stage 1-3 goal test and scripted run holds; "by the road", "by the homes' road" and "on fertile land" are the instructions, and each why, which states a rule, is tested against the sim.
CONTRACT NOTE: `stoneLaid`, `stoneDelivered` and `site.month.units` are sums of fractions (the controller's ruling): achievements and daily goals count a tally in whole units (`Math.floor`), so "Lay 5,000 stone" and "Bring 100 stone" compare whole units with `>=`. Steady hands reads `site.starved` and, for a monument finished this month, `site.month.starvedDays` (crew-days short of material) before the month's roll marks it.

## Track D: Score v2 and gamification

Track D works in its own worktree on the branch `s4-score`, cut from the Track 0 commit:

```powershell
git -C C:\dev\thebes worktree add C:\dev\thebes-s4-score -b s4-score <track-0-commit>
```

Run every command below from `C:\dev\thebes-s4-score`. Track D owns `src/sim/score.js`, `feats.js`, `goals.js`, `firsts.js`, `achievements.js`, `daily.js`; `src/data/scoring.js`, `feats.js`, `goals.js`, `firsts.js`, `achievements.js`, `daily.js`; `src/save/records.js`, `src/ui/scoreUi.js`, `share.js`, `hud.js`, `goalsList.js`, `celebrate.js`; `welcomeBack.js`' score trend only; its sections of `src/ui/text.js`, `src/data/tips.js` and `css/ui.css`; and `tests/stage4/score.all.js` with `tests/stage4/score/*`. Every code block below was applied, in this order, to a copy of the repo at the Track 0 commit (`73198fb` on the scratch branch, 1,426 tests), and each task's tests and the full suite were run after each task: 1,439, 1,448 and 1,458 tests, `ALL PASSED`. The before-blocks are exact; apply them in the order given. Before every commit `git grep -n -i` for the employer's name must print nothing.

What the track builds, in one paragraph: score v2's words and records. The Monuments part's reason names the next step from the monuments standing (finish the most advanced site holding its kind, found the next kind, or when the next kind comes), and a monument's confirm-bar line is what it adds to the part once finished ("+12 Monuments when finished"; nothing for a second of a kind). The summary lists all seven splits; records keep each best under its own score version and medal scale, so a v1 best stays as "older scoring" and a `t1` link is compared only with it; Welcome back's trend compares one version; a sealed reign's stamp gains a glyph for each mastaba and pyramid finished. Then the goals: the opening four say the road and fertile-land rules with a why each (ruling 265), the Monuments chapter runs from City to the great pyramid (with `when` goals that wait without holding up the list), and the first stalled site becomes a goal worded and aimed by its cause. Last, the rewards: five firsts, six achievements (with "Lapis and gold"), two feats, three daily goals drawn only while a site is under way, six tips, ten remarks, and the course, finish and palace captions. Everything passes "skipping it costs you nothing": no streaks, no timers while away, nothing gated.

Tasks: the proposed D2 is split in two (D2 the goals, D3 the rewards and captions), because each half touches a different set of files and Stage 1-3 pins, and either alone is a full task.

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { scoreOf, monumentPreview, medalFor } from '../../../src/sim/score.js';
import { prestigeOf, updatePrestigeUnlocks } from '../../../src/sim/monuments.js';
import { MONUMENTS } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { scoreLineFor } from '../../../src/ui/scoreUi.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { score4ReasonText, score4MonumentLine, score4SplitText, splitCompareText } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';

// A desert street on y = 10 at the given milestone (fertile land is x < 8 in the test world).
function street(milestone = 'city') {
  const w = makeTestWorld({ gold: 100000 });
  setRoad(w, 8, 10, 31, 10);
  w.milestone = milestone;
  return w;
}
// A monument standing by hand: `course` courses laid, finished on day `done` (or a site under way when done is null).
function monument(w, type, x, y, course, done = null) {
  const b = addRaw(w, type, x, y);
  Object.assign(b.site, { course, done });
  return b;
}
const finished = (w, type, x, y) => monument(w, type, x, y, MONUMENTS[type].courses.length, 30);
const reason = (w) => scoreOf(w).reasons.monuments;
const words = (w) => score4ReasonText(reason(w));

describe('s4 score Monuments part', () => {
  it('names the next step before City, at City and with every kind but the pyramids standing', () => {
    const w = street('market_town');
    expect([reason(w), words(w)]).toEqual([{ code: 'locked', type: 'obelisk_small', first: true, milestone: 'city' }, 'Monuments come with City']);
    w.milestone = 'city';
    expect([reason(w), words(w)]).toEqual([{ code: 'found', type: 'obelisk_small', first: true, more: 10, milestone: 'city' }, 'No monument yet: found a small obelisk (City)']);
    finished(w, 'obelisk_small', 10, 11);
    expect(words(w)).toBe('Found a large obelisk: +30 prestige when finished');
    finished(w, 'obelisk_large', 12, 11);
    expect([reason(w), words(w)]).toEqual([{ code: 'locked', type: 'colossus', first: false, milestone: 'great_city' }, 'The colossus comes with Great city']);
    w.milestone = 'capital';
    for (const [k, x] of [['colossus', 14], ['mastaba_small', 17], ['mastaba_large', 21]]) finished(w, k, x, 11);
    expect(prestigeOf(w)).toBe(270);
    expect(words(w)).toBe('The small pyramid needs 100 prestige (you have 270)');   // the day before updatePrestigeUnlocks records it
    updatePrestigeUnlocks(w);
    expect(words(w)).toBe('Found a small pyramid: +160 prestige when finished');
  });
  it('asks to finish the most advanced site holding its kind, and the prestige it names is what finishing it adds', () => {
    const w = street('great_city');
    finished(w, 'obelisk_small', 10, 11);
    const large = monument(w, 'obelisk_large', 12, 11, 2);            // 2 of 4 courses: 7 of 15 course prestige
    const colossus = monument(w, 'colossus', 14, 11, 1);              // 1 of 6: less far along
    expect([reason(w), words(w)]).toEqual([{ code: 'finish', type: 'obelisk_large', id: large.id, more: 23 }, 'Finish the large obelisk: +23 prestige']);
    const before = prestigeOf(w);
    Object.assign(large.site, { course: 4, done: 90 });
    expect(prestigeOf(w) - before).toBe(23);                          // the words follow prestigeOf
    expect(words(w)).toBe(`Finish the colossus: +${50 - Math.floor((25 * 1) / 6)} prestige`);
    expect(reason(w).id).toBe(colossus.id);
    const second = monument(w, 'colossus', 18, 11, 5);                // a second colossus further along holds the kind now
    expect([reason(w).id, reason(w).more]).toEqual([second.id, 50 - Math.floor((25 * 5) / 6)]);
  });
  it('has no reason once the part is 100, and scores the curve of spec 4.19', () => {
    const w = street('capital');
    const at = [['obelisk_small', 8, 11, 12], ['obelisk_large', 10, 11, 24], ['colossus', 12, 11, 36], ['mastaba_small', 15, 11, 48],
      ['mastaba_large', 19, 11, 62], ['pyramid_small', 8, 18, 78], ['pyramid_great', 14, 18, 100]];
    for (const [k, x, y, part] of at) {
      finished(w, k, x, y);
      expect([k, scoreOf(w).parts.monuments]).toEqual([k, part]);
    }
    expect(reason(w)).toBe(null);
  });
  it('previews "+N Monuments when finished" as the part will count it, and nothing for a second of a kind', () => {
    const w = street('city');
    expect(monumentPreview(w, 'obelisk_small')).toEqual({ gain: 12, second: false });
    expect([monumentPreview(w, 'well'), score4MonumentLine(monumentPreview(w, 'obelisk_small'))]).toEqual([null, '+12 Monuments when finished']);
    expect(scoreLineFor(w, 'obelisk_small', 12, 11)).toBe('+12 Monuments when finished');
    const site = monument(w, 'obelisk_small', 10, 11, 0);
    expect([monumentPreview(w, 'obelisk_small'), scoreLineFor(w, 'obelisk_small', 12, 11)]).toEqual([{ gain: 0, second: true }, '']);
    Object.assign(site.site, { course: 3, done: 60 });
    const before = scoreOf(w).parts.monuments;
    const gain = monumentPreview(w, 'obelisk_large').gain;
    expect([before, gain, score4MonumentLine({ gain: 0, second: false })]).toEqual([12, 12, '']);
    monument(w, 'obelisk_large', 12, 11, 4, 90);
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.monuments - before).toBe(gain);           // the preview came true
  });
  it('reads a medal on its own version\'s scale: 240 is silver under v1 and bronze under v2', () => {
    expect([medalFor(240, 1), medalFor(240, 2), medalFor(240), medalFor(159, 1), medalFor(320, 1), medalFor(399)]).toEqual(['silver', 'bronze', 'bronze', null, 'gold', 'silver']);
  });
  it('words the two new splits by name, and the five milestones as before', () => {
    expect(score4SplitText('pyramids', 30 * 12 * 11 + 60, null)).toBe('Pyramids unlocked in year 12, month 3');
    expect(score4SplitText('great_pyramid', 360 * 20, 360 * 20 + 90)).toBe('Great pyramid finished in year 21, month 1: 3 months faster than your best');
    expect(score4SplitText('town', 400, 460)).toBe(splitCompareText('town', 400, 460));
  });
});
```
