Create `tests/stage4/score/recordsV2.test.js`:

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { createRecords, mergeRecords, normalizeRecords } from '../../../src/save/records.js';
import { RECORDS_KEY } from '../../../src/data/scoring.js';
import { createWorld } from '../../../src/sim/world.js';
import { makeTestWorld, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';

function memory(start = null) {
  const data = start ? { [RECORDS_KEY]: JSON.stringify(start) } : {};
  return { data, getItem: (k) => (k in data ? data[k] : null), setItem: (k, v) => { data[k] = String(v); } };
}
// Month-end rows: a v1 row has four parts and no version (MIGRATIONS[4] marks them 1; a missing one reads as 1); a v2 row
// five parts and version 2. Each part is the score's share, so the medal follows the score on its own scale.
const v1 = (day, score) => ({ day, people: 0, gold: 0, mood: 60, score, parts: { people: score / 4, prosperity: score / 4, culture: score / 4, safety: score / 4 } });
const v2 = (day, score) => ({ day, people: 0, gold: 0, mood: 60, score, parts: { people: score / 5, prosperity: score / 5, culture: score / 5, safety: score / 5, monuments: score / 5 }, version: 2 });
function city(history, { id = 'a', seed = 11 } = {}) {
  const w = createWorld({ seed, difficulty: 'normal', cityId: id });
  w.history = history;
  return w;
}

describe('s4 score records', () => {
  it('keeps a city\'s v1 best as older scoring beside its first v2 best, each with its own medal, never one against the other', () => {
    const storage = memory();
    const r = createRecords({ storage });
    r.noteCity(city([v1(30, 300), v1(60, 250)]), 1);                  // a Stage 3 city, before any v2 month end
    expect(r.load().cities[0]).toEqual({ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 300, bestDay: 30, medal: 'silver', splits: {}, updated: 1 });   // 300 of 400: v1's silver
    r.noteCity(city([v1(60, 250), v2(90, 250)]), 2);                  // its first v2 month: 250 is bronze under v2
    expect(r.load().cities[0]).toEqual({ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 2, best: 250, bestDay: 90, medal: 'bronze', splits: {}, updated: 2,
      older: { best: 300, bestDay: 30, medal: 'silver', scoreVersion: 1 } });
    r.noteCity(city([v2(120, 280)]), 3);                              // the v1 rows have left the 12 rows: the older best stays
    expect([r.load().cities[0].best, r.load().cities[0].older]).toEqual([280, { best: 300, bestDay: 30, medal: 'silver', scoreVersion: 1 }]);
    expect(r.bests()).toEqual([
      { seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', score: 300, medal: 'silver', version: 1, older: true },
      { seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', score: 280, medal: 'bronze', version: 2, older: false },
    ]);
    expect([r.bestFor(11, 'normal').score, r.bestFor(11, 'normal', { version: 1 }).score, r.bestFor(11, 'normal', { except: 'a' })]).toEqual([280, 300, null]);
  });
  it('merges an imported Stage 3 row into a Stage 4 one by version, and drops an older best that is not older', () => {
    const stage3 = { version: 1, cities: [{ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 320, bestDay: 60, medal: 'gold', splits: { town: 300 }, updated: 1 }], chronicle: [] };
    const stage4 = { version: 1, cities: [{ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 2, best: 210, bestDay: 900, medal: 'bronze', splits: { town: 400, city: 800 }, updated: 2 }], chronicle: [] };
    const m = mergeRecords(stage3, stage4);
    expect(m.cities).toEqual([{ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 2, best: 210, bestDay: 900, medal: 'bronze', splits: { town: 300, city: 800 }, updated: 2,
      older: { best: 320, bestDay: 60, medal: 'gold', scoreVersion: 1 } }]);
    const odd = normalizeRecords({ cities: [{ ...stage4.cities[0], older: { best: 400, bestDay: 1, medal: 'gold', scoreVersion: 2 } }] });
    expect(odd.cities[0].older).toBe(undefined);
  });
  it('keeps a v1 seal\'s four parts, and lists each finished mastaba and pyramid for the stamp', () => {
    const r = createRecords({ storage: memory() });
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    w.cityId = 'a';
    for (const [type, x, done] of [['pyramid_small', 2, 900], ['mastaba_small', 8, 300], ['mastaba_small', 12, null], ['colossus', 16, 200], ['mastaba_small', 20, 500]]) {
      Object.assign(addRaw(w, type, x, 20).site, { done });
    }
    w.seals.push({ day: 1000, score: 330, parts: { people: 70, prosperity: 70, culture: 70, safety: 70, monuments: 50 }, medal: 'silver', version: 2 });
    const e = r.addSeal(w, w.seals[0], 5);
    expect([e.parts, e.built]).toEqual([{ people: 70, prosperity: 70, culture: 70, safety: 70, monuments: 50 }, ['mastaba_small', 'mastaba_small', 'pyramid_small']]);
    w.seals.push({ day: 1, score: 200, parts: { people: 50, prosperity: 50, culture: 50, safety: 50 }, medal: 'bronze', version: 1 });
    const old = normalizeRecords({ chronicle: [{ ...e, id: 'old', ...w.seals[1] }] }).chronicle[0];
    expect([old.parts, old.version]).toEqual([{ people: 50, prosperity: 50, culture: 50, safety: 50 }, 1]);
    expect(normalizeRecords({ chronicle: [{ ...e, built: ['colossus', 'nonsense'] }] }).chronicle[0].built).toBe(undefined);   // only mastabas and pyramids
  });
});
```

Create `tests/stage4/score/scoreV2Ui.test.js`:

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { scoreOf } from '../../../src/sim/score.js';
import { RECORDS_KEY } from '../../../src/data/scoring.js';
import { createRecords } from '../../../src/save/records.js';
import { shareCheck } from '../../../src/ui/share.js';
import { createTitleCard } from '../../../src/ui/titleCard.js';
import { titleDecor } from '../../../src/ui/scoreUi.js';
import { openSheet } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { mount } from '../../helpers/dom.js';
import { SCORE_TEXT, SCORE4_TEXT, TITLE_SCORE_TEXT, T, score4ReasonText, score4SplitText } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';

const H = 3600 * 1000;
function memory(start = null) {
  const data = start ? { [RECORDS_KEY]: JSON.stringify(start) } : {};
  return { getItem: (k) => (k in data ? data[k] : null), setItem: (k, v) => { data[k] = String(v); } };
}
const summary = (r) => { r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'summary')); return r.root.querySelector('#sheet .score-section'); };
function card(records, shared = '') {
  const m = mount('<div id="title" hidden></div>');
  const container = m.root.querySelector('#title');
  createTitleCard({ container, hasSave: true, onContinue() {}, onNewCity() {}, onSound() {}, onDifficulty() {},
    decorate: titleDecor({ records, shared, startSeed() {}, clock: () => new Date(2026, 9, 11, 12).getTime(), dpr: 1 }) });
  return { container, cleanup: m.cleanup };
}
const t1Link = (seed, parts, splits) => { const body = `t1.${seed}.n.${parts}.${splits}`; return `#${body}.${shareCheck(body)}`; };

describe('s4 score summary and title card', () => {
  it('shows the Monuments part\'s next step and the seven splits in the summary', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();
    try {
      r.world.milestone = 'capital';
      r.world.splits = { town: 400, market_town: 700, city: 1000, great_city: 1500, capital: 2000, pyramids: 4000, great_pyramid: 9000 };
      r.ui.refresh();                                                   // the score is measured once per refresh
      const sec = summary(r);
      const s = scoreOf(r.world);
      expect(sec.querySelector('[data-part="monuments"] .reason').textContent).toBe(score4ReasonText(s.reasons.monuments));
      expect(sec.querySelector('[data-part="monuments"] .reason').textContent).toBe('No monument yet: found a small obelisk (City)');
      const splits = [...sec.querySelectorAll('.split')];
      expect(splits.map((li) => li.dataset.id)).toEqual(['town', 'market_town', 'city', 'great_city', 'capital', 'pyramids', 'great_pyramid']);
      expect(splits[5].textContent).toBe(score4SplitText('pyramids', 4000, null));
      expect(splits[6].textContent.startsWith(SCORE4_TEXT.splitNames.great_pyramid)).toBe(true);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('compares a t1 link only with your best from score v1, and says it is older scoring', () => {
    const records = createRecords({ storage: memory({ version: 1, cities: [
      { id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 2, best: 210, bestDay: 900, medal: 'bronze', splits: {}, updated: 2, older: { best: 300, bestDay: 30, medal: 'gold', scoreVersion: 1 } },
    ], chronicle: [] }) });
    const c = card(records, t1Link(11, '70-60-50-40', '3-x-x-x-x'));
    try {
      expect(c.container.querySelector('.friend-older').textContent).toBe(SCORE4_TEXT.olderLink);
      expect(c.container.querySelector('.your-best').textContent).toBe('Your best here under older scoring: 300');
      expect([...c.container.querySelectorAll('.best-line')].map((p) => p.textContent)).toEqual(['Best: 300, gold, seed 11, Normal, older scoring', 'Best: 210, bronze, seed 11, Normal']);
    } finally { c.cleanup(); }
    const none = card(createRecords({ storage: memory() }), t1Link(11, '70-60-50-40', '3-x-x-x-x'));
    try {
      expect(none.container.querySelector('.your-best').textContent).toBe('You have no older-scoring score on this seed and level');
    } finally { none.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('draws a glyph on a stamp for each mastaba and pyramid finished, and names them', () => {
    const entry = (id, date, built) => ({ id, cityId: 'c', seed: 5, difficulty: 'normal', day: 1, score: 330, parts: {}, splits: {}, medal: 'silver', feats: [], version: 2, date, ...(built ? { built } : {}) });
    const records = createRecords({ storage: memory({ version: 1, cities: [], chronicle: [entry('x', 2, ['mastaba_small', 'pyramid_small', 'pyramid_small']), entry('y', 1, null)] }) });
    const c = card(records);
    try {
      const [withGlyphs, plain] = [...c.container.querySelectorAll('.stamp')];
      expect([withGlyphs.getAttribute('aria-label'), plain.getAttribute('aria-label')])
        .toEqual([`${TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.stampLabel(entry('x', 2))}, with a small mastaba and 2 small pyramids`, TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.stampLabel(entry('y', 1))]);
      const ink = (canvas) => { const d = canvas.getContext('2d').getImageData(20, 31, 1, 1).data; return d[0] + d[1] + d[2]; };
      expect(ink(withGlyphs)).toBeLessThan(ink(plain));                 // a dark glyph at the stamp's foot, where the plain one shows map
    } finally { c.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('compares the score trend in Welcome back only with rows of this score version', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ welcome: { savedAt: Date.now() - H, lastSpeed: 1 } });
    try {
      const now = scoreOf(r.world).total;
      r.world.history = [{ day: 60, people: 4, gold: 0, mood: 60, score: now + 40, parts: { people: 25, prosperity: 25, culture: 25, safety: 25 } }];   // a v1 row
      r.ui.refresh();
      let row = [...r.root.querySelectorAll('#sheet .trends li')][3];
      expect([row.textContent, row.querySelector('.trend')]).toEqual([`${SCORE_TEXT.score} ${now}`, null]);   // no drop shown against v1
      r.world.history.push({ day: 90, people: 4, gold: 0, mood: 60, score: now - 5, parts: { people: 0, prosperity: 0, culture: 0, safety: 0, monuments: 0 }, version: 2 });
      r.ui.refresh();
      row = [...r.root.querySelectorAll('#sheet .trends li')][3];
      expect(row.textContent).toContain(`${SCORE_TEXT.score} ${now}, ${T.upFrom} ${now - 5}`);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

```js
// month-end row, a best or a chronicle entry made under score v1 has v1's four parts and v1's medals (160, 240 and 320 of

// STAMP_GLYPHS_MAX on one stamp (in this order: mastabas, then pyramids). Cosmetic.
```

```js
import { SCORE_VERSION, SCORE_PARTS, SCORE_WEIGHTS, SCORE_TERMS, SCORE_FACTOR, MEDALS, MEDALS_BY_VERSION, SPLITS } from '../data/scoring.js';
```

```js
// The prestige a kind gives in all (its courses' share and its completion share).
const prestigeFullOf = (type) => MONUMENTS[type].prestige.courses + MONUMENTS[type].prestige.done;

// The Monuments part's reason (spec 4.19): the next step, from the monuments standing (prestigeByKind: one of each kind).
//   { code: 'finish', type, id, more }     the most advanced unfinished site that holds its kind's prestige (the highest
//                                          share of its units laid; ties keep the earlier kind), and the prestige still to come
//   { code: 'found', type, first, more, milestone }   else the first kind with none standing, unlocked (first: no monument
//                                          stands at all; more: what it gives once finished; milestone: the one it came with)
//   { code: 'locked', type, first, milestone } or { code: 'locked', type, first, prestige, have }   that kind is not
//                                          unlocked yet: its milestone not reached, or (the pyramids) its prestige not yet held
function monumentsReason(world, prestige) {
  const by = prestigeByKind(world);
  let site = null, share = -1;
  for (const k of MONUMENT_KINDS) {
    const b = by[k].id === null ? null : world.buildings[by[k].id];
    if (!b || b.site.done !== null) continue;
    const done = siteProgress(b).done;
    if (done > share) { site = b; share = done; }
  }
  if (site) return { code: 'finish', type: site.type, id: site.id, more: prestigeFullOf(site.type) - by[site.type].prestige };
  const type = MONUMENT_KINDS.find((k) => by[k].id === null);
  if (!type) return null;
  const first = MONUMENT_KINDS.every((k) => by[k].id === null);
  if (isUnlocked(world, type)) return { code: 'found', type, first, more: prestigeFullOf(type), milestone: MONUMENTS[type].unlock.milestone };
  const u = MONUMENTS[type].unlock;
  return milestoneIndex(world.milestone) >= milestoneIndex(u.milestone)
    ? { code: 'locked', type, first, prestige: u.prestige, have: prestige }
    : { code: 'locked', type, first, milestone: u.milestone };
}

// Stage 4 (score v2, spec 4.19): Monuments, one term, prestige = sqrt(prestige / prestigeFull), at most 1 (complete in the
// contract: src/sim/prestige.js), with the next step as its reason (Track D).
function monumentsTerms(world) {
  const prestige = prestigeOf(world);
  return { prestige: { value: Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(prestige / T.prestigeFull)), reason: monumentsReason(world, prestige) } };
}

// What founding a monument of this type would add to the Monuments part once it is finished (spec 4.19: "+32 Monuments
// when finished"), as monumentsPart counts it: { gain, second }; second is true, and gain 0, when one of its kind already
// stands (one of each kind counts, so a second adds no prestige). null for a type that is not a monument.
export function monumentPreview(world, type) {
  if (!MONUMENTS[type]) return null;
  if (prestigeByKind(world)[type].id !== null) return { gain: 0, second: true };
  const now = prestigeOf(world);
  return { gain: monumentsPart(now + prestigeFullOf(type)) - monumentsPart(now), second: false };
}
```

```js
// A city row as stored, or null when it is not one (an imported file can hold anything). Its `older` best stays only when
// it is a best of an earlier version than the row's own.
function cleanCity(c) {
  if (!isObj(c) || typeof c.id !== 'string' || !c.id || !isInt(c.seed) || !isLevel(c.difficulty)) return null;
  const best = isNum(c.best) ? c.best : null;
  const row = {
    id: c.id, seed: c.seed, difficulty: c.difficulty, scoreVersion: isInt(c.scoreVersion) ? c.scoreVersion : SCORE_VERSION,
    best, bestDay: best !== null && isInt(c.bestDay) ? c.bestDay : null, medal: best !== null && isMedal(c.medal) ? c.medal : null,
    splits: cleanSplits(c.splits), updated: isNum(c.updated) ? c.updated : 0,
  };
  const o = c.older;
  if (best !== null && isObj(o) && isNum(o.best) && isInt(o.scoreVersion) && o.scoreVersion < row.scoreVersion) {
    row.older = { best: o.best, bestDay: isInt(o.bestDay) ? o.bestDay : null, medal: isMedal(o.medal) ? o.medal : null, scoreVersion: o.scoreVersion };
  }
  return row;
}

// The bests a city row holds, one per score version it has: [{ best, bestDay, medal, scoreVersion }].
const bestsOf = (c) => [c, c.older].filter((x) => x && x.best !== null).map((x) => ({ best: x.best, bestDay: x.bestDay, medal: x.medal, scoreVersion: x.scoreVersion }));
// A row with these bests: the highest of each version, the newest version's as the row's own and the one before it as
// `older`; a row with none keeps its version and has no best.
function withBests(row, list) {
  const top = new Map();
  for (const x of list) if (!top.has(x.scoreVersion) || x.best > top.get(x.scoreVersion).best) top.set(x.scoreVersion, x);
  const [main, prev] = [...top.values()].sort((a, b) => b.scoreVersion - a.scoreVersion);
  const out = { ...row, best: null, bestDay: null, medal: null };
  delete out.older;
  if (main) Object.assign(out, { scoreVersion: main.scoreVersion, best: main.best, bestDay: main.bestDay, medal: main.medal });
  if (prev) out.older = { ...prev };
  return out;
}

// A chronicle entry as stored, or null.
function cleanEntry(e) {
  if (!isObj(e) || typeof e.id !== 'string' || !e.id || typeof e.cityId !== 'string' || !isInt(e.seed) || !isLevel(e.difficulty) || !isNum(e.score)) return null;
  const version = isInt(e.version) ? e.version : SCORE_VERSION;
  const parts = {};
  for (const p of PARTS_BY_VERSION[version] || SCORE_PARTS) parts[p] = isObj(e.parts) && isNum(e.parts[p]) ? e.parts[p] : 0;   // a v1 seal has four
  const out = {
    id: e.id, cityId: e.cityId, seed: e.seed, difficulty: e.difficulty, day: isInt(e.day) ? e.day : 0, score: e.score, parts,
    splits: cleanSplits(e.splits), medal: isMedal(e.medal) ? e.medal : null,
    feats: Array.isArray(e.feats) ? e.feats.filter((f) => typeof f === 'string') : [], version,
    date: isNum(e.date) ? e.date : 0,
  };
  const built = Array.isArray(e.built) ? e.built.filter((k) => STAMP_KINDS.includes(k)) : [];
  if (built.length) out.built = built;
  return out;
}
```

```js
}
```

```js
  olderLink: 'Older scoring: this link has four parts, so it is compared with your best from then.',
};
const score4Name = (type) => buildingName(type).toLowerCase();
const score4Milestone = (id) => (MILESTONES.find((m) => m.id === id) || { name: id }).name;
// The Monuments part's reason line (spec 4.19: the next step), from scoreOf's reasons.monuments (src/sim/score.js
// monumentsReason); any other part's reason as scoreReasonText words it.
export function score4ReasonText(r) {
  if (!r) return '';
  switch (r.code) {
    case 'finish': return `Finish the ${score4Name(r.type)}: +${r.more} prestige`;
    case 'found': return r.first ? `No monument yet: found a ${score4Name(r.type)} (${score4Milestone(r.milestone)})` : `Found a ${score4Name(r.type)}: +${r.more} prestige when finished`;
    case 'locked':
      if (r.milestone) return r.first ? `Monuments come with ${score4Milestone(r.milestone)}` : `The ${score4Name(r.type)} comes with ${score4Milestone(r.milestone)}`;
      return `The ${score4Name(r.type)} needs ${r.prestige} prestige (you have ${r.have})`;
    default: return scoreReasonText(r);
  }
}
// The confirm bar's score line for a monument (spec 4.19, ruling 251's first part), from monumentPreview: "+32 Monuments
// when finished"; '' for a second of a kind (one of each kind counts: Track C words that) or a gain under a point.
export const score4MonumentLine = (p) => (p && !p.second && p.gain >= 1 ? `+${p.gain} ${SCORE_TEXT.parts.monuments} when finished` : '');
// A split against the best on this seed and level, as splitCompareText words a milestone's, for all seven (score v2's two
// new ones by their own names: "Pyramids unlocked in year 12, month 3: 5 months faster than your best").
export function score4SplitText(id, day, bestDay) {
  const words = splitCompareText(id, day, bestDay);
  return SCORE4_TEXT.splitNames[id] ? `${SCORE4_TEXT.splitNames[id]}${words.slice(id.length)}` : words;
}
// A shared t1 link (ruling 259): the friend's score says it is older scoring, and "your best" is your best from then.
export const score4YourBest = (score, older) => (!older ? TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.yourBest(score)
  : score === null ? 'You have no older-scoring score on this seed and level' : `Your best here under older scoring: ${score}`);
// A stamp's name: the sealed reign and its glyphs' monuments ("with a small mastaba and 2 small pyramids").
export function score4StampLabel(e) {
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const k of e.built || []) counts.set(k, (counts.get(k) || 0) + 1);
  const names = [...counts].map(([k, n]) => (n === 1 ? `a ${score4Name(k)}` : `${n} ${score4Name(k)}s`));
  return `${TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.stampLabel(e)}${names.length ? `, with ${listText(names)}` : ''}`;
}
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { GOALS, EVENT_GOALS, OPENING_LAST, GOAL_REWARD } from '../../../src/data/goals.js';
import { BUILDINGS } from '../../../src/data/buildings.js';
import { MONUMENTS } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { CATEGORIES } from '../../../src/data/ui.js';
import { goalById, goalMet, goalProgress, openGoals, openingProgress, triggerEventGoals, checkGoals } from '../../../src/sim/goals.js';
import { assignLabour, isWorking } from '../../../src/sim/labour.js';
import { vacancies } from '../../../src/sim/immigration.js';
import { coveredBy } from '../../../src/sim/housing.js';
import { canPlace } from '../../../src/sim/commands.js';
import { createWorld } from '../../../src/sim/world.js';
import { showMeTarget } from '../../../src/ui/goalsList.js';
import { MONUMENT } from '../../../src/data/monuments.js';
import { CHAPTER_NAMES, OVERLAY_NAMES, OVERLAY_LEGEND, T } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';

const MONUMENT_GOALS = ['found_obelisk', 'guild_near', 'quarry', 'finish_obelisk', 'found_colossus', 'brickworks', 'prestige_pyramids', 'found_pyramid', 'found_great_pyramid'];
// A desert street on y = 10 at City, every goal before the Monuments chapter done.
function city(milestone = 'city') {
  const w = makeTestWorld();
  setRoad(w, 8, 10, 31, 10);
  w.milestone = milestone;
  w.guide = { on: false, done: true };
  w.goals.completed.push(...GOALS.filter((g) => g.chapter !== 'monuments').map((g) => g.id));
  return w;
}
const ids = (list) => list.map((g) => g.id);

describe('s4 score opening goals', () => {
  it('says the road rule and the fertile-land rule in the opening four, each with its why, and still opens at 1 of 10', () => {
    expect(GOALS.slice(0, 4).map((g) => [g.id, g.text])).toEqual([
      ['road', 'Lay a road: buildings need one'], ['plots', 'Place 6 housing plots by the road'],
      ['well', "Build a well by the homes' road"], ['food', 'Farm on fertile land, granary, bazaar'],
    ]);
    for (const g of GOALS.slice(0, 4)) expect([g.id, g.text.length <= 37, typeof g.why, g.why.endsWith('.')]).toEqual([g.id, true, 'string', true]);
    expect(GOALS.findIndex((g) => g.id === OPENING_LAST)).toBe(8);
    expect(openingProgress(createWorld({ seed: 3 }))).toEqual({ done: 1, of: 10 });
  });
  it('words each why as the sim plays it: no road, no work and no family; a well\'s water along the road; farms on fertile land', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    setRoad(w, 8, 10, 20, 10);
    const on = addRaw(w, 'granary', 10, 11), off = addRaw(w, 'granary', 10, 20);
    addRaw(w, 'house', 0, 0, { tier: 1, residents: 40 });               // people to work
    assignLabour(w);
    expect(['work', isWorking(w, on), isWorking(w, off)]).toEqual(['work', true, false]);   // "Homes and workplaces work only when they touch a road"
    const plot = addRaw(w, 'house', 14, 11), far = addRaw(w, 'house', 14, 14);
    expect([vacancies(w).some((v) => v.h === plot), vacancies(w).some((v) => v.h === far)]).toEqual([true, false]);   // "Plots off the road stay empty"
    const reach = BUILDINGS.well.reach;
    expect(goalById('well').why).toBe(`A well gives water along the road for ${reach} tiles, so huts become shacks.`);
    addRaw(w, 'well', 8, 11);                                          // its road tile is (8, 10)
    const near = addRaw(w, 'house', 8 + reach - 1, 11), beyond = addRaw(w, 'house', 8 + reach, 11);   // the well's own road tile is the first of its 5
    expect(['water', coveredBy(w, near, 'water'), coveredBy(w, beyond, 'water')]).toEqual(['water', true, false]);
    expect([canPlace(w, 'farm_grain', 3, 11, { roadLater: true }).ok, canPlace(w, 'farm_grain', 22, 11, { roadLater: true }).ok]).toEqual([true, false]);   // x < 8 is fertile in the test world
    expect(goalById('food').why).toContain(`${T.layers} → ${OVERLAY_NAMES.ground}`);
    expect(OVERLAY_LEGEND.ground[0].startsWith('Fertile')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('s4 score Monuments goals', () => {
  it('adds the Monuments chapter: its goals, words, cards and Show me targets', () => {
    const chain = GOALS.filter((g) => g.chapter === 'monuments');
    expect(ids(chain)).toEqual(MONUMENT_GOALS);
    expect(CHAPTER_NAMES.monuments).toBe('Monuments');
    const items = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === 'monuments').items;
    for (const g of chain) expect([g.id, g.reward, items.includes(g.showMe.item)]).toEqual([g.id, GOAL_REWARD, true]);
    expect(goalById('prestige_pyramids').text).toBe(`Reach ${MONUMENTS.pyramid_small.unlock.prestige} prestige to unlock the pyramids`);
    expect(chain.map((g) => g.from)).toEqual(['city', 'city', 'city', 'city', 'great_city', 'great_city', 'capital', 'capital', 'capital']);
  });
  it('lists the City goals from City, counts a site only once a road touches it, and a guild only within its crew reach', () => {
    const w = city('market_town');
    expect(ids(openGoals(w, 9))).toEqual([]);                          // they wait for City
    w.milestone = 'city';
    expect(ids(openGoals(w, 9))).toEqual(['found_obelisk', 'guild_near', 'quarry', 'finish_obelisk']);
    const site = addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 30, 12);
    expect(goalMet(w, goalById('found_obelisk').need)).toBe(false);     // no road touches it yet (ruling 226)
    setRoad(w, 30, 11, 30, 11);
    expect(goalMet(w, goalById('found_obelisk').need)).toBe(true);
    addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 8, 11);                                // 21 road tiles from the site's road: beyond its crew reach
    expect(goalMet(w, goalById('guild_near').need)).toBe(false);
    addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 24, 11);                               // 5 road tiles along: within MONUMENT.crewReach
    expect(goalMet(w, goalById('guild_near').need)).toBe(true);
    expect(goalProgress(w, goalById('finish_obelisk'))).toEqual({ n: 0, of: 1 });
    Object.assign(site.site, { course: 3, done: 90 });
    expect([goalMet(w, goalById('finish_obelisk').need), goalProgress(w, goalById('finish_obelisk'))]).toEqual([true, { n: 1, of: 1 }]);
  });
  it('asks for the brickworks only once a mastaba is founded, without holding up the goals after it', () => {
    const w = city('great_city');
    w.goals.completed.push('found_obelisk', 'guild_near', 'quarry', 'finish_obelisk');
    expect(ids(openGoals(w, 9))).toEqual(['found_colossus']);
    addRaw(w, 'colossus', 12, 11);
    expect([goalMet(w, goalById('found_colossus').need), ids(openGoals(w, 9))]).toEqual([true, ['found_colossus']]);
    addRaw(w, 'mastaba_small', 16, 11);
    expect(ids(openGoals(w, 9))).toEqual(['found_colossus', 'brickworks']);
    w.milestone = 'capital';
    w.goals.completed.push('found_colossus', 'brickworks');
    expect(ids(openGoals(w, 9))).toEqual(['prestige_pyramids']);       // each pyramid waits for its prestige unlock
    expect(goalProgress(w, goalById('prestige_pyramids'))).toEqual({ n: 0, of: 100 });
    w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_small = 4000;
    expect([goalMet(w, goalById('prestige_pyramids').need), ids(openGoals(w, 9))]).toEqual([true, ['prestige_pyramids', 'found_pyramid']]);
    w.prestigeUnlocks.pyramid_great = 6000;
    expect(ids(openGoals(w, 9))).toEqual(['prestige_pyramids', 'found_pyramid', 'found_great_pyramid']);
  });
  it('aims the guild and brickworks goals\' Show me at the newest site', () => {
    const w = city();
    expect(showMeTarget(w, goalById('guild_near'))).toEqual(w.focus);
    addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 12, 11);
    const newest = addRaw(w, 'colossus', 20, 11);
    addRaw(w, 'obelisk_large', 26, 11).site.done = 30;                  // finished: not a site
    expect(showMeTarget(w, goalById('guild_near'))).toEqual({ x: newest.x + 1, y: newest.y + 1 });
  });
});

describe('s4 score first stall', () => {
  it('becomes a goal the first time a site stalls, worded and aimed by its cause, and is done once no site is stalled', () => {
    const w = city();
    w.goals.completed.push(...MONUMENT_GOALS);
    setRoad(w, 12, 11, 12, 11);
    const site = addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 12, 12);
    Object.assign(site.site, { idle: MONUMENT.stallDays - 1, reason: 'no_stone' });
    expect(triggerEventGoals(w)).toEqual([]);                          // not stalled yet
    site.site.idle = MONUMENT.stallDays;
    expect(triggerEventGoals(w)).toEqual(['fix_site']);
    const words = () => openGoals(w, 1)[0];
    const cases = [
      ['no_stone', 'Get stone to the small obelisk', 'quarry'], ['no_bricks', 'Get bricks to the small obelisk', 'brickworks'],
      ['no_crew', 'Get a crew to the small obelisk', 'builders_guild'], ['crew_short', "Find workers for the small obelisk's guild", 'house'],
      ['crew_burning', "Save the small obelisk's guild from the fire", 'firehouse'], ['no_gold', 'Find gold for the small obelisk', null],
      ['waiting_gilding', 'Find gold for the small obelisk', null],
    ];
    for (const [reason, text, item] of cases) {
      site.site.reason = reason;
      const g = words();
      expect([reason, g.id, g.text, g.showMe ? g.showMe.item : null]).toEqual([reason, 'fix_site', text, item]);
    }
    expect(Object.keys(goalById('fix_site').causeText).sort()).toEqual(['crew_burning', 'crew_short', 'no_bricks', 'no_crew', 'no_gold', 'no_stone', 'waiting_capstone', 'waiting_gilding']);
    site.site.reason = 'no_stone';
    expect(showMeTarget(w, words())).toEqual({ x: 12.5, y: 12.5 });
    expect(checkGoals(w)).toBe(null);
    site.site.idle = 0;                                                // it worked a day: no longer stalled
    expect([checkGoals(w).id, w.goals.completed.includes('fix_site')]).toEqual(['fix_site', true]);
    site.site.idle = MONUMENT.stallDays;
    expect(triggerEventGoals(w)).toEqual([]);                          // once per city
    expect(EVENT_GOALS.find((g) => g.id === 'fix_site').text).toBe('Get the monument site working again');
  });
});
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { goalById } from '../../../src/sim/goals.js';
import { openSheet } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';

describe('s4 score goals in the interface', () => {
  it('shows a goal\'s why when the goal is opened in place on a phone, and keeps the rows within 40% of the screen', async () => {
    for (const [w, h] of [[360, 640], [390, 844], [740, 360]]) {
      for (const size of [100, 150]) {
        const r = await rigUI({ width: w, height: h });
        r.renderer.renderFrame = () => {};
        try {
          r.world.goals.completed.push('road', 'plots', 'well');            // 'Farm on fertile land, granary, bazaar': the longest why
          r.ui.settings.set({ textSize: size, motion: 'still' });
          r.ui.refresh();
          r.frame(0);
          const strip = r.root.querySelector('#goals .goal-strip');
          const why = strip.querySelector('.why');
          const at = `${w}x${h} at ${size}%`;
          expect([at, why.hidden]).toEqual([at, true]);                    // closed: the words only
          r.ui.setGuidanceOpen(true);
          r.frame(1000);
          expect([at, why.hidden, why.textContent]).toEqual([at, false, goalById('food').why]);
          expect([at, strip.querySelector('.open-goals').getAttribute('aria-label').includes(goalById('food').why)]).toEqual([at, true]);
          const canvas = r.root.querySelector('#map').getBoundingClientRect();
          expect([at, strip.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - canvas.top <= 0.4 * h + 1]).toEqual([at, true]);
          r.ui.setGuidanceOpen(false);
          r.frame(2000);
          expect([at, why.hidden]).toEqual([at, true]);
        } finally { r.cleanup(); }
      }
    }
  });
  it('lists each open goal\'s why in the Goals sheet', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 1280, height: 800 });
    try {
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'goals'));
      const rows = [...r.root.querySelectorAll('#sheet .goals .goal')];
      expect(rows.map((li) => (li.querySelector('.why') || { textContent: null }).textContent)).toEqual(['road', 'plots', 'well'].map((id) => goalById(id).why));
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

```js
// Stage 4: the first stalled site's alert ({ code, id, reason }), or null.
const firstStall = (world) => monumentAlerts(world)[0] || null;
// A goal worded for this city: one with dirText names the raiders' direction ("Build a tower facing the east"); one with
// causeText (Stage 4) names the first stalled site and its cause ("Get stone to the small obelisk"), and aims Show me by it.
function worded(world, g) {
  if (g.dirText && g.dirText[raidDir(world)]) return { ...g, text: g.dirText[raidDir(world)] };
  if (g.causeText) {
    const a = firstStall(world);
    if (a && a.reason in g.causeText) {
      return { ...g, text: g.causeText[a.reason].replace('{site}', MONUMENTS[world.buildings[a.id].type].name.toLowerCase()), showMe: g.causeShowMe[a.reason] };
    }
  }
  return g;
}
```

```js
describe('s4 score feats and daily goals', () => {
  it('earns Steady hands for a mastaba or pyramid whose crews never waited for material, and Swift pyramid before year 25', () => {
    expect(FEATS.slice(10).map((f) => [f.id, FEAT_TEXT[f.id].name, FEAT_TEXT[f.id].condition])).toEqual([
      ['steady_hands', 'Steady hands', 'Finish a mastaba or pyramid with no month in which its crews stood idle for lack of material'],
      ['swift_pyramid', 'Swift pyramid', 'Finish the great pyramid before year 25 begins'],
    ]);
    const w = city('capital');
    const steady = FEATS.find((f) => f.id === 'steady_hands'), swift = FEATS.find((f) => f.id === 'swift_pyramid');
    finish(w, 'colossus', 10, 11);                                     // not a mastaba or pyramid
    const starved = finish(w, 'mastaba_small', 13, 11, { starved: true });
    const late = finish(w, 'mastaba_large', 17, 11);
    late.site.month.starvedDays = 2;                                   // idle for material this month, before the month's roll marks it
    checkFeats(w);
    expect(featStatus(w, steady)).toBe('open');
    late.site.month.starvedDays = 0;
    expect([checkFeats(w), starved.site.starved]).toEqual([['steady_hands'], true]);
    w.splits.great_pyramid = 24 * 360 - 1;
    expect([checkFeats(w), featStatus(w, swift)]).toEqual([['swift_pyramid'], 'earned']);
    const v = city('capital');
    v.day = 24 * 360;                                                  // year 25 has begun with no great pyramid finished
    checkFeats(v);
    expect(featStatus(v, swift)).toBe('lost');
  });
  it('draws the three monument daily goals from City only while a site is under way, and counts the stone brought to sites', () => {
    expect(DAILY_POOL.slice(18).map((d) => [d.id, DAILY_TEXT[d.id]])).toEqual([
      ['course1', 'Lay a course on any monument'], ['quarry1', 'Build a quarry'], ['stone100', 'Bring 100 stone to a monument site'],
    ]);
    const w = city('market_town');
    const drawn = () => dailyOrder(w, '2026-10-12').filter((id) => ['course1', 'quarry1', 'stone100'].includes(id)).sort();
    const site = addRaw(w, 'obelisk_large', 12, 11);
    expect([siteUnderWay(w), drawn()]).toEqual([true, []]);            // before City
    w.milestone = 'city';
    expect(drawn()).toEqual(['course1', 'quarry1', 'stone100']);
    expect(setPaused(w, site.id, true).ok).toBe(true);
    expect([siteUnderWay(w), drawn()]).toEqual([false, []]);           // paused: not under way
    setPaused(w, site.id, false);
    site.site.done = 90;
    expect(drawn()).toEqual([]);                                       // finished
    w.tally.stoneDelivered = 140.5;
    expect(dailyMeasure(w, DAILY_POOL.find((d) => d.id === 'stone100'))).toBe(140);   // whole units
  });
});

describe('s4 score tips, remarks and captions', () => {
  it('keeps each Monuments tip true to the rules it states', () => {
    expect(TIPS.filter((t) => t.id in SCORE_TIPS_WORDS).length).toBe(6);
    for (const [id, words] of Object.entries(SCORE_TIPS_WORDS)) expect([id, TIP_TEXT[id]]).toEqual([id, words]);
    expect(PRIORITY_LEVELS[PRIORITY_LEVELS.length - 1]).toBe('monuments');   // "come last for workers"
    expect(['builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks'].map((t) => BUILDINGS[t].priority)).toEqual(['monuments', 'monuments', 'monuments']);
    expect([BUILDINGS.quarry.producerReach, BUILDINGS.brickworks.producerReach]).toEqual([MONUMENT.producerReach, MONUMENT.producerReach]);
    expect(BUILDINGS.storehouse.stores).toContain('stone');            // so it can refuse stone
  });
  it('asks for each Monuments tip when its lesson is news', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();
    try {
      const asked = [];
      r.ui.tips.trigger = (key) => { asked.push(key); return false; };
      const s = r.ui.scoreUi, w = r.world;
      const built = (b) => s.onCommand({ kind: 'building', result: { ok: true, id: b.id }, undoable: true });
      built(addRaw(w, 'builders_guild', 40, 40));
      built(addRaw(w, 'quarry', 44, 40));
      built(addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 48, 40));                       // the first site: nothing yet
      built(addRaw(w, 'colossus', 50, 40));                            // another site under way
      built(addRaw(w, 'colossus', 54, 40));                            // and one of its kind
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'site_stalled', id: 1, kind: 'colossus', reason: 'no_crew' }, { type: 'site_stalled', id: 1, kind: 'colossus', reason: 'no_bricks' }]);
      const store = addRaw(w, 'storehouse', 58, 40);
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'month' }]);
      Object.assign(store.store, { stone: 20, clay: 10 });
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'month' }]);
      expect(asked).toEqual(['guildPlaced', 'supplyPlaced', 'secondSite', 'secondOfKind', 'secondSite', 'siteStarved', 'stoneStored']);
      for (const key of new Set(asked)) expect([key, TIPS.some((t) => t.trigger === key)]).toEqual([key, true]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('adds remarks for the masons, haulers and brickmakers, by season', () => {
    const mine = CITIZEN_REMARKS.filter((x) => ['builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks'].includes(x.type));
    expect(['builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks'].map((t) => mine.filter((x) => x.type === t).length)).toEqual([4, 3, 3]);
    for (const t of ['builders_guild', 'quarry', 'brickworks']) expect([t, new Set(mine.filter((x) => x.type === t).map((x) => x.season)).size]).toEqual([t, 3]);
  });
  it('captions a course with the city\'s gain the event carries, a finish as a milestone with the last course\'s gain in it, and the palace\'s new style', () => {
    const w = city('great_city');
    const a = addRaw(w, 'colossus', 10, 11);
    expect(monumentCaptions(w, [{ type: 'course_done', id: a.id, kind: 'colossus', course: 2, prestige: 4 }]))
      .toEqual([{ tier: 'first', text: 'Colossus: course 2 of 6 · +4 prestige', why: '', sound: 'goal' }]);
    expect(monumentCaptions(w, [{ type: 'course_done', id: a.id, kind: 'colossus', course: 3, prestige: 0 }])[0].text).toBe('Colossus: course 3 of 6');   // a second of a kind adds none
    expect(score4CourseText('colossus', 3, 6, 0)).toBe('Colossus: course 3 of 6');
    const o = addRaw(w, 'obelisk_small', 18, 11);
    Object.assign(o.site, { course: 3, done: 90 });                    // its last course (+2) and the completion (+5) on one day
    const total = prestigeOf(w);
    const caps = monumentCaptions(w, [{ type: 'course_done', id: o.id, kind: 'obelisk_small', course: 3, prestige: 2 }, { type: 'monument_done', id: o.id, kind: 'obelisk_small', prestige: 5 }]);
    expect(caps).toEqual([{ tier: 'milestone', text: score4FinishText('obelisk_small'), why: score4FinishWhy(7, total), sound: 'milestone' }]);
    expect([caps[0].text, caps[0].why]).toEqual(['The small obelisk is finished', `+7 prestige: the city now has ${total}`]);
    expect(monumentCaptions(w, [{ type: 'monument_done', id: o.id, kind: 'obelisk_small', prestige: 0 }])[0].why).toBe(SCORE4_TEXT.secondOfKind);
    expect(monumentCaptions(w, [{ type: 'palace_done', id: 99, style: 1 }])).toEqual([{ tier: 'first', text: 'The palace is now a columned hall', why: '', sound: 'goal' }]);
    expect(score4PalaceText(4)).toBe('The palace is now a palace of lapis and gold');
  });
  it('shows the captions in the caption row in the game', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();
    try {
      const o = addRaw(r.world, 'obelisk_small', 40, 40);
      o.site.course = 1;
      r.ui.scoreUi.onEvents([{ type: 'course_done', id: o.id, kind: 'obelisk_small', course: 1, prestige: 1 }]);
      expect(r.ui.celebrations.recent()[0]).toEqual({ tier: 'first', text: 'Small obelisk: course 1 of 3 · +1 prestige', why: '', reward: 0 });
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});

  straight_to_site: `Quarries and brickworks send straight to a monument site within ${MONUMENT.producerReach} road tiles, before any storehouse.`,
  storehouse_bridge: `A site draws from storehouses within ${MONUMENT.supplyReach} road tiles: one between quarry and site bridges a long way.`,
  refuse_stone: 'Tap the storehouse your potters use and refuse stone, so its clay keeps its room.',
  pause_site: 'Pause a site on its sheet to send its crews to another site in reach.',
  one_each: 'One of each kind counts for prestige: a second only makes homes nicer.',
};
```

```js
// The captions for a day's monument events (spec 6.3, rulings 212, 242; spec 4.20): { tier, text, why, sound } each. The
// events carry the monument's kind as `kind` and, as `prestige`, what they added to the city's prestige (0 for a second of
// a kind: Track A's events). A course laid ('first' tier) names that gain; the course that finishes a monument says
// nothing of its own, and its gain goes into the finish caption (a milestone); the palace's works ending names its new style.
export function monumentCaptions(world, events) {
  const out = [];
  const done = new Set(events.filter((e) => e.type === 'monument_done').map((e) => e.id));
  const added = (id) => events.filter((e) => (e.type === 'course_done' || e.type === 'monument_done') && e.id === id).reduce((s, e) => s + (e.prestige || 0), 0);
  for (const e of events) {
    if (e.type === 'course_done' && MONUMENTS[e.kind] && !done.has(e.id)) {
      out.push({ tier: 'first', text: score4CourseText(e.kind, e.course, MONUMENTS[e.kind].courses.length, e.prestige || 0), why: '', sound: 'goal' });
    } else if (e.type === 'monument_done' && MONUMENTS[e.kind]) {
      out.push({ tier: 'milestone', text: score4FinishText(e.kind), why: score4FinishWhy(added(e.id), prestigeOf(world)), sound: 'milestone' });
    } else if (e.type === 'palace_done' && Number.isInteger(e.style)) {
      out.push({ tier: 'first', text: score4PalaceText(e.style), why: '', sound: 'goal' });
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

# Track E: Motion and the moving grand city

CONTRACT NOTE 1 (createUI.js, four lines; Task E1 Step 5 applies them, and only with the controller's consent): the Gentle variants need the Motion level where createUI hands Stage 3's boolean to the effects, the ambient layer and the flames, and the one-time Gentle tip needs a trigger, but `src/ui/createUI.js` is contract-owned and E has no seam there. Without the change a device that asks for less motion still gets a city that looks Still (contract note 9's "until E1"), which is exactly what Josh has seen so far. The smallest fix, as Step 5 writes it: (a) move the existing `motionLevel` const up, above `createEffects`, and pass it: `createEffects({ reducedMotion: settings.reducedMotion, motionLevel })`; (b) `createAmbient({ enabled: () => motionLevel() !== 'still', level: motionLevel })`; (c) the frame's `still` gains `motion: motionLevel()` (drawFires reads it; drawUnitMarks ignores it); (d) in `tickNudge`, after `tips.flush(...)`: `if (!tipsBusy(s) && gentleTipDue(settings)) fireTip('gentleMotion');` with `gentleTipDue` imported from `settings.js`. Each E module keeps its Stage 1-3 behaviour when it is called without the level (reducedMotion alone reads as Full or Still), so nothing else changes if the controller declines (d) or all four.
CONTRACT NOTE 2 (figures, the controller's ruling of 12 Oct): the processions use Track B's walker kinds `priest`, `shrine`, `musician` and `dancer` (B3 adds the last three to `FIGURE_KINDS`) and draw no figure of their own. On a Track 0 base those three slots do not exist yet, so `figureKind(kind)` in `src/render/walkers.js` walks a missing kind as a `priest`; once B is merged (B merges before E) the real figures show with no change here. The festival temple's streamers are art, not figures, and nothing in B's plan draws them: Track E draws them in its own new module `src/render/procession.js` as two walker slots (`fig.streamer`, `fig.streamer2`) and registers each only when the registry has no slot of that name, so a drawing of B's would win. If the controller would rather B owned them, B adds the two slots (same names, bounds `[-6, -46, 14, 4]`) and E deletes `procession.js` and its import.
CONTRACT NOTE 3 (spec 5.7, "over budget they drop with rare life"): processions drop once the ambient budget has dropped **all** it can (rare life, smoke and sway: `ambientState(world).dropped.length >= AMBIENT.dropOrder.length`), not with rare life alone. Under Gentle rare life is already off, so dropping it saves nothing; processions are a dozen cached sprites in the depth pass, not ambient cost; and headless Edge on a loaded machine dropped rare life within seconds in this writer's shots, which hid the procession from the very shots that must show it. If the controller wants the spec's letter, the one line in `processionsAt` becomes `if (state.dropped.includes('rare')) return [];` and the test "drops once the ambient budget has dropped all it can" checks `['rare']`.
CONTRACT NOTE 4 (Track H's base, css/ui.css line 188): `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; } }` stops the chrome's transitions on a device that asks for less motion even when the player chose Motion Full. E's section makes them instant under Gentle and Still from `[data-motion]`, so the media rule is no longer needed; the smallest fix is H deleting it (or scoping it to `:not([data-motion="full"])`). E's CSS test allows for it (it reads `matchMedia` before asserting Full).
CONTRACT NOTE 5 (shared pinned tests): adding the Gentle tip breaks two Stage 1-3 pins that every track adding a tip will meet: `tests/ui/tips.test.js` (`TIPS.length` 20) and `tests/stage3/score/dangerGoals.test.js` (`TIPS.slice(14)`). E1 makes both position-based (`wall_ring` is index 19; `TIPS.slice(14, 20)`), which holds whatever C, D, G and F append; on a merge conflict keep E's lines. The in-game tip tests in `tests/ui/tips.test.js` now choose Motion Gentle in their `quietFrames` helper, so headless Edge's ask for less motion brings no Gentle tip into them. Contract note 9's retirement of the `reducedMotion`/`ambient` mirrors edits four more pinned tests (the setMotion test in `tests/dev/sampleCity.test.js`, `tests/stage3/contract/uiSeams.test.js`, `tests/stage3/balance/scenes.test.js`, `tests/stage4/contract/uiSeams.test.js`); `set()` still accepts the two old keys (forty Stage 1-3 tests write `reducedMotion: 'on'`), only `get()` loses them.
CONTRACT NOTE 6 (cross-track facts E relies on): the brickworks' kiln smoke rises from tile offset (1.56, 0.46), 14 art px up: the mouth of Track B's kiln (`src/render/art/supply.js`, B1); if B moves the kiln, `SMOKE_FROM.brickworks` in `src/render/ambient.js` follows. A kiln (potter, brewery, brickworks) now smokes only while it works and nothing holds it (`isWorking && !b.blocked`), so an idle brickworks (Track A: `b.blocked = 'idle'`, nobody employed) and a potter with no clay are cold; this is a small Stage 3 change. The dedication procession reads state only (`b.site.done` within `PROCESSION.dedicationDays`), never the `monument_done` event (`{ type: 'monument_done', id, kind, prestige }` per the controller), so a reload shows it and A's real completions need no hook.

## Track E: Motion and the moving grand city

```js
// Stage 4, Track E: the Motion setting (spec 5.4, rulings 216-218, 247-249): the Settings row's words and the device's own
// setting read live, the one-time Gentle tip, Gentle's variants of the effects, flames, glints and smoke, the interface's
// instant transitions under Gentle, the title backdrop drifting under Full only, and setMotion for the shots.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { createSettings, motionStatus, gentleTipDue } from '../../../src/ui/settings.js';
import { createEffects, EFFECT_MS } from '../../../src/render/effects.js';
import { drawFires, gentleShapes, GENTLE_FLAME_MS, GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX, FLAME } from '../../../src/render/fire.js';
import { createAmbient, drawAmbientLate, glintAt, riverRows, GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX as AMBIENT_RISE_PX } from '../../../src/render/ambient.js';
import { createBackdrop } from '../../../src/ui/titleCard.js';
import { createCameraControl } from '../../../src/ui/cameraControl.js';
import { createCamera } from '../../../src/render/camera.js';
import { createStore, INITIAL_UI_STATE } from '../../../src/ui/store.js';
import { createMenuSheets } from '../../../src/ui/menu.js';
import { makeDraw } from '../../../src/render/art/ctx.js';
import { TIPS, TIP_FIRST_DELAY_MS } from '../../../src/data/tips.js';
import { MOTION4_TEXT, TIP_TEXT, ART_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { makeTestWorld, addRaw, setRoad, staffAll } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { riverWorld } from '../../helpers/renderWorld.js';
import { makeCanvas } from '../../helpers/canvas.js';
import { mount, fire } from '../../helpers/dom.js';
import { rigUI, mountShell } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';

const noStorage = { getItem: () => null, setItem: () => {} };
// Settings whose device asks for less motion or not (asks()), with the device's change watch in the test's hands.
function deviceSettings(root, asks) {
  const watch = { changed: null };
  const s = createSettings({ storage: noStorage, root, systemReducedMotion: () => asks(), watchSystem: (cb) => { watch.changed = cb; return () => { watch.changed = null; }; } });
  return { s, watch };
}

// A draw object that records its calls (and still draws), on its own canvas.
function spyDraw() {
  const g = makeDraw(makeCanvas(64, 64).getContext('2d'), 1);
  const calls = [];
  for (const k of ['line', 'stroke', 'poly', 'radial', 'path', 'circ', 'ell', 'text']) {
    const f = g[k];
    g[k] = (...a) => { calls.push({ k, a }); return f(...a); };
  }
  return { g, calls };
}

describe('s4 motion settings and the Motion row', () => {
  it('says what the row is doing from the setting and the device, both ways, and drops Stage 3\'s mirrors', () => {
    const { root, cleanup } = mount();
    try {
      let asks = true;
      const { s, watch } = deviceSettings(root, () => asks);
      expect(motionStatus(s)).toEqual({ setting: 'system', level: 'gentle', device: true, asks: true });
      expect(MOTION4_TEXT.status(motionStatus(s))).toBe('Motion: Gentle (your device asks for less motion)');
      expect(gentleTipDue(s)).toBe(true);
      asks = false;
      expect(MOTION4_TEXT.status(motionStatus(s))).toBe("Motion: Full (your device's setting)");
      expect(gentleTipDue(s)).toBe(false);
      s.set({ motion: 'gentle' });
      asks = true;
      expect([MOTION4_TEXT.status(motionStatus(s)), gentleTipDue(s)]).toEqual(['Motion: Gentle', false]);   // chosen here: no tip
      s.set({ motion: 'still' });
      expect(MOTION4_TEXT.status(motionStatus(s))).toBe('Motion: Still');
      expect(['reducedMotion' in s.get(), 'ambient' in s.get(), Object.keys(MOTION4_TEXT.levelLines)]).toEqual([false, false, ['full', 'gentle', 'still']]);
      expect(gentleTipDue({ get: () => ({}), reducedMotion: () => true })).toBe(false);   // a Stage 1-3 stand-in never asks
      s.destroy();
      expect(watch.changed).toBe(null);
    } finally { cleanup(); }
  });
  it('tells every subscriber when the device\'s own setting changes, as set() does', () => {
    const { root, cleanup } = mount();
    try {
      let asks = false;
      const { s, watch } = deviceSettings(root, () => asks);
      const heard = [];
      s.subscribe(() => heard.push(s.motionLevel()));
      asks = true;
      watch.changed();
      expect([heard, root.dataset.motion]).toEqual([['gentle'], 'gentle']);
      s.set({ motion: 'full' });
      expect(heard).toEqual(['gentle', 'full']);
      s.destroy();
    } finally { cleanup(); }
  });
  it('shows the four choices, the status line and what the level moves, following a change of the device at once', () => {
    const { root, cleanup } = mount('<div id="body"></div>');
    try {
      let asks = true;
      const { s, watch } = deviceSettings(root, () => asks);
      const menus = createMenuSheets({ store: createStore(INITIAL_UI_STATE), settings: s, toasts: { show() {} } });
      const body = root.querySelector('#body');
      menus.settings(body, { close() {} });
      const status = body.querySelector('.motion-status'), line = body.querySelector('.motion-line');
      const choices = [...body.querySelectorAll('.choice.motion')];
      expect(choices.map((b) => [b.dataset.value, b.textContent, b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')])).toEqual([
        ['system', 'Follow the device', 'true'], ['full', 'Full', 'false'], ['gentle', 'Gentle', 'false'], ['still', 'Still', 'false']]);
      expect([status.textContent, line.textContent, status.getAttribute('aria-live')]).toEqual([MOTION4_TEXT.status(motionStatus(s)), MOTION4_TEXT.levelLines.gentle, 'polite']);
      expect(status.textContent).toBe('Motion: Gentle (your device asks for less motion)');
      asks = false;
      watch.changed();                                                             // the device's setting changed: the words follow it
      expect([status.textContent, line.textContent]).toEqual(["Motion: Full (your device's setting)", MOTION4_TEXT.levelLines.full]);
      fire(choices[3], 'click');
      expect([status.textContent, line.textContent, choices[3].getAttribute('aria-pressed'), choices[0].getAttribute('aria-pressed')])
        .toEqual(['Motion: Still', MOTION4_TEXT.levelLines.still, 'true', 'false']);
      body.remove();                                                               // the sheet closed: the row stops listening
      s.set({ motion: 'full' });
      expect(status.textContent).toBe('Motion: Still');
      s.destroy();
    } finally { cleanup(); }
  });
  it('makes the interface\'s own transitions and animations instant under Gentle and Still, and leaves them under Full', async () => {
    const shell = await mountShell(390, 844);                                     // the stylesheet comes with the shell
    const was = document.body.dataset.motion;
    try {
      const probe = document.createElement('div');
      probe.setAttribute('style', 'transition: opacity 300ms ease 50ms; animation: cheer-in 200ms ease-out');
      shell.root.append(probe);
      const look = (level) => {
        document.body.dataset.motion = level;
        const cs = getComputedStyle(probe);
        return [cs.transitionDuration, cs.transitionDelay, cs.animationName];
      };
      // Under Full the chrome moves, except where the base's own device rule (prefers-reduced-motion, css/ui.css) stops it.
      const deviceStops = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      expect(look('full')).toEqual(deviceStops ? ['0s', '0s', 'none'] : ['0.3s', '0.05s', 'cheer-in']);
      expect(look('gentle')).toEqual(['0s', '0s', 'none']);
      expect(look('still')).toEqual(['0s', '0s', 'none']);
    } finally {
      if (was === undefined) delete document.body.dataset.motion; else document.body.dataset.motion = was;
      shell.cleanup();
    }
  });
});

describe('s4 motion Gentle tip', () => {
  const settingsAsking = (asks) => createSettings({ storage: noStorage, root: document.body, systemReducedMotion: () => asks, watchSystem: () => () => {} });
  it('has its words and its own trigger, short enough for a tip', () => {
    const tip = TIPS.find((t) => t.id === 'gentle_motion');
    expect([tip.trigger, tip.priority, TIP_TEXT.gentle_motion]).toEqual(['gentleMotion', false, 'Your device asks for less motion, so the city moves gently. Settings → Motion changes it.']);
    expect(TIP_TEXT.gentle_motion.split(/\s+/).length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20);
  });
  it('shows once, after the first 10 s, on a device that asks for less motion; never when it does not, or when a level is chosen', async () => {
    for (const [asks, motion, want] of [[true, null, 'gentle_motion'], [false, null, null], [true, 'gentle', null], [true, 'still', null]]) {
      let t = 0;
      const settings = settingsAsking(asks);
      if (motion) settings.set({ motion });
      const r = await rigUI({ width: 1280, height: 800, now: () => t, settings });
      try {
        r.renderer.renderFrame = () => {};
        r.frame(0);
        expect(r.ui.tips.current()).toBe(null);                                   // never in the first 10 s
        t = TIP_FIRST_DELAY_MS + 1;
        r.frame(t);
        expect([asks, motion, r.ui.tips.current()]).toEqual([asks, motion, want]);
        if (want) {
          expect(r.root.querySelector('#tip .text').textContent).toBe(TIP_TEXT.gentle_motion);
          r.ui.tips.dismiss();
          t += 600000;
          r.frame(t);
          expect(r.ui.tips.current()).toBe(null);                                 // once per device
          expect(settings.get().seenTips.includes('gentle_motion')).toBe(true);
        }
      } finally { r.cleanup(); settings.destroy(); }
    }
  });
  it('waits while a phone\'s game is paused, and shows once it runs', async () => {
    let t = 0;
    const settings = settingsAsking(true);
    settings.set({ seenTips: TIPS.map((x) => x.id).filter((id) => id !== 'gentle_motion') });   // only the Gentle tip is news
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844, now: () => t, settings });
    try {
      r.renderer.renderFrame = () => {};
      r.world.speed = 0;
      t = TIP_FIRST_DELAY_MS + 1;
      r.frame(t);
      expect(r.ui.tips.current()).toBe(null);
      r.world.speed = 1;
      r.frame(t + 1000);
      expect(r.ui.tips.current()).toBe('gentle_motion');
    } finally { r.cleanup(); settings.destroy(); }
  });
});

describe('s4 motion Gentle effects', () => {
  it('fades the upgrade glow, the downgrade pulse and the well ring in place, keeps labels still, and drops puffs and the rise', () => {
    let level = 'gentle';
    const fx = createEffects({ reducedMotion: () => level !== 'full', motionLevel: () => level });
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const h = addRaw(w, 'house', 5, 5, { tier: 2, residents: 8 });
    fx.puff(1, 1, 0);
    fx.rise(h.id, 5, 5, 1, 1, 0);
    fx.ripple(3, 3, 0);
    fx.sparkle(2, 2, '#E2B13C', 0);
    fx.fromEvents(w, [{ type: 'upgrade', id: h.id, from: 1, to: 2 }, { type: 'downgrade', id: h.id, from: 3, to: 2 }], 0);
    const kinds = fx.active(0).map((e) => [e.kind, Boolean(e.still)]);
    expect(kinds).toEqual([['ripple', true], ['sparkle', true], ['glow', true], ['label', false], ['pulse', true], ['label', false]]);
    expect([fx.motion, fx.labelLift(0.5), fx.risingIds(0, w).size]).toEqual(['gentle', 0, 0]);
    // In place: the glow's ring keeps its width, the pulse and the ring keep their size; only their opacity falls.
    const shapes = (t) => {
      const s = spyDraw();
      fx.draw(s.g, t, w);
      return s.calls.filter((c) => c.k === 'poly' && c.a[1] === 'none').map((c) => [c.a[0].map((q) => q.map((v) => Math.round(v * 10))), c.a[2].strokeWidth]);
    };
    expect(shapes(100)).toEqual(shapes(EFFECT_MS.ripple - 50));
    level = 'still';
    fx.glow(0, 0, 0);
    fx.pulse(0, 0, 0);
    fx.ripple(0, 0, 0);
    fx.puff(0, 0, 0);
    expect(fx.active(0).length).toBe(6);                                          // Still adds none of them
    level = 'full';
    fx.glow(0, 0, 0);
    fx.puff(0, 0, 0);
    expect(fx.active(0).slice(6).map((e) => [e.kind, Boolean(e.still)])).toEqual([['glow', false], ['puff', false]]);
    expect(fx.labelLift(0.5)).toBe(5);
  });
  it('keeps Stage 1-3 callers as they were: reducedMotion alone reads as Full or Still', () => {
    expect([createEffects({ reducedMotion: false }).motion, createEffects({ reducedMotion: true }).motion]).toEqual(['full', 'still']);
    const fx = createEffects({ reducedMotion: true });
    fx.glow(0, 0, 0);
    fx.ripple(0, 0, 0);
    expect(fx.count(0)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('wires the game\'s effects, ambient and flames to the Motion level (createUI)', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();

      const render = r.renderer.renderFrame;
      r.renderer.renderFrame = (world, cam, opts) => { seen.push(opts); return render(world, cam, opts); };
      for (const motion of ['full', 'gentle', 'still']) {
        r.ui.settings.set({ motion });
        r.frame(1000);
        expect([motion, r.ui.effects.motion]).toEqual([motion, motion]);
      }
      expect(seen.length).toBe(3);
      // drawFires is handed the level: a burning hut shows "Burning" under Gentle and Still, never under Full.
      const hut = Object.values(r.world.buildings).find((b) => b.type === 'house' && b.residents > 0);
      hut.fire = { stage: 'blaze', days: 1, need: 2, fought: 0 };
      const words = (opts) => { const s = spyDraw(); opts.fire(s.g, { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 63, y1: 63 }); return s.calls.filter((c) => c.k === 'text').map((c) => c.a[1]); };
      expect(seen.map(words)).toEqual([[], [ART_TEXT.burning], [ART_TEXT.burning]]);

describe('s4 motion Gentle flames', () => {
  const burning = (stage) => {
    const w = makeTestWorld({ fertile: [] });
    const b = addRaw(w, 'potter', 10, 10);
    b.fire = stage === 'fire' ? { stage: 'fire', days: 2, left: 9 } : { stage: 'blaze', days: 1, need: 2, fought: 0 };
    return { w, b };
  };
  const calls = (w, now, opts) => { const s = spyDraw(); drawFires(s.g, w, null, now, opts); return s.calls; };
  it('cross-fades two still shapes, one change a second at most, never thinning much', () => {
    let changes = 0, last = null;
    for (let t = 0; t <= 20000; t += 20) {
      const pairs = gentleShapes(t, 7);
      for (const [shape] of pairs) expect([1, 3].includes(shape)).toBe(true);
      const sq = pairs.reduce((s, [, a]) => s + a * a, 0);
      expect(Math.abs(sq - 1) < 1e-9).toBe(true);                                 // cos and sin weights
      expect(pairs.reduce((s, [, a]) => Math.max(s, a), 0)).toBeGreaterThan(0.7);
      const main = pairs.length === 1 ? pairs[0][0] : null;
      if (main !== null && last !== null && main !== last) changes++;
      if (main !== null) last = main;
    }
    expect([changes >= 18, changes <= 21]).toEqual([true, true]);                 // 20 s: about one change a second
    expect(gentleShapes(500, 1)).toEqual(gentleShapes(500 + 2 * GENTLE_FLAME_MS, 1));
    expect(gentleShapes(500, 1) === gentleShapes(500, 2)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('draws no embers under Gentle, with the "Burning" label, and its smoke fading in place within 4 px', () => {
    const { w } = burning('fire');
    const embers = (cs) => cs.filter((c) => c.k === 'circ' && c.a[2] === FLAME.ember).length;
    expect(embers(calls(w, 1000, { motion: 'full' }))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const gentle = calls(w, 1000, { motion: 'gentle' });
    expect([embers(gentle), gentle.filter((c) => c.k === 'text').map((c) => c.a[1])]).toEqual([0, [ART_TEXT.burning]]);
    expect(calls(w, 1000, { motion: 'full' }).filter((c) => c.k === 'text').length).toBe(0);
    // Each puff's centre over 3 s: under Gentle it moves GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX up at most and never sideways.
    const puffs = (t, motion) => calls(w, t, { motion }).filter((c) => c.k === 'radial' && c.a[3] === FLAME.smoke).map((c) => c.a[0]);
    const spread = (motion) => {
      const series = [];
      for (let t = 0; t < 3000; t += 50) series.push(puffs(t, motion));
      return series[0].map((_, i) => {
        const xs = series.map((s) => s[i][0]), ys = series.map((s) => s[i][1]);
        return [Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys)];
      });
    };
    for (const [dx, dy] of spread('gentle')) expect([dx < 1e-9, dy <= GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX + 1e-9]).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(Math.max(...spread('full').map(([, dy]) => dy))).toBeGreaterThan(20);
    const still = calls(w, 1000, { motion: 'still' });
    expect([still.filter((c) => c.k === 'radial').length, still.filter((c) => c.k === 'text').length]).toEqual([0, 1]);   // Stage 3's still flame
    expect(calls(w, 1000, { reducedMotion: true }).filter((c) => c.k === 'text').length).toBe(1);   // Stage 3's option: Still
  });
});

describe('s4 motion Gentle ambient', () => {
  const frame = (a, w, now) => { const s = spyDraw(); a.draw(s.g, w, { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 31, y1: 31 }, now); const n = s.calls.length; drawAmbientLate(s.g); return { ground: s.calls.slice(0, n), late: s.calls.slice(n) }; };
  const ambientAt = (level) => createAmbient({ enabled: () => level !== 'still', level: () => level });
  it('fades glints in place without drifting, holds the bank ripples still, and draws no reeds, crops or rare life', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    const rows = riverRows(w, 0, 31);
    let spot = null;
    for (let y = 4; y < 20 && !spot; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 32; x++) if (w.terrain[y * 32 + x] === 3 && glintAt(w, x, y, 0, rows)) { spot = [x, y]; break; }
    const ys = new Set(), alphas = new Set();
    for (let t = 0; t <= 8000; t += 100) { const g = glintAt(w, spot[0], spot[1], t, rows, false); if (g) { ys.add(g.y); alphas.add(Math.round(g.alpha * 100)); } }
    expect([ys.size, alphas.size > 10]).toEqual([1, true]);                       // one place, fading in and out
    const gentle = ambientAt('gentle');
    const reedColours = new Set(['#4F8A2E', '#6AA83A']);
    const strokes = (f) => f.ground.filter((c) => c.k === 'stroke');
    const a = frame(gentle, w, 1000), b = frame(gentle, w, 2500);
    expect(strokes(a).some((c) => reedColours.has(c.a[1]))).toBe(false);
    const ripples = (f) => strokes(f).filter((c) => c.a[1] !== '#FFFFFF' && !reedColours.has(c.a[1]) && c.a[3] === 0.45).map((c) => JSON.stringify(c.a[0]));
    expect(ripples(a).length).toBe(2);
    expect(ripples(a)).toEqual(ripples(b));                                       // the bank ripples hold still
    expect(frame(gentle, w, 1000).late.some((c) => c.k === 'poly' && c.a[1] === '#FBF3C6')).toBe(false);   // no crop band
    expect(gentle.treeSlot(w, 5, 9, 'palm', 1300)).toBe('palm');
    const full = ambientAt('full');
    expect(strokes(frame(full, w, 1000)).some((c) => reedColours.has(c.a[1]))).toBe(true);
    expect(frame(ambientAt('still'), w, 1000).ground.length).toBe(0);
  });
  it('fades kiln and chimney smoke in place, rising 4 px at most, with no lean', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    setRoad(w, 26, 16, 26, 30);
    addRaw(w, 'potter', 27, 18);
    staffAll(w);
    const series = (level) => {
      const a = ambientAt(level), out = [];
      for (let t = 0; t < 6000; t += 50) out.push(frame(a, w, t).late.filter((c) => c.k === 'radial').map((c) => c.a[0]));
      return out;
    };
    const g = series('gentle');
    const xs = new Set(), ys = [];
    for (const s of g) for (const q of s) { xs.add(Math.round(q[0] * 1000)); ys.push(q[1]); }
    expect([xs.size, Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys) <= AMBIENT_RISE_PX + 1e-9, AMBIENT_RISE_PX]).toEqual([1, true, 4]);
    const f = series('full'), fy = [];
    for (const s of f) for (const q of s) fy.push(q[1]);
    expect(Math.max(...fy) - Math.min(...fy)).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  });

describe('s4 motion title backdrop', () => {
  it('drifts under Full only, stops at once when the level leaves Full, and starts again when it comes back', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld({ size: 64 });
    w.tradeEntry = { x: 30, y: 63 };
    const cam = createCamera({ x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 });
    let reduced = false, t = 0;
    const cc = createCameraControl({ cam, view: () => ({ width: 400, height: 300 }), reducedMotion: () => reduced, now: () => t });
    const backdrop = createBackdrop({ world: w, cam, cameraControl: cc, reducedMotion: () => reduced, driftMs: 1000 });
    const at = () => [Math.round(cam.x * 100), Math.round(cam.y * 100)];
    const start = at();
    backdrop.tick(0); cc.tick(0);
    t = 400; backdrop.tick(t); cc.tick(t);
    const moving = at();
    expect(moving === start || JSON.stringify(moving) === JSON.stringify(start)).toBe(false);   // Full: it drifts
    reduced = true;                                                                // Gentle (the device's setting changed)
    t = 500; backdrop.tick(t); cc.tick(t);
    const held = at();
    t = 900; backdrop.tick(t); cc.tick(t);
    t = 5000; backdrop.tick(t); cc.tick(t);
    expect(at()).toEqual(held);                                                    // it stopped where it was
    reduced = false;
    t = 5100; backdrop.tick(t); cc.tick(t);
    t = 5500; backdrop.tick(t); cc.tick(t);
    expect(JSON.stringify(at()) === JSON.stringify(held)).toBe(false);             // Full again: it drifts on
  });
});
```

```js
export const motionLevelOf = (motion, deviceAsks) => (motion === 'system' ? (deviceAsks ? 'gentle' : 'full') : motion);

// Stage 3's two settings as read-only mirrors of motion, kept in get() for Stage 3 readers (src/dev/scenes.js setMotion and
// its test) until Track E retires them: reducedMotion 'off' for Full, 'system' while following the device, else 'on';
// ambient false only for Still. Writing them goes through motionFromLegacy.
// They are not enumerable, so they are never saved, spread or compared.
const withMirrors = (v) => Object.defineProperties(v, {
  reducedMotion: { value: v.motion === 'full' ? 'off' : v.motion === 'system' ? 'system' : 'on', enumerable: false },

});
```

with:

```js
export const motionLevelOf = (motion, deviceAsks) => (motion === 'system' ? (deviceAsks ? 'gentle' : 'full') : motion);

// What the Settings sheet's Motion row says (spec 5.4): the setting, the level it gives, whether it follows the device,
// and whether the device asks for less motion (known only while following it: that is when it decides the level).
export function motionStatus(settings) {
  const setting = settings.get().motion, level = settings.motionLevel();
  return { setting, level, device: setting === 'system', asks: setting === 'system' && level === 'gentle' };
}

// The one-time Gentle tip (ruling 218) is due while the city follows a device that asks for less motion; a player who
// chose a level needs no telling. A stand-in settings object without motionLevel (a Stage 1-3 test's) never asks.
export const gentleTipDue = (settings) => typeof settings.motionLevel === 'function' && motionStatus(settings).asks;

// Reading the localStorage global itself throws when storage is blocked, so the default is resolved in a guard.
```

```js
// One flame standing on art point q: an orange teardrop, a gold heart, a pale core and two embers above its tip.
export function flame(g, q, size, step) {
  const [x, y] = q, w = 2.2 * size, h = 6.5 * size, lean = LEAN[step % LEAN.length] * size;
  const shape = (k, tip, fill) => g.path([
    ['M', [x - w * k, y]], ['Q', [x - w * k * 1.15, y - h * k * 0.55], [x + tip, y - h * k]],
    ['Q', [x + w * k * 1.15, y - h * k * 0.55], [x + w * k, y]], ['Q', [x, y + w * k * 0.45], [x - w * k, y]], ['Z'],
  ], fill);
  shape(1, lean, FLAME.outer);
  shape(0.62, lean * 0.7, FLAME.mid);
  g.ell([x, y - h * 0.12], w * 0.32, w * 0.26, FLAME.core);
  const side = step % 2 ? 1 : -1;
  g.circ([x + lean * 1.3 + side * size, y - h - (1 + (step % 3)) * size * 1.2], 0.45 * size, FLAME.ember);
```

with:

```js

// One flame standing on art point q: an orange teardrop, a gold heart, a pale core and two embers above its tip.
// { embers: false } leaves the embers out; { alpha } draws the whole flame at that opacity (Gentle's cross-fade).
export function flame(g, q, size, step, { embers = true, alpha = 1 } = {}) {
  const [x, y] = q, w = 2.2 * size, h = 6.5 * size, lean = LEAN[step % LEAN.length] * size;
  const o = { alpha };
  const shape = (k, tip, fill) => g.path([
    ['M', [x - w * k, y]], ['Q', [x - w * k * 1.15, y - h * k * 0.55], [x + tip, y - h * k]],
    ['Q', [x + w * k * 1.15, y - h * k * 0.55], [x + w * k, y]], ['Q', [x, y + w * k * 0.45], [x - w * k, y]], ['Z'],
  ], fill, o);
  shape(1, lean, FLAME.outer);
  shape(0.62, lean * 0.7, FLAME.mid);
  g.ell([x, y - h * 0.12], w * 0.32, w * 0.26, FLAME.core, o);
  if (!embers) return;
  const side = step % 2 ? 1 : -1;
  g.circ([x + lean * 1.3 + side * size, y - h - (1 + (step % 3)) * size * 1.2], 0.45 * size, FLAME.ember);
```

with:

```js
}

// Gentle's cross-fade for flame key id at time now: [shape, alpha] pairs to draw, the shape it is leaving first. Each
// shape holds for GENTLE_FLAME_MS less the fade, then the next fades in over GENTLE_FADE_MS (cosine and sine weights, so
// the flame never thins much mid-fade), out of step by id.
export function gentleShapes(now, id) {
  const u = now / GENTLE_FLAME_MS + ((id * 0.618) % 1), n = Math.floor(u), f = u - n;
  const from = GENTLE_SHAPES[n % 2], to = GENTLE_SHAPES[(n + 1) % 2];
  const fade = GENTLE_FADE_MS / GENTLE_FLAME_MS;
  const b = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (f - (1 - fade)) / fade));
  if (b === 0) return [[from, 1]];
  return [[from, Math.cos((b * Math.PI) / 2)], [to, Math.sin((b * Math.PI) / 2)]];
}

export function drawFires(g, world, range, now, { reducedMotion = false, motion = null } = {}) {
  drawAmbientLate(g);                        // ambient life that shows over the buildings (render/ambient.js), this frame's
  const level = motion || (reducedMotion ? 'still' : 'full');
  for (const id in world.buildings) {
    const b = world.buildings[id];
    if (!b.fire || !inRange(b, range)) continue;
    const q = roofPoint(world, b), big = b.fire.stage === 'fire';
    if (big && level !== 'still') smoke(g, q, now, b.id, level === 'gentle');
    // Each flame: Full steps its shape (sway and embers); Gentle cross-fades two still shapes; Still holds one.
    const draw = (at, size, k) => {
      if (level === 'full') flame(g, at, size, Math.floor(now / FLAME_STEP_MS) + b.id + k);
      else if (level === 'gentle') for (const [shape, alpha] of gentleShapes(now, b.id + k)) flame(g, at, size, shape, { embers: false, alpha });
      else flame(g, at, size, 0);
    };
    if (big) {
      const k = Math.min(2, b.w);
      draw([q[0] - 6.5 * k, q[1] + 1.5], FIRE_SIZES[0], 1);
      draw([q[0] + 6.5 * k, q[1] + 2], FIRE_SIZES[1], 2);
      draw([q[0], q[1] - 1], FIRE_SIZES[2], 0);
    } else {
      draw(q, BLAZE_SIZE, 0);
    }
    // The label sits just over the tallest flame's tip, clear of it.
    const tip = big ? 1 + 6.5 * FIRE_SIZES[2] : 6.5 * BLAZE_SIZE;
    if (level !== 'full') label(g, [q[0], q[1] - tip - LABEL.size / 2 - 3], ART_TEXT.burning);
  }
}
```

with:

```js

// River tile (x, y)'s glint at time now (most tiles have one): { x, y } in tiles and its alpha, or null. Each glint lives
// 4-7 s, drifting downstream (+y) at AMBIENT.glintDriftTilesPerSecond and fading in and out, then starts again. With
// drift false (Gentle) it fades in and out where it starts.
export function glintAt(world, x, y, now, rows, drift = true) {
  const seed = world.seed | 0, h = unit(x, y, seed + SALT.glint);
  if (h > 0.7) return null;
  const life = between(AMBIENT.glintFadeMs, unit(y, x, seed + SALT.glint));
```

```js
export const STAGE4_SCENES = ['title', 'tutorial', 'site', 'pyramid', 'capstone', 'procession', 'palace', 'sitesheet', 'motion'];

// The two motions every Stage 4 shot is taken under (review note 7.2, "Screenshots in both"; spec 5.4): full is Motion
// Full; reduced follows the device (Motion 'system'), which headless Edge, asking for less motion, resolves to Gentle.
// 'gentle' and 'still' choose those levels outright (for a shot or a test that wants one whatever the device says).
// Returns the motion it set. tools/shots.ps1 -Motion takes MOTIONS.
export const MOTIONS = ['full', 'reduced'];
const MOTION_FOR = { full: 'full', reduced: 'system', gentle: 'gentle', still: 'still' };
export function setMotion(settings, motion) {
  if (!(motion in MOTION_FOR)) throw new Error(`setMotion: no motion named ${motion} (${Object.keys(MOTION_FOR).join(', ')})`);
  settings.set({ motion: MOTION_FOR[motion] });
  return motion;
}
```
