```js
// third brighter, larger and longer-lived smoke (a working kiln always has a puff in the air), rare life every 45-90 s,
// the brickworks' kiln smoking while it works, all within the 2 ms budget.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { createAmbient, drawAmbientLate, glintAt, riverRows, rareAt, smokeBase, SMOKE_FROM } from '../../../src/render/ambient.js';
import { AMBIENT } from '../../../src/data/ambient.js';
import { drawFires } from '../../../src/render/fire.js';
import { createRenderer } from '../../../src/render/renderer.js';
import { createCamera, visibleTileRange } from '../../../src/render/camera.js';
import { makeDraw } from '../../../src/render/art/ctx.js';
import { createWorld } from '../../../src/sim/world.js';
import { buildStressCity } from '../../../src/dev/sampleCity.js';
import { riverWorld } from '../../helpers/renderWorld.js';
import { addRaw, setRoad, staffAll } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { makeCanvas } from '../../helpers/canvas.js';

const ALL = { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 31, y1: 31 };
function late(a, w, now, range = ALL) {
  const g = makeDraw(makeCanvas(64, 64).getContext('2d'), 1);
  const calls = [];
  const radial = g.radial;
  g.radial = (...args) => { calls.push(args); return radial(...args); };
  a.draw(g, w, range, now);
  drawAmbientLate(g);
  return calls;
}
const full = () => createAmbient({ enabled: () => true, level: () => 'full' });

describe('s4 motion ambient a notch up', () => {
  it('has a third more glints, a third brighter, larger and longer-lived puffs and rare life every 45-90 s', () => {
    expect([AMBIENT.glintShare, AMBIENT.glintAlpha, AMBIENT.smokeLifePeriods, AMBIENT.smokeRadius, AMBIENT.smokeAlpha, AMBIENT.rareEveryMs])
      .toEqual([0.93, 1, 3, [2.2, 3.8], 0.5, [45000, 90000]]);
    expect([Math.abs(AMBIENT.glintShare / 0.7 - 4 / 3) < 0.01, AMBIENT.glintAlpha / 0.75]).toEqual([true, 4 / 3]);   // Stage 3: 0.7 and 0.75
    const w = riverWorld();
    for (const kind of AMBIENT.rareKinds) {
      const starts = [];
      let was = false;
      for (let t = 0; t < 30 * 60000; t += 250) { const a = rareAt(w, kind, t); if (a && !was) starts.push(t); was = Boolean(a); }
      const gaps = starts.slice(1).map((s, i) => s - starts[i]);
      expect([kind, starts.length >= 20, Math.min(...gaps) >= 45000 - 250, Math.max(...gaps) <= 90000 + 250]).toEqual([kind, true, true, true]);
    }
  });
  it('shows at least six glints in a 390x844 phone view of the river at any moment', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    const rows = riverRows(w, 0, 31);
    const cam = createCamera({ x: 5, y: 16, zoom: 1 });
    const r = visibleTileRange(cam, { width: 390, height: 844 }, w.size);
    let fewest = Infinity;
    for (let t = 0; t < 20000; t += 250) {
      let n = 0;
      for (let y = r.y0; y <= r.y1; y++) for (let x = r.x0; x <= r.x1; x++) {
        if (w.terrain[y * 32 + x] !== 3) continue;
        const gl = glintAt(w, x, y, t, rows);
        if (gl && gl.alpha >= 0.3) n++;                                            // a glint plainly visible
      }
      fewest = Math.min(fewest, n);
    }
    expect(fewest).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(6);
  });
  it('keeps a puff in the air over a working kiln at every moment', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    setRoad(w, 26, 16, 26, 30);
    addRaw(w, 'potter', 27, 18);
    staffAll(w);
    const a = full();
    for (let t = 0; t < 12000; t += 50) {
      const alphas = late(a, w, t).map((c) => c[4]);
      expect([t, alphas.length, Math.max(...alphas) >= 0.2]).toEqual([t, AMBIENT.smokeLifePeriods, true]);
    }
  });
  it('smokes from the brickworks\' kiln while it works, and not while it is idle, blocked or unstaffed', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    setRoad(w, 26, 16, 26, 30);
    const kiln = addRaw(w, 'brickworks', 27, 18);
    staffAll(w);
    expect(SMOKE_FROM.brickworks).toEqual([1.56, 0.46, 14]);
    const base = smokeBase(w, kiln);
    expect(Array.isArray(base)).toBe(true);
    const puffs = () => late(full(), w, 1000);
    expect(puffs().length).toBe(AMBIENT.smokeLifePeriods);
    for (const c of puffs()) expect([Math.abs(c[0][0] - base[0]) < 3, c[0][1] < base[1]]).toEqual([true, true]);   // over the kiln's mouth, rising
    kiln.blocked = 'idle';                                                         // no monument site needs bricks (Track A): nobody at work
    kiln.staff = 0;
    expect([smokeBase(w, kiln), puffs().length]).toEqual([null, 0]);
    staffAll(w);
    kiln.blocked = 'no_input';                                                     // staffed, but no clay: the kiln is cold
    expect(puffs().length).toBe(0);
    kiln.blocked = null;
    expect(puffs().length).toBe(AMBIENT.smokeLifePeriods);
  });
  it('costs well under its budget on the stress city at laptop size, under Full and Gentle', () => {
    const world = buildStressCity(createWorld({ seed: 3 }));
    const renderer = createRenderer({ canvas: makeCanvas(1280, 800), dpr: 1, maxBakesPerFrame: Infinity });
    const cam = createCamera({ x: 32, y: 32, zoom: 0.75 });
    const view = { width: 1280, height: 800 };
    for (const level of ['full', 'gentle']) {
      const a = createAmbient({ enabled: () => true, level: () => level });
      const ms = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        const t = 1000 + i * 16;
        renderer.renderFrame(world, cam, { view, ambient: (g, r) => a.draw(g, world, r, t), fire: (g, r) => drawFires(g, world, r, t) });
        if (i >= 10) ms.push(a.stats.ms);
      }
      ms.sort((x, y) => x - y);
      expect([level, ms[10] < AMBIENT.budgetMs * 2]).toEqual([level, true]);
    }
  });
});
```

```js
// Smoke: puffs from a working kiln or brewhouse, or the roof of a lived-in Townhouse and up, one every 2-3 s, each
// rising about a tile and fading over two of those periods, leaning with the wind. Under Gentle (inPlace) a puff fades
// where it starts, rising GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX at most, with no lean.
function drawSmoke(g, b, base, now, wind, inPlace = false) {
  const P = between(AMBIENT.smokeEveryMs, unit(b.id, 3, SALT.smoke)), off = unit(b.id, 4, SALT.smoke) * P;
  const rise = inPlace ? GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX : 16 * AMBIENT.smokeRiseTiles;
  if (inPlace) wind = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
    const a = ((now + off) / (2 * P) + k / 2) % 1;          // this puff's age, 0 to 1 over its life of 2P: a new one every P
    const alpha = 0.42 * Math.min(1, a / 0.15) * (1 - a);
    const r = 1.6 + a * 2.6;
    const drift = p(wind.x * a * 0.3, wind.y * a * 0.3);
    g.radial([base[0] + drift[0], base[1] - 2 - rise * a + drift[1]], r, r * 0.8, '#F4F0F2', alpha);
```

with:

```js

// Smoke: puffs from a working kiln or brewhouse, or the roof of a lived-in Townhouse and up, one every 2-3 s, each
// rising about a tile and fading over AMBIENT.smokeLifePeriods of those periods, leaning with the wind, so a puff is always
// in the air. Under Gentle (inPlace) a puff fades where it starts, rising GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX at most, with no lean.
function drawSmoke(g, b, base, now, wind, inPlace = false) {
  const P = between(AMBIENT.smokeEveryMs, unit(b.id, 3, SALT.smoke)), off = unit(b.id, 4, SALT.smoke) * P;
  const rise = inPlace ? GENTLE_SMOKE_RISE_PX : 16 * AMBIENT.smokeRiseTiles;
  if (inPlace) wind = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  const n = AMBIENT.smokeLifePeriods, [r0, grow] = AMBIENT.smokeRadius;
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const a = ((now + off) / (n * P) + k / n) % 1;          // this puff's age, 0 to 1 over its life of nP: a new one every P
    const alpha = AMBIENT.smokeAlpha * Math.min(1, a / 0.15) * (1 - a);
    const r = r0 + a * grow;
    const drift = p(wind.x * a * 0.3, wind.y * a * 0.3);
    g.radial([base[0] + drift[0], base[1] - 2 - rise * a + drift[1]], r, r * 0.8, '#F4F0F2', alpha);
```

```js
}

// Rare life on a fixed schedule from the real clock and the seed: kind k's n-th appearance starts 0-30 s into its n-th
// 90 s window and lasts RARE_MS[k], so at most one of each is on screen and they come 60-120 s apart. Returns the
// appearance under way as { t (0..1 through it), h (its own hash) }, or null.
export function rareAt(world, kind, now) {
  const k = AMBIENT.rareKinds.indexOf(kind) + 1, n = Math.floor(now / RARE_WINDOW_MS);
  const start = n * RARE_WINDOW_MS + unit(n, k, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.rare) * 30000;
  const t = (now - start) / RARE_MS[kind];
  return t >= 0 && t < 1 ? { t, h: unit(n, k + 10, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.rare) } : null;
```

```js
// Rare life on a fixed schedule from the real clock and the seed: kind k's n-th appearance starts 0-RARE_JITTER_MS into
// its n-th RARE_WINDOW_MS window and lasts RARE_MS[k], so at most one of each is on screen and they come
// AMBIENT.rareEveryMs apart (45-90 s). Returns the appearance under way as { t (0..1 through it), h (its own hash) }, or null.
export function rareAt(world, kind, now) {
  const k = AMBIENT.rareKinds.indexOf(kind) + 1, n = Math.floor(now / RARE_WINDOW_MS);
  const start = n * RARE_WINDOW_MS + unit(n, k, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.rare) * RARE_JITTER_MS;
  const t = (now - start) / RARE_MS[kind];
  return t >= 0 && t < 1 ? { t, h: unit(n, k + 10, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.rare) } : null;
```

```js
// The festival temple's streamers (spec 5.7 item 3), Track E: a tall painted pole at each of a festival temple's two
// front corners with three pennants, drawn as walker slots so they sort in depth with the temple (src/render/walkers.js
// places them): fig.streamer hangs still; fig.streamer2 is the same blown out the other way (the flutter, Full only).
// The procession's figures themselves (priest, musician, dancer, shrine) are Track B's (src/render/art/figures.js).
// Contract note (Track E): the streamers are art, which the ownership table gives to Track B; Track E draws them here and
// adds each slot to the registry only when the registry has none of that name, so a drawing of B's wins.
import { ART } from './art/registry.js';
import { p, U } from './art/primitives.js';
import { SHADOW, GOLD, TEAL, RED, ORANGE, WOOD } from './art/palette.js';

// A streamer pole at tile point (gx, gy): a tall painted pole with three pennants, hanging one way (step 0) or blown
// out the other (step 1).
const PENNANTS = [RED, TEAL, GOLD];
export function streamer(g, gx, gy, step = 0) {
  const [X, Y] = U(p(gx, gy), 0);
  g.ell([X, Y], 1.6, 0.6, SHADOW, { alpha: 0.25 });
  g.line([X, Y], [X, Y - 38], WOOD, 1.1);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) g.line([X - 0.5, Y - 8 - i * 9], [X + 0.5, Y - 8 - i * 9], ORANGE, 0.7);   // painted bands
  g.circ([X, Y - 38.6], 1, GOLD);
  PENNANTS.forEach((c, i) => {
    const top = Y - 37 + i * 4.2, len = 9 - i * 1.2, sag = step ? -1.6 : 1.4;
    g.path([['M', [X + 0.5, top]], ['Q', [X + len * 0.55, top + sag], [X + len, top + 1.2 + sag]], ['L', [X + 0.5, top + 3]], ['Z']], c, { outline: true });
  });
}

const slot = (draw) => ({ w: 0, d: 0, height: 40, bounds: [-6, -46, 14, 4], shadows: [], draw });
export const STREAMER_ART = {
  'fig.streamer': slot((g, x, y) => streamer(g, x, y, 0)),
  'fig.streamer2': slot((g, x, y) => streamer(g, x, y, 1)),
};
// Registered when the walkers first load; a slot the registry already has (Track B's) is kept.
for (const [name, def] of Object.entries(STREAMER_ART)) if (!(name in ART)) ART[name] = def;
```

```js
// ── Processions (Stage 4, Track E) ──

export const PROCESSION_ID_BASE = 200000;   // festival figures: base + temple id x 16 + i (units are 100000 + id)
export const DEDICATION_ID_BASE = 600000;   // dedication figures: base + monument id x 16 + i
export const STREAMER_ID_BASE = 900000;     // streamers: base + temple id x 2 + corner

// Whether a festival is on today (its mood lasts FESTIVAL.days from the day it was held).
export function festivalOn(world) {
  const d = world.danger && world.danger.festivalDay;
  return d !== null && d !== undefined && world.day >= d && world.day - d < FESTIVAL.days;
}

// How many figures a festival's procession has: PROCESSION.start, one more for each temple, booth and finished monument,
// at most PROCESSION.max (spec 5.7: a later festival is visibly bigger).
export function festivalSize(world) {
  let n = PROCESSION.start;
  for (const b of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (b.type === 'temple' || b.type === 'booth') n++;
    else if (BUILDINGS[b.type] && BUILDINGS[b.type].monument && b.site && b.site.done !== null && b.site.done !== undefined) n++;
  }
  return Math.min(PROCESSION.max, n);
}

// The monuments finished in the last PROCESSION.dedicationDays (from site.done, so a reload shows the dedication).
export function dedicationsOn(world) {
  return allBuildings(world).filter((b) => BUILDINGS[b.type] && BUILDINGS[b.type].monument && b.site && b.site.done !== null && b.site.done !== undefined
    && world.day >= b.site.done && world.day - b.site.done < PROCESSION.dedicationDays);
}

// A dedication's road: from the nearest temple (by road, within its reach) to the monument and back; with none in
// reach, along the monument's own road. Cached with the other loops until the roads change.
export function dedicationLoop(world, m) {
  return cached(world, `d${m.id}`, () => {
    const ends = new Set(adjacentRoadTiles(world, m));
    let best = null;
    for (const t of allBuildings(world)) {
      if (t.type !== 'temple') continue;
      const reach = roadReach(world, t, BUILDINGS.temple.reach);
      for (const e of ends) {
        const d = reach.get(e);
        if (d !== undefined && (!best || d < best.d || (d === best.d && (t.id < best.t.id || (t.id === best.t.id && e < best.e))))) best = { t, e, d, reach };
      }
    }
    if (!best) return walkerLoop(world, m, PROCESSION.ownReach);
    return outAndBack(world, pathBack(world, best.reach, best.e));
  });
}

function cached(world, key, make) {
  let c = cache.get(world);
  if (!c || c.version !== world.roadVersion) {
    c = { version: world.roadVersion, loops: new Map() };
    cache.set(world, c);
  }
  if (!c.loops.has(key)) c.loops.set(key, make());
  return c.loops.get(key);
}

// The walker kind a procession figure is drawn as: its own when the registry has the figure (Track B's), else a priest.
export const figureKind = (kind) => (ART[`fig.${kind}`] ? kind : 'priest');

// One procession's figures on a loop, setting out on day `from`: the first leads, the rest follow PROCESSION.spacing
// apart, each showing once it is out.
function figuresOn(loop, timeDays, from, n, idBase) {
  const out = [];
  if (!loop.length) return out;
  const lead = (timeDays - from) * PROCESSION.tilesPerDay;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const s = lead - i * PROCESSION.spacing;
    if (s < 0) break;
    const w = positionAt(loop, s, idBase + i, figureKind(PROCESSION.order[i % PROCESSION.order.length]));
    if (w) out.push(w);
  }
  return out;
}

// The procession walkers in view: festivals' and dedications', with the festival temples' streamers.
export function processionsAt(world, timeDays, range = null) {
  const state = ambientState(world);
  if (state.dropped.length >= AMBIENT.dropOrder.length) return [];
  const hosts = [];
  if (festivalOn(world)) {
    for (const t of allBuildings(world)) {
      if (t.type !== 'temple' || !isWorking(world, t) || outOfRange(t, BUILDINGS.temple.reach, range)) continue;
      hosts.push({ b: t, kind: 'festival' });
    }
  }
  for (const m of dedicationsOn(world)) if (!outOfRange(m, BUILDINGS.temple.reach, range)) hosts.push({ b: m, kind: 'dedication' });
  if (range) {
    const cx = (range.x0 + range.x1) / 2, cy = (range.y0 + range.y1) / 2;
    const dist = (h) => Math.abs(h.b.x + h.b.w / 2 - cx) + Math.abs(h.b.y + h.b.d / 2 - cy);
    hosts.sort((a, b) => dist(a) - dist(b) || a.b.id - b.b.id);
  }
  const out = [];
  const size = festivalSize(world);
  const flutter = state.level === 'full' && Math.floor(state.now / PROCESSION.flutterMs) % 2 === 1;
  for (const h of hosts.slice(0, PROCESSION.maxOnScreen)) {
    const b = h.b;
    if (h.kind === 'festival') {
      out.push(...figuresOn(loopFor(world, b, BUILDINGS.temple.reach), timeDays, world.danger.festivalDay, size, PROCESSION_ID_BASE + b.id * 16));
      const kind = flutter ? 'streamer2' : 'streamer';
      out.push({ id: STREAMER_ID_BASE + b.id * 2, kind, x: b.x + 0.12, y: b.y + b.d - 0.12, dir: 2 });
      out.push({ id: STREAMER_ID_BASE + b.id * 2 + 1, kind, x: b.x + b.w - 0.12, y: b.y + 0.12, dir: 2 });
    } else {
      out.push(...figuresOn(dedicationLoop(world, b), timeDays, b.site.done, Math.min(PROCESSION.dedicationFigures, size), DEDICATION_ID_BASE + b.id * 16));
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

## Track G: The picture cards and the music

Track G works in its own worktree on the branch `s4-cards`, cut from the Track 0 commit (`563a45c`, Track 0 with its review fixes):

Every code block below was applied, in this order, to a copy of the repo at the Track 0 commit (`563a45c`), on the writer's branch `s4w-cards` (`C:\dev\thebes-s4-w-cards`, commits `ee1a8f9`, `912f3c0`, `e49d44f`: `git -C C:\dev\thebes-s4-w-cards show <hash>` is the ground truth if a block reads ambiguously), and each task's tests and the full suite were run after it: **1,441, 1,458 and 1,461 tests, `ALL PASSED`** (1,429 before). The blocks were also replayed by script onto a fresh checkout of `563a45c` and give each commit's tree exactly (but `sw-files.js`, which `tools/sw-files.ps1` makes, and G3's six pictures, which `tools/tutorial.ps1` makes). The before-blocks are exact at the time each is applied; apply them top to bottom.

How the blocks are written: "Create `path`:" gives a whole new file; "Replace the whole of `path` with:" gives a whole file in place of Track 0's stub; "In `path`, replace: ... with: ..." gives one change, with enough unchanged lines that the before-block is unique, and "Then in `path`, replace:" the next change in the same file. `sw-files.js` is never shown: run `tools/sw-files.ps1`.

What the track builds, in one paragraph: the music is an original loop made in the page with Web Audio, in hijaz on D (D E♭ F♯ G A B♭ C) at 72 beats a minute: three drone oscillators (tonic and fifth, and a low D the raid mood brings in), a plucked string made once per pitch by Karplus-Strong and played as one line, a ney-like flute (a soft wave with a scoop and vibrato) for two bars about once a minute, and a frame drum (a low dum and a light tek), with a short feedback delay for space. Bars are composed from a small set of motifs by a stateless hash of the city's seed and the bar (never the sim's numbers), four bars to a phrase that asks on A and answers on D, so no minute repeats; a raid warning or raid moves a "tension" a quarter a bar towards a quicker, firmer maqsum, a lower drone, a sparser pluck and no flute, and back after. A light look-ahead scheduler (`tick`) schedules a bar once it is within 1.5 s; at most eight voices sound (the three drones and never more than five notes); an offline render checks it never clips or clicks, sits about -32 dBFS (RMS) at the default volume 30 and stays soft. Settings gains Music On / Off and its volume (− and +, 44 px, in tens), and `tools/music.html` plays and renders a minute to listen to. The picture cards are a modal dialog: six cards, each a 600 px picture with its ring or arrow drawn live over it from `cards.json`, a title and plain words (the share of people who work is the sim's own number, and each card's rule is checked against the sim), moved by Next, Back, a swipe, the arrow keys and the dots, ended by Start building, Skip, the X, Esc or the phone's Back, with focus kept inside and handed back; a full-screen sheet on a phone, the picture beside the words held sideways, a centred card of at most 560 px on a wide screen, sized from its own box (a CSS size container) so they fit 390x844 and 844x390 at 150% text; a slide under Full motion only. They show before the first city on a device and from How to play on the title card and at the top of the How to play sheet, where the game pauses behind them. `tools/tutorial.ps1` makes the pictures from development scenes: a small riverside village on seed 7's fresh city that has lived 150 days, framed per card on a 390x844 phone and captured as a 600x600 WebP under 60 KB; each mark is read from the scene (a road tile through the camera, a building's drawn box from its art slot, a button's or a row's box on the page). `-Check` shoots the six cards as a player sees them, to look at.

Task sizes follow the proposed list. G1 also holds `tools/music.html` (a page to hear the music: the writer could not listen, so it is there for Josh's ear). G2 holds the boot.js lines of the first contract note and the one-line Stage 1-3 test changes of the third, because the real cards land in G2. The `pad` a button's ring sits at (so the goals card's ring keeps clear of the goal's words) landed with the pictures in G3, as two small edits to G2's files.

Model: **opus** for all three (judgement in the music's sound, the cards' layout and the pictures' framing); the code is complete and was run, so a sonnet implementer can transcribe it, with an opus reviewer looking at the `-Check` shots.

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import {
  createMusic, composeBar, nextTension, neyPhrase, masterGain, barSeconds, pluckSamples, scheduleOffline, MUSIC,
} from '../../../src/audio/music.js';

// A stand-in audio context that records what the music builds: every source with its start and stop, and every gain's
// automation, so voices, fades and suspends can be checked without sound. lazy: the first resume() does not settle (as
// on a phone, where the first touch's resume arrives a moment later).
function fakeAudio({ state = 'suspended', lazy = true } = {}) {
  const param = (v) => {
    const p = { value: v, events: [] };
    for (const k of ['setValueAtTime', 'linearRampToValueAtTime', 'exponentialRampToValueAtTime', 'setTargetAtTime', 'setValueCurveAtTime', 'cancelScheduledValues']) p[k] = (...a) => { p.events.push([k, ...a]); return p; };
    return p;
  };
  const node = (extra = {}) => ({ connect() {}, disconnect() {}, ...extra });
  const ctx = {
    state, currentTime: 0, sampleRate: 8000, destination: node(), sources: [], gains: [], resumed: 0, suspended: 0, closed: 0,
    resume() { ctx.resumed++; if (!lazy || ctx.resumed > 1) ctx.state = 'running'; return Promise.resolve(); },
    suspend() { ctx.suspended++; ctx.state = 'suspended'; return Promise.resolve(); },
    close() { ctx.closed++; ctx.state = 'closed'; return Promise.resolve(); },
    createGain() { const g = node({ gain: param(1) }); ctx.gains.push(g); return g; },
    createBiquadFilter() { return node({ type: 'lowpass', frequency: param(350), Q: param(1) }); },
    createDelay() { return node({ delayTime: param(0) }); },
    createPeriodicWave() { return {}; },
    createBuffer(ch, len, sr) { const d = new Float32Array(len); return { length: len, sampleRate: sr, getChannelData: () => d }; },
    createOscillator() { return source(node({ type: 'sine', frequency: param(440), setPeriodicWave() {} }), 'osc'); },
    createBufferSource() { return source(node({ buffer: null }), 'buffer'); },
  };
  function source(n, kind) {
    Object.assign(n, { kind, started: null, stopped: Infinity, start(t) { n.started = t; }, stop(t) { n.stopped = t; } });
    ctx.sources.push(n);
    return n;
  }
  return ctx;
}
// The value a gain is last asked to move to (setTargetAtTime), and the most notes sounding at once among sources.
const lastTarget = (g) => { const e = g.gain.events.filter((x) => x[0] === 'setTargetAtTime'); return e.length ? e[e.length - 1][1] : null; };
function mostAtOnce(sources) {
  const marks = sources.flatMap((s) => [[s.started, 1], [s.stopped, -1]]).sort((a, b) => (a[0] - b[0]) || (a[1] - b[1]));
  let n = 0, most = 0;
  for (const [, d] of marks) { n += d; most = Math.max(most, n); }
  return most;
}
const HIJAZ = [2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 10, 0];                       // D E♭ F♯ G A B♭ C as pitch classes

describe('s4 cards music: the sound', () => {
  // Renders 12 bars (40 s) offline at volume 1 and measures: the peak, the RMS level, a "mean frequency" from the first
  // difference (a sine at f gives f), the largest second difference (a click stands out there), the offset and the
  // quietest half second after the first two.
  async function render(mood) {
    const sr = 22050, bars = 12;
    const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(sr * (bars * barSeconds() + 1)), sr);
    scheduleOffline(ctx, { seed: 11, bars, volume: 1, mood: () => mood });
    const d = (await ctx.startRendering()).getChannelData(0);
    let peak = 0, sum = 0, dsum = 0, bend = 0, dc = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
      const x = d[i];
      peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(x)); sum += x * x; dc += x;
      if (i > 0) dsum += (x - d[i - 1]) ** 2;
      if (i > 1) bend = Math.max(bend, Math.abs(x - 2 * d[i - 1] + d[i - 2]));
    }
    let quietest = Infinity;
    const w = Math.floor(sr / 2);
    for (let s = 2 * sr; s + w <= d.length - sr; s += w) {
      let e = 0;
      for (let i = s; i < s + w; i++) e += d[i] * d[i];
      quietest = Math.min(quietest, Math.sqrt(e / w));
    }
    const db = (v) => 20 * Math.log10(v);
    return { peak, rmsDb: db(Math.sqrt(sum / d.length)), meanHz: Math.asin(Math.sqrt(dsum / sum) / 2) * sr / Math.PI, bend, dc: dc / d.length, quietestDb: db(quietest) };
  }

  it('renders forty seconds offline that never clip or click, sit quietly at volume 30, stay soft and never drop out', async () => {
    const calm = await render('calm'), raid = await render('raid');
    for (const m of [calm, raid]) {
      expect(m.peak).toBeLessThan(0.85);                               // at full volume: headroom, never clipping
      expect(m.bend).toBeLessThan(0.25);                               // no clicks (a one-frame step shows above 0.3)
      expect(Math.abs(m.dc)).toBeLessThan(0.002);
      expect(m.meanHz).toBeLessThan(900);                              // soft: the sound sits low, nothing shrill
      expect(m.quietestDb).toBeGreaterThan(-40);                       // the drone holds: never a silence
    }
    const atDefault = calm.rmsDb + 20 * Math.log10(masterGain(0.3));
    expect([atDefault > -36, atDefault < -28]).toEqual([true, true]); // quiet behind the game at the default volume
    expect(raid.rmsDb).toBeGreaterThan(calm.rmsDb);                    // the raid mood is firmer
  });
});
```

```js
// Music (spec 5.5, rulings 266-270): an original, quiet loop generated with Web Audio, in hijaz on D at 72 beats a
// minute: a drone, a plucked voice, a ney-like flute about once a minute and a soft frame drum, built bar by bar from
// motifs by a seeded draw of the city's seed and the bar number (never the sim's random numbers). A tenser raid mood
// fades in over four bars while a raid warning or a raid is on. On by default at volume 30, separate from the effects.
// Stage 4 contract: Track 0 fixed the names and the boot wiring; Track G implements createMusic and owns this file.
//
// boot.js makes one for the page (it outlives each game, so the title card plays too) and:
//   calls unlock() on every pointerdown, pointerup and keydown until it returns true (the browser's autoplay rule:
//   nothing sounds before the first gesture);
//   calls stop() when the page is hidden and start() when it shows again;
//   calls refresh() whenever the settings change (music on or off, the volume);
//   calls tick(now) once a frame from the title's and the game's loops (now: performance.now() ms), so the music can
//   schedule notes a little ahead on that light timer;
//   calls destroy() when the page goes.
// The music reads everything else through its options when it needs it: enabled() (settings music), volume() (0-1),
// seed() (the city's seed, or the title city's), mood() ('calm' or 'raid', musicMood of the city on screen).
// It respects the iPhone silent switch as the effects do (navigator.audioSession.type = 'ambient', set by createSfx).
//
// How it is made (Track G). Everything is synthesised in the page: no files, no third-party code.
//   composeBar(seed, bar, tension) is pure: the bar's notes and drone levels. A phrase is four bars: a motif on the
//   phrase's anchor (D4 or A4), the same motif moved or a second one, a third, then a cadence that ends a phrase on A
//   (a question) or on D (the answer). Motifs, anchors, moves and velocities are drawn by musicDraw(seed, n, salt), a
//   stateless hash, so the same city plays the same bars and two minutes are never the same.
//   Voices: three drone oscillators (tonic D3 and fifth A3; the low D2 of the raid mood), a plucked string (a
//   Karplus-Strong buffer made once per pitch, ringing until the next pluck: one line, at most two sounding), a ney
//   (a soft flute wave with a scoop and vibrato, one note at a time, in a two-bar line every fifth phrase: about once a
//   minute, never in the raid mood), and a frame drum (a low dum and a light tek). The drones hold three of the eight
//   voices and the rest can never sound more than five at once (the voice check drops a note that would).
//   tension moves a quarter a bar towards 1 while the mood is raid and back to 0 after (ruling 267): the fifth gives way
//   to the low drone, the drum takes the quicker maqsum and plays firmer, the pluck thins out, the ney waits.
//   The scheduler is tick(): it schedules a whole bar once that bar's start is within MUSIC.lookahead seconds of the
//   audio clock. A short feedback delay gives space; there is no reverb, worklet or compressor.
//   scheduleOffline(ctx, ...) schedules bars on an OfflineAudioContext with the same code (the level test and
//   tools/music.html, which plays and renders a sample to listen to).

// The music's mood for a world: 'raid' while a raid warning or a raid is on (ruling 267), else 'calm'. Complete.
export const musicMood = (world) => (world && world.raid && (world.raid.warning || world.raid.active) ? 'raid' : 'calm');

// Every number of the music (ruling 266: a taste call, so all of it is here).
export const MUSIC = {
  bpm: 72, beatsPerBar: 4,
  base: 50,                                 // MIDI D3 is degree 0
  scale: [0, 1, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10],            // hijaz on D (Phrygian dominant): D E♭ F♯ G A B♭ C
  lookahead: 1.5,                           // s: a bar is scheduled once its start is this close (frames run at 30 fps or more)
  maxVoices: 8, droneVoices: 3,             // the three drones are always counted
  moodBars: 4,                              // the raid mood fades in and out over four bars
  neyEvery: 5,                              // a ney line every fifth phrase of four bars: one about every 67 s
  fadeIn: 2, fadeOut: 0.3,                  // s: the music's own fades (start, stop, on and off)
  pluckRing: 0.3,                           // s a pluck rings past its written length, unless the next pluck cuts it
  pluckSeconds: 1.4,                        // the longest a pluck rings
  volumeCurve: 0.8,                         // the master gain is volume ^ this (30 -> 0.38, -8.4 dB)
  level: { drone: 0.062, pluck: 0.5, ney: 0.1, dum: 0.36, tek: 0.24, wet: 0.24, feedback: 0.3, delay: 0.208 },   // delay: s, a sixteenth at 72 bpm
  tone: { drone: 700, pluck: 1800, delay: 2000, tek: 2800 },   // Hz: the low-pass on each (the tek's band-pass)
};

const BAR_BEATS = MUSIC.beatsPerBar;
export const beatSeconds = () => 60 / MUSIC.bpm;
export const barSeconds = () => BAR_BEATS * beatSeconds();

// A stateless draw in [0, 1) from the city's seed, a number (a bar, a phrase) and a salt: the music's own hash, so the
// sim's random numbers are never touched (spec 5.5).
export function musicDraw(seed, n, salt) {
  let h = (Math.imul(seed | 0, 0x9E3779B1) ^ Math.imul((n | 0) + 0x632BE5AB, 0x85EBCA77) ^ Math.imul(salt | 0, 0xC2B2AE3D)) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 0x7FEB352D) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 15), 0x846CA68B) >>> 0;
  return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}
const pick = (list, r) => list[Math.min(list.length - 1, Math.floor(r * list.length))];

// A degree of the mode (0 = D3, 7 = D4, 14 = D5; negative below D3) as a MIDI note, and a MIDI note as Hz.
export const midiOfDegree = (d) => MUSIC.base + 12 * Math.floor(d / 7) + MUSIC.scale[((d % 7) + 7) % 7];
export const freqOf = (midi) => 440 * 2 ** ((midi - 69) / 12);

// The pluck's motifs: [eighth in the bar, degree from the anchor, length in eighths]. Hijaz lives in the step from
// E♭ to F♯ (degrees 1 to 2): most motifs turn on it.
const MOTIFS = [
  [[0, 0, 2], [2, 1, 1], [3, 2, 1], [4, 1, 2], [6, 0, 2]],
  [[0, 4, 1], [1, 3, 1], [2, 2, 2], [4, 1, 1], [5, 0, 3]],
  [[0, 0, 3], [3, 4, 1], [4, 3, 2], [6, 2, 2]],
  [[0, 2, 1], [1, 1, 1], [2, 2, 1], [3, 3, 1], [4, 2, 2], [6, 1, 2]],
  [[0, 0, 1], [1, 4, 3], [4, 3, 1], [5, 2, 1], [6, 1, 2]],
  [[0, 0, 1], [1, 0, 1], [2, 1, 2], [4, 0, 1], [5, -1, 1], [6, 0, 2]],
  [[2, 2, 2], [4, 1, 2], [6, 0, 2]],
  [[0, -1, 2], [2, 0, 1], [3, 1, 1], [4, 2, 4]],
];
const SPARSE = [[[0, 0, 4], [4, -1, 2], [6, 0, 2]], [[0, 0, 6], [6, 1, 2]], [[2, 0, 4], [6, -1, 2]]];
// Cadences end on degree 0 (the phrase's goal note).
const CADENCES = [[[0, 2, 1], [1, 1, 1], [2, 0, 6]], [[0, 1, 2], [2, 0, 6]], [[0, 3, 1], [1, 2, 1], [2, 1, 2], [4, 0, 4]]];
const MOVES = [-1, 1, 2, 0];
// The ney's two-bar lines, in absolute degrees (7 = D4 ... 14 = D5), [eighth, degree, length in eighths] per bar.
const NEY_LINES = [
  [[[0, 11, 3], [3, 12, 1], [4, 11, 4]], [[0, 10, 2], [2, 9, 2], [4, 8, 2], [6, 9, 2]]],
  [[[0, 14, 4], [4, 13, 2], [6, 12, 2]], [[0, 11, 2], [2, 10, 2], [4, 11, 4]]],
  [[[0, 9, 2], [2, 11, 2], [4, 12, 4]], [[0, 11, 2], [2, 9, 2], [4, 8, 4]]],
];
// The drum: [voice, eighth, velocity]. Calm is a light baladi, with a pickup at a phrase's end; raid is a quicker,
// firmer maqsum with sixteenth teks.
const DRUMS = {
  calm: [['dum', 0, 0.9], ['tek', 3, 0.55], ['dum', 4, 0.7], ['tek', 6, 0.5]],
  turn: [['dum', 0, 0.9], ['dum', 1, 0.55], ['tek', 3, 0.55], ['dum', 4, 0.7], ['tek', 6, 0.5], ['tek', 7, 0.4]],
  raid: [['dum', 0, 1], ['tek', 1, 0.6], ['tek', 1.5, 0.35], ['tek', 3, 0.7], ['dum', 4, 0.95], ['tek', 5, 0.45], ['tek', 6, 0.7], ['tek', 6.5, 0.4], ['tek', 7, 0.55], ['tek', 7.5, 0.35]],
};

// Whether phrase p (four bars) has a ney line in its second and third bars: every MUSIC.neyEvery phrases, from a phrase
// the seed picks (never the first, so the music starts with the pluck).
export function neyPhrase(seed, p) {
  const offset = Math.floor(musicDraw(seed, 0, 7) * MUSIC.neyEvery);
  return p > 0 && (p + offset) % MUSIC.neyEvery === 0;
}

// Keeps a motif's notes inside the pluck's range (A3 to E♭5) by moving the whole motif an octave.
function inRange(notes) {
  const lo = Math.min(...notes.map((n) => n[1])), hi = Math.max(...notes.map((n) => n[1]));
  const shift = lo < 4 ? 7 : hi > 15 ? -7 : 0;
  return shift ? notes.map(([at, d, len]) => [at, d + shift, len]) : notes;
}

// One bar: { notes: [{ voice, at, len, midi, vel }] (at and len in beats from the bar's start; drums have no midi),
// drone: { tonic, fifth, low } (0-1, times MUSIC.level.drone), tension }. Pure: the same seed, bar and tension always
// give the same bar.
export function composeBar(seed, bar, tension = 0) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tension));
  const p = Math.floor(bar / 4), pos = bar % 4;
  const notes = [];
  const anchor = pick([7, 11], musicDraw(seed, p, 1));
  const goal = p % 2 === 0 ? 11 : 7;                                        // a question on A, the answer on D
  const ney = t === 0 && neyPhrase(seed, p) && (pos === 1 || pos === 2);
  // The pluck.
  let motif;
  if (ney) motif = pick(SPARSE, musicDraw(seed, bar, 6)).map(([at, d, len]) => [at, d + 7, len]);
  else if (pos === 3) motif = pick(CADENCES, musicDraw(seed, p, 5)).map(([at, d, len]) => [at, d + goal, len]);
  else {
    const first = pick(MOTIFS, musicDraw(seed, p, 2));
    let m = first, move = 0;
    if (pos === 1) {
      if (musicDraw(seed, p, 3) < 0.15) m = pick(SPARSE, musicDraw(seed, p, 10));
      else if (musicDraw(seed, p, 3) < 0.6) move = pick(MOVES, musicDraw(seed, p, 4));
      else m = pick(MOTIFS, musicDraw(seed, p, 12));
    } else if (pos === 2) {
      m = pick(MOTIFS, musicDraw(seed, p, 13));
      move = pick([0, 2, -2], musicDraw(seed, p, 14));
    }
    motif = inRange(m.map(([at, d, len]) => [at, d + anchor + move, len]));
  }
  motif.forEach(([at, d, len], i) => {
    if (i > 0 && musicDraw(seed, bar * 16 + i, 9) < 0.45 * t) return;    // the raid mood thins the pluck
    const vel = (i === 0 ? 0.95 : 0.6 + 0.3 * musicDraw(seed, bar * 16 + i, 8)) * (1 + 0.15 * t);
    notes.push({ voice: 'pluck', at: at / 2, len: len / 2, midi: midiOfDegree(d), vel: Math.min(1, vel) });
  });
  // The ney.
  if (ney) {
    const line = pick(NEY_LINES, musicDraw(seed, p, 15))[pos - 1];
    for (const [at, d, len] of line) notes.push({ voice: 'ney', at: at / 2, len: len / 2, midi: midiOfDegree(d), vel: 0.8 + 0.2 * musicDraw(seed, bar * 16 + at, 16) });
  }
  // The drum.
  const pattern = t >= 0.5 ? DRUMS.raid : pos === 3 ? DRUMS.turn : DRUMS.calm;
  for (const [voice, at, vel] of pattern) notes.push({ voice, at: at / 2, len: voice === 'dum' ? 0.5 : 0.25, vel: Math.min(1, vel * (1 + 0.35 * t) * (0.9 + 0.1 * musicDraw(seed, bar * 16 + at * 2, 17))) });
  const swell = 0.6 + 0.4 * musicDraw(seed, bar, 11);
  return { notes, drone: { tonic: swell * (1 + 0.2 * t), fifth: (0.6 + 0.4 * musicDraw(seed, bar, 18)) * (1 - t), low: swell * t }, tension: t };
}

// The next bar's tension: a quarter of the way per bar towards the mood (ruling 267: four bars to fade in or out).
export const nextTension = (tension, mood) => {
  const step = 1 / MUSIC.moodBars, target = mood === 'raid' ? 1 : 0;
  return tension < target ? Math.min(target, tension + step) : Math.max(target, tension - step);
};

// The master gain for a volume of 0-1 (the settings' 0-100 / 100).
export const masterGain = (volume) => (volume > 0 ? Math.min(1, volume) ** MUSIC.volumeCurve : 0);

// ── The audio graph ──

// A soft reed for the drone and a breathy flute for the ney, as harmonic amplitudes (index 1 = the fundamental).
const DRONE_PARTIALS = [0, 1, 0.5, 0.32, 0.2, 0.12, 0.07, 0.04];
const NEY_PARTIALS = [0, 1, 0.12, 0.05, 0.02];

function waveOf(ctx, partials) {
  const real = new Float32Array(partials.length), imag = new Float32Array(partials);
  return ctx.createPeriodicWave(real, imag);
}
function lowpass(ctx, hz, type = 'lowpass') {
  const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  f.type = type;
  f.frequency.value = hz;
  return f;
}
// A small fixed noise buffer for the tek, from a seeded generator (the same every time).
function noiseBuffer(ctx, seconds = 0.12) {
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * seconds));
  const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, n, ctx.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
  let s = 12345;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { s = (Math.imul(s, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; d[i] = (s / 4294967296) * 2 - 1; }
  return buf;
}

// A plucked string at a MIDI note (Karplus-Strong): a softened noise burst one period long (its mean taken out), fed back through a
// two-tap average, decaying to about -34 dB in 1.2 s, faded out at the end and scaled to a peak of 1.
export function pluckSamples(sampleRate, midi, seconds = MUSIC.pluckSeconds) {
  const f = freqOf(midi), period = Math.max(2, Math.round(sampleRate / f));
  const len = Math.max(period + 2, Math.floor(sampleRate * seconds));
  const d = new Float32Array(len);
  const rho = Math.pow(0.02, 1 / (f * 1.2));
  let s = (midi * 7919 + 1) >>> 0, prev = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < period; i++) {
    s = (Math.imul(s, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0;
    prev = 0.7 * prev + 0.3 * ((s / 4294967296) * 2 - 1);
    d[i] = prev;
  }
  let mean = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < period; i++) mean += d[i] / period;
  for (let i = 0; i < period; i++) d[i] -= mean;                           // no offset to ring on
  for (let i = period; i < len; i++) d[i] = rho * 0.5 * (d[i - period] + (i - period - 1 >= 0 ? d[i - period - 1] : 0));
  const fade = Math.min(len, Math.floor(sampleRate * 0.03));
  for (let i = 0; i < fade; i++) d[len - 1 - i] *= i / fade;
  let peak = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(d[i]));
  if (peak > 0) for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] /= peak;
  return d;
}

// The graph: master (the volume) to the speakers; a feedback delay for space (the pluck and the ney send to it); the
// three drones, started once and moved bar by bar; per-note voices made as they are scheduled.
function buildGraph(ctx) {
  const L = MUSIC.level, T = MUSIC.tone;
  const master = ctx.createGain();
  master.gain.value = 0;
  master.connect(ctx.destination);
  const send = ctx.createGain();
  send.gain.value = L.wet;
  const delay = ctx.createDelay(1);
  delay.delayTime.value = L.delay;
  const echo = lowpass(ctx, T.delay);
  const feedback = ctx.createGain();
  feedback.gain.value = L.feedback;
  send.connect(delay); delay.connect(echo); echo.connect(feedback); feedback.connect(delay); echo.connect(master);
  const pluckBus = lowpass(ctx, T.pluck);
  pluckBus.connect(master); pluckBus.connect(send);
  const neyBus = ctx.createGain();
  neyBus.connect(master); neyBus.connect(send);
  const drumBus = ctx.createGain();
  drumBus.connect(master);
  const tekBus = lowpass(ctx, T.tek, 'bandpass');
  tekBus.Q.value = 1.1;
  tekBus.connect(drumBus);
  const droneBus = lowpass(ctx, T.drone);
  droneBus.connect(master);
  const droneWave = waveOf(ctx, DRONE_PARTIALS);
  const drones = {};
  for (const [name, midi] of [['tonic', MUSIC.base], ['fifth', MUSIC.base + 7], ['low', MUSIC.base - 12]]) {
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator(), gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.setPeriodicWave(droneWave);
    osc.frequency.value = freqOf(midi);
    gain.gain.value = 0;
    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(droneBus);
    osc.start(ctx.currentTime);
    drones[name] = { osc, gain };
  }
  return {
    ctx, master, send, pluckBus, neyBus, drumBus, tekBus, drones,
    neyWave: waveOf(ctx, NEY_PARTIALS), noise: noiseBuffer(ctx), plucks: new Map(),
    voices: [],            // [start, stop] of every note still to end, for the voice check
    lastPluck: null,       // the last pluck scheduled: { gain, src, stop } (the next pluck cuts it)
    tension: 0, bar: 0, nextAt: 0,
  };
}

function pluckBuffer(g, midi) {
  let buf = g.plucks.get(midi);
  if (!buf) {
    const d = pluckSamples(g.ctx.sampleRate, midi);
    buf = g.ctx.createBuffer(1, d.length, g.ctx.sampleRate);
    buf.getChannelData(0).set(d);
    g.plucks.set(midi, buf);
  }
  return buf;
}

// The voice check: true (and the note is counted) when [start, stop) keeps the notes sounding at once, with the three
// drones, at or under MUSIC.maxVoices.
function takeVoice(g, start, stop) {
  g.voices = g.voices.filter((v) => v[1] > g.ctx.currentTime - 0.01);
  const limit = MUSIC.maxVoices - MUSIC.droneVoices;
  const points = [start, ...g.voices.map((v) => v[0]).filter((s) => s > start && s < stop)];
  for (const p of points) if (g.voices.filter((v) => v[0] <= p && v[1] > p).length >= limit) return false;
  g.voices.push([start, stop]);
  return true;
}

const SILENT = 0.0001;
// A note's gain starts at 0, not the default 1: a source may sound a frame before its gain's first event (a click).
const silentGain = (ctx) => { const gain = ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value = 0; return gain; };
// A note's nodes leave the graph once its source ends.
const end = (src, ...nodes) => { src.onended = () => { for (const n of [src, ...nodes]) { try { n.disconnect(); } catch (e) { /* already gone */ } } }; };

function playPluck(g, n, t, len) {
  const ctx = g.ctx;
  const stop = t + Math.min(MUSIC.pluckSeconds, len + MUSIC.pluckRing) + 0.08;
  // The next pluck cuts the last one short (one line on one string), freeing its voice.
  const last = g.lastPluck;
  if (last && last.stop > t) {
    last.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, t, 0.015);
    try { last.src.stop(t + 0.08); } catch (e) { /* already stopped */ }
    const v = g.voices.find((x) => x[0] === last.start && x[1] === last.stop);
    if (v) v[1] = t + 0.08;
  }
  if (!takeVoice(g, t, stop)) return false;
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource(), gain = silentGain(ctx);
  src.buffer = pluckBuffer(g, n.midi);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(MUSIC.level.pluck * n.vel, t);
  gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, stop - 0.08, 0.015);
  src.connect(gain); gain.connect(g.pluckBus);
  end(src, gain);
  src.start(t);
  src.stop(stop);
  g.lastPluck = { gain, src, start: t, stop };
  return true;
}

function playNey(g, n, t, len) {
  const ctx = g.ctx, stop = t + len;
  if (!takeVoice(g, t, stop)) return false;
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator(), gain = silentGain(ctx);
  osc.setPeriodicWave(g.neyWave);
  // A scoop up from a little flat, then a gentle vibrato that grows in (one curve, no extra oscillator).
  const f = freqOf(n.midi), steps = Math.max(8, Math.ceil(len * 60)), curve = new Float32Array(steps);
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const s = (i / (steps - 1)) * len;
    const scoop = s < 0.08 ? 2 ** ((-0.3 * (1 - s / 0.08)) / 12) : 1;
    curve[i] = f * scoop * (1 + 0.006 * Math.min(1, s / 0.35) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5 * s));
  }
  osc.frequency.setValueCurveAtTime(curve, t, len);
  const peak = MUSIC.level.ney * n.vel, release = Math.min(0.12, len / 3);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(SILENT, t);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, t + Math.min(0.15, len / 3));
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(peak, stop - release);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, stop);
  osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(g.neyBus);
  end(osc, gain);
  osc.start(t);
  osc.stop(stop);
  return true;
}

function playDum(g, n, t) {
  const ctx = g.ctx, stop = t + 0.4;
  if (!takeVoice(g, t, stop)) return false;
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator(), gain = silentGain(ctx);
  osc.type = 'sine';
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(110, t);
  osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(62, t + 0.12);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(SILENT, t);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(MUSIC.level.dum * n.vel, t + 0.006);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(SILENT, t + 0.38);
  osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(g.drumBus);
  end(osc, gain);
  osc.start(t);
  osc.stop(stop);
  return true;
}

function playTek(g, n, t) {
  const ctx = g.ctx, stop = t + 0.09;
  if (!takeVoice(g, t, stop)) return false;
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource(), gain = silentGain(ctx);
  src.buffer = g.noise;
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(MUSIC.level.tek * n.vel, t);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(SILENT, t + 0.07);
  src.connect(gain); gain.connect(g.tekBus);
  end(src, gain);
  src.start(t);
  src.stop(stop);
  return true;
}

const PLAYERS = { dum: playDum, ney: playNey, pluck: playPluck, tek: playTek };
const ORDER = ['dum', 'ney', 'pluck', 'tek'];   // who keeps a voice when one must go

// Schedules bar `bar` to start at t0 (the audio clock's seconds) at `tension`; returns the composed bar.
function scheduleBar(g, bar, t0, seed, tension) {
  const composed = composeBar(seed, bar, tension), beat = beatSeconds(), barLen = barSeconds();
  const L = MUSIC.level;
  for (const [name, level] of Object.entries(composed.drone)) g.drones[name].gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(level * L.drone, t0, barLen / 3);
  const notes = composed.notes.slice().sort((a, b) => (ORDER.indexOf(a.voice) - ORDER.indexOf(b.voice)) || (a.at - b.at));
  const plucks = composed.notes.filter((n) => n.voice === 'pluck').sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
  // Plucks are scheduled in time order (each cuts the one before), after the drum and the ney have their voices.
  for (const n of notes) if (n.voice !== 'pluck') PLAYERS[n.voice](g, n, t0 + n.at * beat, n.len * beat);
  for (const n of plucks) playPluck(g, n, t0 + n.at * beat, n.len * beat);
  return composed;
}

// Schedules `bars` bars from the context's start on an OfflineAudioContext, at master gain masterGain(volume), with the
// mood of each bar from mood(bar) (a raid from bar 0 starts at full tension); returns the graph. Each bar after the first
// is scheduled when the render reaches the look-ahead before it (ctx.suspend), as tick() does live, so only a bar or two
// of notes exist at a time (a render with every note made up front is many times slower). The level test and
// tools/music.html render with it.
export function scheduleOffline(ctx, { seed = 1, bars = 9, volume = 0.3, mood = () => 'calm' } = {}) {
  const g = buildGraph(ctx);
  g.master.gain.setValueAtTime(masterGain(volume), 0);
  let tension = 0;
  const one = (bar) => {
    tension = bar === 0 && mood(0) === 'raid' ? 1 : nextTension(tension, mood(bar));
    scheduleBar(g, bar, bar * barSeconds() + 0.05, seed, tension);
  };
  one(0);
  for (let bar = 1; bar < bars; bar++) ctx.suspend(bar * barSeconds() + 0.05 - MUSIC.lookahead).then(() => { one(bar); ctx.resume(); });
  return g;
}

function defaultCreate() {
  const Ctx = typeof AudioContext !== 'undefined' ? AudioContext : (typeof webkitAudioContext !== 'undefined' ? webkitAudioContext : null);
  if (!Ctx) throw new Error('no_audio');
  return new Ctx();
}

// The music's controls (spec 5.5). context: an audio context to use (tests); create: how to make one on the first
// gesture; timer(fn, ms): how a fade-out's suspend waits (tests).
export function createMusic({
  context = null, create = defaultCreate, enabled = () => false, volume = () => 0.3, seed = () => 1, mood = () => 'calm',
  timer = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms), cancelTimer = (id) => clearTimeout(id),
} = {}) {
  let ctx = context, g = null, hidden = false, destroyed = false, quieting = null;

  const running = () => Boolean(ctx && ctx.state === 'running');
  const on = () => !destroyed && !hidden && Boolean(enabled());
  function graph() {
    if (!g && ctx) { try { g = buildGraph(ctx); g.nextAt = ctx.currentTime + 0.1; } catch (e) { g = null; } }
    return g;
  }
  function resume() {
    if (ctx && ctx.state === 'suspended' && typeof ctx.resume === 'function') { try { const p = ctx.resume(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {}); } catch (e) { /* stays suspended */ } }
  }
  // Fades the master to the volume (or in from silence), cancelling a pending suspend.
  function fadeTo(level, seconds) {
    if (!g) return;
    const t = ctx.currentTime;
    g.master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);
    g.master.gain.setValueAtTime(g.master.gain.value, t);
    g.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(level, t, seconds / 3);
  }
  function wake() {
    if (quieting !== null) { cancelTimer(quieting); quieting = null; }
    if (!graph()) return;
    resume();
    if (g.nextAt < ctx.currentTime) g.nextAt = ctx.currentTime + 0.1;   // never catch up on bars missed
    fadeTo(masterGain(volume()), MUSIC.fadeIn);
  }
  // Fades out, then suspends the context, so nothing plays (or costs anything) while off or hidden.
  function quiet(seconds) {
    if (!g || quieting !== null) return;
    fadeTo(0, seconds);
    quieting = timer(() => {
      quieting = null;
      if (!on() && ctx && ctx.state === 'running' && typeof ctx.suspend === 'function') { try { const p = ctx.suspend(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {}); } catch (e) { /* keeps running, silent */ } }
    }, seconds * 1000 + 50);
  }

  const api = {
    get context() { return ctx; },
    // A user gesture: make or resume the context, but only while the music is on; true once it is running.
    unlock() {
      if (!on()) return false;
      if (!ctx) { try { ctx = create(); } catch (e) { ctx = null; return false; } }
      wake();
      return running();
    },
    start() { hidden = false; if (on() && ctx) wake(); },
    stop() { hidden = true; quiet(0.05); },
    // The settings changed: on or off, the volume.
    refresh() {
      if (destroyed) return;
      if (!on()) { quiet(MUSIC.fadeOut); return; }
      if (!ctx) { try { ctx = create(); } catch (e) { ctx = null; return; } }   // turned on from the Settings sheet: a tap
      wake();
    },
    // The light timer: schedules each bar once its start is within the look-ahead.
    tick() {
      if (!on() || !running() || !g) return;
      const now = ctx.currentTime;
      if (g.nextAt < now) g.nextAt = now + 0.05;
      while (g.nextAt < now + MUSIC.lookahead) {
        g.tension = nextTension(g.tension, mood());
        scheduleBar(g, g.bar, g.nextAt, seed(), g.tension);
        g.bar += 1;
        g.nextAt += barSeconds();
      }
    },
    destroy() {
      destroyed = true;
      if (quieting !== null) { cancelTimer(quieting); quieting = null; }
      if (ctx && !context && typeof ctx.close === 'function') { try { const p = ctx.close(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {}); } catch (e) { /* gone */ } }
      g = null;
    },
    playing: () => on() && running() && Boolean(g),
    // For tests: the bar about to be scheduled and the tension it will move from.
    state: () => (g ? { bar: g.bar, tension: g.tension, nextAt: g.nextAt } : null),
  };
  return api;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Add the listening page**

The writer could not listen; this page is for Josh's ear. Serve the repo (`python tests/serve.py 8000 .`) and open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/tools/music.html`: Play live (with a Mood button for the raid mood), or Render 60 s (calm, then raid from 30 s) to hear it, read its peak and RMS and save it as a WAV.

Create `tools/music.html`:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Thebes music</title>
<style>
  body { font: 15px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 16px; max-width: 640px; }
  button, input { font: inherit; min-height: 44px; margin: 4px 4px 4px 0; padding: 0 12px; }
  pre { background: #f3ead6; padding: 8px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>Thebes music</h1>
<p>The game's music (src/audio/music.js) to listen to: play it live, or render a minute offline, hear it and save it as a WAV.
Serve the repo (python tests/serve.py 8000 .) and open http://127.0.0.1:8000/tools/music.html.</p>
<p>
  <label>Seed <input id="seed" type="number" value="11" style="width: 9em"></label>
  <label>Volume <input id="volume" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="10" value="30" style="width: 5em"></label>
</p>
<p>
  <button id="play">Play live</button> <button id="mood">Mood: calm</button> <button id="halt">Stop</button>
</p>
<p><button id="render">Render 60 s (calm, raid from 30 s)</button> <a id="save" hidden download="thebes-music.wav">Save the WAV</a></p>
<pre id="log">Ready.</pre>
<script type="module">
  import { createMusic, scheduleOffline, barSeconds, masterGain } from '../src/audio/music.js';
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const log = (text) => { $('log').textContent = text; };
  let mood = 'calm', music = null, raf = null, player = null;
  const seed = () => Number($('seed').value) || 1, volume = () => Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number($('volume').value))) / 100;
  $('mood').onclick = () => { mood = mood === 'calm' ? 'raid' : 'calm'; $('mood').textContent = `Mood: ${mood}`; };
  $('play').onclick = () => {
    if (!music) {
      music = createMusic({ enabled: () => true, volume, seed, mood: () => mood });
      const loop = (t) => { music.tick(t); const s = music.state(); if (s) log(`Live: bar ${s.bar}, tension ${s.tension}, ${music.playing() ? 'playing' : 'waiting'}`); raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
    music.unlock(); music.refresh();
  };
  $('halt').onclick = () => { if (music) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); music.destroy(); music = null; } if (player) { player.stop(); player = null; } log('Stopped.'); };
  // A mono 16-bit WAV of the rendered samples.
  function wav(d, sr) {
    const out = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(44 + d.length * 2));
    const str = (o, s) => { for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) out.setUint8(o + i, s.charCodeAt(i)); };
    str(0, 'RIFF'); out.setUint32(4, 36 + d.length * 2, true); str(8, 'WAVEfmt '); out.setUint32(16, 16, true); out.setUint16(20, 1, true);
    out.setUint16(22, 1, true); out.setUint32(24, sr, true); out.setUint32(28, sr * 2, true); out.setUint16(32, 2, true); out.setUint16(34, 16, true);
    str(36, 'data'); out.setUint32(40, d.length * 2, true);
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) out.setInt16(44 + i * 2, Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, d[i])) * 32767, true);
    return new Blob([out], { type: 'audio/wav' });
  }
  $('render').onclick = async () => {
    log('Rendering...');
    const sr = 44100, bars = Math.ceil(60 / barSeconds()), raidFrom = Math.floor(30 / barSeconds());
    const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(sr * (bars * barSeconds() + 1)), sr);
    scheduleOffline(ctx, { seed: seed(), bars, volume: volume(), mood: (bar) => (bar >= raidFrom ? 'raid' : 'calm') });
    const buffer = await ctx.startRendering(), d = buffer.getChannelData(0);
    let peak = 0, sum = 0;
    for (const x of d) { peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(x)); sum += x * x; }
    const db = (v) => (20 * Math.log10(v)).toFixed(1);
    log(`Rendered ${(d.length / sr).toFixed(1)} s at volume ${Math.round(volume() * 100)} (master ${masterGain(volume()).toFixed(2)}): peak ${peak.toFixed(3)} (${db(peak)} dBFS), RMS ${db(Math.sqrt(sum / d.length))} dBFS.`);
    $('save').href = URL.createObjectURL(wav(d, sr));
    $('save').hidden = false;
    const live = new AudioContext();
    player = live.createBufferSource();
    player.buffer = buffer;
    player.connect(live.destination);
    player.start();
  };
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

The dialog's tests. `rig()` mounts the real shell at a size and opens the cards in it (the dialog is its own size container, so the shell lays it out as that phone or screen would); the history and the window's popstate are stand-ins.

Create `tests/stage4/cards/pictureCards.test.js`:

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { showPictureCards, markSvg, loadMarks, forgetMarks } from '../../../src/ui/tutorial.js';
import { TUTORIAL_CARDS, TUTORIAL } from '../../../src/data/tutorial.js';
import { CARDS4_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { createSettings } from '../../../src/ui/settings.js';
import { mountShell } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { fire, key } from '../../helpers/dom.js';

const MARKS = { road: { mark: { kind: 'ring', x: 300, y: 320, w: 40, h: 40 } }, farm: { mark: { kind: 'arrow', x: 560, y: 520, angle: 45 } } };

// The page's history and its capturing popstate listeners, as the cards use them.
function fakeHistory() {
  const h = { pushed: 0, backs: 0, state: null, pushState(s) { h.pushed++; h.state = s; }, back() { h.backs++; } };
  return h;
}
function fakeListeners() {
  const l = {
    fns: [],
    add: (type, fn) => l.fns.push([type, fn]),
    remove: (type, fn) => { l.fns = l.fns.filter((x) => x[1] !== fn); },
    pop() { const e = { stopped: false, stopImmediatePropagation() { e.stopped = true; } }; for (const [t, fn] of [...l.fns]) if (t === 'popstate') fn(e); return e; },
  };
  return l;
}

// The cards on the real shell at a phone's or a screen's size, opened from a button that had focus.
async function rig({ width = 390, height = 844, motion = 'still', text = 100, marks = MARKS } = {}) {
  const shell = await mountShell(width, height);
  const settings = createSettings({ storage: { getItem: () => null, setItem() {} }, root: document.body, systemReducedMotion: () => false });
  settings.set({ motion, textSize: text });
  const opener = document.createElement('button');
  opener.textContent = 'How to play';
  shell.root.append(opener);
  opener.focus();
  const history = fakeHistory(), l = fakeListeners();
  let done = 0;
  const c = showPictureCards({ root: shell.root, doc: document, settings, marks, history, addListener: l.add, removeListener: l.remove, onDone: () => { done++; } });
  const d = c.element;
  return {
    shell, settings, opener, history, l, c, d, q: (sel) => d.querySelector(sel), done: () => done,
    cleanup() { c.close(); settings.destroy(); shell.cleanup(); delete document.body.dataset.motion; },
  };
}
const swipe = (node, dx, dy = 0) => {
  fire(node, 'pointerdown', { clientX: 200, clientY: 300, pointerId: 4 });
  fire(node, 'pointerup', { clientX: 200 + dx, clientY: 300 + dy, pointerId: 4 });
};

describe('s4 cards picture cards: the dialog', () => {
  it('gives every card a title, its words and its picture\'s alt text', () => {
    expect(TUTORIAL_CARDS.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['road', 'homes', 'farm', 'food', 'goals', 'ahead']);
    for (const c of TUTORIAL_CARDS) {
      const w = CARDS4_TEXT.cards[c.id];
      expect([c.id, w.title.length > 0, w.words.length > 0, w.alt.length > 0, w.words.split('. ').length <= 3]).toEqual([c.id, true, true, true, true]);
    }
  });

  it('shows six cards, each a picture with its alt text and mark, a title and words, and moves by Next, Back, the dots, the arrow keys and a swipe', async () => {
    const r = await rig();
    try {
      const { d, q } = r;
      expect([d.getAttribute('role'), d.getAttribute('aria-modal'), d.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'), d.parentElement]).toEqual(['dialog', 'true', 'pc-title', r.shell.root]);
      const showing = (id, i) => {
        const w = CARDS4_TEXT.cards[id];
        const current = [...d.querySelectorAll('.pc-dot')].findIndex((b) => b.getAttribute('aria-current') === 'step');
        expect([q('.pc-count').textContent, q('.pc-picture').getAttribute('src'), q('.pc-picture').alt, q('#pc-title').textContent, q('#pc-words').textContent, r.c.index(), current])
          .toEqual([`${i + 1} of 6`, `${TUTORIAL.dir}${id}.webp`, w.alt, w.title, w.words, i, i]);
      };
      showing('road', 0);
      expect([q('.pc-back').disabled, document.activeElement === q('.pc-next'), q('.pc-next').textContent, d.querySelectorAll('.pc-dot').length]).toEqual([true, true, CARDS4_TEXT.next, 6]);
      expect(q('.pc-dot').getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe(CARDS4_TEXT.dot(1, 6));
      const ring = q('.pc-mark rect.line');                                     // a ring 10 px out from the 40 px box at (300, 320)
      expect([q('.pc-mark').dataset.kind, q('.pc-mark').getAttribute('aria-hidden'), d.querySelectorAll('.pc-mark .halo').length, ring.getAttribute('x'), ring.getAttribute('y'), ring.getAttribute('width'), ring.getAttribute('rx')])
        .toEqual(['ring', 'true', 1, '270', '290', '60', '30']);
      fire(q('.pc-next'), 'click');
      showing('homes', 1);
      expect([q('.pc-back').disabled, q('.pc-mark').childElementCount]).toEqual([false, 0]);   // no mark given for it: the picture alone
      key(d, 'ArrowRight');
      showing('farm', 2);
      expect([q('.pc-mark').dataset.kind, d.querySelectorAll('.pc-mark path').length]).toEqual(['arrow', 2]);
      key(d, 'ArrowLeft');
      showing('homes', 1);
      fire(d.querySelectorAll('.pc-dot')[4], 'click');
      showing('goals', 4);
      swipe(q('.pc-stage'), -80);
      showing('ahead', 5);
      expect(q('.pc-next').textContent).toBe(CARDS4_TEXT.start);
      swipe(q('.pc-stage'), -20);                                                // too short
      swipe(q('.pc-stage'), -60, 120);                                           // more up than across
      key(d, 'ArrowRight');                                                      // nothing after the last
      showing('ahead', 5);
      swipe(q('.pc-stage'), 80);
      showing('goals', 4);
      fire(q('.pc-back'), 'click');
      showing('food', 3);
      let heard = 0;
      const listen = () => { heard++; };
      r.shell.root.addEventListener('keydown', listen);
      key(q('.pc-next'), 'p'); key(q('.pc-next'), ' '); key(d, 'ArrowRight');   // a modal: no key gets past it to the game
      r.shell.root.removeEventListener('keydown', listen);
      expect([heard, r.done()]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('ends on Start building, Skip, the X, Esc or the phone\'s Back, calling onDone once and handing focus back; close() calls nothing', async () => {
    for (const how of ['start', 'skip', 'close', 'esc', 'back']) {
      const r = await rig();
      try {
        expect([r.history.pushed, r.l.fns.length]).toEqual([1, 1]);           // one history entry of its own, while it shows
        if (how === 'start') {
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) fire(r.q('.pc-next'), 'click');
          fire(r.q('.pc-next'), 'click');
        } else if (how === 'skip') fire(r.q('.pc-skip'), 'click');
        else if (how === 'close') fire(r.q('.pc-close'), 'click');
        else if (how === 'esc') key(r.q('.pc-next'), 'Escape');
        else expect(r.l.pop().stopped).toBe(true);                             // the phone's Back closes the cards and goes no further
        expect([how, r.done(), r.d.isConnected, document.activeElement === r.opener]).toEqual([how, 1, false, true]);
        if (how === 'back') expect([r.history.backs, r.l.fns.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
        else {
          expect(r.history.backs).toBe(1);                                     // its entry taken back...
          const e = r.l.pop();                                                 // ...and that Back's popstate stops there too
          expect([e.stopped, r.l.fns.length]).toEqual([true, 0]);
        }
        fire(r.q('.pc-skip'), 'click');
        expect(r.done()).toBe(1);                                              // once only
      } finally { r.cleanup(); }
    }
    const r = await rig();
    try {
      r.c.close();
      expect([r.done(), r.d.isConnected, r.history.backs]).toEqual([0, false, 1]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('keeps focus inside: Tab and Shift+Tab go round its buttons', async () => {
    const r = await rig();
    try {
      const next = r.q('.pc-next'), skip = r.q('.pc-skip');
      key(next, 'Tab');
      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(skip);                               // past the last, back to the first
      key(skip, 'Tab', { shiftKey: true });
      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(next);
      key(next, 'Tab', { shiftKey: true });
      expect(r.d.contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('slides a new card in under Full motion only', async () => {
    for (const motion of ['full', 'gentle', 'still']) {
      const r = await rig({ motion });
      try {
        fire(r.q('.pc-next'), 'click');
        const forward = [r.q('.pc-figure').classList.contains('pc-in-next'), r.q('.pc-text').classList.contains('pc-in-next')];
        fire(r.q('.pc-back'), 'click');
        const backward = r.q('.pc-figure').classList.contains('pc-in-back');
        expect([motion, ...forward, backward]).toEqual([motion, motion === 'full', motion === 'full', motion === 'full']);
      } finally { r.cleanup(); }
    }
  });

  it('fits a phone held either way at 100% and 150% text, and sits in a card of at most 560 px on a wide screen', async () => {
    for (const [w, h] of [[390, 844], [375, 667], [844, 390], [667, 375], [1280, 800], [1024, 768]]) {
      for (const text of [100, 150]) {
        const r = await rig({ width: w, height: h, text });
        try {
          const at = `${w}x${h} at ${text}%`;
          const frame = r.shell.root.getBoundingClientRect(), box = r.q('.pc-box').getBoundingClientRect();
          const inside = (b) => b.left >= box.left - 0.5 && b.right <= box.right + 0.5 && b.top >= box.top - 0.5 && b.bottom <= box.bottom + 0.5;
          const wide = w >= 900 && h >= 600, sideways = !wide && w > h;
          if (wide) expect([at, box.width <= 560, Math.abs(box.left + box.width / 2 - (frame.left + w / 2)) < 1, box.height <= h]).toEqual([at, true, true, true]);
          else expect([at, Math.round(box.width), Math.round(box.height)]).toEqual([at, w, h]);   // a full-screen sheet
          for (let i = 0; i < TUTORIAL_CARDS.length; i++) {
            r.c.go(i);
            const fig = r.q('.pc-figure').getBoundingClientRect(), t = r.q('.pc-text'), tb = t.getBoundingClientRect();
            expect([at, i, Math.abs(fig.width - fig.height) < 1, fig.width >= 280, inside(fig)]).toEqual([at, i, true, true, true]);
            expect([at, sideways ? fig.right <= tb.left : fig.bottom <= tb.top]).toEqual([at, true]);   // beside the words sideways, above them otherwise
            for (const b of r.d.querySelectorAll('button')) {
              const rb = b.getBoundingClientRect();
              expect([at, b.className, rb.width >= 44, rb.height >= 44, inside(rb)]).toEqual([at, b.className, true, true, true]);
            }
            if (text === 100) expect([at, i, t.scrollHeight <= t.clientHeight + 1]).toEqual([at, i, true]);   // nothing scrolls at 100%
            else expect([at, i, t.clientHeight >= 60]).toEqual([at, i, true]);                                  // at 150% only the words may
          }
        } finally { r.cleanup(); }
      }
    }
  });
});

describe('s4 cards picture cards: the marks', () => {
  it('draws a ring as a rounded outline round its box and an arrow to its point, each a white halo under a line', () => {
    const ring = markSvg({ kind: 'ring', x: 100, y: 200, w: 80, h: 30 });
    const rect = ring.querySelector('rect.line');
    expect([ring.getAttribute('viewBox'), rect.getAttribute('x'), rect.getAttribute('y'), rect.getAttribute('width'), rect.getAttribute('height'), rect.getAttribute('rx')])
      .toEqual(['0 0 600 600', '50', '175', '100', '50', '25']);
    const arrow = markSvg({ kind: 'arrow', x: 300, y: 300, angle: 0 });         // pointing right: the tail to its left
    const d = arrow.querySelector('path.line').getAttribute('d');
    expect([d.startsWith(`M${300 - TUTORIAL.arrowLength} 300 L300 300`), arrow.querySelectorAll('.halo').length]).toEqual([true, 1]);
    expect([markSvg(null).childElementCount, markSvg({ kind: 'blob' }).childElementCount]).toEqual([0, 0]);
  });

  it('fetches the marks once a page from cards.json and draws them as they come; without them a card shows its picture alone', async () => {
    const shell = await mountShell(390, 844);
    forgetMarks();
    try {
      let fetched = 0, fail = false;
      const fetchMarks = async (url) => {
        fetched++;
        if (fail) throw new Error('offline');
        return { ok: url === `${TUTORIAL.dir}${TUTORIAL.marks}`, json: async () => ({ size: 600, cards: MARKS }) };
      };
      let c = showPictureCards({ root: shell.root, fetchMarks, history: null });
      expect(c.element.querySelector('.pc-mark').childElementCount).toBe(0);    // not yet
      await loadMarks(fetchMarks);
      await Promise.resolve();
      expect([fetched, c.element.querySelector('.pc-mark').dataset.kind]).toEqual([1, 'ring']);
      c.close();
      c = showPictureCards({ root: shell.root, fetchMarks, history: null });
      expect([fetched, c.element.querySelector('.pc-mark').dataset.kind]).toEqual([1, 'ring']);   // kept for the page
      c.close();
      forgetMarks();
      fail = true;
      expect(await loadMarks(fetchMarks)).toEqual({});                          // offline without them: no marks
      fail = false;
      expect(await loadMarks(fetchMarks)).toEqual(MARKS);                       // and tried again next time
      expect(fetched).toBe(3);
    } finally { forgetMarks(); shell.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { boot } from '../../../src/boot.js';
import { createSaveStore } from '../../../src/save/store.js';
import { openSheet } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { CARDS4_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { fakeIndexedDB } from '../../helpers/fakeStorage.js';
import { mountShell, fakeHistory, fakeDoc } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { fire } from '../../helpers/dom.js';

const memory = (data = {}) => ({ getItem: (k) => (k in data ? data[k] : null), setItem: (k, v) => { data[k] = String(v); } });
const storedSettings = (storage) => JSON.parse(storage.getItem('thebes.settings') || '{}');

// boot on the real shell, the picture cards real unless a stand-in is given (tests/stage4/contract/uiSeams.test.js rigs it
// the same way). Frames are never run.
async function bootWith({ showPictureCards = undefined, storage = memory() } = {}) {
  const shell = await mountShell(1280, 800);
  const history = fakeHistory();
  const api = await boot(fakeDoc(), window, {
    root: document.body, store: createSaveStore({ idb: fakeIndexedDB(), local: null }), params: new URLSearchParams(''), now: () => 0, clock: () => 1760000000000, storage,
    envInput: { ua: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0) Chrome/124.0' }, sw: null,
    uiOptions: { getSize: () => ({ width: 1280, height: 800 }), subscribeResize: () => () => {}, history, addListener: history.addListener, removeListener: history.removeListener, keyTarget: shell.root, storage },
    loopOptions: { raf: () => 0, caf: () => {} },
    ...(showPictureCards ? { showPictureCards } : {}),
  });
  const cleanup = () => { api.destroy(); shell.cleanup(); document.body.classList.remove('on-title'); delete window.__thebes; };
  return { api, root: shell.root, storage, cleanup };
}

describe('s4 cards how to play', () => {
  it('offers How to play on the title card before Play with sound; a second call while the cards show joins them', async () => {
    let shown = 0, held = null;
    const cards = ({ onDone }) => { shown++; held = onDone; return { close() {} }; };
    const b = await bootWith({ showPictureCards: cards });
    try {
      const how = b.root.querySelector('#title .how-to-play');
      expect([how.textContent, how.nextElementSibling.classList.contains('sound')]).toEqual([CARDS4_TEXT.howToPlay, true]);
      fire(how, 'click');
      expect([shown, b.api.phase()]).toEqual([1, 'title']);
      let a = 0, z = 0;
      b.api.hooks.pictureCards(() => { a++; });
      b.api.hooks.pictureCards(() => { z++; });
      fire(b.root.querySelector('#title .new-city'), 'click');                 // New city while they show: ignored
      expect([shown, a, z, b.api.phase()]).toEqual([1, 0, 0, 'title']);
      held();
      expect([a, z, storedSettings(b.storage).cardsSeen, b.api.phase()]).toEqual([1, 1, true, 'title']);   // seen; the title stays
      fire(b.root.querySelector('#title .new-city'), 'click');
      expect([b.api.phase(), shown]).toEqual(['game', 1]);                      // seen once: New city starts at once
    } finally { b.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('puts Show the picture cards at the top of How to play in the game, pauses the game behind them, and leaves the sheet open', async () => {
    const b = await bootWith({ storage: memory({ 'thebes.settings': JSON.stringify({ cardsSeen: true }) }) });
    try {
      fire(b.root.querySelector('#title .new-city'), 'click');
      const g = b.api.game();
      g.ui.speedControl.set(2);
      g.ui.store.set(openSheet(g.ui.store.get(), 'help'));
      const show = b.root.querySelector('#sheet .body button.show-cards');
      expect([show.textContent, b.root.querySelector('#sheet .body').firstElementChild.contains(show)]).toEqual([CARDS4_TEXT.showCards, true]);
      show.focus();
      fire(show, 'click');
      const d = document.querySelector('.picture-cards');
      expect([Boolean(d), g.world.speed, g.ui.store.get().sheet.kind, document.activeElement === d.querySelector('.pc-next')]).toEqual([true, 0, 'help', true]);
      fire(d.querySelector('.pc-skip'), 'click');
      expect([document.querySelector('.picture-cards'), g.ui.store.get().sheet.kind, document.activeElement === b.root.querySelector('#sheet .body button.show-cards')]).toEqual([null, 'help', true]);
    } finally { b.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('shows the real cards over the title before the first city on a device, and starts the city from Start building', async () => {
    const b = await bootWith();
    try {
      fire(b.root.querySelector('#title .new-city'), 'click');
      const d = document.querySelector('.picture-cards');
      expect([b.api.phase(), Boolean(d), document.activeElement === d.querySelector('.pc-next'), storedSettings(b.storage).cardsSeen === true]).toEqual(['title', true, true, false]);
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) fire(d.querySelector('.pc-next'), 'click');
      expect([b.api.phase(), document.querySelector('.picture-cards'), storedSettings(b.storage).cardsSeen]).toEqual(['game', null, true]);
    } finally { b.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('closes the real cards with the page, without starting a city', async () => {
    const b = await bootWith();
    fire(b.root.querySelector('#title .new-city'), 'click');
    expect(Boolean(document.querySelector('.picture-cards'))).toBe(true);
    b.cleanup();
    expect([document.querySelector('.picture-cards'), b.api.game()]).toEqual([null, null]);
  });
});
```
