```js
// The picture cards state rules; each is checked here against the sim, the world set up both ways (Global Constraints:
// words follow the sim). The share of people who work is the sim's own number in the words (cards4WorkShare).
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { CARDS4_TEXT, cards4WorkShare } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { ECONOMY } from '../../../src/data/economy.js';
import { place, canPlace, setSpeed } from '../../../src/sim/commands.js';
import { assignLabour, isWorking } from '../../../src/sim/labour.js';
import { vacancies } from '../../../src/sim/immigration.js';
import { monthlyHousing, needsOf } from '../../../src/sim/housing.js';
import { produceDay } from '../../../src/sim/production.js';
import { createGameLoop } from '../../../src/render/loop.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';

const W = CARDS4_TEXT.cards;

describe('s4 cards the rules on the cards', () => {
  it('card 1: homes and workplaces work only when they touch a road', () => {
    expect(W.road.words).toContain('work only when they touch a road');
    const w = makeTestWorld();                                         // fertile land at x < 8
    addRaw(w, 'house', 20, 20, { tier: 1, residents: 100 });            // people to work, on a road of their own
    setRoad(w, 19, 21, 22, 21);
    const plot = addRaw(w, 'house', 12, 6);
    const farm = addRaw(w, 'farm_grain', 2, 5);
    assignLabour(w);
    expect([vacancies(w).some((v) => v.h === plot), isWorking(w, farm)]).toEqual([false, false]);
    setRoad(w, 0, 7, 14, 7);                                            // a road along both
    assignLabour(w);
    expect([vacancies(w).some((v) => v.h === plot), isWorking(w, farm)]).toEqual([true, true]);
  });

  it('card 2: a well near the homes, then food, lets them grow', () => {
    expect(W.homes.words).toContain('A well near them, then food, lets them grow');
    expect([needsOf(2), needsOf(3)]).toEqual([['water'], ['water', 'food']]);   // a Shack wants water; a Cottage food as well
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    setRoad(w, 10, 10, 20, 10);
    const home = addRaw(w, 'house', 12, 11, { tier: 1, residents: 5 });
    monthlyHousing(w);
    expect(home.tier).toBe(1);
    addRaw(w, 'well', 14, 11);
    monthlyHousing(w);
    expect(home.tier).toBe(2);
  });

  it('card 3: farms grow only on the fertile land by the river', () => {
    expect(W.farm.words).toContain('Farms grow only on the fertile land by the river');
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    setRoad(w, 0, 10, 20, 10);
    expect([canPlace(w, 'farm_grain', 2, 8).ok, canPlace(w, 'farm_grain', 12, 8).ok]).toEqual([true, false]);
  });

  it('card 4: a farm fills a granary; about four in ten people work; a building short of workers works slowly', () => {
    expect(W.food.words).toContain(`${cards4WorkShare()}, and a building short of workers works slowly`);
    expect([cards4WorkShare(0.4), cards4WorkShare(0.3)]).toEqual(['About four in ten people work', 'About three in ten people work']);
    expect(cards4WorkShare()).toBe(cards4WorkShare(ECONOMY.workerShare));
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    setRoad(w, 0, 10, 20, 10);
    addRaw(w, 'house', 16, 11, { tier: 1, residents: 100 });
    assignLabour(w);
    expect(w.labour.workforce).toBe(Math.round(ECONOMY.workerShare * 10) * 10);   // the words' share of 100 people
    const farm = place(w, 'farm_grain', 2, 8), granary = place(w, 'granary', 6, 11);
    assignLabour(w);
    for (let d = 0; d < 30; d++) produceDay(w);
    expect(w.buildings[granary.id].store.grain).toBeGreaterThan(0);             // the farm filled the granary
    const f = w.buildings[farm.id], store = w.buildings[granary.id].store;
    const made = (staff, days) => { f.staff = staff; const before = store.grain; for (let d = 0; d < days; d++) produceDay(w); return store.grain - before; };
    expect([made(10, 10), made(5, 10)]).toEqual([10, 5]);                       // half the workers, half the grain
  });

  it('card 6: pause any time, and nothing happens while you plan', () => {
    expect(W.ahead.words).toContain('Pause any time: nothing happens while you plan');
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    setRoad(w, 0, 10, 20, 10);
    const frames = [];
    const loop = createGameLoop({ world: w, render: () => {}, raf: (fn) => { frames.push(fn); return frames.length; }, caf: () => {} });
    const run = (n) => { for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) loop.tick(i * 250); };
    setSpeed(w, 0);
    loop.start();
    run(40);                                                            // ten seconds paused
    const day = w.day;
    expect(place(w, 'well', 12, 11).ok).toBe(true);                      // building while paused
    run(40);
    expect(w.day).toBe(day);
    setSpeed(w, 1);
    run(40);
    expect(w.day).toBeGreaterThan(day);
    loop.stop();
  });
});
```

```js
// The picture cards (spec 4.1, rulings 261-264): six cards read before the first city and any time from How to play,
// each one real game screenshot with one ring or arrow, a title and one or two plain sentences (their words, and each
// picture's alt text, live in src/ui/text.js CARDS4_TEXT.cards under the card's id). Track G owns this file.
//
// The pictures are made by tools/tutorial.ps1 from the development scenes (src/dev/tutorialScenes.js: the `tutorial`
// scene with { picture: id }), saved as assets/tutorial/<id>.webp, TUTORIAL.size px square and at most TUTORIAL.maxBytes,
// with assets/tutorial/cards.json giving each card's mark in picture px, read from the scene itself:
//   { "size": 600, "cards": { "<id>": { "mark": { "kind": "ring", "x", "y", "w", "h" } | { "kind": "arrow", "x", "y", "angle" } } } }
// A ring is a rounded outline around the box centred on (x, y), w by h (a circle when they are equal); an arrow's tip is at
// (x, y) and it points along angle (degrees: 0 points right, 90 down). The interface draws the mark live over the picture
// (src/ui/tutorial.js), so it stays sharp and stays aligned when the pictures are made again.
export const TUTORIAL_CARDS = [
  { id: 'road', mark: 'ring' },     // a road with homes, a well and a farm along it: a ring on the road
  { id: 'homes', mark: 'ring' },    // housing plots on a road and a well beside them: a ring on the well
  { id: 'farm', mark: 'arrow' },    // the Ground layer on, fertile land green by the river, a farm on it: an arrow to Layers
  { id: 'food', mark: 'ring' },     // a granary and a bazaar by the homes, a building sheet: a ring on its workers row
  { id: 'goals', mark: 'ring' },    // the goals strip: a ring on Show me
  { id: 'ahead', mark: 'ring' },    // a pyramid under way, a tower and a firehouse beyond: a ring on the pyramid
];

export const TUTORIAL = {
  dir: './assets/tutorial/',        // the pictures and the marks, beside index.html (cached for offline play)
  marks: 'cards.json',
  size: 600,                        // the pictures' side in px, and the marks' coordinates
  maxBytes: 60 * 1024,              // each picture at most 60 KB (ruling 264)
  ringPad: 10,                      // px (picture) between a ring and the box it marks
  arrowLength: 110, arrowHead: 34,  // px (picture)
  swipePx: 40,                      // a swipe moves a card when it goes this far, more across than up or down
};
```

Replace the whole of `src/ui/tutorial.js` (Track 0's stub) with:

```js
// The picture cards (spec 4.1, rulings 261-265): six cards, each a real game screenshot with one ring or arrow drawn
// live over it, a title and one or two sentences, read before the first city and any time from How to play. Stage 4
// contract: Track 0 fixed the name and the wiring; Track G implements it (with src/data/tutorial.js, assets/tutorial/ and
// tools/tutorial.ps1) and owns this file.
//
// showPictureCards({ root, doc, settings, onDone }) shows the cards as a modal dialog over whatever is behind it (the
// title card, or a paused game), with focus kept inside and handed back on close. onDone() is called once, when the
// player reaches Start building, skips, or closes them (Back, Esc, X). It returns { close() }, which closes the cards
// without calling onDone (a page torn down under them). Under Full motion the cards slide; under Gentle and Still they
// change at once (settings.motionLevel()).
//
// The wiring (src/boot.js): New city and This week's Nile show them first when settings.get().cardsSeen is false, then
// set cardsSeen (seen or skipped, ruling 262) and start the city; hooks.pictureCards(onDone) shows them any time (the title
// card's How to play button and the How to play sheet's "Show the picture cards", both Track G's).
//
// Track G: the dialog is appended to root (the page's body) and is its own size container, so it lays out as a
// full-screen sheet on a phone, the picture beside the words on a landscape phone and a centred card of at most 560 px on
// a wide screen (css/ui.css, s4 cards), whatever box holds it. Moving: Next and Back, a swipe on the picture, the arrow
// keys, the dots (each a button), Skip, the X, Esc and the phone's Back (one history entry of its own, taken back when
// the cards close another way; its popstate is caught first and goes no further, so the sheet under the cards stays
// open). Every key pressed inside stops there, so the game's shortcuts never act behind the cards. The marks come from
// assets/tutorial/cards.json (fetched once a page; until then, or offline without it, the pictures show without one).
// Options for tests: cards, marks (the cards.json "cards" object, given instead of fetched), fetchMarks, history,
// addListener and removeListener (the window's popstate, capturing), base (where the pictures are).
import { TUTORIAL_CARDS, TUTORIAL } from '../data/tutorial.js';
import { CARDS4_TEXT } from './text.js';
import { el, button } from './components.js';

const SVG = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
function svgEl(tag, attrs = {}) {
  const n = document.createElementNS(SVG, tag);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) n.setAttribute(k, String(v));
  return n;
}
const round = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;

// The mark as SVG in picture px (TUTORIAL.size square, scaled with the picture): a white halo under a teal line, a
// rounded ring around a box or an arrow to a point (src/data/tutorial.js gives the shapes). An empty SVG for no mark.
export function markSvg(mark, size = TUTORIAL.size) {
  const svg = svgEl('svg', { class: 'pc-mark', viewBox: `0 0 ${size} ${size}`, 'aria-hidden': 'true', focusable: 'false' });
  if (!mark) return svg;
  let shape = null;
  if (mark.kind === 'ring') {
    const w = mark.w + 2 * TUTORIAL.ringPad, h = mark.h + 2 * TUTORIAL.ringPad, r = Math.min(w, h) / 2;
    shape = { tag: 'rect', attrs: { x: round(mark.x - w / 2), y: round(mark.y - h / 2), width: round(w), height: round(h), rx: round(r), ry: round(r) } };
  } else if (mark.kind === 'arrow') {
    const a = (mark.angle * Math.PI) / 180, L = TUTORIAL.arrowLength, H = TUTORIAL.arrowHead;
    const tail = [mark.x - Math.cos(a) * L, mark.y - Math.sin(a) * L];
    const wing = (s) => [mark.x - Math.cos(a + s) * H, mark.y - Math.sin(a + s) * H];
    const [w1, w2] = [wing(0.5), wing(-0.5)];
    shape = { tag: 'path', attrs: { d: `M${round(tail[0])} ${round(tail[1])} L${round(mark.x)} ${round(mark.y)} M${round(w1[0])} ${round(w1[1])} L${round(mark.x)} ${round(mark.y)} L${round(w2[0])} ${round(w2[1])}` } };
  }
  if (shape) for (const cls of ['halo', 'line']) svg.append(svgEl(shape.tag, { class: cls, ...shape.attrs }));
  svg.dataset.kind = shape ? mark.kind : '';
  return svg;
}

// The marks (assets/tutorial/cards.json's "cards"), fetched once a page and kept (marksNow: drawn at once by every later
// show); a failed fetch is tried again next time.
let marksOnce = null, marksNow = null;
export function loadMarks(fetchMarks = (url) => fetch(url)) {
  if (!marksOnce) {
    marksOnce = Promise.resolve()
      .then(() => fetchMarks(TUTORIAL.dir + TUTORIAL.marks))
      .then((r) => (r && r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((json) => { if (!json || !json.cards) throw new Error('no_marks'); marksNow = json.cards; return json.cards; })
      .catch(() => { marksOnce = null; return {}; });
  }
  return marksOnce;
}

// For tests: forget the fetched marks, so the next show fetches them again.
export function forgetMarks() { marksOnce = null; marksNow = null; }

const defaultHistory = () => { try { return typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.history : null; } catch (e) { return null; } };

export function showPictureCards({
  root = null, doc = null, settings = null, onDone = () => {},
  cards = TUTORIAL_CARDS, marks = null, fetchMarks = undefined, history = defaultHistory(),
  addListener = (type, fn) => window.addEventListener(type, fn, true), removeListener = (type, fn) => window.removeEventListener(type, fn, true),
  base = TUTORIAL.dir,
} = {}) {
  const C = CARDS4_TEXT, n = cards.length;
  const host = root || document.body;
  const opener = (doc && doc.activeElement) || document.activeElement;
  // A sheet that rebuilds while the cards show replaces its buttons: focus then goes back to its twin (the same classes).
  const openerClasses = opener && typeof opener.className === 'string' && opener.className.trim() ? `${opener.tagName.toLowerCase()}.${opener.className.trim().split(/\s+/).join('.')}` : null;
  const motion = () => (settings && typeof settings.motionLevel === 'function' ? settings.motionLevel() : 'still');
  let index = 0, closed = false, known = marks || marksNow;

  // The dialog.
  const count = el('span', { class: 'pc-count small muted' });
  const skip = button(C.skip, { class: 'pc-skip quiet' });
  const shut = button('✕', { class: 'pc-close quiet', 'aria-label': C.close, title: C.close });
  const picture = el('img', { class: 'pc-picture', width: TUTORIAL.size, height: TUTORIAL.size, decoding: 'async', alt: '' });
  const figure = el('figure', { class: 'pc-figure' }, [picture, markSvg(null)]);
  const stage = el('div', { class: 'pc-stage' }, [figure]);
  const title = el('h2', { id: 'pc-title' });
  const words = el('p', { id: 'pc-words' });
  const text = el('div', { class: 'pc-text', 'aria-live': 'polite' }, [title, words]);
  const dots = cards.map((c, i) => button('', { class: 'pc-dot', 'aria-label': C.dot(i + 1, n), dataset: { index: String(i) } }));
  const back = button(C.back, { class: 'pc-back' });
  const next = button(C.next, { class: 'pc-next primary' });
  const box = el('div', { class: 'pc-box' }, [
    el('div', { class: 'pc-top' }, [count, skip, shut]),
    stage, text,
    el('div', { class: 'pc-dots', role: 'group', 'aria-label': C.dots }, dots),
    el('div', { class: 'pc-nav' }, [back, next]),
  ]);
  const dialog = el('div', { class: 'picture-cards', role: 'dialog', 'aria-modal': 'true', 'aria-labelledby': 'pc-title', 'aria-describedby': 'pc-words' }, [box]);

  function render(dir = null) {
    const card = cards[index], words4 = C.cards[card.id] || { title: card.id, words: '', alt: '' };
    count.textContent = C.count(index + 1, n);
    picture.src = `${base}${card.id}.webp`;
    picture.alt = words4.alt;
    figure.replaceChild(markSvg(known && known[card.id] ? known[card.id].mark : null), figure.lastChild);
    title.textContent = words4.title;
    words.textContent = words4.words;
    text.scrollTop = 0;
    dots.forEach((d, i) => { if (i === index) d.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step'); else d.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
    back.disabled = index === 0;
    next.textContent = index === n - 1 ? C.start : C.next;
    // Under Full the new card slides in from the side it came from; under Gentle and Still it is simply there (spec 5.4).
    for (const node of [figure, text]) {
      node.classList.remove('pc-in-next', 'pc-in-back');
      if (dir && motion() === 'full') { void node.offsetWidth; node.classList.add(dir === 'next' ? 'pc-in-next' : 'pc-in-back'); }
    }
    if (back.disabled && doc4Active() === back) next.focus();
    if (index + 1 < n) { const pre = new Image(); pre.src = `${base}${cards[index + 1].id}.webp`; }
  }
  const doc4Active = () => (doc && doc.activeElement) || document.activeElement;
  function go(i) {
    if (closed || i < 0 || i >= n || i === index) return;
    const dir = i > index ? 'next' : 'back';
    index = i;
    render(dir);
  }

  // The phone's Back: one history entry while the cards show.
  let pushed = false, popping = false, listening = false;
  function onPop(e) {
    if (popping) { popping = false; e.stopImmediatePropagation(); unlisten(); return; }   // our own entry, taken back
    if (closed) return;
    pushed = false;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    unlisten();
    finish();
  }
  function unlisten() { if (listening) { listening = false; removeListener('popstate', onPop); } }
  if (history && typeof history.pushState === 'function') {
    try { history.pushState({ thebesCards: true }, ''); pushed = true; addListener('popstate', onPop); listening = true; } catch (e) { pushed = false; }
  }

  function teardown() {
    closed = true;
    dialog.remove();
    if (pushed) {
      pushed = false;
      popping = true;
      try { history.back(); } catch (e) { popping = false; unlisten(); }
    } else unlisten();
    const to = opener && opener.isConnected ? opener : (openerClasses ? host.querySelector(openerClasses) : null);
    if (to && typeof to.focus === 'function') to.focus();
  }
  function finish() {
    if (closed) return;
    teardown();
    onDone();
  }

  // Moving.
  next.addEventListener('click', () => { if (index === n - 1) finish(); else go(index + 1); });
  back.addEventListener('click', () => go(index - 1));
  skip.addEventListener('click', finish);
  shut.addEventListener('click', finish);
  dots.forEach((d, i) => d.addEventListener('click', () => go(i)));
  let swipe = null;
  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => { swipe = { id: e.pointerId, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; });
  stage.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => {
    if (!swipe || swipe.id !== e.pointerId) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - swipe.x, dy = e.clientY - swipe.y;
    swipe = null;
    if (Math.abs(dx) >= TUTORIAL.swipePx && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.2) go(index + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
  });
  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { swipe = null; });
  dialog.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();                                   // a modal: the game's shortcuts never act behind it
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); go(index + 1); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); go(index - 1); }
    else if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); finish(); }
    else if (e.key === 'Tab') {                            // focus stays inside
      const stops = [...dialog.querySelectorAll('button')].filter((b) => !b.disabled);
      const at = stops.indexOf(doc4Active());
      const to = e.shiftKey ? (at <= 0 ? stops.length - 1 : at - 1) : (at < 0 || at === stops.length - 1 ? 0 : at + 1);
      e.preventDefault();
      stops[to].focus();
    }
  });

  host.append(dialog);
  render();
  next.focus();
  if (!known) {
    loadMarks(fetchMarks).then((m) => { known = m; if (!closed) figure.replaceChild(markSvg(m[cards[index].id] ? m[cards[index].id].mark : null), figure.lastChild); });
  }

  return {
    element: dialog,
    index: () => index,
    go,
    close() { if (!closed) teardown(); },
  };
}
```

with:

```css
.music-volume .stepper .value { min-width: 2.5em; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
```

```css
/* The picture cards (spec 4.1): a full-screen sheet on a phone, the picture beside the words on a landscape phone and a
   centred card of at most 560 px on a wide screen. The dialog is its own size container (pc), so its parts are sized from
   its box, never the window's: a test's mounted shell lays it out as the phone it stands for. --s4g-pic is the picture's
   side: the picture keeps its shape and size, and only the words scroll when they do not fit (150% text). */
.picture-cards { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 20; container: pc / size; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(43, 31, 14, 0.55); }
.picture-cards .pc-box {
  --s4g-pic: min(600px, 100cqw - 24px, 100cqh - 300px);
  box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; gap: 8px;
  padding: max(8px, var(--safe-top)) max(12px, var(--safe-right)) max(10px, var(--safe-bottom)) max(12px, var(--safe-left));
  background: var(--parchment); color: var(--ink);
}
.picture-cards .pc-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.picture-cards .pc-count { flex: 1; }
.picture-cards .pc-stage { touch-action: pan-y; }
.picture-cards .pc-figure { position: relative; margin: 0 auto; width: var(--s4g-pic); height: var(--s4g-pic); }
.picture-cards .pc-picture { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--parchment-2); object-fit: cover; }
.picture-cards .pc-mark { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.picture-cards .pc-mark .halo { fill: none; stroke: #FFFFFF; stroke-width: 16; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.picture-cards .pc-mark .line { fill: none; stroke: var(--teal); stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.picture-cards .pc-text { min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; }
.picture-cards .pc-text h2 { font-size: calc(20px * var(--ui-scale)); line-height: 1.25; margin: 0 0 4px; }
.picture-cards .pc-text p { margin: 0; }
.picture-cards .pc-dots { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
.picture-cards .pc-dot { position: relative; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; }
.picture-cards .pc-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin: -6px 0 0 -6px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--ink-soft); }
.picture-cards .pc-dot[aria-current="step"]::after { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: -8px 0 0 -8px; background: var(--teal); border-color: var(--teal); }
.picture-cards .pc-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.picture-cards .pc-next { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 40%; }
/* A landscape phone: the picture on the left, the words, the dots and the buttons beside it. */
@container pc (min-aspect-ratio: 1 / 1) and (max-height: 599px) {
  .picture-cards .pc-box { --s4g-pic: min(600px, 100cqh - 20px, 50cqw); grid-template-columns: var(--s4g-pic) minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; column-gap: 16px; }
  .picture-cards .pc-stage { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / 5; align-self: center; }
  .picture-cards .pc-top, .picture-cards .pc-text, .picture-cards .pc-dots, .picture-cards .pc-nav { grid-column: 2; }
}
/* A wide screen: a centred card. */
@container pc (min-width: 900px) and (min-height: 600px) {
  .picture-cards .pc-box { --s4g-pic: min(536px, 100cqh - 330px); width: min(560px, 100cqw - 32px); height: auto; max-height: calc(100cqh - 32px); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
}
/* Under Full motion only (src/ui/tutorial.js adds the classes): the new card slides in from the side it came from. */
@keyframes s4g-in-next { from { transform: translateX(32px); opacity: 0.2; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes s4g-in-back { from { transform: translateX(-32px); opacity: 0.2; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.picture-cards .pc-in-next { animation: s4g-in-next 200ms ease-out; }
.picture-cards .pc-in-back { animation: s4g-in-back 200ms ease-out; }
/* ── end s4 cards ── */
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { boot } from '../../../src/boot.js';
import { createSaveStore } from '../../../src/save/store.js';
import { devScene } from '../../../src/dev/scenes.js';
import { TUTORIAL_SHOT } from '../../../src/dev/tutorialScenes.js';

import { alertsFor } from '../../../src/sim/alerts.js';
import { idx } from '../../../src/sim/grid.js';
import { T as TERRAIN } from '../../../src/sim/terrain.js';
import { tileToScreen, screenToTile } from '../../../src/render/camera.js';
import { CARDS4_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { fakeIndexedDB } from '../../helpers/fakeStorage.js';
import { mountShell, fakeHistory } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';

const noStorage = { getItem: () => null, setItem: () => {} };

// The page as tools/tutorial.ps1 opens it for a picture, or the title card: the real game loop runs (the city is paused).
async function bootShot(params) {
  const { width, height } = TUTORIAL_SHOT;
  const shell = await mountShell(width, height);
  const history = fakeHistory();
  const api = await boot(document, window, {
    root: document.body, store: createSaveStore({ idb: fakeIndexedDB(), local: null }), params: new URLSearchParams(params.replace(/^\/\?/, '')),
    now: () => performance.now(), clock: () => 1760000000000, storage: noStorage,
    envInput: { ua: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0) Chrome/124.0' }, sw: null,
    uiOptions: { getSize: () => ({ width, height }), subscribeResize: () => () => {}, history, addListener: history.addListener, removeListener: history.removeListener, keyTarget: shell.root, storage: noStorage },
  });
  return { api, root: shell.root, cleanup() { api.destroy(); shell.cleanup(); document.body.classList.remove('on-title'); delete window.__thebes; } };
}

describe('s4 cards pictures', () => {
  it('has each card\'s picture, 600 px square and at most 60 KB, with its mark inside it, all kept for offline play', async () => {
    const json = await (await fetch(`/assets/tutorial/${TUTORIAL.marks}`)).json();
    const self = {};
    new Function('self', await (await fetch('/sw-files.js')).text())(self);
    expect(self.THEBES_FILES).toContain(`${TUTORIAL.dir}${TUTORIAL.marks}`);
    expect(json.size).toBe(TUTORIAL.size);
    for (const card of TUTORIAL_CARDS) {
      const r = await fetch(`/assets/tutorial/${card.id}.webp`);
      const blob = await r.blob();
      const image = await createImageBitmap(blob);
      const mark = json.cards[card.id] && json.cards[card.id].mark;
      expect([card.id, r.status, blob.size <= TUTORIAL.maxBytes, image.width, image.height, self.THEBES_FILES.includes(`${TUTORIAL.dir}${card.id}.webp`), mark && mark.kind])
        .toEqual([card.id, 200, true, TUTORIAL.size, TUTORIAL.size, true, card.mark]);
      const inside = (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= TUTORIAL.size && y <= TUTORIAL.size;
      if (mark.kind === 'ring') expect([card.id, inside(mark.x - mark.w / 2, mark.y - mark.h / 2), inside(mark.x + mark.w / 2, mark.y + mark.h / 2)]).toEqual([card.id, true, true]);
      else {
        const a = (mark.angle * Math.PI) / 180;

      }

  it('sets each picture up with its mark on its thing, and nothing in the picture with a problem', async () => {
    for (const card of TUTORIAL_CARDS) {
      const s = await bootShot(TUTORIAL_SHOT.params);

        const shot = await devScene(s.api, 'tutorial', { picture: card.id });

        const view = { width: TUTORIAL_SHOT.width, height: TUTORIAL_SHOT.height };
        const frame = s.root.querySelector('#map').getBoundingClientRect();
        const { clip, mark } = shot;

        const k = clip.size / TUTORIAL.size;
        const toScreen = (px, py) => [clip.x + px * k, clip.y + py * k];
        const [mx, my] = toScreen(mark.x, mark.y);
        const centreOf = (b) => tileToScreen(cam, view, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2);
        const inClip = ([x, y]) => x >= clip.x && x <= clip.x + clip.size && y >= clip.y && y <= clip.y + clip.size;
        const inRing = ([x, y]) => Math.abs(x - mx) <= (mark.w * k) / 2 && Math.abs(y - my) <= (mark.h * k) / 2;
        const box = (node) => { const r = node.getBoundingClientRect(); return { left: r.left - frame.left, right: r.right - frame.left, top: r.top - frame.top, bottom: r.bottom - frame.top }; };
        const inBox = (b, x, y, slack = 0) => x >= b.left - slack && x <= b.right + slack && y >= b.top - slack && y <= b.bottom + slack;
        const all = Object.values(world.buildings), one = (type) => all.find((b) => b.type === type);
        const at = card.id;
        if (at === 'road') {

          for (const type of ['house', 'well', 'farm_grain']) expect([at, type, inClip(centreOf(one(type)))]).toEqual([at, type, true]);
        } else if (at === 'homes') {

          expect([at, all.filter((b) => b.type === 'house' && b.residents > 0 && inClip(centreOf(b))).length >= 3]).toEqual([at, true]);
        } else if (at === 'farm') {
          const farm = one('farm_grain'), layers = box(s.root.querySelector('#corners .overlay-button'));
          const a = (mark.angle * Math.PI) / 180, tail = [mx - Math.cos(a) * TUTORIAL.arrowLength * k, my - Math.sin(a) * TUTORIAL.arrowLength * k];
          const dist = ([x, y]) => Math.hypot(x - (layers.left + layers.right) / 2, y - (layers.top + layers.bottom) / 2);
          expect([at, g.ui.store.get().overlay, inBox(layers, mx, my, 12), dist(tail) > dist([mx, my]), inClip(centreOf(farm))]).toEqual([at, 'ground', true, true, true]);
          let fertile = 0;
          for (let y = farm.y; y < farm.y + farm.d; y++) for (let x = farm.x; x < farm.x + farm.w; x++) if (world.terrain[idx(world.size, x, y)] === TERRAIN.FERTILE) fertile++;
          expect([at, fertile]).toEqual([at, farm.w * farm.d]);
        } else if (at === 'food') {
          const row = [...s.root.querySelectorAll('#sheet .row')].find((n) => inBox(box(n), mx, my));
          const sheetTop = box(s.root.querySelector('#sheet')).top;
          expect([at, Boolean(row) && /worker/i.test(row.textContent), world.buildings[g.ui.store.get().selectedId].type]).toEqual([at, true, 'bazaar']);
          for (const type of ['granary', 'bazaar']) { const [x, y] = centreOf(one(type)); expect([at, type, inClip([x, y]), y < sheetTop]).toEqual([at, type, true, true]); }
        } else if (at === 'goals') {
          const show = [...s.root.querySelectorAll('#goals button')].find((b) => inBox(box(b), mx, my));
          expect([at, Boolean(show) && /show me/i.test(show.textContent)]).toEqual([at, true]);
        } else if (at === 'ahead') {

          expect([at, inRing(centreOf(pyramid)), pyramid.site.course > 0]).toEqual([at, true, true]);
          for (const type of ['tower', 'firehouse']) { const [x, y] = centreOf(one(type)); expect([at, type, inClip([x, y]), y < my]).toEqual([at, type, true, true]); }   // beyond it
        }
        const troubled = alertsFor(world).filter((a) => a.id !== undefined && world.buildings[a.id] && inClip(centreOf(world.buildings[a.id])));
        expect([at, troubled.map((a) => `${a.code} ${world.buildings[a.id].type}`)]).toEqual([at, []]);
      } finally { s.cleanup(); }
    }
  });
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the picture scenes**

Create `src/dev/tutorialScenes.js`:

```js
// The picture cards' pictures (spec 4.1, ruling 264): the `tutorial` development scene (src/dev/scenes.js). Track G owns
// this file.
//
// devScene('tutorial') on the title card (/?nosw=1) shows the picture cards as a player first meets them (the shots tool's
// Stage 4 scene; { card: i } shows card i). devScene('tutorial', { picture: id }), or tutorialPicture(game, id), sets up
// the picture of one card (src/data/tutorial.js) on a fresh city (TUTORIAL_SHOT.params) at a phone's size
// (TUTORIAL_SHOT.width x .height), and resolves with what tools/tutorial.ps1 needs: { id, clip: { x, y, size } (the square to capture, CSS px from the screen's top left), mark (in picture px:
// TUTORIAL.size across the clip, the shape src/data/tutorial.js describes) }. Every mark is read from the scene itself:
// a tile's place on screen through the camera, or a button's or a row's box on the page, so it stays on its thing when the
// art or the interface's look changes and the pictures are made again.
//
// Each picture builds a small riverside village through the sim's commands on seed 7's fresh city and lets it live for
// some days (tickDay), so homes are lived in and have grown: a road off the start road along the fertile land, six homes,
// a well, a farm on the fertile land, a granary and a bazaar. The guide's strip stays only for the goals card; the
// city stays paused.
import { drawRoad, paintHouses, place, setGuide } from '../sim/commands.js';
import { tickDay } from '../sim/clock.js';
import { assignLabour } from '../sim/labour.js';
import { makeBuilding, insertBuilding } from '../sim/world.js';
import { tileToScreen, screenToTile, pxPerArt } from '../render/camera.js';
import { ART, slotFor } from '../render/art/registry.js';
import { select, toggleOverlay } from '../ui/modes.js';
import { TUTORIAL_CARDS, TUTORIAL } from '../data/tutorial.js';

// The phone the pictures are taken on, the square of it each picture is (scaled to TUTORIAL.size), and the city.
export const TUTORIAL_SHOT = { width: 390, height: 844, clip: 390, params: '/?skipTitle=1&nosw=1&seed=7' };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

// The map's size in CSS px and its box on the page (the screen in the game; a test's mounted shell).
function frameOf(g) {
  const c = g.ui.cameraControl.centre();
  const map = document.querySelector('#map');
  const r = map ? map.getBoundingClientRect() : { left: 0, top: 0 };
  return { width: c.x * 2, height: c.y * 2, left: r.left, top: r.top };
}

// Puts tile (x, y) at screen point (sx, sy) at a zoom, by a jump (no camera tween is left running).
function putTileAt(g, x, y, sx, sy, zoom) {
  g.cam.zoom = zoom;
  const v = frameOf(g);
  const c = screenToTile({ x, y, zoom }, v, v.width - sx, v.height - sy);
  g.ui.cameraControl.jumpTo(c.x, c.y);
}

// A point on the screen as a point in the picture.
const toPicture = (clip, sx, sy) => [((sx - clip.x) * TUTORIAL.size) / clip.size, ((sy - clip.y) * TUTORIAL.size) / clip.size];
const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
// A ring round a tile's middle, `across` tiles wide; a ring round a box on the page; an arrow to a box.
function tileRing(g, clip, x, y, across = 1) {
  const v = frameOf(g);
  const [sx, sy] = tileToScreen(g.cam, v, x, y);
  const [px, py] = toPicture(clip, sx, sy);
  const w = (64 * g.cam.zoom * across * TUTORIAL.size) / clip.size;
  return { kind: 'ring', x: r1(px), y: r1(py), w: r1(w), h: r1(w) };
}
// A ring round a building as it is drawn: its art slot's box (the slot's bounds, less their margin) on the screen.
function buildingRing(g, clip, b) {
  const v = frameOf(g), art = ART[slotFor(b, g.world)] || ART[b.type];
  const m = 8, [l, t, r, bt] = art.bounds, s = pxPerArt(g.cam);
  const [ox, oy] = tileToScreen(g.cam, v, b.x, b.y);
  const [x0, y0] = toPicture(clip, ox + (l + m) * s, oy + (t + m) * s), [x1, y1] = toPicture(clip, ox + (r - m) * s, oy + (bt - m) * s);
  return { kind: 'ring', x: r1((x0 + x1) / 2), y: r1((y0 + y1) / 2), w: r1(x1 - x0), h: r1(y1 - y0) };
}
function boxRing(g, clip, node) {
  const v = frameOf(g), b = node.getBoundingClientRect();
  const [x0, y0] = toPicture(clip, b.left - v.left, b.top - v.top), [x1, y1] = toPicture(clip, b.right - v.left, b.bottom - v.top);
  return { kind: 'ring', x: r1((x0 + x1) / 2), y: r1((y0 + y1) / 2), w: r1(x1 - x0), h: r1(y1 - y0), pad: 2 };
}
function boxArrow(g, clip, node, angle) {
  const v = frameOf(g), b = node.getBoundingClientRect();
  const a = (angle * Math.PI) / 180;
  // The tip just outside the box, on the side the arrow comes from.
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2 - v.left, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2 - v.top;
  const reach = Math.min(b.width, b.height) / 2 + 6;
  const [px, py] = toPicture(clip, cx - Math.cos(a) * reach, cy - Math.sin(a) * reach);
  return { kind: 'arrow', x: r1(px), y: r1(py), angle };
}

// The village (seed 7: the start road runs north to (24, 55); the river and its fertile land lie west of x = 17): a road
// west from the start road's end, six homes on its north side, a well and a farm on the fertile land on its south side,
// and a granary and a bazaar on the start road's east side (out of the road card's frame). It lives `days` days. Returns
// its buildings by role.
function village(g, { days = 150 } = {}) {
  const { world } = g;
  const [ex, ey] = world.startRoad[world.startRoad.length - 1];
  const gold = world.gold;
  world.gold = 1e6;
  const must = (r, what) => { if (!r || r.ok === false) throw new Error(`devScene tutorial: no ${what} (${r && r.reason})`); return r; };
  must(drawRoad(world, ex, ey, ex - 12, ey), 'road');
  must(paintHouses(world, ex - 6, ey - 1, ex - 1, ey - 1), 'plots');
  const well = must(place(world, 'well', ex - 3, ey + 1), 'well');
  const farm = must(place(world, 'farm_grain', ex - 11, ey + 1), 'farm');
  const granary = must(place(world, 'granary', ex + 1, ey + 1), 'granary');
  const bazaar = must(place(world, 'bazaar', ex + 1, ey + 4), 'bazaar');
  world.gold = gold;
  setGuide(world, false);
  for (let d = 0; d < days; d++) tickDay(world);
  assignLabour(world);
  const b = (r) => world.buildings[r.id];
  return { well: b(well), farm: b(farm), granary: b(granary), bazaar: b(bazaar), start: { x: ex, y: ey } };
}

// A clip of the screen: TUTORIAL_SHOT.clip square, y from the top.
const clipAt = (y) => ({ x: 0, y, size: TUTORIAL_SHOT.clip });

const PICTURES = {
  // A road with homes, a well and a farm along it: a ring on the road between the farm and the homes.
  async road(g) {
    const v = village(g);
    const clip = clipAt(220);
    putTileAt(g, v.start.x - 7, v.start.y + 0.5, 195, clip.y + 195, 0.9);
    await wait(50);
    return { clip, mark: tileRing(g, clip, v.start.x - 7.5, v.start.y + 0.5, 1.2) };
  },
  // Housing plots on a road and a well beside them: a ring on the well.
  async homes(g) {
    const v = village(g, { days: 60 });
    const clip = clipAt(220);
    putTileAt(g, v.well.x, v.well.y, 195, clip.y + 215, 1.5);
    await wait(50);
    return { clip, mark: buildingRing(g, clip, v.well) };
  },
  // The Ground layer on, the fertile land green by the river, a farm on it: an arrow to the Layers button.
  async farm(g) {
    const v = village(g);
    g.ui.store.set(toggleOverlay(g.ui.store.get(), 'ground'));
    const layers = document.querySelector('#corners .overlay-button');
    const lb = layers.getBoundingClientRect(), fv = frameOf(g);
    const clip = clipAt(Math.round(lb.bottom - fv.top + 12 - TUTORIAL_SHOT.clip));
    putTileAt(g, v.farm.x + 1, v.farm.y + 1, 150, clip.y + 170, 1);
    await wait(50);
    return { clip, mark: boxArrow(g, clip, layers, 60) };
  },
  // A granary and a bazaar by the homes, and a building sheet (the bazaar's): a ring on its workers row.
  async food(g) {
    const v = village(g);
    g.ui.store.set(select(g.ui.store.get(), v.bazaar.id));
    await wait(100);
    const sheet = document.querySelector('#sheet');
    const row = sheet && [...sheet.querySelectorAll('.row')].find((n) => /worker/i.test(n.textContent));
    if (!row) throw new Error('devScene tutorial: no workers row on the bazaar sheet');
    const fv = frameOf(g), top = sheet.getBoundingClientRect().top - fv.top;
    const clip = clipAt(Math.max(0, Math.round(top - 170)));
    putTileAt(g, v.start.x + 0.5, v.start.y + 2, 195, clip.y + 85, 0.8);
    await wait(50);
    return { clip, mark: boxRing(g, clip, row) };
  },
  // The goals strip, the start road below it: a ring on Show me.
  async goals(g) {
    const show = [...document.querySelectorAll('#goals button')].find((b) => b.offsetParent && /show me/i.test(b.textContent));
    if (!show) throw new Error('devScene tutorial: no Show me on the goals strip');
    const [ex, ey] = g.world.startRoad[g.world.startRoad.length - 1];
    const clip = clipAt(0);
    putTileAt(g, ex + 0.5, ey + 2, 230, clip.y + 300, 1);
    await wait(50);
    return { clip, mark: boxRing(g, clip, show) };
  },
  // A pyramid under way, a tower and a firehouse beyond it: a ring on the pyramid. The road north from the village runs
  // past them with homes along it (people to staff them), and the site has had no day yet (no stall to warn of).
  async ahead(g) {
    const { world } = g;
    const [ex, ey] = world.startRoad[world.startRoad.length - 1];
    world.gold = 1e6;
    drawRoad(world, ex, ey, ex, ey - 13);
    paintHouses(world, ex - 1, ey - 12, ex - 1, ey - 1);
    const v = village(g);
    const put = (type, x, y) => insertBuilding(world, makeBuilding(world, type, x, y));
    const pyramid = put('pyramid_small', ex + 1, ey - 9);
    Object.assign(pyramid.site, { course: 3 });
    put('tower', ex + 1, ey - 13);
    put('firehouse', ex - 1, ey - 13);
    world.gold = 2000;
    assignLabour(world);
    const clip = clipAt(220);
    putTileAt(g, pyramid.x + 2, pyramid.y + 2, 205, clip.y + 260, 0.9);
    await wait(50);
    return { clip, mark: buildingRing(g, clip, pyramid) };
  },
};

// One card's picture on the open city g ({ world, ui, cam }: boot's game, or window.__thebes in the page, which is how
// tools/tutorial.ps1 calls it): { id, clip, mark } (see the header).
export async function tutorialPicture(g, id) {
  if (!g || !g.world || !g.ui) throw new Error(`devScene tutorial: no city is open (use ${TUTORIAL_SHOT.params})`);
  const make = PICTURES[id];
  if (!make) throw new Error(`devScene tutorial: no picture named ${id} (${TUTORIAL_CARDS.map((c) => c.id).join(', ')})`);
  const { clip, mark } = await make(g);
  return { id, clip, mark };
}

// The scene (see the header). api is boot's ({ phase, game, hooks }).
export async function tutorialScene(api, options = {}) {
  if (options.picture) return tutorialPicture(api.game(), options.picture);
  if (api.phase() !== 'title') throw new Error('devScene tutorial: open the title card (/?nosw=1)');
  api.hooks.pictureCards();
  await wait(100);
  const at = Number(options.card) || 0;
  const dialog = document.querySelector('.picture-cards');
  if (dialog) for (let i = 0; i < at; i++) dialog.querySelector('.pc-next').click();
  await wait(300);
  return `tutorial card ${at + 1}`;
}
```

Create `tools/tutorial.ps1`:

```powershell
# Makes the picture cards' pictures (spec 4.1, ruling 264): for each card of src/data/tutorial.js it opens the game on
# the picture's city (src/dev/tutorialScenes.js TUTORIAL_SHOT: seed 7's fresh city on a 390x844 phone), runs the
# picture's dev scene (tutorialPicture(window.__thebes, '<id>'), which devScene('tutorial', { picture }) runs too) and
# captures the square the scene names as a 600x600 WebP (the phone's pixel ratio is 600/390, so it is sharp) of at most
# 60 KB (the quality steps down from -Quality until it fits), saved as assets/tutorial/<id>.webp. The marks the scenes
# read off the page (a tile through the camera, a building's drawn box, a button's or a row's box) go to
# assets/tutorial/cards.json. Run it again whenever the art or the interface's look changes (every visual review's
# checklist; Track F runs it last on the final art), then tools/sw-files.ps1. A page that fails to load a module while
# it boots is opened again (three tries).
#
# -Check also shoots the six cards as a player sees them, picture and ring together, on the title card at a phone held
# both ways (devScene('tutorial'), then Next), as <CheckDir>/card-<n>-<id>-<size>.png: look at each one and make sure the
# ring or arrow sits on its thing. -CheckOnly shoots those without making the pictures again.
# Usage: tools/tutorial.ps1 [-Only road,farm] [-Quality 80] [-Check | -CheckOnly] [-CheckDir <dir>]
param([string[]]$Only = @(), [int]$Quality = 80, [switch]$Check, [switch]$CheckOnly,
  [string]$CheckDir = (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'docs\superpowers\notes\screenshots\raw'))
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$outDir = Join-Path $root 'assets\tutorial'
$Only = @($Only | ForEach-Object { $_ -split ',' } | Where-Object { $_ })
$edge = @("${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe", "$env:ProgramFiles\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe") |
  Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $edge) { Write-Output 'Microsoft Edge not found'; exit 2 }
function Get-FreePort {
  $l = [System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener]::new([System.Net.IPAddress]::Loopback, 0); $l.Start(); $p = $l.LocalEndpoint.Port; $l.Stop(); return $p
}
$port = Get-FreePort
$debugPort = Get-FreePort
$server = Start-Process -FilePath python -ArgumentList "`"$(Join-Path $root 'tests\serve.py')`"", "$port", "`"$root`"" -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
$profileDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('thebes-tutorial-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
$browser = $null
$socket = $null
$failed = $false
try {
  $up = $false
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40 -and -not $up; $i++) {
    try { $up = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:$port/index.html" -TimeoutSec 2).StatusCode -eq 200 } catch { $up = $false }
    if (-not $up) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }
  }
  if (-not $up) { Write-Output "Server did not answer on port $port"; exit 1 }
  $browserArgs = @('--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', '--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check', '--hide-scrollbars', '--disable-frame-rate-limit',
    "--user-data-dir=`"$profileDir`"", "--remote-debugging-port=$debugPort", 'about:blank')
  $browser = Start-Process -FilePath $edge -ArgumentList $browserArgs -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
  $wsUrl = $null
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40 -and -not $wsUrl; $i++) {
    try {
      $targets = Invoke-RestMethod "http://127.0.0.1:$debugPort/json" -TimeoutSec 2
      $wsUrl = ($targets | Where-Object type -eq 'page' | Select-Object -First 1).webSocketDebuggerUrl
    } catch { $wsUrl = $null }
    if (-not $wsUrl) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }
  }
  if (-not $wsUrl) { Write-Output 'Edge did not open a DevTools page'; exit 1 }
  $socket = [System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket]::new()
  $socket.ConnectAsync([uri]$wsUrl, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait()
  $script:msgId = 0
  function Invoke-Cdp([string]$Method, $Params) {
    $script:msgId++
    $json = @{ id = $script:msgId; method = $Method; params = $Params } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
    $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($json)
    $socket.SendAsync([ArraySegment[byte]]::new($bytes), [System.Net.WebSockets.WebSocketMessageType]::Text, $true, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait()
    while ($true) {
      $stream = [IO.MemoryStream]::new(); $buffer = New-Object byte[] 65536
      do {
        $cts = [Threading.CancellationTokenSource]::new(60000)
        $r = $socket.ReceiveAsync([ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buffer), $cts.Token).Result
        $stream.Write($buffer, 0, $r.Count)
      } until ($r.EndOfMessage)
      $reply = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($stream.ToArray()) | ConvertFrom-Json
      if ($reply.id -eq $script:msgId) {
        if ($reply.error) { throw "DevTools $Method failed: $($reply.error.message)" }
        return $reply
      }
    }
  }
  # Opens a page at a size and pixel ratio and waits for the game to boot.
  function Open-Page([string]$Url, [int]$W, [int]$H, [double]$Dpr) {
    Invoke-Cdp 'Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride' @{ width = $W; height = $H; deviceScaleFactor = $Dpr; mobile = $false } | Out-Null
    Invoke-Cdp 'Page.navigate' @{ url = "http://127.0.0.1:$port$Url" } | Out-Null
    $loaded = $false
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 120 -and -not $loaded; $i++) {
      $state = Invoke-Cdp 'Runtime.evaluate' @{ expression = 'document.readyState' }
      $loaded = $state.result.result.value -eq 'complete'
      if (-not $loaded) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }
    }
    if (-not $loaded) { throw "TIMEOUT loading $Url" }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900                     # the boot is async: let the game (and window.__thebes) exist first
  }
  function Invoke-Page([string]$Expression) {
    $r = Invoke-Cdp 'Runtime.evaluate' @{ expression = $Expression; awaitPromise = $true; returnByValue = $true }
    if ($r.result.exceptionDetails) { throw "Page threw: $($r.result.exceptionDetails.exception.description)" }
    return $r.result.result.value
  }
  Invoke-Cdp 'Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled' @{ enabled = $true } | Out-Null
  $info = $null
  for ($try = 1; $try -le 3 -and -not $info; $try++) {
    try {
      Open-Page '/?nosw=1' 390 844 1
      $info = Invoke-Page "(async () => { const t = await import('./src/data/tutorial.js'), s = await import('./src/dev/tutorialScenes.js'); return JSON.stringify({ ids: t.TUTORIAL_CARDS.map((c) => c.id), size: t.TUTORIAL.size, maxBytes: t.TUTORIAL.maxBytes, shot: s.TUTORIAL_SHOT }); })()" | ConvertFrom-Json
    } catch { if ($try -eq 3) { throw } }
  }
  $ids = @($info.ids)
  if ($Only.Count) { foreach ($o in $Only) { if ($ids -notcontains $o) { Write-Output "No card named $o ($($ids -join ', '))"; exit 2 } } }

  if (-not $CheckOnly) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $outDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $outDir | Out-Null }
    $marksPath = Join-Path $outDir 'cards.json'
    # Marks of cards not made this run are kept from the last cards.json.
    $marks = [ordered]@{}
    if (Test-Path $marksPath) {
      $old = Get-Content -LiteralPath $marksPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
      foreach ($id in $ids) { if ($old.cards.$id) { $marks[$id] = ($old.cards.$id.mark | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } }
    }
    $dpr = [double]$info.size / [double]$info.shot.clip
    foreach ($id in $ids) {
      if ($Only.Count -and -not ($Only -contains $id)) { continue }
      # A page now and then fails to fetch a module while it boots: open it again (three tries).
      $scene = $null
      for ($try = 1; $try -le 3 -and -not $scene; $try++) {
        try {
          Open-Page $info.shot.params ([int]$info.shot.width) ([int]$info.shot.height) $dpr
          $scene = Invoke-Page "(async () => JSON.stringify(await (await import('./src/dev/tutorialScenes.js')).tutorialPicture(window.__thebes, '$id')))()" | ConvertFrom-Json
        } catch { if ($try -eq 3) { throw } else { Write-Output "Retrying $id ($($_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]))" } }
      }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700                   # a few frames with the scene drawn
      $clip = @{ x = [double]$scene.clip.x; y = [double]$scene.clip.y; width = [double]$scene.clip.size; height = [double]$scene.clip.size; scale = 1 }
      $q = $Quality
      $bytes = $null
      while ($true) {
        $shot = Invoke-Cdp 'Page.captureScreenshot' @{ format = 'webp'; quality = $q; clip = $clip }
        $bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($shot.result.data)
        if ($bytes.Length -le [int]$info.maxBytes -or $q -le 30) { break }
        $q -= 10
      }
      if ($bytes.Length -gt [int]$info.maxBytes) { Write-Output "TOO BIG $id $($bytes.Length) bytes at quality $q"; $failed = $true; continue }
      [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $outDir "$id.webp"), $bytes)
      $marks[$id] = ($scene.mark | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
      Write-Output ("Wrote assets/tutorial/{0}.webp: {1:N0} bytes at quality {2}, mark {3}" -f $id, $bytes.Length, $q, $marks[$id])
    }
    $lines = @($ids | Where-Object { $marks.Contains($_) } | ForEach-Object { "    `"$_`": { `"mark`": $($marks[$_]) }" })
    $text = "{`n  `"size`": $($info.size),`n  `"cards`": {`n" + ($lines -join ",`n") + "`n  }`n}`n"
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($marksPath, $text, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    Write-Output "Wrote assets/tutorial/cards.json: $($lines.Count) marks. Now run tools/sw-files.ps1."
  }

  if ($Check -or $CheckOnly) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $CheckDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $CheckDir | Out-Null }
    foreach ($size in @(@{ name = 'phone-portrait'; w = 390; h = 844 }, @{ name = 'phone-landscape'; w = 844; h = 390 })) {
      for ($n = 0; $n -lt $ids.Count; $n++) {
        if ($Only.Count -and -not ($Only -contains $ids[$n])) { continue }
        $said = $null
        for ($try = 1; $try -le 3 -and -not $said; $try++) {
          try {
            Open-Page '/?nosw=1' $size.w $size.h 1
            $said = Invoke-Page "(async () => { const said = await window.__thebes.devScene('tutorial'); for (let i = 0; i < $n; i++) document.querySelector('.picture-cards .pc-next').click(); return said + ', then card $($n + 1)'; })()"
          } catch { if ($try -eq 3) { throw } }
        }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
        $shot = Invoke-Cdp 'Page.captureScreenshot' @{ format = 'png' }
        $out = Join-Path $CheckDir ("card-{0}-{1}-{2}.png" -f ($n + 1), $ids[$n], $size.name)
        [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($out, [Convert]::FromBase64String($shot.result.data))
        Write-Output "Wrote $out ($said)"
      }
    }
  }
} finally {
  if ($socket) { $socket.Dispose() }
  if ($browser) { Stop-Process -Id $browser.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  Stop-Process -Id $server.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $profileDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
if ($failed) { exit 1 }
```

```powershell
$files = @('index.html', 'manifest.webmanifest', 'css/ui.css') +
  @(Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $root 'src') -Recurse -Filter *.js | ForEach-Object { & $rel $_.FullName }) +
```

# Track H: The interface look

CONTRACT NOTE: The parchment tokens keep their values, so `src/ui/theme.js` (which mirrors the Stage 1-3 tokens and is in no track's list) is untouched. Spec 6.9's "the parchment colours, warmed slightly" is done by the fibre, not by new token values: teal text on parchment is 4.85:1 today, and any darker papyrus under a fibre takes it below 4.5:1 (the dock's chosen category, a sheet's ✓, the confirm bar's "Gives water to 4 homes"). The fibre's two lighter layers warm and lift the surface; its one darker layer is capped at 7% of `#A9844C`, which keeps teal at 4.6:1. The look's new tokens are mirrored in `tests/stage4/look/lookTokens.js` (Track H's), checked against the stylesheet as `theme.test.js` checks the old ones. If the controller would rather have them in `theme.js`'s `TOKENS` and `TEXT_PAIRS`, that is a three-line move with no behaviour change.

CONTRACT NOTE: Gold on lapis goes on every `button.primary`, because the stylesheet cannot know which button is "the one main action". A `button.primary` inside a sheet's list item (`#sheet li button.primary`: each need's Show me on the house sheet, each goal's on the goals sheet, each route's Open route) is lapis words in a lapis outline instead, so a sheet keeps one gold-on-lapis button. Rule for the other tracks (C's site, guild and palace sheets, D's score sections, G's cards): give `primary` to at most one button per sheet or bar outside a list; a row's own action in a `<li>` gets the outline by itself. The corner Play button (`speed-main primary`) and the goal strip's Show me also turn gold on lapis: each is its bar's main action. Pressed and chosen states (`aria-pressed`, the chosen tab, the chosen choice) keep their teal: teal still means "chosen", lapis means "do it".

CONTRACT NOTE: No class hook is needed (contract note 20 holds): the frieze hangs on `#topbar::after` and `#sheet .head::after`, the cartouches on `#sheet .head h2` and `#sheet h3`, the title card's frieze on `.title-card::before`, and its one glyph on `.title-card h1::before` (with the cartouche's tie on `h1::after`). Those pseudo-elements are Track H's: Track D's `titleDecor` and Track G's How to play button must not use `.title-card::before` or the h1's `::before`/`::after`. Sheet heads get no glyph (spec 6.9 allows at most one; with a cartouche and a frieze on every head, none keeps it calm). Every sheet, including Track C's new ones, gets the frieze and the cartouche from `sheets.js`' shared `head()`.

CONTRACT NOTE: The look's tokens are open to every track's section: `--lapis`, `--lapis-ink` (the gold for words on lapis), `--terracotta`, `--turquoise`, `--ink-line` (the outline), `--serif` (the display stack), `--look-fibre` (the papyrus background image) and `--look-frieze` (the 4 px band, a `background` value). Track G's picture-card dialog can wear `background-image: var(--look-fibre)` and a `var(--look-frieze)` edge without a base change.

CONTRACT NOTE: A section title (`#sheet h3`) gains 14 px of margin (10 above, 4 below) for its cartouche, so long sheets scroll a little sooner. Nothing under the top bar moves: the frieze sits over the bar's existing 1 px border and 3 px inside it, the head's the same, and the cartouches' outlines are inset shadows that take no room. `tests/ui/mobileBudget.test.js` passes unchanged and `tools/shots.ps1 -Mobile` measures the same rows to the percent before and after.

CONTRACT NOTE (the controller's binding note): the base's `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { transition: none; animation: none } }` stopped the interface's transitions even when the player chose Full. Task H2 keys that stop off `[data-motion="gentle"]` and `[data-motion="still"]` (written on the root by `settings.js`), keeps the media query only for a page whose settings have not applied yet (`body:not([data-motion])`), and tests that Full keeps transitions on a device that asks for less motion. Track E's section adds any per-level transitions on top; the base's older `body.reduce-motion ...` rules (the caption, the guidance row, the nudge) stay as they are and agree with it.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the helpers and the failing tests**

Create `tests/stage4/look/lookTokens.js`:

```js
// Track H's helpers for the look's tests (spec 6.9): the look's tokens as JavaScript, mirroring css/ui.css as
// src/ui/theme.js mirrors the Stage 1-3 tokens (lookBase.test.js keeps the two equal), and the colour sums the
// contrast checks need. Not a test file: tests/stage4/look.all.js imports only the *.test.js files.
import { TOKENS, cssName } from '../../../src/ui/theme.js';

export const LOOK_TOKENS = { lapis: '#1C3768', lapisInk: '#F5D98A', terracotta: '#B4502E', turquoise: '#3A9E96', inkLine: '#8C7550' };
export const SERIF = '"Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Book Antiqua", Georgia, serif';
export const ALL_TOKENS = { ...TOKENS, ...LOOK_TOKENS };
export { cssName };

const hexOf = (rgb) => '#' + rgb.map((v) => Math.round(v).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').toUpperCase();
export const rgbOf = (hex) => { const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16); return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]; };
// A computed colour ("rgb(28, 55, 104)" or "rgba(...)") as [r, g, b, a].
export const parseColour = (s) => { const m = s.match(/[\d.]+/g).map(Number); return [m[0], m[1], m[2], m.length > 3 ? m[3] : 1]; };
export const cssRgb = (hex) => `rgb(${rgbOf(hex).join(', ')})`;
// `top` laid over `bottom` at `alpha`, as a hex colour.
export const blend = (bottom, top, alpha) => { const b = rgbOf(bottom), t = rgbOf(top); return hexOf(b.map((v, i) => t[i] * alpha + v * (1 - alpha))); };

// The fibre tile's layers, read from the --look-fibre value itself: each <g> with its stroke colour and group opacity. A
// group's strokes are composited first and then faded by the group's opacity, so no point of the tile lies further from
// the parchment than the parchment blended with that stroke at that opacity, however the strokes cross.
export function fibreLayers(value) {
  const at = value.indexOf('data:image/svg+xml,');
  const svg = decodeURIComponent(value.slice(at + 'data:image/svg+xml,'.length).replace(/["')\s]+$/, ''));
  return [...svg.matchAll(/<g\b([^>]*)>/g)].map((m) => {
    const stroke = (m[1].match(/(?:^|\s)stroke='(#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6})'/) || [])[1] || null;
    const opacity = Number((m[1].match(/(?:^|\s)opacity='([\d.]+)'/) || [])[1] || 1);
    return { stroke: stroke && stroke.toUpperCase(), opacity };
  });
}
```

Create `tests/stage4/look/lookBase.test.js`:

```js
// Track H, task H1: the look's tokens and base (spec 6.9, rulings 276-277): papyrus tones with a faint fibre drawn in
// CSS, the serif display stack as a token, gold on lapis for the one main action, an ink outline on every other button.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { contrastIn } from '../../helpers/contrast.js';
import { TOKENS, TEXT_PAIRS, contrastRatio, luminance } from '../../../src/ui/theme.js';
import { CATEGORY_TINT } from '../../../src/data/ui.js';
import { openSheet, startTool, pickCategory } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { LOOK_TOKENS, SERIF, cssName, cssRgb, blend, fibreLayers } from './lookTokens.js';

const rootVar = (name) => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();

describe('s4 look tokens and base', () => {
  it('keeps the look\'s tokens in the stylesheet: gold on lapis at about 8:1, lapis words at 4.5:1, outlines at 3:1', async () => {
    const css = (await (await fetch('/css/ui.css')).text()).toUpperCase();
    const missing = Object.entries(LOOK_TOKENS).filter(([name, hex]) => !css.includes(`${cssName(name).toUpperCase()}: ${hex}`)).map(([n]) => n);
    expect(missing).toEqual([]);
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });   // the stylesheet is on the page from here
    try {
      expect(rootVar('--serif')).toBe(SERIF);
      const ratio = contrastRatio(LOOK_TOKENS.lapisInk, LOOK_TOKENS.lapis);
      expect([ratio >= 7.5, ratio <= 9]).toEqual([true, true]);                                   // "about 8:1"
      expect(contrastRatio(LOOK_TOKENS.lapis, TOKENS.parchment)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);     // a row's action: lapis on papyrus
      // An outline is a boundary, not text: 3:1 against the surfaces buttons sit on (WCAG 1.4.11).
      for (const bg of ['parchment', 'parchment2']) expect([bg, contrastRatio(LOOK_TOKENS.inkLine, TOKENS[bg]) >= 3]).toEqual([bg, true]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('lays the fibre on every surface of the chrome, and its darkest point keeps every text pair at 4.5:1', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      const layers = fibreLayers(rootVar('--look-fibre'));
      expect(layers.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
      const dark = layers.filter((l) => l.stroke && luminance(l.stroke) < luminance(TOKENS.parchment));
      expect(dark.length).toBe(1);                                                   // one darker layer; the rest lighten
      expect(dark[0].opacity <= 0.1).toBe(true);                                     // faint
      for (const bg of ['parchment', 'parchment2']) {
        const worst = blend(TOKENS[bg], dark[0].stroke, dark[0].opacity);
        const failing = TEXT_PAIRS.filter(([, b]) => b === bg).map(([fg]) => [fg, bg, contrastRatio(TOKENS[fg], worst)]).filter(([, , c]) => c < 4.5);
        expect(failing).toEqual([]);
      }
      const fibred = (sel) => [sel, getComputedStyle(r.root.querySelector(sel)).backgroundImage.includes('data:image/svg+xml')];
      expect(['#topbar', '#dock', '#panel', '#rail'].map(fibred)).toEqual(['#topbar', '#dock', '#panel', '#rail'].map((s) => [s, true]));
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'summary'));
      expect([fibred('#sheet'), fibred('#sheet .head')]).toEqual([['#sheet', true], ['#sheet .head', true]]);
      r.store.set(startTool(r.store.get(), { kind: 'building', type: 'well' }));
      expect(fibred('#confirm .confirm')).toEqual(['#confirm .confirm', true]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('gives the main action gold on lapis, a row\'s action lapis in an outline, and every other button an ink outline', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      r.store.set(startTool(r.store.get(), { kind: 'building', type: 'well' }));
      const ok = r.root.querySelector('#confirm .ok');
      const cs = getComputedStyle(ok);
      expect([ok.classList.contains('primary'), cs.backgroundColor, cs.color]).toEqual([true, cssRgb(LOOK_TOKENS.lapis), cssRgb(LOOK_TOKENS.lapisInk)]);
      const cancel = [...r.root.querySelectorAll('#confirm button')].find((b) => !b.classList.contains('primary'));
      expect(getComputedStyle(cancel).borderTopColor).toBe(cssRgb(LOOK_TOKENS.inkLine));
      // A sheet's list: each row's own action (here two goals' Show me) is lapis words in a lapis outline.
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'summary'));
      const list = document.createElement('ul');
      list.innerHTML = '<li><button type="button" class="show-me primary">Show me</button></li><li><button type="button" class="show-me primary">Show me</button></li>';
      r.root.querySelector('#sheet .body').append(list);
      for (const b of list.querySelectorAll('button')) {
        const s = getComputedStyle(b);
        expect([s.backgroundColor, s.color, s.borderTopColor]).toEqual([cssRgb(TOKENS.parchment), cssRgb(LOOK_TOKENS.lapis), cssRgb(LOOK_TOKENS.lapis)]);
        expect(contrastIn(b, b)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
      }
      // ✕ is an ordinary button; a quiet one (the top bar's numbers) stays without an edge; Demolish stays coral.
      expect(getComputedStyle(r.root.querySelector('#sheet .close')).borderTopColor).toBe(cssRgb(LOOK_TOKENS.inkLine));
      expect(getComputedStyle(r.root.querySelector('#topbar .stats')).borderTopColor).toBe('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
      const danger = document.createElement('button');
      danger.className = 'danger';
      danger.textContent = 'Demolish';
      r.root.querySelector('#sheet .body').append(danger);
      expect(getComputedStyle(danger).backgroundColor).toBe(cssRgb(TOKENS.coralText));
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('leaves the category tints and the teal of a chosen tab as they were (they carry meaning)', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      const cats = [...r.root.querySelectorAll('#dock .cat[data-category]')];
      expect(cats.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      for (const c of cats) expect([c.dataset.category, getComputedStyle(c).backgroundImage.includes(cssRgb(CATEGORY_TINT[c.dataset.category]))]).toEqual([c.dataset.category, true]);
      r.resize(1280, 800);
      r.store.set(pickCategory(r.store.get(), 'food'));
      const pressed = r.root.querySelector('#panel .tab[aria-pressed="true"]');
      expect(getComputedStyle(pressed).backgroundColor).toBe(cssRgb(TOKENS.teal));
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

```js
// Track H, task H2: the frieze, the cartouches and the title card's glyph (spec 6.9, rulings 276-277). The frieze lies along
// the top bar's lower edge and each sheet's head, 4 px, inside the heights they had; titles sit in cartouches in the serif
// display face; one glyph, on the title card, hidden from screen readers; nothing in the look moves.
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { openSheet } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { createTitleCard } from '../../../src/ui/titleCard.js';
import { LOOK_TOKENS, SERIF, cssRgb } from './lookTokens.js';
import { TOKENS } from '../../../src/ui/theme.js';

const SIZES = [[390, 844], [844, 390], [1280, 800]];
const TEXT_SIZES = [100, 150];
const pseudo = (el, which) => getComputedStyle(el, which);
// The look switched off for a moment: what each box measures without the frieze and the cartouche.
const PLAIN = '#topbar::after, #sheet .head::after { display: none !important; } #sheet .head h2 { padding: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; }';
function heightsWithout(root, sels) {
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = PLAIN;
  document.head.append(style);
  try { return sels.map((s) => root.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect().height); } finally { style.remove(); }
}
const heights = (root, sels) => sels.map((s) => root.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect().height);

describe('s4 look frieze and cartouches', () => {
  it('runs a 4 px frieze of lapis, gold, terracotta and turquoise along the top bar and each sheet\'s head, inside their heights', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      for (const [w, h] of SIZES) {
        r.resize(w, h);
        for (const ts of TEXT_SIZES) {
          r.ui.settings.set({ textSize: ts });
          r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'summary'));
          const at = `${w}x${h} ${ts}%`;
          for (const sel of ['#topbar', '#sheet .head']) {
            const box = r.root.querySelector(sel), f = pseudo(box, '::after');
            expect([at, sel, f.content, f.height, f.bottom, getComputedStyle(box).borderBottomWidth, f.zIndex]).toEqual([at, sel, '""', '4px', '-1px', '1px', '-1']);
            const colours = [LOOK_TOKENS.lapis, TOKENS.gold, LOOK_TOKENS.terracotta, LOOK_TOKENS.turquoise, TOKENS.ink].map((c) => f.backgroundImage.includes(cssRgb(c)));
            expect([at, sel, colours]).toEqual([at, sel, [true, true, true, true, true]]);
          }
          const sels = ['#topbar', '#sheet .head', '#under-bar'];
          expect([at, heights(r.root, sels)]).toEqual([at, heightsWithout(r.root, sels)]);
          const top = r.root.querySelector('#under-bar').getBoundingClientRect().top;
          r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'menu'));
          expect([at, r.root.querySelector('#under-bar').getBoundingClientRect().top]).toEqual([at, top]);
        }
      }
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('puts sheet and section titles in cartouches in the serif face, and keeps body text in the system sans', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'summary'));
      const h2 = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .head h2'), h3 = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .body h3');
      for (const [el, edge] of [[h2, TOKENS.inkSoft], [h3, LOOK_TOKENS.inkLine]]) {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(el), tie = pseudo(el, '::after');
        expect([el.tagName, cs.fontFamily, cs.boxShadow.startsWith(cssRgb(edge)) && cs.boxShadow.includes('inset'), parseFloat(cs.borderTopLeftRadius) >= el.getBoundingClientRect().height / 2]).toEqual([el.tagName, SERIF, true, true]);
        expect([el.tagName, tie.content, tie.position, parseFloat(tie.width) >= 2]).toEqual([el.tagName, '""', 'absolute', true]);
      }
      // The cartouche hugs its words: the head's ✕ keeps its place at the far end, the section title is no wider than it needs.
      const head = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .head').getBoundingClientRect(), close = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .head .close').getBoundingClientRect();
      expect([Math.round(head.right - close.right) <= 8, h2.getBoundingClientRect().right < close.left]).toEqual([true, true]);
      expect(h3.getBoundingClientRect().width < r.root.querySelector('#sheet .body').getBoundingClientRect().width - 32).toBe(true);
      const body = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .body .row');
      expect(getComputedStyle(body).fontFamily).toBe(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--font').trim());
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('gives the title card its frieze, the city\'s name in a cartouche and one ankh hidden from screen readers', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      const container = r.root.querySelector('#title');
      const card = createTitleCard({ container, hasSave: false, onContinue: () => {}, onNewCity: () => {}, onSound: () => {} });
      const h1 = card.element.querySelector('h1');
      expect([h1.textContent, getComputedStyle(h1).fontFamily, pseudo(card.element, '::before').height]).toEqual(['Thebes', SERIF, '4px']);
      const glyph = pseudo(h1, '::before');
      expect([glyph.content, glyph.backgroundImage.startsWith('url("data:image/svg+xml'), parseFloat(glyph.width) > 0]).toEqual(['""', true, true]);
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#title').textContent.includes('☥')).toBe(false);              // the glyph is a picture, never a word
      const images = [...card.element.querySelectorAll('*'), card.element].flatMap((el) => ['::before', '::after'].map((p) => pseudo(el, p).backgroundImage)).filter((b) => b.includes('url('));
      expect(images.length).toBe(1);
      // The name still fits a 375 px phone at 150% text, inside the card.
      r.resize(375, 667);
      r.ui.settings.set({ textSize: 150 });
      const box = card.element.getBoundingClientRect(), name = h1.getBoundingClientRect();
      expect([name.left >= box.left, name.right + 4 <= box.right]).toEqual([true, true]);
      card.element.remove();
      container.hidden = true;
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('keeps sheet heads to one glyph at most, and nothing in the look moves', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ width: 390, height: 844 });
    try {
      for (const kind of ['summary', 'menu', 'settings', 'help', 'minimap', 'goals']) {
        r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), kind));
        const head = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .head');
        const images = [head, ...head.querySelectorAll('*')].flatMap((el) => ['::before', '::after'].map((p) => pseudo(el, p).backgroundImage)).filter((b) => b.includes('url('));
        expect([kind, images.length <= 1]).toEqual([kind, true]);
      }
      const still = (el, p = null) => { const cs = getComputedStyle(el, p); return [cs.animationName, cs.transitionDuration]; };
      const h2 = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .head h2'), h3 = r.root.querySelector('#sheet .body h3') || h2;
      const parts = [[r.root.querySelector('#topbar'), '::after'], [r.root.querySelector('#sheet .head'), '::after'], [h2, null], [h2, '::after'], [h3, null], [h3, '::after']];
      for (const [el, p] of parts) expect(still(el, p)).toEqual(['none', '0s']);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```
